CMO:0000961.name: percentage of entries into a discrete space in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0000961.def: The proportion of the total number of entries into any area of an experimental apparatus in which an organism or experimental subject enters a distinct and specified area of the apparatus, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0000962.name: blood vessel lesion measurement
CMO:0000962.def: Measurement of a localized pathological change in structure of a blood vessel due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0000963.name: calculated blood vessel diameter measurement
CMO:0000963.def: A measurement of blood vessel diameter which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0000965.name: calculated blood vessel wall thickness measurement
CMO:0000965.def: A measurement of the depth of the wall of a blood vessel which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0000966.name: artery wall thickness
CMO:0000966.def: A measurement of the depth of the wall of an artery, one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues.

CMO:0000967.name: calculated artery wall thickness measurement
CMO:0000967.def: A measurement of the depth of the wall of an artery which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation. An artery is one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues.

CMO:0000969.name: blood vessel inner diameter
CMO:0000969.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a blood vessel, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall.

CMO:0000970.name: blood vessel outer diameter
CMO:0000970.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a blood vessel, passing through its center and ending on either side at the outer surface of the blood vessel wall.

CMO:0000971.name: artery inner diameter
CMO:0000971.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of an artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall.

CMO:0000972.name: artery outer diameter
CMO:0000972.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of an artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the outer surface of the blood vessel wall.

CMO:0000973.name: calculated artery diameter measurement
CMO:0000973.def: Measurement of the length of a line which crosses a transverse view of an artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at either the inner surface or outer surface of the blood vessel wall, which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0000974.name: artery measurement
CMO:0000974.def: Any measurement of one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues.

CMO:0000975.name: artery lesion measurement
CMO:0000975.def: Measurement of any localized pathological change in structure of an artery, one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues, due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0000976.name: calculated artery lesion measurement
CMO:0000976.def: Measurement which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation of any localized pathological change in structure of an artery due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0000977.name: calculated blood vessel lesion measurement
CMO:0000977.def: Measurement which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation of any localized pathological change in structure of a blood vessel due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0000978.name: blood vessel wall thickness to blood vessel inner diameter ratio
CMO:0000978.def: A calculated measurement in which the ratio of the wall thickness (WT) of a blood vessel is divided by the inner diameter (ID) of that vessel at that location, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, for example, WT/ID x 100.  This measurement is often used to assess stenosis, a pathological narrowing of a blood vessel.
synonyms: blood vessel wall thickness as percentage of blood vessel inner diameter
blood vessel wall thickness as percentage of blood vessel lumen diameter

CMO:0000979.name: artery wall thickness to artery inner diameter ratio
CMO:0000979.def: Ratio of the wall thickness (WT) of an artery to inner diameter (ID) of that artery at that location, usually expressed as a percentage, i.e. WT/ID x 100, but could also be expressed as a ratio, fraction or quotient.  This measurement can be used to assess stenosis, a pathological narrowing of a blood vessel.
synonyms: artery wall thickness as percentage of artery inner diameter
artery wall thickness as percentage of artery lumen diameter

CMO:0000980.name: calculated artery inner diameter measurement
CMO:0000980.def: A measurement of the length of a line which crosses a transverse view of an artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall, after that measurement has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation. An artery is a blood vessel that carries blood away from the heart.

CMO:0000981.name: ventricle contraction measurement
CMO:0000981.def: Any measurement of components of the periodic tightening and loosening of the muscles of a ventricle of the heart.

CMO:0000982.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic diameter
CMO:0000982.def: The diameter across the left ventricle of the heart at the end of diastole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally relaxed, and usually corresponds to its largest diameter.

CMO:0000983.name: heart left ventricle end-systolic diameter
CMO:0000983.def: The diameter across the left ventricle of the heart at the end of systole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally contracted, and usually corresponds to its smallest diameter.

CMO:0000984.name: calculated heart left ventricle morphological measurement
CMO:0000984.def: A measurement of the physical form or structure of the left ventricle of the heart which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation. The heart left ventricle is the lower chamber of the left side of the heart, which pumps oxygenated blood out through the aorta to all the tissues of the body.

CMO:0000985.name: heart left ventricle fractional shortening
CMO:0000985.def: A calculated measurement corresponding to the ratio or percent reduction in left ventricular diameter between end-diastole and end-systole. Can be calculated as the left ventricle end-diastolic diameter (LVDd) minus the left ventricle end-systolic diameter (LVSd) divided by the left ventricle end-diastolic diameter (LVDd) with the quotient multiplied by 100, i.e. FS = [(LVDd-LVSd)/LVDd] x 100.

CMO:0000986.name: heart left ventricle anterior wall thickness
CMO:0000986.def: The thickness or depth of the ventral/anterior wall of the left ventricle of the heart. The ventral/anterior wall is the portion of the muscle enclosing the ventricle which is farthest from the spine and closest to the chest wall of the organism.
synonyms: heart left ventricle ventral wall thickness

CMO:0000987.name: heart ventricle septal wall thickness
CMO:0000987.def: The thickness or depth of the septal wall of the heart ventricles. The septal wall is the portion of the heart left ventricle ventral/anterior wall and right ventricle dorsal/posterior wall which is shared between the ventricles.

CMO:0000988.name: heart left ventricle relative wall thickness
CMO:0000988.def: A calculated measurement of left ventricular geometry. It is calculated by dividing the end-diastolic diameter into 2x the posterior wall thickness or into the sum of the posterior and septal wall thicknesses. It represents a measure of the wall thickness normalized to the size of the ventricle lumen.
synonyms: heart left ventricle end-diastolic relative wall thickness

CMO:0000989.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic relative wall thickness
CMO:0000989.def: A calculated measurement of left ventricular geometry and is calculated by dividing the end-diastolic diameter into 2x the posterior wall thickness at end-diastole, 2x the septal wall thickness at end-diastole or the sum of the posterior and septal wall thicknesses at end-diastole. It represents a measure of the wall thickness normalized to the size of the ventricle lumen.

CMO:0000990.name: heart anterior wall thickness
CMO:0000990.def: The thickness or depth of the ventral/anterior wall of the heart. The ventral wall is the portion of the heart muscle which is farthest from the spine and closest to the chest wall of the organism.

CMO:0000994.name: velocity of circumferential fiber shortening
CMO:0000994.def: The extent of shortening of the minor internal circumference (at the midpoint of the long axis) between end-diastole and end-systole, divided by the time required for shortening.

CMO:0000995.name: alimentary/gastrointestinal measurement
CMO:0000995.def: Any measurement to assess the morphological or physiological state of the alimentary/gastrointestinal tract, that is, the system of organs within multicellular animals that takes in food, digests it to extract energy and nutrients, and expels the remaining waste. The major functions of the alimentary/GI/digestive tract are ingestion, digestion, absorption, and defecation.

CMO:0000996.name: heart right ventricle anterior wall thickness
CMO:0000996.def: The thickness or depth of the ventral/anterior wall of the right ventricle of the heart. The ventral wall is the portion of the muscle enclosing the ventricle which is farthest from the spine and closest to the chest wall of the organism.
synonyms: heart right ventricle ventral wall thickness

CMO:0000997.name: defecation measurement
CMO:0000997.def: Any measurement related to the elimination of wastes and undigested food, as feces, from the rectum.

CMO:0000998.name: defecation rate
CMO:0000998.def: This is a measurement of the number of instances of defecation, or amount of defecation as measured by the number of pieces of fecal matter, or the weight of fecal matter within a specified period of time.

CMO:0000999.name: urine albumin level to urine low molecular weight protein ratio
CMO:0000999.def: The ratio of the amount of albumin in the urine, or excreted into the urine in a specified period of time to the amount of low molecular weight proteins in the urine, or excreted into the urine in a specified period of time.

CMO:0001000.name: superficial glomerulus count
CMO:0001000.def: Count of the number of glomeruli located in the superficial layer of the renal cortex, the cortex corticis. Glomeruli are the tufts of capillaries each situated within a Bowman's capsule at the end of a renal tubule in the vertebrate kidney that filter waste products from the blood and thus initiate urine formation.

CMO:0001001.name: count of superficial glomeruli directly contacting the kidney surface
CMO:0001001.def: Count of the number of glomeruli located in the superficial layer of the renal cortex, the cortex corticis, and directly in contact with the surface of the kidney, i.e. the renal capsule. Glomeruli are the tufts of capillaries each situated within a Bowman's capsule at the end of a renal tubule in the vertebrate kidney that filter waste products from the blood and thus initiate urine formation.

CMO:0001002.name: count of superficial glomeruli not directly contacting the kidney surface
CMO:0001002.def: Count of the number of glomeruli located in the superficial layer of the renal cortex, the cortex corticis but without any direct contact with the surface of the kidney, i.e. the renal capsule. Glomeruli are the tufts of capillaries each situated within a Bowman's capsule at the end of a renal tubule in the vertebrate kidney that filter waste products from the blood and thus initiate urine formation.

CMO:0001003.name: blood hormone level
CMO:0001003.def: Measurement of the amount in blood of any complex chemical substance produced in one part or organ of the body that initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0001004.name: blood steroid hormone level
CMO:0001004.def: Measurement of the amount in blood of an organic compound the basis of which is a characteristic arrangement of four fused cycloalkane rings, i.e. three cyclohexane rings and one cyclopentane ring, that is produced in one part or organ of the body and initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0001005.name: blood monoamine hormone level
CMO:0001005.def: Measurement of the amount in blood of an amine compound containing one amino group and derived from an aromatic amino acid, that is produced in one part or organ of the body and initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0001006.name: blood epinephrine level
CMO:0001006.def: Measurement of the amount of epinephrine, a catecholamine which can act as a neurotransmitter, a stress hormone, a stimulator of the sympathetic nervous system and a vasoconstrictor, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001007.name: serum epinephrine level
CMO:0001007.def: The amount of epinephrine, a catecholamine which can act as a neurotransmitter, a stress hormone, a stimulator of the sympathetic nervous system and a vasoconstrictor, found in a specific volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001008.name: plasma epinephrine level
CMO:0001008.def: The amount of epinephrine, a catecholamine which can act as a neurotransmitter, a stress hormone, a stimulator of the sympathetic nervous system and a vasoconstrictor, found in a specific volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001009.name: blood norepinephrine level
CMO:0001009.def: Measurement of the amount of norepinephrine, a catecholamine which can act as a neurotransmitter, a stress hormone and a vasoconstrictor, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001010.name: plasma norepinephrine level
CMO:0001010.def: The amount of norepinephrine, a catecholamine which can act as a neurotransmitter, a stress hormone and a vasoconstrictor, found in a specific volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001011.name: serum norepinephrine level
CMO:0001011.def: The amount of norepinephrine, a catecholamine which can act as a neurotransmitter, a stress hormone and a vasoconstrictor, found in a specific volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001013.name: brain infarction volume
CMO:0001013.def: Measurement of the size of the three dimensional space occupied by an area of necrotic tissue in the brain resulting from a reduction or obstruction of the oxygen supply to the brain.

CMO:0001014.name: brain infarction size
CMO:0001014.def: Measurement of the size of an area of necrotic tissue in the brain resulting from a reduction or obstruction of the oxygen supply to the brain.

CMO:0001016.name: change in diastolic blood pressure
CMO:0001016.def: Measurement of any change or difference in the diastolic blood pressure between two points or two conditions. The diastolic pressure is the minimum arterial pressure within the cardiac cycle, usually at the point at which the heart is in a state of relaxation and expansion. This is the time when the ventricles fill with blood.

CMO:0001017.name: percent change in diastolic blood pressure
CMO:0001017.def: The relative difference in the diastolic blood pressure between two points or two conditions, expressed as a percentage. The diastolic pressure is the minimum arterial pressure within the cardiac cycle, usually at the point at which the heart is in a state of relaxation and expansion. This is the time when the ventricles fill with blood.

CMO:0001018.name: change in cell membrane potential
CMO:0001018.def: Measurement of any change in the difference in electrical polarization or charge between two sides of a cell membrane or cell wall over time or after a change in conditions.

CMO:0001019.name: absolute change in left ventricular systolic blood pressure
CMO:0001019.def: Calculated measurement of a difference in the pressure within the heart left ventricle at the point of maximal contraction, when the blood is forced from the left ventricle into the aorta, between two points in time or two conditions expressed as the result of the subtraction in and of itself without comparison by ratio with another quantity.

CMO:0001020.name: mortality/survival measurement
CMO:0001020.def: Any measurement having to do with quantitative measures of mortality, death, fatality or survival of an individual or study population.

CMO:0001021.name: survival measurement
CMO:0001021.def: This is any quantitative measurement of survival of an individual or a study population.

CMO:0001022.name: mortality measurement
CMO:0001022.def: Any quantitative measurement of death, mortality or fatality in an individual or study population. Death is defined as the cessation of all vital functions of the body including the heartbeat, brain activity (including the brain stem), and breathing.

CMO:0001023.name: ratio of deaths to total study population during a period of time
CMO:0001023.def: A measure of the total number of deaths occurring during a specified period of time within a study population divided by the total number of individuals in the study population and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: death incidence measurement as a ratio
percentage of deaths in a study population during a period of time

CMO:0001024.name: percentage of deaths in a study population during a period of time
CMO:0001024.def: The total number of deaths occurring during a specified period of time within a study population divided by the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001025.name: pituitary tumor measurement
CMO:0001025.def: Measurement of an abnormal growth of tissue in the pituitary gland resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0001026.name: post-insult time to pituitary tumor formation
CMO:0001026.def: The amount of time to the first discernible appearance of tumor in the pituitary gland following the administration of a tumor causing agent.

CMO:0001027.name: pituitary tumor growth rate
CMO:0001027.def: The change is size between two points in time for a tumor found within the pituitary gland.

CMO:0001028.name: pituitary tumor incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001028.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population displaying one or more tumors of the pituitary gland at a point in time or developing such growths within a determined period of time, are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. A tumor is an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0001029.name: percentage of study population developing pituitary tumors during a period of time
CMO:0001029.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop new instances of pituitary gland tumors during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. A tumor is an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0001030.name: percentage of study population displaying pituitary tumors at a point in time
CMO:0001030.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display tumors of the pituitary gland compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. A tumor is an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0001031.name: pituitary tumor number
CMO:0001031.def: The number of tumors found within the pituitary gland.

CMO:0001032.name: pituitary tumor weight
CMO:0001032.def: The weight of a tumor found within a pituitary gland.

CMO:0001033.name: pituitary tumor diameter
CMO:0001033.def: The length of a transverse line moving from side to side through the center of a tumor located in the pituitary gland.

CMO:0001034.name: pituitary gland tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001034.def: Measurement of a pituitary gland lesion which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. The pituitary gland is the gland located at the base of the brain in vertebrates that produces a number of hormones, including those that regulate growth and reproductive functions. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001035.name: head temperature
CMO:0001035.def: Temperature measured at the surface of or within the head of an experimental subject. Because the temperature of the head/brain can influence neurological measurements, head temperature is or can be considered to be distinct from core body temperature.

CMO:0001036.name: core body temperature
CMO:0001036.def: The temperature of the internal tissues and organs of the body.

CMO:0001037.name: time to first movement outside a discrete space in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0001037.def: The latency period spent by an organism or experimental subject in the initial occupied space before moving to a different space in an experimental apparatus.
synonyms: initial amount of time spent in a discrete space in an experimental apparatus before moving to a different space
latency period before first movement outside a discrete space in an experimental apparatus

CMO:0001038.name: stretched attend posture measurement
CMO:0001038.def: Any measurement of the movement of an experimental subject or organism during which the hind legs remain stationary while the body is stretched forward with head raised.

CMO:0001039.name: number of stretched attend posture movements
CMO:0001039.def: Measurement of the number of times an experimental subject or organism displays a stretched-attend posture movement during an experimental time period. The stretched-attend posture is one during which the hind legs remain stationary while the body is stretched forward with head raised.

CMO:0001040.name: number of prompted entries into a discrete space in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0001040.def: The total number of times during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject enters into a distinct and specified area of an experimental apparatus in response to a specific external inducement, enticement or encouragement.

CMO:0001041.name: number of unprompted entries into a discrete space in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0001041.def: The total number of times during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject enters into a distinct and specified area of an experimental apparatus without external inducement, enticement or encouragement.

CMO:0001042.name: measurement of voluntary immobility
CMO:0001042.def: Any measurement of a movement or quantifiable behavior which does not involve the movement of the organism from one place to another but which originated with or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of that organism's free will or choice.

CMO:0001043.name: amount of time spent in voluntary immobility
CMO:0001043.def: Measurement of the total amount of experiment time that an organism or experimental subject spends frozen, that is, not moving from one place or position to another, when such behavior originated with or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of that organism's free will or choice.
synonyms: amount of time spent in freeze behavior
amount of time spent in freezing behavior

CMO:0001044.name: percent of time spent in voluntary immobility
CMO:0001044.def: Calculated measurement of the relative amount of experiment time that an organism or experimental subject spends frozen, that is, not moving from one place or position to another, when such behavior originated with or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of that organism's free will or choice, expressed as a percentage.
synonyms: percent of time spent in freeze behavior
percent of time spent in freezing behavior

CMO:0001045.name: number of periods of voluntary immobility
CMO:0001045.def: A count of the number of discrete intervals during which an organism or experimental subject is frozen, that is, not moving from one place or position to another, when such behavior originated with or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of that organism's free will or choice.
synonyms: number of periods of freeze behavior
number of periods of freezing behavior

CMO:0001046.name: experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001046.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) at a point in time or develop EAE within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. EAE is an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells.

CMO:0001047.name: percentage of study population developing experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis during a period of time
CMO:0001047.def: The number of new cases of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. EAE is an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells.
synonyms: percentage of study population developing experimental allergic encephalomyelitis during a period of time

CMO:0001048.name: percentage of study population displaying experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis at a point in time
CMO:0001048.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE) at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. EAE is an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells.
synonyms: percentage of study population displaying experimental allergic encephalomyelitis at a point in time

CMO:0001049.name: pancreas measurement
CMO:0001049.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological, involving the pancreas or any part thereof. The pancreas is the elongated, racemose gland containing both endocrine and exocrine elements which secretes hormones such as insulin and glucagon internally and digestive enzymes externally.

CMO:0001050.name: pancreatic islet measurement
CMO:0001050.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological, involving one or more pancreatic islets, i.e. islets of Langerhans, the endocrine, hormone-producing portion of the pancreas.

CMO:0001051.name: exocrine pancreas measurement
CMO:0001051.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological, involving the exocrine gland portion of the pancreas, that is, the elongated, racemose gland which secretes digestive enzymes into the intestine.

CMO:0001052.name: pancreatic islet morphological measurement
CMO:0001052.def: Measurement of the physical form or structure of one or more pancreatic islets, i.e. islets of Langerhans, the endocrine, hormone-producing portion of the pancreas.

CMO:0001053.name: endocrine gland measurement
CMO:0001053.def: Any measurement of an endocrine gland, that is, a ductless gland that produces and secretes hormones directly into the blood or lymph.

CMO:0001054.name: pancreatic islet area
CMO:0001054.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through a single pancreatic islet, or a measurement of the total area occupied by pancreatic islets in a cross-section of the pancreas.  The pancreatic islets are the irregular microscopic structures scattered throughout the pancreas and comprising its endocrine portion.

CMO:0001055.name: single pancreatic islet area
CMO:0001055.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through a single pancreatic islet, one of the irregular microscopic structures scattered throughout the pancreas and comprising its endocrine portion.

CMO:0001056.name: total area occupied by pancreatic islets
CMO:0001056.def: A measurement of the total area occupied by pancreatic islets in a cross-section of the pancreas. The pancreatic islets are the irregular microscopic structures scattered throughout the pancreas and comprising its endocrine portion.
synonyms: total area occupied by islets of Langerhans

CMO:0001057.name: calculated pancreatic islet area
CMO:0001057.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through a single pancreatic islet, or a measurement of the total area occupied by pancreatic islets in a cross-section of the pancreas which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001058.name: pancreatic islet area to total pancreatic area ratio
CMO:0001058.def: A calculated value in which the area of a cross-section of the pancreas which is occupied by pancreatic islets is divided by the total area of the pancreas cross-section, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage thus normalizing it to the size of the pancreas.
synonyms: pancreatic islet area as percentage of total pancreatic area
pancreatic islet area to total pancreas area ratio
ratio of the area occupied by islets of Langerhans to total pancreatic area
ratio of the area occupied by pancreatic islets to total pancreatic area

CMO:0001059.name: pancreatic islet area to total pancreatic area ratio
CMO:0001059.def: A calculated value in which the area of a cross-section of the pancreas which is occupied by pancreatic islets is divided by the total area of the pancreas cross-section and presented as a ratio thus normalizing it to the size of the pancreas.

CMO:0001060.name: pancreatic islet beta cell area
CMO:0001060.def: The area of, that is, the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through, the beta cells in a pancreatic islet. A beta cell is a type of basophilic cell that makes up most of the bulk of the pancreatic islets (i.e. the islets of Langerhans) and secretes insulin.
synonyms: islet of Langerhans beta cell area

CMO:0001061.name: calculated pancreatic islet beta cell area
CMO:0001061.def: Any measurement of beta cell area which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation. A beta cell is a type of basophilic cell that makes up most of the bulk of the pancreatic islets (i.e. the islets of Langerhans) and secretes insulin.

CMO:0001062.name: beta cell area to total pancreatic islet area ratio
CMO:0001062.def: A calculated value in which the area occupied by beta cells is divided by the total area of the pancreatic islet and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the size of the pancreatic islet(s). A beta cell is a type of basophilic cell that makes up most of the bulk of the pancreatic islets (i.e. the islets of Langerhans) and secretes insulin.
synonyms: beta cell area as percentage of total islet of Langerhans area
ratio of area occupied by beta cells to total pancreatic islet area
ratio of beta cell area to total islet of Langerhans area

CMO:0001063.name: beta cell area to total pancreatic islet area ratio
CMO:0001063.def: A calculated value in which the area occupied by beta cells is divided by the total area of the pancreatic islet and presented as a ratio thus normalizing it to the size of the pancreatic islet(s). A beta cell is a type of basophilic cell that makes up most of the bulk of the pancreatic islets (i.e. the islets of Langerhans) and secretes insulin.

CMO:0001064.name: liver measurement
CMO:0001064.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological, involving the liver or any part thereof. The liver is the large, dark-red organ located in the cranial portion of the abdomen of vertebrates, just behind or below the diaphragm, the functions of which include storage and filtration of blood; secretion of bile; detoxification of noxious substances; conversion of sugars into glycogen; synthesis and breakdown of fats and temporary storage of fatty acids; and synthesis of serum proteins.

CMO:0001065.name: liver lesion measurement
CMO:0001065.def: Measurement of a lesion in the liver, the large, dark-red organ located in the cranial portion of the abdomen of vertebrates, just behind or below the diaphragm, that secretes bile and is active in the formation of certain blood proteins, in the metabolism of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins and in the detoxification of noxious substances. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0001066.name: liver non-tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001066.def: Measurement of a liver lesion which is not neoplastic in origin. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined. Examples of non-tumorous lesions would include wounds, sores, ulcers, infarctions, etc.

CMO:0001067.name: liver tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001067.def: Measurement of a liver lesion which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001068.name: liver tumorous lesion number
CMO:0001068.def: The number of tumorous lesions in or on the surface of the liver, or in a specified section of the liver, the large, highly vascularized organ located in the abdomen of vertebrates that secretes bile and is active in the formation of certain blood proteins, in the metabolism of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins and in the detoxification of noxious substances. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001069.name: liver tumorous lesion size measurement
CMO:0001069.def: Any measurement of the size of an individual tumorous lesion in the liver, or of the amount of the liver occupied by tumorous lesions. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001070.name: liver tumorous lesion area measurement
CMO:0001070.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through an individual tumorous lesion in the liver, or a measurement of the total area occupied by tumorous lesions in a cross-section of the liver. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001071.name: area of individual liver tumorous lesion
CMO:0001071.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of, or of a plane through an individual tumorous lesion in the liver. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001072.name: area of liver occupied by tumorous lesions
CMO:0001072.def: A measurement of the total extent of the two-dimensional surface of the liver occupied by tumorous lesions, or a measurement of the total extent of a two-dimensional cross-section through the liver occupied by tumorous lesions. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001073.name: calculated liver tumorous lesion area measurement
CMO:0001073.def: Measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface or plane through an individual tumorous lesion in the liver, or a measurement of the total area occupied by tumorous lesions in a cross-section of the liver when such a measurement has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001074.name: area of liver occupied by tumorous lesions as percentage of total liver area
CMO:0001074.def: A calculated measurement of the area of the liver occupied by tumorous lesions compared to the total area of the liver, expressed as a percentage. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.
synonyms: percent tumorous foci area in liver

CMO:0001075.name: liver tumorous lesion area to total liver area ratio
CMO:0001075.def: A calculated value in which area of the liver occupied by tumorous lesions is divided by the total area of the liver and presented as a ratio, percentage, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the size of the liver.
synonyms: area of liver occupied by tumorous lesions as percentage of total liver area
hepatic tumorous lesion area to total liver area ratio
percent tumorous foci area in liver

CMO:0001076.name: liver tumorous lesion diameter measurement
CMO:0001076.def: The distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of a tumorous lesion found on or in the liver. A tumorous lesion is one that is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001077.name: liver tumorous lesion volume measurement
CMO:0001077.def: Measurement of the size of the three dimensional space occupied by an individual liver tumorous lesion, or of the total three dimensional space occupied by tumorous lesions in the liver. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001078.name: volume of individual liver tumorous lesion
CMO:0001078.def: Measurement of the size of the three dimensional space occupied by an individual liver tumorous lesion. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.
synonyms: volume of individual hepatic tumorous lesion

CMO:0001079.name: volume of liver occupied by tumorous lesions
CMO:0001079.def: Measurement of the size of the total three dimensional space occupied by tumorous lesions in the liver. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001080.name: calculated liver tumorous lesion volume measurement
CMO:0001080.def: Measurement of the size of the three dimensional space occupied by an individual liver tumorous lesion, or of the total three dimensional space occupied by tumorous lesions in the liver when such a measurement has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.
synonyms: calculated hepatic tumorous lesion volume measurement

CMO:0001081.name: volume of liver occupied by tumorous lesions as percentage of total liver volume
CMO:0001081.def: A calculated value in which the volume of the liver occupied by tumorous lesions is compared to the total volume of the liver and expressed as a percentage thus normalizing it to the size of the liver.

CMO:0001082.name: liver tumorous lesion volume to total liver volume ratio
CMO:0001082.def: A calculated value in which volume of the liver occupied by tumorous lesions is divided by the total volume of the liver and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the size of the liver.
synonyms: hepatic tumorous lesion volume to total liver volume ratio
volume of liver occupied by tumorous lesions as percentage of total liver volume

CMO:0001083.name: mammary gland morphological measurement
CMO:0001083.def: Measurement of the physical form or structure of the mammary gland, the specialized exocrine gland of the skin of female mammals, which secretes milk for nourishment of the young.

CMO:0001084.name: mammary gland terminal end bud count
CMO:0001084.def: Measurement of the number of mammary gland terminal end buds in a specified sample. Terminal end buds are the highly proliferative structures found at the tips of mammary ducts as they elongate into the mammary fat pad during mammary gland development.

CMO:0001085.name: blood natural killer cell count
CMO:0001085.def: The number of natural killer (NK) cells in a specified volume of blood. NK cells are cells capable of mediating cytotoxic reactions without themselves being specifically sensitized against the target and are critical to the innate immune system.

CMO:0001086.name: blood natural killer T cell count
CMO:0001086.def: The number of natural killer T (NKT) cells in a specified volume of blood. NKT cells are a specialized population of T cells that express both a semi-invariant T cell receptor (TCR alpha beta) and surface antigens typically associated with natural killer cells.

CMO:0001087.name: blood CD4+ T helper cell count
CMO:0001087.def: The number of CD4-positive T helper lymphocytes in a specified volume of blood. Th cells are differentiated T lymphocytes which express the CD4 (also known as the T4 antigen) on their surface and cooperate with other lymphocytes, e.g. with B lymphocytes in the synthesis of antibody to many antigens; they play an integral role in immunoregulation.

CMO:0001088.name: liver fibrotic lesion measurement
CMO:0001088.def: Measurement of a liver lesion resulting from a process of fibrosis, the proliferation of fibroblasts and fibrous tissue, usually in response to an injury, inflammation or infection. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0001089.name: liver fibrotic lesion size measurement
CMO:0001089.def: Any measurement of the size of an individual fibrotic lesion in the liver, or of the amount of the liver occupied by fibrotic lesions. A fibrotic lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease, especially one that is circumscribed and well defined, resulting from a process of fibrosis, the proliferation of fibroblasts and fibrous tissue, usually in response to an injury, inflammation or infection.

CMO:0001090.name: liver fibrotic lesion area measurement
CMO:0001090.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through an individual fibrotic lesion in the liver, or a measurement of the total area occupied by fibrotic lesions in a cross-section of the liver. A fibrotic lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease, especially one that is circumscribed and well defined, resulting from a process of fibrosis, the proliferation of fibroblasts and fibrous tissue, usually in response to an injury, inflammation or infection.

CMO:0001091.name: area of individual liver fibrotic lesion
CMO:0001091.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through an individual fibrotic lesion in the liver. A fibrotic lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease, especially one that is circumscribed and well defined, resulting from a process of fibrosis, the proliferation of fibroblasts and fibrous tissue, usually in response to an injury, inflammation or infection.

CMO:0001092.name: area of liver occupied by fibrotic lesions
CMO:0001092.def: A measurement of the total extent of the two-dimensional surface of the liver occupied by fibrotic lesions, or a measurement of the total extent of a two-dimensional cross-section through the liver occupied by fibrotic lesions. A fibrotic lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease, especially one that is circumscribed and well defined, resulting from a process of fibrosis, the proliferation of fibroblasts and fibrous tissue, usually in response to an injury, inflammation or infection.
synonyms: area of liver occupied by fibrosis

CMO:0001093.name: calculated liver fibrotic lesion area measurement
CMO:0001093.def: Any measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through an individual fibrotic lesion in the liver, or a measurement of the total area occupied by fibrotic lesions in a cross-section of the liver when such a measurement has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001094.name: area of liver occupied by fibrotic lesions to total liver area ratio
CMO:0001094.def: A calculated measurement in which the area of the liver occupied by fibrotic lesions is divided by the total area of the liver, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. A fibrotic lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease, especially one that is circumscribed and well defined, resulting from a process of fibrosis, the proliferation of fibroblasts and fibrous tissue, usually in response to an injury, inflammation or infection.
synonyms: area of liver occupied by fibrosis as percentage of total liver area
area of liver occupied by fibrotic lesions as percentage of total liver area
liver fibrosis area to total liver area ratio
liver fibrotic lesion area to total liver area ratio

CMO:0001095.name: liver fibrotic lesion area to total liver area ratio
CMO:0001095.def: A calculated value in which area of the liver occupied by fibrotic lesions is divided by the total area of the liver and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the size of the liver.

CMO:0001098.name: TUNEL-positive cell number to total cell number ratio
CMO:0001098.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of cells in a specified sample that stain positively in the terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick end labeling (TUNEL) assay (i.e. in which the DNA is fragmented and therefore is labeled by the terminal transferase, a marker of apoptosis) is divided by the total number of cells in the sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: number of apoptotic cells as percentage of total number of cells
number of TUNEL-positivecells as percentage of total number of cells

CMO:0001099.name: urine protein excretion rate to body weight ratio
CMO:0001099.def: A calculated value in which the amount of protein excreted in the urine is divided by the total weight of the body and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight.
synonyms: urine total protein excretion rate to body weight ratio

CMO:0001105.name: blood CD4Th1 cell to CD4 Th2 cell ratio
CMO:0001105.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of CD4-positive T lymphocytes of the T helper 1 type in a specified sample of blood is divided by the number of CD4-positive T lymphocytes of the T helper 2 type in the same sample and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: blood Th1 cell to Th2 cell ratio as percentage
TH1 cell to TH2 cell ratio
TH1 cell to TH2 cell ratio as percentage
type 1 helper T cell to type 2 helper T cell ratio
type 1 helper T cell to type 2 helper T cell ratio as percentage

CMO:0001106.name: blood Th1 cell to Th2 cell ratio as percentage

CMO:0001107.name: disease process measurement
CMO:0001107.def: Any measurement that deals with the process or development of a disease state, for example, the onset, progression or severity of the disease or its symptoms.

CMO:0001108.name: disease onset/diagnosis measurement
CMO:0001108.def: Any measurement which expresses a quantity related to the beginning, early stages or development of a disease, or to the official determination of a disease as the cause of the observed symptom(s).

CMO:0001109.name: disease severity measurement
CMO:0001109.def: Any measurement of the degree to which the presentation of a disease state has caused pain or damage, established one or more lesions or infectious colonies, and/or taken over or interfered with the normal functioning of the body as a whole, or of one or more organs, tissues, cells or subcellular mechanisms of an organism.

CMO:0001110.name: disease progression measurement
CMO:0001110.def: Any measurement related to the course of a disease, for example, a series of stages or a succession of states in the disease process.

CMO:0001111.name: diabetes mellitus onset/diagnosis measurement
CMO:0001111.def: Any measurement which expresses a quantity related to the beginning, early stages or development of diabetes mellitus, or to the official determination of diabetes mellitus as the cause of the observed symptom(s). Diabetes mellitus is a chronic syndrome of impaired carbohydrate, protein, and fat metabolism owing to insufficient secretion of insulin or to target tissue insulin resistance and resulting in hyperglycemia due to decreased glucose tolerance.

CMO:0001112.name: age at onset/diagnosis of diabetes mellitus
CMO:0001112.def: A measurement of the chronological age, that is, the length of time since birth, of the individual when the symptoms of diabetes mellitus first appeared, or when an official diagnosis of diabetes mellitus was first determined. Diabetes mellitus is a chronic syndrome of impaired carbohydrate, protein, and fat metabolism owing to insufficient secretion of insulin or to target tissue insulin resistance and resulting in hyperglycemia due to decreased glucose tolerance.

CMO:0001113.name: diabetes mellitus incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001113.def: Any measurement which expresses either the total number of cases of diabetes mellitus in a population at a given point in time or the rate of occurrence of new cases of diabetes mellitus, that is, the proportion of the population which develop the condition within a period of time.

CMO:0001114.name: percentage of study population developing diabetes mellitus during a period of time
CMO:0001114.def: The number of new cases of diabetes mellitus appearing in a study population during a specified period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. Diabetes mellitus is a chronic syndrome of impaired carbohydrate, protein, and fat metabolism owing to insufficient secretion of insulin or to target tissue insulin resistance and resulting in hyperglycemia due to decreased glucose tolerance.

CMO:0001115.name: percentage of study population displaying diabetes mellitus at a point in time
CMO:0001115.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display diabetes mellitus at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. Diabetes mellitus is a chronic syndrome of impaired carbohydrate, protein, and fat metabolism owing to insufficient secretion of insulin or to target tissue insulin resistance and resulting in hyperglycemia due to decreased glucose tolerance.

CMO:0001116.name: calculated apoptotic body measurement
CMO:0001116.def: Any measurement which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation, of one or more apoptotic bodies, small sealed membrane vesicles that are produced from cells undergoing cell death by apoptosis.

CMO:0001117.name: liver enzyme measurement
CMO:0001117.def: Any measurement related to an enzyme, a protein that acts as a catalyst, increasing the rate at which a chemical reaction occurs without itself being destroyed or altered upon completion of the reaction, in the liver or in a sample of liver tissue.  The liver is the large, dark-red organ located in the cranial portion of the abdomen of vertebrates, just behind or below the diaphragm, the functions of which include storage and filtration of blood; secretion of bile; detoxification of noxious substances; conversion of sugars into glycogen; synthesis and breakdown of fats and temporary storage of fatty acids; and synthesis of serum proteins.

CMO:0001118.name: liver ornithine decarboxylase activity
CMO:0001118.def: Measurement in a specified sample of liver of the amount of ezymatic activity of ornithine decarboxylase, that is, the ability of the protein to catalyze the decarboxylation of ornithine (a product of the urea cycle) to form putrescine, the rate-limiting and first committed step in polyamine synthesis. The liver is the large, dark-red organ located in the cranial portion of the abdomen of vertebrates, just behind or below the diaphragm, the functions of which include storage and filtration of blood; secretion of bile; detoxification of noxious substances; conversion of sugars into glycogen; synthesis and breakdown of fats and temporary storage of fatty acids; and synthesis of serum proteins.

CMO:0001119.name: blood R73 cell count
CMO:0001119.def: Measurement of the number of lymphocytes expressing a surface antigen recognised by R73 in a specified volume of whole blood. R73 is a monoclonal antibody that appears to be specific for a constant determinant of the rat alpha/beta heterodimeric T cell receptor.
synonyms: T cell receptor alpha/beta positive cell count

CMO:0001120.name: blood R73 cell to total mononuclear cell ratio
CMO:0001120.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of lymphocytes in a sample of blood which express a surface antigen recognised by R73 is divided by the total number of mononuclear cells in that sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. A mononuclear cell is a leukocyte with a one-lobed nucleus and without cytoplasmic granules.

CMO:0001121.name: blood CD4 cell to R73 cell ratio
CMO:0001121.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of lymphocytes expressing surface CD4 antigen is divided by the number of lymphocytes expressing a surface antigen recognised by R73, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0001122.name: blood CD8 cell count to R73 cell count ratio
CMO:0001122.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of lymphocytes expressing surface CD8 antigen is divided by the number of lymphocytes expressing a surface antigen recognised by R73, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. R73 is a monoclonal antibody that appears to be specific for a constant determinant of the rat alpha/beta heterodimeric T cell receptor.

CMO:0001123.name: calculated heart left ventricle weight
CMO:0001123.def: A measurement which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation of the weight of the left ventricle of the heart, that is, its the heaviness or degree to which it is drawn toward the earth by gravity. The heart left ventricle is the lower chamber of the left side of the heart, which pumps oxygenated blood out through the aorta to all the tissues of the body.

CMO:0001125.name: calculated heart right ventricle morphological measurement

CMO:0001126.name: cerebral artery inner diameter
CMO:0001126.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall. The cerebral arteries are those which supply blood to the brain, more specifically, to the cerebrum.

CMO:0001127.name: anterior cerebral artery inner diameter
CMO:0001127.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of an anterior cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall. The anterior cerebral artery (ACA) is one of a pair of arteries that supply oxygenated blood to the most medial portions of the frontal lobes and superior medial parietal lobes of the brain.

CMO:0001128.name: middle cerebral artery inner diameter
CMO:0001128.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a middle cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall. The middle cerebral arteries are the largest of the cerebral arteries and supply blood to the lateral cerebral cortex, anterior temporal lobes and insular cortices of the brain.

CMO:0001129.name: posterior cerebral artery inner diameter
CMO:0001129.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a posterior cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall. The posterior cerebral artery (PCA) is one of a pair of blood vessels that supply blood to the posterior aspect, i.e. the occipital lobe, of the brain.

CMO:0001130.name: kidney lesion measurement
CMO:0001130.def: Measurement of a lesion in kidney, he organ which functions to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0001131.name: kidney non-tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001131.def: Measurement of a lesion in the kidney, he organ which functions to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes, which is not neoplastic in origin. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined. Examples of non-tumorous lesions would include wounds, sores, ulcers, infarctions, etc.

CMO:0001132.name: kidney tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001132.def: Measurement of a lesion in the kidney, he organ which functions to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes, which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001133.name: kidney glomerulosclerotic lesion measurement
CMO:0001133.def: Any measurement of lesions resulting from fibrosis, scarring or hyaline deposits within a kidney glomerulus, a tuft of capillaries situated within a Bowman's capsule at the end of a renal tubule in the vertebrate kidney, that filters waste products from the blood and thus initiates urine formation.

CMO:0001134.name: calculated kidney glomerulosclerotic lesion measurement
CMO:0001134.def: A measurement of lesions resulting from fibrosis, scarring or hyaline deposits within one or more kidney glomeruli which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001135.name: index of glomerular damage
CMO:0001135.def: A measurement of lesions resulting from fibrosis, scarring or hyaline deposits within kidney glomeruli which is derived from a combination of multiple measurements and/or objective or subjective severity scores according to a specified formula or set of criteria.

CMO:0001136.name: percentage of study population developing type 1 diabetes mellitus during a period of time
CMO:0001136.def: The number of new cases of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) appearing in a study population during a specified period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. T1DM is a form of diabetes mellitus which results from the autoimmune destruction of beta cells of the pancreatic islets of Langerhans.

CMO:0001137.name: percentage of study population developing type 2 diabetes mellitus during a period of time
CMO:0001137.def: The number of new cases of type 2 diabetes mellitus appearing in a study population during a specified period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. T2DM is a form of diabetes often, although not universally, associated with obesity, insulin resistance, hyperlipidemia(s) and cardiovascular symptoms such as hypertension.

CMO:0001138.name: percentage of study population displaying type 1 diabetes mellitus at a point in time
CMO:0001138.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. T1DM is a form of diabetes mellitus which results from the autoimmune destruction of beta cells of the pancreatic islets of Langerhans.

CMO:0001139.name: percentage of study population displaying type 2 diabetes mellitus at a point in time
CMO:0001139.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. T2DM is a form of diabetes often, although not universally, associated with obesity, insulin resistance, hyperlipidemia(s) and cardiovascular symptoms such as hypertension.

CMO:0001140.name: age at onset/diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus
CMO:0001140.def: A measurement of the chronological age, that is, the length of time since birth, of the individual when the symptoms of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) first appeared, or when an official diagnosis of T1DM was first determined. T1DM is a form of diabetes mellitus which results from the autoimmune destruction of beta cells of the pancreatic islets of Langerhans.
synonyms: age at onset/diagnosis of diabetes mellitus type I
age at onset/diagnosis of insulin-dependent diabetes
age at onset/diagnosis of juvenile diabetes

CMO:0001141.name: age at onset/diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus
CMO:0001141.def: A measurement of the chronological age, that is, the length of time since birth, of the individual when the symptoms of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) first appeared, or when an official diagnosis of T2DM was first determined. T2DM is a form of diabetes often, although not universally, associated with obesity, insulin resistance, hyperlipidemia(s) and cardiovascular symptoms such as hypertension.
synonyms: age at onset/diagnosis of adult-onset diabetes mellitus
age at onset/diagnosis of diabetes mellitus type II
age at onset/diagnosis of non-insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus

CMO:0001142.name: pancreas total protein level
CMO:0001142.def: Measurement of the amount of total protein in the pancreas, the elongated, racemose gland containing both endocrine and exocrine elements which secretes hormones such as insulin and glucagon internally and digestive enzymes externally, or in a specified sample of pancreas tissue without division or fractionation of the tissue (for example separation of the endocrine and exocrine pancreas).

CMO:0001143.name: calculated pancreas total protein level
CMO:0001143.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the amount of protein in the pancreas without division or fractionation of the tissue (for example separation of the endocrine and exocrine pancreas).

CMO:0001144.name: pancreas insulin level to pancreas total protein ratio
CMO:0001144.def: The ratio of the amount of insulin, the polypeptide hormone secreted by the islets of Langerhans which helps regulate the metabolism of carbohydrates and fats, in the pancreas to the total amount of protein in the pancreas without division or fractionation of the tissue (for example separation of the endocrine and exocrine pancreas).
synonyms: pancreatic insulin to total pancreatic protein ratio

CMO:0001145.name: calculated intramuscular fat morphological measurement
CMO:0001145.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the physical form or structure of the small deposits of fat located within and throughout skeletal muscle.

CMO:0001146.name: calculated skeletal muscle morphological measurement
CMO:0001146.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the physical form or structure of skeletal muscles, the striated muscles attached to bones.

CMO:0001147.name: skeletal muscle morphological measurement
CMO:0001147.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of skeletal muscles, the striated muscles attached to bones.

CMO:0001148.name: skeletal muscle weight
CMO:0001148.def: The weight of all or part of a skeletal muscle, one of the striated muscles attached to bones.

CMO:0001149.name: disease population measurement
CMO:0001149.def: Any measurement which deals with a disease in terms of population, geography or demographics.

CMO:0001150.name: pancreas lesion measurement
CMO:0001150.def: Measurement of a lesion in the pancreas, the elongated, racemose gland containing both endocrine and exocrine elements which secretes hormones such as insulin and glucagon internally and digestive enzymes externally. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0001151.name: pancreas non-tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001151.def: Measurement of a pancreas lesion which is not neoplastic in origin. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined. Examples of non-tumorous lesions would include wounds, sores, ulcers, infarctions, etc.

CMO:0001152.name: pancreas tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001152.def: Measurement of a pancreas lesion which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001153.name: pancreatic islet lesion measurement
CMO:0001153.def: Measurement of a lesion involving one or more pancreatic islets, i.e. islets of Langerhans, the endocrine, hormone-producing portion of the pancreas. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0001154.name: pancreatic islet non-tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001154.def: Measurement of a pancreatic islet lesion which is not neoplastic in origin. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined. Examples of non-tumorous lesions would include wounds, sores, ulcers, infarctions, etc.
synonyms: islet of Langerhans non-tumorous lesion measurement

CMO:0001155.name: pancreatic islet tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001155.def: Measurement of a pancreatic islet lesion which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.
synonyms: islet of Langerhans tumorous lesion measurement

CMO:0001156.name: pancreatic islet damage composite score
CMO:0001156.def: A measurement of the extent of pancreatic islet damage (e.g. fibrosis) which is derived from a combination of multiple measurements and/or objective or subjective severity scores according to a specified formula or set of criteria.
synonyms: islet of Langerhans damage composite score

CMO:0001157.name: pancreatic islet non-tumorous lesion count
CMO:0001157.def: The number of pancreatic islets which display lesions in a particular sample.

CMO:0001158.name: muscle measurement
CMO:0001158.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological of a muscle or a group of muscles. Muscles are organs or tissues composed of bundles of fibers that have the power to contract and hence to produce movement.

CMO:0001159.name: skeletal system measurement
CMO:0001159.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological, of all or part of the skeletal system, the body's framework of bones which give support and shape to the body, protect delicate internal organs, provide sites of attachment for muscles to make motion possible, manufacture blood cells and store minerals.

CMO:0001160.name: intramuscular fat area to skeletal muscle area ratio
CMO:0001160.def: A calculated value in which the area (i.e., the extent of the two-dimensional region) occupied by intramuscular fat in a specified sample of skeletal muscle is divided by the total area of that sample of skeletal muscle and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to muscle area.
synonyms: intramuscular adipose area to muscle area ratio
intramuscular adipose area to skeletal muscle area ratio

CMO:0001161.name: intramuscular fat area to body weight ratio
CMO:0001161.def: A calculated value in which the area occupied by intramuscular fat in a specified sample of skeletal muscle is divided by the total weight of the body and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.
synonyms: intramuscular adipose area to body weight ratio

CMO:0001162.name: intramuscular fat area
CMO:0001162.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through a single deposit of intramuscular fat or a measurement of the total area occupied by intramuscular fat in a cross-section of skeletal muscle.

CMO:0001163.name: calculated intramuscular fat area
CMO:0001163.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through a single deposit of intramuscular fat or a measurement of the total area occupied by intramuscular fat in a cross-section of skeletal muscle, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001164.name: calculated intramuscular fat weight
CMO:0001164.def: A measurement of the amount, by weight, of the small deposits of fat located within a specified amount of skeletal muscle, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001165.name: kidney glomerulus morphological measurement
CMO:0001165.def: Measurement of the physical form or structure of one or more glomeruli in the kidney. Glomeruli are the tufts of capillaries each situated within a Bowman's capsule at the end of a renal tubule in the vertebrate kidney that filter waste products from the blood and thus initiate urine formation.

CMO:0001166.name: kidney glomerulus diameter
CMO:0001166.def: The length of a straight line passing through the center of a kidney glomerulus and connecting opposite points on its circumference.

CMO:0001167.name: calculated renal blood flow rate
CMO:0001167.def: A measurement of the volume of blood delivered to or exiting from the kidneys per unit time, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001168.name: absolute change in renal blood flow rate
CMO:0001168.def: The difference in the volume of blood delivered to or exiting from the kidneys per unit time between two points in time or two conditions expressed as the result of the subtraction in and of itself without comparison by ratio with another quantity.

CMO:0001169.name: blood phospholipid level
CMO:0001169.def: Measurement of the amount of any of various phosphorus-containing lipids that are composed mainly of fatty acids, a phosphate group, and a simple organic molecule found in a specified volume of whole blood.

CMO:0001170.name: plasma phospholipid level
CMO:0001170.def: Measurement of the amount of any  of various phosphorus-containing lipids that are composed mainly of fatty acids, a phosphate group, and a simple organic molecule found in a specific volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001171.name: serum phospholipid level
CMO:0001171.def: Measurement of any of various phosphorus-containing lipids that are composed mainly of fatty acids, a phosphate group, and a simple organic molecule found in a specific volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001172.name: blood corticosterone level
CMO:0001172.def: The amount of corticosterone, a corticosteroid produced in the adrenal cortex that functions in the metabolism of carbohydrates and proteins, found in a specific volume of blood.

CMO:0001173.name: plasma corticosterone level
CMO:0001173.def: The amount of corticosterone, a corticosteroid produced in the adrenal cortex that functions in the metabolism of carbohydrates and proteins, found in a specific volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001174.name: serum corticosterone level
CMO:0001174.def: The amount of corticosterone, a corticosteroid produced in the adrenal cortex that functions in the metabolism of carbohydrates and proteins, found in a specific volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001175.name: kidney glomerulosclerotic lesion count
CMO:0001175.def: The number of kidney glomeruli with lesions resulting from fibrosis, scarring or hyaline deposits, or the number of such lesions in a specified sample.

CMO:0001176.name: kidney glomerulosclerotic lesion count to total glomeruli count ratio
CMO:0001176.def: A calculated value in which the number of glomeruli with lesions resulting from fibrosis, scarring or hyaline deposits is divided by the total number of glomeruli in a specified sample of kidney and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the total number of glomeruli.

CMO:0001177.name: kidney protein/peptide composition measurement
CMO:0001177.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more proteins (complex high molecular weight organic compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, and sulfur consisting of alpha-amino acids joined by peptide linkages) or peptides (low molecular weight compounds composed of at least two amino acids joined by peptide linkages) in kidney.

CMO:0001178.name: renal cortex measurement
CMO:0001178.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological of the outer part of the kidney, composed mainly of glomeruli and convoluted tubules.

CMO:0001179.name: renal medulla measurement
CMO:0001179.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological, of the renal medulla, the innermost part of the kidney which contains the structures of the nephrons responsible for maintaining the salt and water balance of the blood.

CMO:0001180.name: renal medulla protein measurement
CMO:0001180.def: Any measurement involving the amount, composition or type of protein, the complex organic compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, and sulfur consisting of alpha-amino acids joined by peptide linkages, in kidney medulla, the innermost part of the kidney which contains the structures of the nephrons responsible for maintaining the salt and water balance of the blood.

CMO:0001181.name: renal cortex protein measurement
CMO:0001181.def: Any measurement involving the amount, composition or type of protein, the complex organic compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, and sulfur consisting of alpha-amino acids joined by peptide linkages, in renal cortex, the outer part of the kidney, composed mainly of glomeruli and convoluted tubules.

CMO:0001182.name: calculated kidney protein composition measurement
CMO:0001182.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type, of protein (the complex organic compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, and sulfur consisting of alpha-amino acids joined by peptide linkages) in kidney.

CMO:0001183.name: calculated renal cortex protein composition measurement
CMO:0001183.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation involving the amount, composition or type of protein in the kidney cortex, the outer part of the kidney, composed mainly of glomeruli and convoluted tubules.
