synonyms: calculated kidney cortex protein composition measurement

CMO:0001184.name: calculated renal medulla protein composition measurement
CMO:0001184.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation involving the amount, composition or type of protein in the renal medulla, the innermost part of the kidney which contains the structures of the nephrons responsible for maintaining the salt and water balance of the blood.
synonyms: calculated kidney medulla protein composition measurement

CMO:0001185.name: kidney TRPV4 protein level to beta-actin protein level ratio
CMO:0001185.def: A calculated value in which the amount of TRPV4 protein in a specified sample of kidney is divided by the amount of beta-actin protein in the same or a corresponding sample of kidney and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the beta-actin protein level.
synonyms: renal TRPV4 protein level to beta-actin protein level ratio

CMO:0001186.name: renal cortex TRPV4 protein level to beta-actin protein level ratio
CMO:0001186.def: A calculated value in which the amount of TRPV4 protein in a specified sample of renal cortex is divided by the amount of beta-actin protein in the same or a corresponding sample of renal cortex and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the beta-actin protein level.
synonyms: kidney cortex TRPV4 protein level to beta-actin protein level ratio

CMO:0001187.name: renal medulla TRPV4 protein level to beta-actin protein level ratio
CMO:0001187.def: A calculated value in which the amount of TRPV4 protein in a specified sample of renal medulla is divided by the amount of beta-actin protein in the same or a corresponding sample of renal medulla and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the beta-actin protein level.
synonyms: kidney medulla TRPV4 protein level to beta-actin protein level ratio

CMO:0001188.name: calculated cerebral artery inner diameter measurement
CMO:0001188.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall, after that measurement has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation. The cerebral arteries are those which supply blood to the brain, more specifically, to the cerebrum.

CMO:0001189.name: calculated middle cerebral artery inner diameter measurement
CMO:0001189.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a middle cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall, after that measurement has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation. The middle cerebral arteries are the largest of the cerebral arteries and supply blood to the lateral cerebral cortex, anterior temporal lobes and insular cortices of the brain.

CMO:0001190.name: resting tone of middle cerebral artery
CMO:0001190.def: This is a calculated measurement of the relative difference in the middle cerebral artery inner diameter between a treated, fully relaxed state and a control resting state, expressed as a percentage. This calculated value is given by this equation: [(Dmax - Drest) /Dmax] x 100.
synonyms: active resting tone of middle cerebral artery

CMO:0001191.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic area
CMO:0001191.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional plane through the left ventricle of the heart at the end of diastole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally relaxed, and usually corresponds to its largest diameter.

CMO:0001192.name: heart left ventricle end-systolic area
CMO:0001192.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional plane through the left ventricle of the heart at the end of systole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally contracted, and usually corresponds to its smallest diameter.

CMO:0001193.name: age at time of death
CMO:0001193.def: Measurement of the amount of time between the beginning of life of an organism and the permanent and irreversible cessation of the vital functions of that organism.

CMO:0001194.name: white adipose tissue weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0001194.def: A calculated value in which the weight of white adipose tissue, the thermal-insulating and energy-storing fat tissue of mammals, is divided by the total weight of the body and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percent, thus normalizing it to body weight.
synonyms: white fat weight to body weight ratio

CMO:0001195.name: epididymal plus perirenal white adipose tissue weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0001195.def: This measurement is a calculated value in which the sum of the weights of the white adipose tissue associated with the epididymis and that surrounding the kidneys is divided by the total weight of the body and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percent, thus normalizing it to body weight.
synonyms: sum of epididymal and perirenal white adipose tissue to body weight ratio

CMO:0001197.name: body weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0001197.def: A calculated value in which the total body weight of an organism is divided by the length of the tibia, the inner and larger bone of the lower leg or hindlimb, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the length of the leg and, by extension, to the length of the body.

CMO:0001198.name: heart weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0001198.def: A calculated value in which the weight of the heart, the chambered, muscular organ that maintains the circulation of the blood, is divided by the length of the tibia, the inner and larger bone of the lower leg or hindlimb, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the length of the leg and, by extension, to the length of the body.

CMO:0001199.name: both kidneys wet weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0001199.def: A calculated value in which the total weight after removal from the body but without desiccation of both kidneys is divided by the length of the tibia, the inner and larger bone of the lower leg or hindlimb, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the length of the leg and, by extension, to the length of the body.

CMO:0001200.name: calculated epididymal fat pad weight
CMO:0001200.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the weight of the encapsulated adipose tissue surrounding the epididymis, the structure along the posterior body of the testis.

CMO:0001201.name: epididymal fat pad weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0001201.def: A calculated value in which the weight of the epididymal fat pad, the encapsulated adipose tissue that is attached to the epididymis, is divided by the length of the tibia, the inner and larger bone of the lower leg or hindlimb, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the length of the leg and, by extension, to the length of the body.

CMO:0001202.name: hematuria incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001202.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display hematuria, that is, blood in the urine, at a point in time or develop hematuria within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio.

CMO:0001203.name: percentage of study population developing hematuria during a period of time
CMO:0001203.def: The number of new cases of hematuria, that is blood in the urine, appearing in a study population during a specified period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001204.name: percentage of study population displaying hematuria at a point in time
CMO:0001204.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display hematuria, that is blood in the urine, at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001205.name: percentage of study population with hydronephrosis developing hematuria during a period of time
CMO:0001205.def: The number of new cases of hematuria, that is blood in the urine, appearing in a study population with preexisting hydronephrosis, that is, dilation of the pelvis and calices of one or both kidneys because of the accumulation of urine resulting from obstruction to urine outflow, during a specified period compared to the total number of individuals in that study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001206.name: percentage of study population with hydronephrosis displaying hematuria at a point in time
CMO:0001206.def: The number of individuals in a study population with preexisting hydronephrosis, that is, dilation of the pelvis and calices of one or both kidneys because of the accumulation of urine resulting from obstruction to urine outflow, which display hematuria, that is blood in the urine, at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001207.name: hydronephrosis severity measurement
CMO:0001207.def: Any measurement of the degree to which the presentation of the hydronephrosis disease state, i.e. dilation of the pelvis and calices of one or both kidneys because of the accumulation of urine resulting from obstruction to urine outflow, causes pain or damage.

CMO:0001208.name: hydronephrosis severity score
CMO:0001208.def: A calculated measurement of hydronephrosis severity which is derived from a combination of multiple measurements and/or objective or subjective assessments of severity, that is, the degree to which the hydronephrosis disease state causes pain or damage, according to a specified formula or set of criteria.

CMO:0001209.name: calculated liver tumorous lesion number
CMO:0001209.def: A measure of the number of tumorous lesions in or on the surface of the liver, or in a specified section of the liver when that number has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001210.name: liver tumorous lesion number to liver area ratio
CMO:0001210.def: A measure of the number of tumorous lesions in a measured and specified area, e.g. in a histological section.

CMO:0001211.name: creatinine clearance to body weight ratio
CMO:0001211.def: A calculated measurement in which the value for creatinine clearance is divided by the total body weight of the organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight.

CMO:0001212.name: chronic pancreatitis incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001212.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display chronic pancreatitis, that is, chronic or ongoing inflammation of the pancreas with fibrosis and calcification of the gland at a point in time or develop chronic pancreatitis within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio.

CMO:0001213.name: percentage of study population developing chronic pancreatitis during a period of time
CMO:0001213.def: The number of new cases of chronic pancreatitis appearing in a study population during a specified period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001214.name: percentage of study population displaying chronic pancreatitis at a point in time
CMO:0001214.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display chronic pancreatitis at a specified point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001215.name: pancreatic islet physiological measurement
CMO:0001215.def: Any measurement relating to the function of the pancreatic islets or their cells. Pancreatic islets, i.e. islets of Langerhans, are the endocrine, hormone-producing portion of the pancreas.

CMO:0001216.name: pancreatic islet insulin release measurement
CMO:0001216.def: Any measurement pertaining to the secretion of insulin, the major fuel-regulating peptide hormone formed from proinsulin in the beta cells of the pancreatic islets of Langerhans, from the pancreatic islets.

CMO:0001217.name: calculated pancreatic islet insulin release measurement
CMO:0001217.def: Any measurement pertaining to the secretion of insulin, the major fuel-regulating peptide hormone formed from proinsulin in the beta cells of the pancreatic islets of Langerhans, from the pancreatic islets which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001218.name: frequency of pancreatic islet insulin release oscillations
CMO:0001218.def: A measure of the frequency at which the basal levels of insulin secretion from the pancreatic islets oscillate or vary between alternate levels, i.e. higher and lower, within a definable period of time.

CMO:0001219.name: partial pressure of pancreatic islet oxygen
CMO:0001219.def: A measurement of the partial pressure of oxygen measured directly within the pancreatic islet.  The partial pressure of oxygen is the pressure exerted by oxygen dissolved in the islet milieu and is proportional to the concentration of oxygen in the liquid.

CMO:0001220.name: adipocyte morphological measurement
CMO:0001220.def: Measurement of the physical form or structure of a single or group of fat cells, connective tissue cells specialized for the synthesis and storage of fat; such cells consist of a large cytoplasmic vesicle filled with globules of triglycerides with the nucleus displaced to one side and the cytoplasm seen as a thin line around the fat vesicle.

CMO:0001221.name: adipocyte area
CMO:0001221.def: A measurement of the average extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through an adipocyte, a connective tissue cell specialized for the synthesis and storage of fat.

CMO:0001222.name: adipocyte diameter
CMO:0001222.def: The average length of a straight line passing through the center of an adipocyte and connecting opposite points on its circumference. An adipocyte is a connective tissue cell specialized for the synthesis and storage of fat.

CMO:0001223.name: adipocyte circumference
CMO:0001223.def: The length of a boundary line fully enclosing an adipocyte or of a line which follows the periphery of an adipocyte, a connective tissue cell specialized for the synthesis and storage of fat.

CMO:0001224.name: small intestine length
CMO:0001224.def: A measurement of the small intestine, the proximal portion of the intestine extending from the pylorus of the stomach to the cecum and comprising the duodenum, jejunum, and ileum.

CMO:0001225.name: large intestine length
CMO:0001225.def: A measurement of the large intestine, the distal portion of the intestine extending from its junction with the small intestine to the anus and comprising the cecum, colon, rectum, and anal canal.

CMO:0001226.name: bone mineral density
CMO:0001226.def: Measurement of the mineral mass per unit area of bone, the hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates and composed chiefly of calcium salts.

CMO:0001227.name: blood growth hormone level
CMO:0001227.def: Measurement of the amount of growth hormone, a polypeptide hormone which promotes body growth and fat mobilization and inhibits glucose utilization, in a specified volume of whole blood.

CMO:0001228.name: plasma growth hormone level
CMO:0001228.def: Measurement of the amount of growth hormone, a polypeptide hormone which promotes body growth and fat mobilization and inhibits glucose utilization, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001229.name: serum growth hormone level
CMO:0001229.def: Measurement of the amount of growth hormone, a polypeptide hormone which promotes body growth and fat mobilization and inhibits glucose utilization, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001230.name: change in mean arterial blood pressure to change in intracerebroventricular sodium concentration ratio
CMO:0001230.def: A calculated measurement of the ratio between the change in mean arterial blood pressure and the concentration of sodium infused directly into the ventricle(s) of the brain; calculated as the slope of the curve of mean arterial blood pressure versus intracerebroventricular-infused sodium concentration.

CMO:0001231.name: change in heart rate to change in intracerebroventricular sodium concentration ratio
CMO:0001231.def: A calculated measurement of the ratio between the change in heart rate and the concentration of sodium infused directly into the ventricle(s) of the brain; calculated as the slope of the curve of heart rate versus intracerebroventricular-infused sodium concentration.

CMO:0001232.name: nervous system measurement
CMO:0001232.def: Any measurement of the nervous system, the organ system which, along with the endocrine system, correlates the adjustments and reactions of the organism to its internal and external environment via transmission of information, in the form of electrochemical impulses, throughout the body.

CMO:0001233.name: autonomic nervous system measurement
CMO:0001233.def: Any measurement of the autonomic nervous system, the part of the nervous system that regulates involuntary action, as of the intestines, smooth muscle, heart, and glands, and that is divided into two physiologically and anatomically distinct, mutually antagonistic systems, the sympathetic nervous system and the parasympathetic nervous system. The nervous system is the organ system which, along with the endocrine system, correlates the adjustments and reactions of the organism to its internal and external environment via transmission of information, in the form of electrochemical impulses, throughout the body.

CMO:0001234.name: sympathetic nervous system measurement
CMO:0001234.def: Any measurement of or directly related to the part of the autonomic nervous system (the part of the nervous system that regulates involuntary action) that is concerned especially with preparing the body to react to situations of stress or emergency. The sympathetic nervous system contains chiefly adrenergic fibers and tends to depress secretion, decrease the tone and contractility of smooth muscle, and increase heart rate. The nervous system is the organ system which, along with the endocrine system, correlates the adjustments and reactions of the organism to its internal and external environment via transmission of information, in the form of electrochemical impulses, throughout the body.

CMO:0001235.name: nerve activity measurement
CMO:0001235.def: Any assessment or quantification of the presence and/or amount of recordable electrical energy in a nerve, any of the cordlike structures that convey impulses between the central nervous system and one or more parts of the body, and that each consist of an outer connective tissue sheath surrounding a bundle of conductive fibers.

CMO:0001236.name: sympathetic nerve activity measurement
CMO:0001236.def: Any assessment or quantification of the presence and/or amount of recordable electrical energy in a sympathetic nerve, a nerve of the autonomic nervous system that regulates involuntary and automatic reactions, especially to stress. A nerve is any of the cordlike structures that convey impulses between the central nervous system and one or more parts of the body, and that each consist of an outer connective tissue sheath surrounding a bundle of conductive fibers.

CMO:0001237.name: renal sympathetic nerve activity measurement
CMO:0001237.def: Assessment or quantification of the presence and/or amount of recordable electrical energy in a renal sympathetic nerve, a nerve of the autonomic nervous system that regulates involuntary and automatic reactions, especially to stress, associated with and controlling activity of the kidneys. A nerve is any of the cordlike structures that convey impulses between the central nervous system and one or more parts of the body, and that each consist of an outer connective tissue sheath surrounding a bundle of conductive fibers.

CMO:0001238.name: change in renal sympathetic nerve activity to change in intracerebroventricular sodium concentration ratio
CMO:0001238.def: A calculated measurement in which the change in the activity, i.e., the recordable electrical energy, of the renal sympathetic nerves between two points in time or two conditions is compared to the concentration of a solution of sodium, the chemical element with atomic number 11, infused directly into the ventricle(s) of the brain; calculated as the slope of the curve of renal sympathetic nerve activity versus intracerebroventricular-infused sodium concentration. A renal sympathetic nerve is a nerve (a cordlike structure that conveys impulses between the central nervous system and one or more parts of the body, and that consists of an outer connective tissue sheath surrounding a bundle of conductive fibers) of the autonomic nervous system that regulates involuntary and automatic reactions, especially to stress, associated with and controlling activity of the kidneys.
synonyms: change in RSNA to change in intracerebroventricular sodium concentration ratio

CMO:0001239.name: ratio of change in renal blood flow to change in renal perfusion pressure
CMO:0001239.def: A value calculated by dividing the proportionate change in renal blood flow (RBF) by the proportionate change in renal perfusion pressure (RPP), i.e. (RBF2 - RBF1)/RBF1 divided by (RPP2 - RPP1)/RPP1.
synonyms: ratio of renal blood flow change to renal perfusion pressure change

CMO:0001240.name: cerebrospinal fluid measurement
CMO:0001240.def: Any measurement of the fluid contained within the ventricles of the brain, the subarachnoid space, and the central canal of the spinal cord.

CMO:0001241.name: cerebrospinal fluid chemistry measurement
CMO:0001241.def: A quantification of a parameter of the chemical composition of the cerebrospinal fluid, the fluid contained within the ventricles of the brain, the subarachnoid space, and the central canal of the spinal cord.

CMO:0001242.name: cerebrospinal fluid electrolyte measurement
CMO:0001242.def: A quantification of one or more mineral salts found in the cerebrospinal fluid in the form of electrically charged ions.

CMO:0001243.name: cerebrospinal fluid chloride level
CMO:0001243.def: Measurement of the amount of choride, the negatively charged ion of chlorine, found in a specified volume of cerebrospinal fluid.

CMO:0001244.name: cerebrospinal fluid sodium level
CMO:0001244.def: The amount of cationic sodium in a specified volume of cerebrospinal fluid.

CMO:0001245.name: calculated plasma low density lipoprotein cholesterol level
CMO:0001245.def: The amount of low density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) in a specified volume of blood plasma where the value was derived by a mathematical process or computation rather than being measured directly.  The calculation can be made using any of several computational formulas, e.g. the Friedewald (1972) Formula: LDL = TC - HDL - TG/5.0 (mg/dL), or the 'Iranian' (2008) Formula:  LDL = TC/1.19 + TG/1.9 - HDL/1.1 - 38 (mg/dL).

CMO:0001246.name: cubic root of body weight to nasoanal length ratio
CMO:0001246.def: A calculated measurement of body weight in which it is compared to the length of the organism from nose to anus, thus normalizing it to body length.

CMO:0001247.name: blood thyroid stimulating hormone level
CMO:0001247.def: Measurement of the amount of thyroid-stimulating hormone, a glycoprotein hormone secreted by the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland that stimulates and regulates activity of the thyroid gland, in a specified volume of whole blood.

CMO:0001248.name: serum thyroid stimulating hormone level
CMO:0001248.def: Measurement of the amount of thyroid-stimulating hormone, a glycoprotein hormone secreted by the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland that stimulates and regulates activity of the thyroid gland, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001249.name: plasma thyroid stimulating hormone level
CMO:0001249.def: Measurement of the amount of thyroid-stimulating hormone, a glycoprotein hormone secreted by the anterior lobe of the pituitary gland that stimulates and regulates activity of the thyroid gland, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001250.name: calculated body region fat morphological measurement
CMO:0001250.def: Measurement of the adipose tissue located in a specific body region which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001251.name: inguinal fat morphological measurement
CMO:0001251.def: Any measurement of adipose tissue located in the junctional region between the abdomen and thigh.

CMO:0001252.name: calculated inguinal fat pad weight
CMO:0001252.def: A value which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation for the heaviness or degree to which the inguinal fat pad, the accumulation of encapsulated adipose tissue located in the junctional region between the abdomen and thigh, is drawn toward the earth by gravity.

CMO:0001253.name: inguinal fat pad weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0001253.def: A calculated value in which the weight of one or both of the inguinal fat pads, that is, the accumulations of encapsulated adipose tissue located in the junctional region between the abdomen and thigh, is divided by the total weight of the body and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.

CMO:0001254.name: kidney fibrotic lesion measurement
CMO:0001254.def: Any measurement of a lesion in the kidney characterized by an abnormal proliferation of fibrous connective tissue. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0001255.name: kidney fibrotic lesion size measurement
CMO:0001255.def: Any measurement of the physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of a lesion in the kidney characterized by an abnormal proliferation of fibrous connective tissue. A lesion is a localized pathological change in structure of an organ or tissue due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0001256.name: kidney fibrotic lesion area measurement
CMO:0001256.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through a single kidney fibrotic lesion, or a measurement of the total area occupied by fibrotic lesions in a cross-section of the kidney.

CMO:0001257.name: calculated kidney fibrotic lesion area measurement
CMO:0001257.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through a single kidney fibrotic lesion, or a measurement of the total area occupied by fibrotic lesions in a cross-section of the kidney, when that value has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001258.name: kidney fibrotic lesion area to total kidney area ratio
CMO:0001258.def: A calculated value in which the extent of the two-dimensional surface occupied by fibrotic lesions is divided by the total extent of the two-dimensional surface of the kidney and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the size of the kidney.

CMO:0001260.name: testis tumor incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001260.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display testis tumors at a point in time or develop testis tumors within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio.

CMO:0001261.name: percentage of study population developing testis tumors during a period of time
CMO:0001261.def: The number of new cases of individuals developing one or more testis tumors appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001262.name: percentage of study population displaying testis tumors at a point in time
CMO:0001262.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display one or more testis tumors at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001263.name: bilateral testis tumor incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001263.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display tumors in both testes at a point in time or develop tumors in both testes within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio.

CMO:0001264.name: percentage of study population developing bilateral testis tumors during a period of time
CMO:0001264.def: The number of new cases of individuals developing tumors in both testes in a study population during a certain period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001265.name: percentage of study population displaying bilateral testis tumors at a point in time
CMO:0001265.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display tumors in both testes at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001266.name: leukemia incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001266.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display leukemia, any of a group of progressive, malignant diseases of the blood-forming organs, marked by distorted proliferation and development of leukocytes and their precursors in the blood and bone marrow, at a point in time or develop leukemia within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio.

CMO:0001267.name: percentage of study population developing leukemia during a period of time
CMO:0001267.def: The number of new cases of leukemia, any of a group of progressive, malignant diseases of the blood-forming organs, marked by distorted proliferation and development of leukocytes and their precursors in the blood and bone marrow, appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001268.name: percentage of study population displaying leukemia at a point in time
CMO:0001268.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display leukemia, any of a group of progressive, malignant diseases of the blood-forming organs, marked by distorted proliferation and development of leukocytes and their precursors in the blood and bone marrow, at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001269.name: kidney sclerotic glomeruli count to total glomeruli count ratio
CMO:0001269.def: A calculated value in which the number of glomeruli with lesions resulting from fibrosis, scarring or hyaline deposits is divided by the total number of glomeruli in a specified sample of kidney and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the total number of glomeruli.
synonyms: kidney glomerulosclerotic lesion count to total glomeruli count ratio
sclerotic glomeruli to total glomeruli ratio

CMO:0001270.name: urine albumin excretion rate to body weight ratio
CMO:0001270.def: A calculated value in which the amount of albumin, the major protein of blood plasma, excreted in the urine is divided by the total weight of the body and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight.

CMO:0001271.name: plasma anti-collagen antibody level
CMO:0001271.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to one or more types of collagen,  the fibrous protein constituent of bone, cartilage, tendon, and other connective tissue, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001272.name: plasma anti-type 2 collagen antibody level
CMO:0001272.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.
synonyms: plasma anti-type II collagen antibody level

CMO:0001273.name: plasma anti-bovine type 2 collagen antibody level
CMO:0001273.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds cattle-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.
synonyms: plasma anti-bovine type II collagen antibody level

CMO:0001274.name: plasma anti-porcine type 2 collagen antibody level
CMO:0001274.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds pig-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.
synonyms: plasma anti-porcine type II collagen antibody level

CMO:0001275.name: plasma anti-rat type 2 collagen antibody level
CMO:0001275.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds rat-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.
synonyms: plasma anti-rat type II collagen antibody level

CMO:0001276.name: serum immunoglobulin measurement
CMO:0001276.def: Any measurement related to immunoglobulin, any of several classes of proteins produced by plasma cells and lymphocytes which play essential roles in the immune system, for example, attaching to foreign substances in an effort to destroy them, in serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001277.name: serum antibody level
CMO:0001277.def: A measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen, a substance introduced into an organism which initiates an immune response including the production of the very antibodies which bind to it in an effort to destroy it, in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001278.name: calculated serum anti-porcine type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0001278.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds pig-derived type 2 collagen in a specified sample of serum, when that measurement is based on, or uses in the calculation, the antibody titer. An antibody titer is the last dilution of a sample at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: calculated serum anti-porcine type II collagen antibody titer
serum anti-porcine type 2 collagen antibody titer normalized for absorbance

CMO:0001279.name: calculated serum anti-type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0001279.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds type 2 collagen in a specified volume of serum, when that calculation is based on the antibody titer. A serum antibody titer is the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: serum anti-type II collagen antibody titer normalized for absorbance

CMO:0001280.name: serum anti-collagen antibody level
CMO:0001280.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to one or more types of collagen,  the fibrous protein constituent of bone, cartilage, tendon, and other connective tissue, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001281.name: calculated serum anti-rat type 2 collagen autoantibody titer
CMO:0001281.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of rat type 2 collagen autoantibody in a specified sample of serum, when the caluculation is based on the autoantibody titer. A serum autoantibody titer is the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained for an antibody that attacks the cells, tissues, native proteins, or other endogenous molecules of the organism in which it was formed.
synonyms: calculated rat serum anti-self type 2 collagen autoantibody titer
calculated serum anti-rat type II collagen autoantibody titer
serum anti-rat type 2 collagen autoantibody titer normalized for absorbance

CMO:0001282.name: serum anti-bovine type 2 collagen antibody level
CMO:0001282.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds cattle-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.
synonyms: serum anti-bovine type II collagen antibody level

CMO:0001284.name: blood troponin T level
CMO:0001284.def: The amount in a specified volume of whole blood of troponin T, one subunit of a complex of three regulatory proteins required for skeletal and cardiac muscle contraction; used as an indicator for myocardial damage.

CMO:0001285.name: serum troponin T level
CMO:0001285.def: The amount of troponin T, one subunit of a complex of three regulatory proteins required for skeletal and cardiac muscle contraction in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001286.name: plasma troponin T level
CMO:0001286.def: The amount of troponin T, one subunit of a complex of three regulatory proteins required for skeletal and cardiac muscle contraction in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001287.name: blood thyroid hormone level
CMO:0001287.def: The amount of one or more thyroid hormones, that is, hormones produced by the thyroid gland that are primarily responsible for regulation of metabolism, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001288.name: blood thyroxine level
CMO:0001288.def: The amount of thyroxine, the major hormone derived from the thyroid gland which regulates cellular metabolism, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001289.name: plasma thyroxine level
CMO:0001289.def: The amount of thyroxine, the major hormone derived from the thyroid gland which regulates cellular metabolism, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001290.name: serum thyroxine level
CMO:0001290.def: The amount of thyroxine, the major hormone derived from the thyroid gland which regulates cellular metabolism, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001291.name: blood triiodothyronine level
CMO:0001291.def: The amount of triiodothyronine, a hormone synthesized and secreted by the thyroid which constitutes the main thyroid hormone used by the tissues, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001292.name: plasma triiodothyronine level
CMO:0001292.def: The amount of triiodothyronine, a hormone synthesized and secreted by the thyroid which constitutes the main thyroid hormone used by the tissues, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001293.name: serum triiodothyronine level
CMO:0001293.def: The amount of triiodothyronine, a hormone synthesized and secreted by the thyroid which constitutes the main thyroid hormone used by the tissues, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001294.name: blood glucagon level
CMO:0001294.def: The amount of glucagon, a peptide secreted by pancreatic alpha cells which plays an important role in regulation of blood glucose concentration, ketone metabolism, and other biochemical and physiological processes, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001295.name: serum glucagon level
CMO:0001295.def: The amount of glucagon, a peptide secreted by pancreatic alpha cells which plays an important role in regulation of blood glucose concentration, ketone metabolism, and other biochemical and physiological processes, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001296.name: plasma glucagon level
CMO:0001296.def: The amount of glucagon, a peptide secreted by pancreatic alpha cells which plays an important role in regulation of blood glucose concentration, ketone metabolism, and other biochemical and physiological processes, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001297.name: blood insulin-like growth factor 1 level
CMO:0001297.def: The amount of insulin-like growth factor 1, a basic peptide with growth-regulating, insulin-like, and mitogenic activities which is largely dependent on growth hormone, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001298.name: serum insulin-like growth factor 1 level
CMO:0001298.def: The amount of insulin-like growth factor 1, a basic peptide with growth-regulating, insulin-like, and mitogenic activities which is largely dependent on growth hormone, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001299.name: plasma insulin-like growth factor 1 level
CMO:0001299.def: The amount of insulin-like growth factor 1, a basic peptide with growth-regulating, insulin-like, and mitogenic activities which is largely dependent on growth hormone, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001300.name: serum insulin-like growth factor 2 level
CMO:0001300.def: The amount of insulin-like growth factor 1, a neutral peptide with growth-regulating, insulin-like, and mitogenic activities which is largely dependent on somatotropin, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001301.name: plasma insulin-like growth factor 2 level
CMO:0001301.def: The amount of insulin-like growth factor 1, a neutral peptide with growth-regulating, insulin-like, and mitogenic activities which is largely dependent on somatotropin, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001302.name: blood insulin-like growth factor 2 level
CMO:0001302.def: The amount of insulin-like growth factor 1, a neutral peptide with growth-regulating, insulin-like, and mitogenic activities which is largely dependent on somatotropin, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001303.name: blood lactate level
CMO:0001303.def: The amount of lactate, a salt of lactic acid which is produced in the body by anaerobic metabolism of carbohydrate, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0001304.name: serum lactate level
CMO:0001304.def: The amount of lactate, a salt of lactic acid which is produced in the body by anaerobic metabolism of carbohydrate, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0001305.name: plasma lactate level
CMO:0001305.def: The amount of lactate, a salt of lactic acid which is produced in the body by anaerobic metabolism of carbohydrate, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0001306.name: milk yield
CMO:0001306.def: The total amount of milk produced by a lactating mammal over a specific period of time.

CMO:0001307.name: average daily milk yield
CMO:0001307.def: The average amount of milk produced by a lactating mammal per day.

CMO:0001308.name: 305-day milk yield
CMO:0001308.def: The total amount of milk produced by a lactating mammal over a 305-day lactation period.

CMO:0001309.name: milk urea nitrogen measurement
CMO:0001309.def: Any measurement of the urea-associated nitrogen in milk.

CMO:0001310.name: milk urea nitrogen content
CMO:0001310.def: The amount in milk of the portion of nitrogen that derives from its content of urea.

CMO:0001311.name: milk urea nitrogen yield
CMO:0001311.def: The total amount of milk urea nitrogen, the portion of nitrogen derived from urea, produced over a specific period of time.

CMO:0001312.name: feed conversion ratio
CMO:0001312.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of feed consumed over a specific period of time is divided by body weight gain for the same period.

CMO:0001313.name: dry matter intake
CMO:0001313.def: Amount of feed consumed, excluding water content, over a specific period of time.

CMO:0001314.name: average daily food intake weight
CMO:0001314.def: Average weight or heaviness of food (i.e. material, usually of plant or animal origin, that contains essential nutrients such as carbohydrates, fats, proteins, vitamins, and/or minerals and that is ingested and assimilated by an organism to produce energy, stimulate growth, and maintain life) consumed per day.

CMO:0001315.name: residual feed intake
CMO:0001315.def: The actual weight of feed consumed minus the expected feed intake.

CMO:0001316.name: total heart ventricle weight
CMO:0001316.def: The combined weight of both ventricles of the heart, that is, their heaviness or the degree to which they are drawn toward the earth by gravity. The ventricles are the lower chambers of the heart that pump blood away from the heart either to the lungs to be oxygenated or, once oxygenated, to the rest of the body.

CMO:0001317.name: calculated total heart ventricle weight
CMO:0001317.def: A measurement of the combined weight of both heart ventricles that has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001318.name: total heart ventricle weight as a percentage of body weight
CMO:0001318.def: A calculated value in which the combined weight of both the left and right ventricles, the lower chambers of the heart that pump blood away from the heart either to the lungs to be oxygenated or, once oxygenated, to the rest of the body, is presented as percentage of the total weight of the body thus normalizing it to body weight.

CMO:0001319.name: lumbar vertebrae number
CMO:0001319.def: The number of bones of the portion of the spinal column between the thoracic and sacral vertebrae.

CMO:0001320.name: rib number
CMO:0001320.def: The number of the elongated, curved bones forming the main portion of the bony wall of the chest.

CMO:0001321.name: blood gas measurement
CMO:0001321.def: Any measurement of a gas or gases dissolved in the blood, including oxygen, nitrogen carbon dioxide and/or hydrogen.

CMO:0001322.name: blood carbon dioxide level
CMO:0001322.def: The concentration of carbon dioxide (the product of the combustion of carbon with an excess of oxygen) in the blood.

CMO:0001324.name: oxygen saturation
CMO:0001324.def: The amount of oxygen bound to hemoglobin in the blood expressed as a percentage of the maximal binding capacity.

CMO:0001325.name: base excess
CMO:0001325.def: A measure of the deviation from normal blood acid-base balance expressed as the amount of acid required to titrate a sample of whole arterial blood to its normal pH.

CMO:0001326.name: male reproductive organ weight
CMO:0001326.def: The heaviness, that is, the degree to which a physical mass is drawn toward the earth by gravity, of any of the male reproductive organs (any organ which is part of the complex of male gonads, associated ducts, and external genitalia concerned with sexual reproduction).

CMO:0001327.name: male reproductive organ volume
CMO:0001327.def: Measurement of the size of the three dimensional space occupied by any male reproductive organ.

CMO:0001328.name: testis volume
CMO:0001328.def: Measurement of the size of the three dimensional space occupied by one or both testes, the paired egg-shaped glands normally situated in the scrotum, in which the spermatozoa develop.

CMO:0001329.name: single testis volume
CMO:0001329.def: The volume of a single testis, one of the paired egg-shaped glands normally situated in the scrotum, in which the spermatozoa develop.

CMO:0001330.name: both testes volume
CMO:0001330.def: The combined volume of both testes, the paired egg-shaped glands normally situated in the scrotum, in which the spermatozoa develop.

CMO:0001331.name: body height at withers
CMO:0001331.def: The vertical measurement of the body of a four-legged animal, from the ground to the high part of the back between the shoulder blades.

CMO:0001332.name: body height at hip
CMO:0001332.def: The vertical measurement of the body of a four-legged animal, from the ground to the point of the hip.

CMO:0001333.name: egg weight, fowl
CMO:0001333.def: The relative heaviness of an ovum in combination with its nutrient stores and protective outer coverings, of a bird.

CMO:0001334.name: egg yolk measurement, fowl
CMO:0001334.def: Any measurement of the portion of the egg of a bird that consists of protein and fat from which the early embryo gets its main nourishment.

CMO:0001335.name: eggshell measurement, fowl
CMO:0001335.def: Any measurement of the outermost protective covering of a bird's egg.

CMO:0001336.name: egg albumen measurement, fowl
CMO:0001336.def: Any measurement of the nutritive and protective gelatinous substance (egg white) surrounding the yolk of a bird's egg.

CMO:0001337.name: eggshell weight, fowl
CMO:0001337.def: The relative heaviness of the rinsed and dried outermost protective covering of a bird's egg.

CMO:0001338.name: eggshell percentage, fowl
CMO:0001338.def: The weight of the rinsed and dried eggshell, expressed as a percentage of total egg weight.

CMO:0001339.name: eggshell color, fowl
CMO:0001339.def: The visually perceived hue of the outermost protective covering of a bird's egg.

CMO:0001340.name: eggshell strength, fowl
CMO:0001340.def: The force required to fracture the hard outermost covering of a bird's egg.

CMO:0001341.name: eggshell thickness, fowl
CMO:0001341.def: The thickness, that is, the length or extent of the dimension between the inner and outer surfaces of an eggshell, the outermost protective covering of a bird's egg.

CMO:0001342.name: egg albumen weight, fowl
CMO:0001342.def: The relative heaviness of the nutritive and protective gelatinous substance (egg white) surrounding the yolk of a bird's egg.

CMO:0001343.name: egg albumen height, fowl
CMO:0001343.def: The height of the inner thick albumen (egg white) when a bird's egg is broken onto a flat surface.

CMO:0001344.name: egg albumen percentage, fowl
CMO:0001344.def: The weight of the nutritive and protective gelatinous substance (egg white) surrounding the yolk of a bird's egg, expressed as a percentage of total egg weight.

CMO:0001345.name: egg length, fowl
CMO:0001345.def: The length from end to end, that is, the linear extent along the longest axis, of a bird's egg, the ovum in combination with its nutrient stores and protective outer coverings.

CMO:0001346.name: egg width, fowl
CMO:0001346.def: The diameter across the short axis of a bird's egg, the ovum in combination with its protective outer coverings.

CMO:0001347.name: egg specific gravity, fowl
CMO:0001347.def: The ratio of the mass of a bird's egg to the mass of an equal volume of water at a specified temperature.

CMO:0001348.name: mean platelet volume
CMO:0001348.def: Measurement of the average size of the three dimensional space occupied by a blood platelet, a minute, irregularly shaped, disklike, non-nucleated cytoplasmic body found in blood that functions to promote blood clotting.

CMO:0001349.name: plateletcrit
CMO:0001349.def: The proportion of blood volume that is occupied by platelets, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001350.name: platelet distribution width
CMO:0001350.def: A measurement of platelet anisocytosis calculated from the distribution of individual platelet volumes.

CMO:0001351.name: viable sperm count to total sperm count ratio
CMO:0001351.def: Number of live sperm in a sample divided by the total number of sperm  in that sample, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001352.name: abnormal sperm count to total sperm count ratio
CMO:0001352.def: Number of sperm which display visible defects divided by the total number of sperm in a sample, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001353.name: semen measurement
CMO:0001353.def: Any measurement of the viscous secretion of the male reproductive organs, typically containing spermatazoa and secretions of the testes, seminal vesicles, prostate, and bulbourethral glands.

CMO:0001354.name: semen volume
CMO:0001354.def: Volume of semen, the viscous secretion of the male reproductive organs, typically containing spermatazoa and secretions of the testes, seminal vesicles, prostate, and bulbourethral glands, in a single ejaculate.

CMO:0001355.name: semen pH
CMO:0001355.def: Measurement of the acidity, expressed as the negative logarithm of hydrogen ion concentration, of a sample of semen, the viscous secretion of the male reproductive organs, typically containing spermatazoa and secretions of the testes, seminal vesicles, prostate, and bulbourethral glands.

CMO:0001356.name: red blood cell measurement
CMO:0001356.def: Any measurement of a single red blood cell, one of the hemoglobin-containing blood cells that transport oxygen and carbon dioxide to and from the tissues, or of all of the red blood cells in a sample of blood.

CMO:0001357.name: red blood cell Na+/K+ ATPase activity
CMO:0001357.def: Measurement of the level of activity of the erythrocyte sodium-potassium adenosine triphosphatase, an enzyme which catalyzes the active, ATP-dependent transport of sodium and potassium ions across cell membranes, in a specified volume of red blood cells.
synonyms: red blood cell sodium/potassium ATPase activity
red blood cell sodium-potassium adenosine triphosphatase activity

CMO:0001358.name: calculated blood glucagon level
CMO:0001358.def: Measurement of the amount of glucagon in a specified volume of blood, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001359.name: blood insulin to glucagon ratio
CMO:0001359.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of insulin in a sample of blood is divided by the amount of glucagon in that sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the glucagon level.

CMO:0001360.name: calculated blood thyroid hormone level
CMO:0001360.def: A measurement of one or more thyroid hormones, the hormones produced by the thyroid gland that are primarily responsible for regulation of metabolism, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0001361.name: blood triiodothyronine to thyroxine ratio
CMO:0001361.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of triiodothyronine in a specified volume of blood is divided by the amount of thyroxine in the same sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to thyroxine level.

CMO:0001362.name: calculated blood lipoprotein level
CMO:0001362.def: A measurement of the amount of lipoprotein(s) in blood which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.  Lipoprotein refers to any of a group of conjugated proteins that have at least one lipid component.

CMO:0001363.name: calculated serum lipoprotein level
CMO:0001363.def: A measurement of the amount of lipoprotein(s) in serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.  Lipoprotein refers to any of a group of conjugated proteins that have at least one lipid component.

CMO:0001364.name: calculated plasma lipoprotein level
CMO:0001364.def: A measurement of the amount of lipoprotein(s) in plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.  Lipoprotein refers to any of a group of conjugated proteins that have at least one lipid component.

CMO:0001365.name: serum high density lipoprotein cholesterol to low density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio
CMO:0001365.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of HDL, small-particle lipoproteins that promote transport of cholesterol from extrahepatic tissue to the liver for excretion in the bile, in a specified volume of serum is divided by the amount  of LDL, relatively large-particle lipoproteins that transport cholesterol to extrahepatic tissue, in the same sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0001366.name: horn morphological measurement
CMO:0001366.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of one or more horns of an animal. A horn is a usually pointed projection of skin on the head of various animals consisting of a covering of keratin and other proteins surrounding a core of live bone.

CMO:0001367.name: skin measurement
CMO:0001367.def: Any measurement of the tough, supple cutaneous membrane that covers the surface of the body.

CMO:0001368.name: skin morphological measurement
CMO:0001368.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of the tough, supple cutaneous membrane that covers the surface of the body.

CMO:0001369.name: horn length
CMO:0001369.def: Length from base to tip of the pointed projections, often found in pairs, on the head of an animal.

CMO:0001370.name: horn circumference
CMO:0001370.def: Distance measured around the base of the pointed projections, often found in pairs, on the head of an animal.

CMO:0001371.name: back fat thickness, last rib
CMO:0001371.def: Depth of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the posterior trunk area at the location of the last rib.

CMO:0001372.name: back fat thickness, last lumbar vertebra
CMO:0001372.def: Depth of subcutaneous adipose tissue in the posterior trunk area at the location of the last lumbar vertebra.

CMO:0001373.name: offspring measurement
CMO:0001373.def: Any measurement of the direct progeny of a parent or parents.

CMO:0001374.name: number of offspring
CMO:0001374.def: The number of direct progeny born, either per individual gestation or the total over a specified period of time.
synonyms: number of children ever born measurement

CMO:0001375.name: stillborn offspring number
CMO:0001375.def: Number of offspring per litter that are dead at parturition.

CMO:0001376.name: weaned offspring number
CMO:0001376.def: Number of direct progeny that survive to the age of weaning, that is, the discontinuation of the offspring's dependence on its mother's milk.

CMO:0001377.name: femur morphological measurement
CMO:0001377.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of the femur, the major bone in the upper portion of the hindlimb of quadrupeds or the lower limb of bipeds.

CMO:0001378.name: tibia morphological measurement
CMO:0001378.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of the tibia, the major bone in the lower part of the hindlimb, which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

CMO:0001379.name: humerus morphological measurement
CMO:0001379.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of the humerus, the bone in the upper portion of the forelimb  that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

CMO:0001380.name: humerus area
CMO:0001380.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through the bone in the upper portion of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below.

CMO:0001381.name: mid-humerus width
CMO:0001381.def: Distance across the humerus, the bone in the upper portion of the forelimb that articulates with the scapula above and the radius and ulna below, measured midway between the two ends of the bone.

CMO:0001382.name: tibia area measurement
CMO:0001382.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg of bipeds or hindlimb of quadrupeds which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

CMO:0001383.name: milk polyunsaturated fatty acid percentage
CMO:0001383.def: The amount in milk fat of all organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons in which the carbon chain has two or more double or triple carbon-carbon bonds, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001384.name: milk monounsaturated fatty acid percentage
CMO:0001384.def: The amount in milk fat of all organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons in which the carbon chain has only one double or triple carbon-carbon bond, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001385.name: milk saturated fatty acid percentage
CMO:0001385.def: The amount in milk fat of all organic, monobasic acids derived from hydrocarbons in which the carbon chain contains only single carbon-carbon bonds, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001386.name: milk fatty acid cis-10-C17:1 percentage
CMO:0001386.def: The amount in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with a seventeen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-10, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001387.name: milk fatty acid cis-11-C18:1 percentage
CMO:0001387.def: The amount in milk fat of an unsaturated fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and a cis double bond at C-11, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001388.name: milk fatty acid C18:3 (n-3) percentage
CMO:0001388.def: The amount in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-3 fatty acid with an eighteen-carbon backbone and three double bonds, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001389.name: milk fatty acid cis-5,8,11,14-C20:4 percentage
CMO:0001389.def: The amount in milk fat of an unsaturated, omega-6 fatty acid with a twenty-carbon backbone and cis double bonds at C-5, C-8, C11, and C-14, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001390.name: milk fatty acid C17:0 percentage
CMO:0001390.def: The amount in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a seventeen-carbon backbone, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001391.name: milk fatty acid C4:0 percentage
CMO:0001391.def: The amount in milk fat of a saturated fatty acid with a four-carbon backbone, expressed as a percentage of the total fatty acid amount.

CMO:0001392.name: milk omega-6 to omega-3 fatty acid ratio
CMO:0001392.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount in milk fat of unsaturated, omega-6 fatty acids is divided by the amount of unsaturated, omega-3 fatty acids and expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001393.name: milk palmitoleic to palmitic acid ratio
CMO:0001393.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount in milk fat of the 16 carbon monounsaturated fatty acid palmitoleic acid is divided by the amount of the 16 carbon saturated fatty acid palmitic acid and expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0001394.name: longissimus muscle weight
CMO:0001394.def: The weight or the measure of the heaviness of the longissimus muscle of the back.  The longissimus is the longest subdivision of the sacrospinalis located lateral to the semispinalis and extends forward into the transverse processes of the posterior cervical vertebrae.

CMO:0001395.name: semitendinosus muscle weight
CMO:0001395.def: The weight or the measure of the heaviness of the of the semitendinosus muscle, one of three posterior femoral muscles of the thigh which functions to flex the leg, to rotate it medially after flexion, and to extend the thigh.

CMO:0001396.name: semimembranosus muscle weight
CMO:0001396.def: The weight or the measure of the heaviness of the semimembranosus muscle, one of three posterior femoral muscles. Situated at the back and medial side of the thigh, it originates in a thick tendon attached to the tuberosity of the ischium and inserts into the horizontal groove on the medial condyle of the tibia. It functions to flex the leg, to rotate it medially after flexion, and to extend the thigh.

CMO:0001397.name: biceps femoris muscle weight
CMO:0001397.def: The weight or the measure of the heaviness of one of the posterior femoral muscles whose long head has origin from the tuberosity of the ischium and whose short head has origin from the lower half of the lateral lip of the linea aspera, with insertion into the head of the fibula, whose action flexes the knee and rotates the leg laterally.

CMO:0001398.name: gluteus medius muscle weight
CMO:0001398.def: The weight or the measure of the heaviness of the leg muscle with origin in the ilium and insertion to the surface of the greater trochanter, whose action abducts and rotates the thigh.

CMO:0001399.name: body weight loss
CMO:0001399.def: A calculated measurement of the absolute, relative or proportional decrease in total body weight of an individual over time.

CMO:0001400.name: maximum body weight loss to initial body weight ratio
CMO:0001400.def: A calculated measurement in which the largest weight loss recorded between two time points or two conditions is divided by the body weight under basal conditions and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: ratio of maximum body weight loss to basal body weight

CMO:0001401.name: relapsing-remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0001401.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display relapsing-remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (R-EAE) at a point in time or develop R-EAE within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. Relapsing-remitting EAE is an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells where such induction results in a disease characterized by repeated symptomatic attacks followed by complete or almost complete improvement.
synonyms: relapsing/remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis incidence/prevalence measurement

CMO:0001402.name: percentage of study population developing relapsing-remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis during a period of time
CMO:0001402.def: The number of new cases of relapsing-remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (R-EAE) appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. R-EAE is an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells where such induction results in a disease characterized by repeated symptomatic attacks followed by complete or almost complete improvement.
synonyms: percentage of study population developing relapsing/remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis during a period of time

CMO:0001403.name: percentage of study population displaying relapsing-remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis at a point in time
CMO:0001403.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display relapsing-remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (R-EAE) at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. R-EAE is an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells where such induction results in a disease characterized by repeated symptomatic attacks followed by complete or almost complete improvement.
synonyms: percentage of study population displaying relapsing/remitting experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis at a point in time

CMO:0001404.name: experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis onset/diagnosis measurement
CMO:0001404.def: Any measurement which expresses a quantity related to the beginning, early stages or development of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), or to the official determination of a disease as the cause of the observed symptom(s) of EAE.  EAE is an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells.

CMO:0001405.name: distance run on treadmill
CMO:0001405.def: A measurement of the linear equivalent of the extent of forward progress attained while running on a treadmill, a piece of equipment consisting of a continuously moving belt which allows the action of walking or running without the entire body moving forward.

CMO:0001406.name: longest distance run on treadmill
CMO:0001406.def: This is a measurement of the greatest reached or recorded linear equivalent of the extent of forward progress attained while running on a treadmill, a piece of equipment consisting of a continuously moving belt which allows the action of walking or running without the entire body moving forward. This measurement refers to the longest distance run before the subject experienced exhaustion.
synonyms: longest distance run until exhaustion on treadmill
maximum distance run until exhaustion on treadmill

CMO:0001407.name: ethanol drink intake rate
CMO:0001407.def: The amount of ethanol, a colorless volatile flammable liquid CH3CH2OH that is the intoxicating agent in liquors, consumed per unit time.

CMO:0001408.name: artery lumen measurement
CMO:0001408.def: Any measurement of the cavity or channel within an artery, one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues.

CMO:0001409.name: artery lumen area
CMO:0001409.def: A measurement of the two-dimensional extent of the enclosed cavity or channel in a cross-section of an artery, one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues. For an artery with a neointimal lesion, the cross-sectional area of the lesion would be subtracted from the circular vessel area to obtain the artery lumen area.

CMO:0001410.name: artery wall measurement
CMO:0001410.def: Any measurement of the fibrous and muscular structure of one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues. The wall of an artery is composed of three layers: the tunica intima, the inner coat; the tunica media, the middle coat; and the tunica adventitia, the outer coat.

CMO:0001411.name: artery tunica media measurement
CMO:0001411.def: Any measurement of the tunica media, or middle coat, of the wall of an artery, one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues.

CMO:0001412.name: artery tunica media area
CMO:0001412.def: A direct measurement of two dimensional extent of the tunica media, the middle coat of the arterial wall, in a cross-section of an artery, one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues. The total area of the tunica media gives an indication of the thickness of the arterial wall.

CMO:0001413.name: artery tunica media thickness
CMO:0001413.def: A calculated measurement of the average width of the tunica media, the middle layer of the arterial wall. Can be calculated using the media area and the length of the internal elastic lamina.

CMO:0001414.name: artery neointimal hyperplastic lesion area
CMO:0001414.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through a single hyperplastic lesion of the tunica intima, that is, the inner coat of the arterial wall, or a measurement of the total area occupied by hyperplastic lesions of the tunica intima in a cross-section of an artery, one of the large blood vessels carrying blood in a direction away from the heart to the tissues. A hyperplastic lesion is a localized pathological increase in the number of cells of an organ or tissue resulting from an increased rate of cellular division due to injury or disease; especially one that is circumscribed and well defined.

CMO:0001415.name: calculated artery neointimal hyperplastic lesion area
CMO:0001415.def: Any measurement of one or more hyperplastic lesions of the arterial tunica intima which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process.

CMO:0001416.name: artery neointimal hyperplastic lesion area to total wall area ratio
CMO:0001416.def: A calculated measurement in which the area of the arterial tunica intima occupied by one or more hyperplastic lesions is divided by the total cross-sectional area of the artery wall and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: ratio of neointimal hyperplasia area to total wall area of artery

CMO:0001417.name: lesioned artery residual lumen area
CMO:0001417.def: The area of the arterial lumen remaining when the luminal space is restricted by a pathological process, e.g. hyperplasia.
synonyms: residual lumen area of diseased artery

CMO:0001418.name: experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis severity measurement
CMO:0001418.def: Any measurement of the degree to which the presentation of the experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis disease state, i.e. the animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells, causes pain or damage.

CMO:0001419.name: experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis severity score
CMO:0001419.def: A rating, usually expressed numerically and based on the degree to which certain qualities or conditions are present, of the degree to which the presentation of the experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis disease state, i.e. the animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells, causes pain or damage.

CMO:0001420.name: calculated liver tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0001420.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process of a liver lesion which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0001421.name: ratio of proliferating cell nuclear antigen-positive cells to total liver tumorous lesion cells
CMO:0001421.def: A calculated value in which the number of proliferating cell nuclear antigen-positive cells is divided by the total number of liver tumorous lesion cells and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: ratio of PCNA-positive cells to total liver tumorous lesion cells
ratio of proliferating cell nuclear antigen-positive nuclei to total liver tumorous lesion nuclei

CMO:0001422.name: post-insult time to onset of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis
CMO:0001422.def: Measurement of the length of time between introduction of a disease-producing stimulus to the observation of symptoms of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells.

CMO:0001423.name: experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis progression measurement
CMO:0001423.def: Any measurement related to the course of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells, for example, a series of stages or a succession of states in the disease process or the duration of the disease state.

CMO:0001424.name: experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis duration
CMO:0001424.def: Measurement of the length of time between onset of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE), an animal model of brain inflammation in which inflammation is induced through immunization of the animal with central nervous system antigens or by the passive transfer of autoreactive T cells, and either the point at which the measurement is taken, the resolution of symptoms or the death of the organism.

CMO:0001425.name: both kidneys dry weight
