CMO:0002569.def: The amount of norepinephrine eliminated from the body in the urine per unit time. Norepinephrine is a catecholamine hormone and neurotransmitter, secreted by the adrenal medulla and the nerve endings of the sympathetic nervous system, that causes vasoconstriction and increases heart rate, blood pressure, and blood sugar level.

CMO:0002570.name: urine catecholamine measurement
CMO:0002570.def: The quantification of any parameter related to one or more catecholamines, any of a group of amines composed of a pyrocatechol molecule and the aliphatic portion of an amine that have important physiological effects as neurotransmitters and hormones, in urine, the fluid waste product excreted by the kidneys.

CMO:0002571.name: urine vanillylmandelic acid excretion rate
CMO:0002571.def: The amount of vanillylmandelic acid eliminated from the body in the urine per unit time. Vanillylmandelic acid is the major urinary metabolite of adrenal and sympathetic catecholamines such as epinephrine and norepinephrine.

CMO:0002572.name: calculated urine catecholamine excretion rate
CMO:0002572.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of one or more catecholamines eliminated from the body in the urine per unit time.

CMO:0002573.name: absolute change in urine epinephrine excretion rate
CMO:0002573.def: The calculated difference in urine epinephrine excretion rate between two points in time or two conditions expressed as the result of the subtraction in and of itself without comparison by ratio with another quantity.
synonyms: absolute change in urine adrenaline excretion rate

CMO:0002574.name: absolute change in urine norepinephrine excretion rate
CMO:0002574.def: The calculated difference in urine norepinephrine excretion rate between two points in time or two conditions expressed as the result of the subtraction in and of itself without comparison by ratio with another quantity.
synonyms: absolute change in urine noradrenaline excretion rate

CMO:0002575.name: absolute change in urine vanillylmandelic acid excretion rate
CMO:0002575.def: The calculated difference in urine vanillylmandelic acid excretion rate between two points in time or two conditions expressed as the result of the subtraction in and of itself without comparison by ratio with another quantity.
synonyms: absolute change in urine 3-methoxy-4-hydroxymandelic acid excretion rate
absolute change in urine VMA excretion rate

CMO:0002576.name: pancreas molecular composition measurement
CMO:0002576.def: Any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of a sample of pancreatic tissue.

CMO:0002577.name: tissue protein/peptide composition measurement
CMO:0002577.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more proteins (complex high molecular weight organic compounds containing carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, and sulfur consisting of alpha-amino acids joined by peptide linkages) or peptides (low molecular weight compounds composed of at least two amino acids joined by peptide linkages) in a specified tissue or set of tissues.

CMO:0002578.name: brain protein/peptide composition measurement
CMO:0002578.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more proteins or peptides in a specified sample of brain tissue.

CMO:0002579.name: aorta wall protein/peptide composition measurement
CMO:0002579.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more proteins or peptides in a specified sample of tissue from the wall of the aorta.

CMO:0002580.name: pancreas protein/peptide composition measurement
CMO:0002580.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more proteins or peptides in any sample of pancreas tissue.

CMO:0002581.name: whole pancreas protein/peptide composition measurement
CMO:0002581.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more proteins or peptides in a specified sample of tissue derived from the entire pancreas without division or fractionation of the tissue (for example separation of the endocrine and exocrine pancreas).
synonyms: total pancreatic tissue protein/peptide composition measurement

CMO:0002582.name: pancreatic islet protein/peptide composition measurement
CMO:0002582.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more proteins or peptides in a specified sample of tissue derived from one or more pancreatic islets.
synonyms: pancreatic islet tissue protein/peptide composition measurement

CMO:0002583.name: tissue hormone composition measurement
CMO:0002583.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more hormones in a specified tissue or set of tissues. A hormone is any complex chemical substance produced in one part or organ of the body that initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0002584.name: tissue peptide hormone composition measurement
CMO:0002584.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more hormones in a specified tissue or set of tissues. A peptide hormone is a molecular chain compound composed of two or more amino acids joined by peptide bonds that is produced in one part or organ of the body and initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0002585.name: pancreas peptide hormone composition measurement
CMO:0002585.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more peptide hormones in a sample of tissue from the pancreas.

CMO:0002586.name: pancreas hormone composition measurement
CMO:0002586.def: Any measurement involving the composition, that is, the absolute amount, relative amount or type of one or more hormones in a sample of tissue from the pancreas.

CMO:0002587.name: pancreas insulin level
CMO:0002587.def: Measurement of the amount of insulin in a sample of tissue from the pancreas without division or fractionation of the tissue (for example separation of the endocrine and exocrine pancreas). Insulin is the fuel-regulating peptide hormone which is formed from proinsulin in the beta cells of the pancreatic islets and which promotes the storage of glucose and the uptake of amino acids, increases protein and lipid synthesis, and inhibits lipolysis and gluconeogenesis.

CMO:0002588.name: calculated pancreas insulin level
CMO:0002588.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of insulin in a sample of tissue from the pancreas without division or fractionation of the tissue (for example separation of the endocrine and exocrine pancreas).

CMO:0002589.name: blood pressure time series calculated parameter
CMO:0002589.def: A calculated parameter derived from a a sequence of blood pressure measurements taken sequentially and ordered in time. A parameter is a mathematical and statistical variable in a model system that partially or completely characterises the mathematical model.

CMO:0002590.name: blood pressure time series baroreceptor response calculation parameter
CMO:0002590.def: A mathematical and statistical variable in a model system that partially or completely characterises the baroreceptor response in a blood pressure time series calculation. The baroreceptor response is the system whereby specific nerve terminals that stabilize moment to moment blood pressure variability in the carotid sinus and aortic arch sense deviations from the baseline pressure and initiate signals that dampens such deviations.

CMO:0002591.name: blood pressure time series first order moving average coefficient
CMO:0002591.def: The first order coefficient parameter derived from a blood pressure time series moving average (also known as a rolling average, running average, moving mean, or rolling mean) calculation.

CMO:0002592.name: blood pressure time series fractal parameter
CMO:0002592.def: The fractal parameter derived from a blood pressure time series calculation based on a autoregressive fractionally integrated moving average time series model (ARFIMA, FARIMA, or fARIMA).

CMO:0002593.name: blood pressure time series experimental set point of the baroreceptor response
CMO:0002593.def: The experimental set point parameter of the blood pressure time series baroreceptor response calculation.

CMO:0002594.name: blood pressure time series average exponential scaling factor of the baroreceptor response
CMO:0002594.def: The average exponential scaling factor parameter of the blood pressure time series baroreceptor response calculation.

CMO:0002595.name: blood pressure time series linear term first order parameter
CMO:0002595.def: A parameter based on a blood pressure time series calculation using a first order mechanistic model.

CMO:0002596.name: blood pressure time series linear term second order parameter
CMO:0002596.def: A parameter based on a blood pressure time series calculation using a second order mechanistic model.

CMO:0002597.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic  posterior wall thickness
CMO:0002597.def: The thickness or depth (i.e. the measurement of the two-dimensional extent of the distance between the inner and outer surfaces) of the dorsal/posterior wall of the left ventricle of the heart at the end of diastole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally relaxed. The dorsal wall is the portion of the muscle enclosing the ventricle which is closest to the spine and farthest from the chest wall of the organism.
synonyms: end-diastolic heart left ventricle posterior wall thickness

CMO:0002598.name: calculated serum acetaminophen level
CMO:0002598.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of acetaminophen, an analgesic and antipyretic with effects similar to aspirin but only weakly anti-inflammatory, in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0002599.name: serum acetaminophen level area under curve
CMO:0002599.def: A calculated measurement in which a series of measurements of the amount of acetaminophen in a specified volume of serum is plotted against time for a single individual and the extent of the two dimensional region bounded by the curve and the axes of the graph is determined.
synonyms: serum paracetamol level area under curve (AUC)

CMO:0002600.name: hepatocellular carcinoma tumor number
CMO:0002600.def: A value or quantity determined by count of hepatocellular carcinoma tumors in the liver or in a specified sample of liver tissue, i.e. growths that result from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells, that serve no physiological function, and that display the properties of anaplasia, invasiveness and metastasis. Hepatocellular carcinomas (HCC) are primary malignant neoplasms of hepatocytes, epithelial liver cells which perform the functions of the liver such as transformation of carbohydrates, synthesis of cholesterol, bile salts and phospholipids, detoxification of exogenous substances, etc. HCC is often associated with cirrhosis and hepatitis B and/or C infection.

CMO:0002601.name: percentage of study population displaying hepatocellular carcinoma at a point in time
CMO:0002601.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display hepatocellular carcinoma at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0002602.name: percentage of study population developing hepatocellular carcinoma during a period of time
CMO:0002602.def: The number of new cases of hepatocellular carcinoma appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0002603.name: hepatocellular carcinoma incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0002603.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display hepatocellular carcinoma at a point in time or develop hepatocellular carcinoma within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. Hepatocellular carcinomas (HCC) are primary malignant neoplasms of hepatocytes, epithelial liver cells which perform the functions of the liver such as transformation of carbohydrates, synthesis of cholesterol, bile salts and phospholipids, detoxification of exogenous substances, etc. HCC is often associated with cirrhosis and hepatitis B and/or C infection.

CMO:0002604.name: plasma E. coli specific antibody titer
CMO:0002604.def: The amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds with Escherichia coli, a Gram negative rod-shaped bacterium, in a specific volume of plasma expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: plasma Escherichia coli specific antibody titer

CMO:0002605.name: calculated plasma E. coli specific antibody level
CMO:0002605.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds with Escherichia coli, a Gram negative rod-shaped bacterium, in a specific volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.
synonyms: calculated plasma Escherichia coli specific antibody level

CMO:0002606.name: blood anti-DNA antibody level
CMO:0002606.def: The amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds to deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), a molecule composed of the sugar deoxyribose, phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or thymine, in a specified sample of blood.

CMO:0002607.name: blood anti-collagen antibody level
CMO:0002607.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to one or more types of collagen, the fibrous protein constituent of bone, cartilage, tendon, and other connective tissue, in a specified sample of blood.

CMO:0002608.name: blood anti-laminin antibody level
CMO:0002608.def: The amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that specifically binds to laminin, a large polypeptide glycoprotein component of basement membranes, in a specified sample of blood.

CMO:0002609.name: serum immunoglobulin M-type rheumatoid factor level
CMO:0002609.def: The amount in a specified sample of serum of rheumatoid factor that is expressed as an immunoglobulin M (IgM) molecule. Rheumatoid factor (RF) is an autoantibody against the Fc portion of IgG found in rheumatoid arthritis and some other autoimmune diseases. RF and IgG join to form immune complexes that contribute to the disease process.

CMO:0002610.name: serum immunoglobulin G-type rheumatoid factor level
CMO:0002610.def: The amount in a specified sample of serum of rheumatoid factor that is expressed as an immunoglobulin G (IgG) molecule. Rheumatoid factor (RF) is an autoantibody against the Fc portion of IgG found in rheumatoid arthritis and some other autoimmune diseases. RF and IgG join to form immune complexes that contribute to the disease process.

CMO:0002611.name: serum immunoglobulin G-type rheumatoid factor titer
CMO:0002611.def: The level of rheumatoid factor that is expressed as an immunoglobulin G (IgG) molecule  in a specified sample of serum, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002612.name: serum immunoglobulin M-type rheumatoid factor titer
CMO:0002612.def: The amount of rheumatoid factor that is expressed as an immunoglobulin M (IgM) molecule in a specified sample of serum, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002613.name: blood autoantibody titer
CMO:0002613.def: Measurement of the amount of a specific autoantibody in a specified sample of blood, determined as the maximal dilution of the sample at which that antibody can still be detected. The value represents the denominator of the dilution ratio, i.e., a titer of 32 means that the sample can be maximally diluted 1/32 and still contain enough antibody to be detected.

CMO:0002614.name: autoantibody level
CMO:0002614.def: Measurement of the amount of an autoantibody in a specified sample. An autoantibody is an antibody that attacks the cells, tissues, native proteins, or other endogenous molecules of the organism in which it was formed.

CMO:0002615.name: plasma autoantibody titer
CMO:0002615.def: Measurement of the amount of one or more autoantibodies in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002616.name: serum autoantibody titer
CMO:0002616.def: Measurement of the amount of one or more autoantibodies in a specified sample of serum, expressed as the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002617.name: blood antibody titer
CMO:0002617.def: A measurement of the amount of a specific antibody in a specified sample of blood, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002618.name: plasma antibody titer
CMO:0002618.def: A measurement of the amount of a specific antibody in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained. Plasma is the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0002619.name: serum antibody titer
CMO:0002619.def: A measurement of the amount of a specific antibody in a specified sample of serum, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained. Serum is the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0002620.name: serum anti-rat type 2 collagen antibody level
CMO:0002620.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds rat-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.
synonyms: serum anti-rat type II collagen antibody level

CMO:0002621.name: serum anti-rat type 2 collagen autoantibody level
CMO:0002621.def: The amount in a specified sample of serum, of an immunoglobulin molecule, specifically one produced by the immune system of a rat against its own collagen, possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds rat-derived type 2 collagen.
synonyms: serum anti-rat type II collagen autoantibody level
serum rat anti-self type 2 collagen antibody level

CMO:0002622.name: serum anti-porcine type 2 collagen antibody level
CMO:0002622.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds pig-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.
synonyms: serum anti-porcine type II collagen antibody level

CMO:0002623.name: serum anti-porcine type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002623.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds pig-derived type 2 collagen in a specified sample of serum expressed as the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: serum anti-porcine type II collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002624.name: serum anti-rat type 2 collagen autoantibody titer
CMO:0002624.def: The amount in a specified sample of serum, of an immunoglobulin molecule, specifically one produced by the immune system of a rat against its own collagen, possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds rat-derived type 2 collagen, expressed as the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: serum anti-rat type II collagen autoantibody titer
serum rat anti-self type 2 collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002625.name: serum anti-type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002625.def: Measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds type 2 collagen in a specified volume of serum expressed as the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: serum anti-type II collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002626.name: serum anti-rat type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002626.def: The amount in a specified sample of serum, of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds rat-derived type 2 collagen, expressed as the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: serum anti-rat type II collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002627.name: serum anti-type 2 collagen antibody level
CMO:0002627.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.
synonyms: serum anti-type II collagen antibody level

CMO:0002628.name: serum anti-laminin antibody titer
CMO:0002628.def: Measurement of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that specifically binds to laminin, in a specified sample of serum expressed as the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002629.name: serum anti-collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002629.def: A measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to one or more types of collagen,  the fibrous protein constituent of bone, cartilage, tendon, and other connective tissue, in a specified volume of serum, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002630.name: serum anti-DNA antibody titer
CMO:0002630.def: A measurement of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds to deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) in a specified sample of serum, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002631.name: serum anti-dsDNA antibody titer
CMO:0002631.def: A measurement of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds to double-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), a molecule composed of two anti-parallel, hydrogen-bonded, polymeric strands of nucleic acids in which the sugar is deoxyribose and which is also composed of phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or thymine, in a specified sample of serum, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: serum anti-double-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid antibody titer

CMO:0002632.name: serum anti-ssDNA antibody titer
CMO:0002632.def: A measurement of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds to single-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), a single polymeric strand of nucleic acids in which the sugar is deoxyribose and which is also composed of phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or thymine, in a specified sample of serum, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: serum anti-single-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid antibody titer

CMO:0002633.name: plasma anti-laminin antibody titer
CMO:0002633.def: A measurement of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that specifically binds to laminin, a large polypeptide glycoprotein component of basement membranes, in a specific sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002634.name: plasma anti-DNA antibody titer
CMO:0002634.def: A measurement of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds to deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002635.name: plasma anti-dsDNA antibody titer
CMO:0002635.def: A measurement of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds to double-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), a molecule composed of two anti-parallel, hydrogen-bonded, polymeric strands of nucleic acids in which the sugar is deoxyribose and which is also composed of phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or thymine, in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: plasma anti-double-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid antibody titer

CMO:0002636.name: plasma anti-ssDNA antibody titer
CMO:0002636.def: A measurement of the amount of immunoglobulin molecule with an amino acid sequence that binds to single-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), a single polymeric strand of nucleic acids in which the sugar is deoxyribose and which is also composed of phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or thymine, in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: plasma anti-single-stranded deoxyribonucleic acid antibody titer

CMO:0002637.name: plasma anti-collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002637.def: A measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to one or more types of collagen,  the fibrous protein constituent of bone, cartilage, tendon, and other connective tissue, in a specified volume of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.

CMO:0002638.name: plasma anti-type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002638.def: Measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of serum,expressed as the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: plasma anti-type II collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002639.name: plasma anti-bovine type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002639.def: A measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds cattle-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: plasma anti-bovine type II collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002640.name: plasma anti-porcine type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002640.def: A measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds pig-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: plasma anti-porcine type II collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002641.name: plasma anti-rat type 2 collagen autoantibody level
CMO:0002641.def: The amount of an immunoglobulin molecule produced by the immune system of a rat and possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds its own type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.
synonyms: plasma anti-rat type II collagen autoantibody level
plasma rat anti-self type 2 collagen antibody level

CMO:0002642.name: plasma anti-rat type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002642.def: A measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds rat-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: plasma anti-rat type II collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002643.name: plasma anti-rat type 2 collagen autoantibody titer
CMO:0002643.def: A measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule produced by the immune system of a rat and possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds its own type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified sample of plasma, expressed as the last dilution of plasma at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: plasma anti-rat type II collagen autoantibody titer
plasma rat anti-self type 2 collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002644.name: serum anti-bovine type 2 collagen antibody titer
CMO:0002644.def: A measurement of the amount of an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds cattle-derived type 2 collagen, the main fibrous protein constituent of cartilage, in a specified sample of serum, expressed as the last dilution of serum at which a positive result could be obtained.
synonyms: serum anti-bovine type II collagen antibody titer

CMO:0002645.name: bone ash content
CMO:0002645.def: The amount of ash produced by the calcination of bone, that is, a thermal treatment of bone resulting in thermal decomposition and/or removal of the volatile fraction.

CMO:0002646.name: bone calcium content
CMO:0002646.def: The amount of calcium in a specified sample of bone.  Calcium is the chemical element with symbol Ca and atomic number 20, and is the dense hard component of teeth and bones.

CMO:0002647.name: bone phosphorus content
CMO:0002647.def: The amount of phosphorus in a specified sample of bone.  Phosphorus is the chemical element with symbol P and atomic number 15, and is a major component of the mineral phase of bone.

CMO:0002648.name: femur metaphysis morphological measurement
CMO:0002648.def: Measurement of the physical form or structure of the femur metaphysis, the segment of the femur that lies between the epiphysis in the femoral neck and the diaphysis (shaft).

CMO:0002649.name: femur metaphysial mediolateral diameter
CMO:0002649.def: The distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of the femur metaphysis measured from one side to the other, that is, along the mediolateral axis of the bone.

CMO:0002650.name: femur metaphysial anterior-posterior diameter
CMO:0002650.def: The distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of the femur metaphysis measured from front to back, that is, along the anteroposterior axis of the bone.

CMO:0002651.name: total calorie intake level
CMO:0002651.def: The entire number of calories, i.e. the total amount of energy, consumed by an organism, regardless of source.
synonyms: combined food plus drink calorie intake level
combined food plus drink energy intake level

CMO:0002652.name: bacterial infection severity measurement
CMO:0002652.def: Any measurement of the degree to which the presentation of a bacterial infection has caused pain or damage, or of the degree to which bacteria has established lesions or infectious colonies, and/or taken over or interfered with the normal functioning of the body as a whole, or of one or more organs, tissues, cells or subcellular mechanisms of an organism. A bacterial infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by bacteria, any of the unicellular prokaryotic microorganisms that commonly multiply by cell division, lack a nucleus or membrane-bound organelles, and possess a cell wall.

CMO:0002653.name: bacterial infection severity score
CMO:0002653.def: A measurement of bacterial infection severity which is derived from a combination of multiple measurements and/or an objective or subjective ranking or rating system according to a specified formula or set of criteria.
synonyms: composite score for bacterial infection severity

CMO:0002654.name: bacterial infection severity score based on mucosal leukocyte infiltration
CMO:0002654.def: A ranking or rating of bacterial infection severity which is based on or derived from the ratio of the number of leukocytes in a sample of mucosal membrane to total number of cells the that sample.
synonyms: bacterial infection severity score based on the percentage of leukocyte infiltration
leukocyte infiltrate in mucosa (% total cellularity)

CMO:0002655.name: bacterial infection severity score based on inflammatory foci in exudate
CMO:0002655.def: A ranking or rating of bacterial infection severity which is based on or derived from the number and/or size of foci of inflammatory cells (that is, leukocytes, especially neutrophils, macrophages, monocytes, eosinophils, and/or basophils) in a sample of exudate from an infected tissue or organ. An exudate is a fluid with a high content of protein and cellular debris which has escaped from blood vessels and has been deposited in tissues or on tissue surfaces, usually as a result of inflammation.
synonyms: score of inflammatory exudate in tympanic cavity

CMO:0002656.name: bacteria count
CMO:0002656.def: The enumeration, i.e. measurement of the total number, of bacteria in a specified sample of an infected tissue or bodily fluid, or in the entire body of the host.

CMO:0002657.name: total number of bacterial colony forming units recovered
CMO:0002657.def: The enumeration, i.e. measurement of the total number, of bacterial colony forming units (CFUs) in a specified sample of fluid removed from and/or solution used to wash the interior of a cavity in a body or an organ. A bacterial CFU is an individual bacterium which is able to clonally propagate itself into an entire colony of identical cells.
synonyms: total number of CFU in effusion plus wash

CMO:0002658.name: logarithm of the total number of bacterial colony forming units recovered
CMO:0002658.def: The logarithm of the enumeration, i.e. measurement of the total number, of bacterial colony forming units (CFUs) in a specified sample of fluid removed from and/or solution used to wash the interior of a cavity in a body or an organ. A logarithm is the power to which a base, such as 10, must be raised to produce a given number. A bacterial CFU is an individual bacterium which is able to clonally propagate itself into an entire colony of identical cells.
synonyms: logarithm of the total number of CFU in effusion plus wash

CMO:0002659.name: logarithm of the total number of Haemophilus influenzae bacterial colony forming units recovered
CMO:0002659.def: The logarithm of the enumeration, i.e. measurement of the total number, of colony forming units (CFUs) of the bacterial species Haemophilus influenzae in a specified sample of fluid removed from and/or solution used to wash the interior of a cavity in a body or an organ. Haemophilus influenzae is a Gram-negative, coccobacillary, facultatively anaerobic bacterium which is considered an opportunistic pathogen, i.e. one that can colonize a host without causing disease unless there are extenuating circumstances which result in susceptibility on the part of the host.
synonyms: logarithm of the total number of H. influenzae CFU in effusion plus wash

CMO:0002660.name: logarithm of the total number of Streptococcus pneumoniae bacterial colony forming units recovered
CMO:0002660.def: The logarithm of the enumeration, i.e. measurement of the total number, of colony forming units (CFUs) of the bacterial species Streptococcus pneumoniae in a specified sample of fluid removed from and/or solution used to wash the interior of a cavity in a body or an organ. Streptococcus pneumoniae is a species of Gram-positive, alpha-hemolytic, facultative anaerobic bacteria commonly found in the nasopharynx of healthy human carriers.
synonyms: logarithm of the total number of S. pneumoniae CFU in effusion plus wash
log of the total number of recovered TIGR4 bacterial CFUs

CMO:0002661.name: logarithm of the total number of nontypeable Haemophilus influenzae bacterial colony forming units recovered
CMO:0002661.def: The logarithm of the enumeration, i.e. measurement of the total number, of colony forming units (CFUs) of a nontypeable strain of the bacterial species Haemophilus influenzae in a specified sample of fluid removed from and/or solution used to wash the interior of a cavity in a body or an organ. Nontypeable Haemophilus influenzae refers to any unencapsulated strain of the Gram-negative, coccobacillary, facultatively anaerobic bacterium species Haemophilus influenza. Such bacteria lack the capsular antigens used to serotype strains and therefore cannot be classified by serology.
synonyms: logarithm of the total number of nontypeable H. influenzae CFU in effusion plus wash
log of the total number of recovered NTHi bacterial CFUs
Log recovered nontypeable H. influenzae CFU

CMO:0002662.name: calculated inflammatory exudate cell count
CMO:0002662.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the number of cells (all cells and/or cells of a specific type) in a sample of exudate.

CMO:0002663.name: ratio of the number of neutrophils in an inflammatory exudate to number of all cells in that exudate
CMO:0002663.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of neutrophils in a specified sample of exudate is divided by the total number of cells in that sample of exudate and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. A neutrophil is a granular leukocyte having a nucleus with three to five lobes connected by threads of chromatin, and cytoplasm containing very fine granules.

CMO:0002664.name: inflammatory exudate monocyte count
CMO:0002664.def: The number of monocytes, that is, mononuclear phagocytic leukocytes, in a specified volume of fluid which has escaped from blood vessels and been deposited within tissues or on tissue surfaces as a result of inflammation, a usually localized, protective reaction of tissue to irritation, injury or infection, characterized by pain, redness, swelling and sometimes loss of function.

CMO:0002665.name: inflammatory exudate lymphocyte count
CMO:0002665.def: The number of lymphocytes (mononuclear, nongranular, nonphagocytic leukocytes) in a specified volume of fluid which has escaped from blood vessels and been deposited within tissues or on tissue surfaces as a result of inflammation, a usually localized, protective reaction of tissue to irritation, injury or infection, characterized by pain, redness, swelling and sometimes loss of function.

CMO:0002666.name: ratio of the number of lymphocytes in an inflammatory exudate to the number of all cells in that exudate
CMO:0002666.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of lymphocytes in a specified sample of exudate is divided by the total number of cells in that sample of exudate and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. A lymphocyte is a mononuclear, nonphagocytic, nongranular leukocyte having a deeply staining nucleus containing dense chromatin and a pale-blue-staining cytoplasm.

CMO:0002667.name: ear measurement
CMO:0002667.def: Any measurement of the sense organ in vertebrates specialized for the detection of sound and the maintenance of balance.

CMO:0002668.name: middle ear measurement
CMO:0002668.def: Any measurement of the middle ear, the middle of the three parts of the ear, consisting of an air-filled cavity bound externally by the tympanic membrane and containing three ossicles that vibrate in response to sound waves, passing the amplified sound to the inner ear.

CMO:0002669.name: middle ear morphological measurement
CMO:0002669.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of the middle ear,  the middle of the three parts of the ear, consisting of an air-filled cavity bound externally by the tympanic membrane and containing three ossicles that vibrate in response to sound waves, passing the amplified sound to the inner ear.

CMO:0002670.name: tympanic cavity epithelium thickness
CMO:0002670.def: Quantification of the thickness, that is the distance from the junction with the underlying bone/tissue to the surface of the membrane, of the layer of epithelial cells lining the tympanic cavity.

CMO:0002671.name: calculated middle ear morphological measurement
CMO:0002671.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the physical form or structure of the middle ear,  the middle of the three parts of the ear, consisting of an air-filled cavity bound externally by the tympanic membrane and containing three ossicles that vibrate in response to sound waves, passing the amplified sound to the inner ear.

CMO:0002672.name: single ear average of tympanic cavity epithelium thickness
CMO:0002672.def: The average of a set of epithelium thickness measurements which were all taken from a single ear of a single experimental subject.
synonyms: single ear average of middle ear epithelium thickness
single ear average of tympanic cavity epithelium depth
single ear average of tympanic cavity epithelium width

CMO:0002673.name: both ears average of tympanic cavity epithelium thickness
CMO:0002673.def: The average of a set of epithelium thickness measurements from both ears of a single experimental subject.
synonyms: both ears average of middle ear epithelium thickness
both ears average of tympanic cavity epithelium depth
both ears average of tympanic cavity epithelium width

CMO:0002674.name: average horizontal distance between subject and target during voluntary locomotion in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002674.def: The arithmetic mean of all measured horizontal distances between a test subject and a specific target such as a food reward or a submerged platform as the subject searches for the target. Horizontal distance is the length of a line between two points within a single plane parallel to the ground.
synonyms: average horizontal distance in proximity to the target  during voluntary locomotion in an experimental apparatus

CMO:0002675.name: total horizontal distance covered resulting from voluntary locomotion in proximity to the target  in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002675.def: The sum of the lengths of the lines representing all voluntary movements of an experimental subject within a flat plane parallel to the ground in an apparatus made while attempting to locate a specific target such as a food reward or a submerged platform.

CMO:0002676.name: voluntary social interaction measurement
CMO:0002676.def: Any measurement of interplay, contact, communication or interchange between two or more organisms originated, undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice on the part of one or more participants.

CMO:0002677.name: total accumulated time of physical contact or close proximity between test subject and social stimulus per unit time
CMO:0002677.def: The aggregate amount of time within a specified period during which a test subject touches or voluntarily moves or remains close to (for example within one centimeter of) a social stimulus such as another animal of the same species.

CMO:0002678.name: difference between duration of physical contact or close proximity of test subject and social stimulus during sample phase and test phase
CMO:0002678.def: The difference in time spent in direct social interaction (that is, the amount of time within a specified period during which a test subject touches or voluntarily moves or remains close to, for example within one centimeter of, a social stimulus such as another animal of the same species) between the first introduction of a social stimulus and a subsequent reintroduction of the same stimulus.
synonyms: difference between time of physical contact/close proximity of test subject and social stimulus during sample phase and test phase

CMO:0002679.name: blood glycerol level
CMO:0002679.def: The amount of free glycerol, a trihydroxy sugar alcohol produced by lipolysis of triglycerides in adipose tissue and a precursor for the synthesis of triacylglycerols and phospholipids in the body, found in a specific volume of blood.

CMO:0002680.name: serum blood glycerol level
CMO:0002680.def: The amount of free glycerol, a trihydroxy sugar alcohol produced by lipolysis of triglycerides in adipose tissue and a precursor for the synthesis of triacylglycerols and phospholipids in the body, found in a specific volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0002681.name: plasma glycerol level
CMO:0002681.def: The amount of free glycerol, a trihydroxy sugar alcohol produced by lipolysis of triglycerides in adipose tissue and a precursor for the synthesis of triacylglycerols and phospholipids in the body, found in a specific volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0002682.name: blood chylomicron cholesterol level
CMO:0002682.def: Measurement of the amount of cholesterol, a eukaryotic sterol that in higher animals is the precursor of bile acids and steroid hormones and a key constituent of cell membranes, carried in chylomicron molecules in a specified volume of blood. Chylomicrons are a class of lipoproteins (approximate density range <0.95 g/ml) that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the small intestine to other tissues.

CMO:0002683.name: serum chylomicron cholesterol level
CMO:0002683.def: Measurement of the amount of cholesterol, a eukaryotic sterol that in higher animals is the precursor of bile acids and steroid hormones and a key constituent of cell membranes, carried in chylomicron molecules in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. Chylomicrons are a class of lipoproteins (approximate density range <0.95 g/ml) that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the small intestine to other tissues.

CMO:0002684.name: plasma chylomicron cholesterol level
CMO:0002684.def: Measurement of the amount of cholesterol, a eukaryotic sterol that in higher animals is the precursor of bile acids and steroid hormones and a key constituent of cell membranes, carried in chylomicron molecules in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. Chylomicrons are a class of lipoproteins (approximate density range <0.95 g/ml) that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the small intestine to other tissues.

CMO:0002685.name: blood lipoprotein triglyceride level
CMO:0002685.def: Measurement of the amount of triglyceride (any of a group of lipids that are esters formed from one molecule of glycerol and three molecules of one or more fatty acids, are widespread in adipose tissue, and commonly circulate in the blood in the form of lipoproteins) carried in lipoprotein particles (complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids) in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0002686.name: blood high density lipoprotein triglyceride level
CMO:0002686.def: Measurement of the amount of triglyceride (any of a group of lipids that are esters formed from one molecule of glycerol and three molecules of one or more fatty acids, are widespread in adipose tissue, and commonly circulate in the blood in the form of lipoproteins) carried in high-density lipoprotein (HDL) molecules in a specified volume of blood. HDL is the smallest of the major lipoprotein particles, complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids. The HDL class of lipoproteins, specifically the subtypes of HDL2 and HDL3, have densities between 1.063 and 1.210 g/ml.

CMO:0002687.name: blood low density lipoprotein triglyceride level
CMO:0002687.def: Measurement of the amount of triglyceride (any of a group of lipids that are esters formed from one molecule of glycerol and three molecules of one or more fatty acids, are widespread in adipose tissue, and commonly circulate in the blood in the form of lipoproteins) carried in low-density lipoprotein (LDL) molecules in a specified volume of blood. LDL constitute a class of relatively large, heterogeneous lipoprotein particles, complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids. The LDL class of lipoproteins has a density between 1.019 and 1.063 g/ml. In some animal species, such as canine and rodents, this may overlap with the HDL1 class and be designated LDL/HDL1.

CMO:0002688.name: blood very low density lipoprotein triglyceride level
CMO:0002688.def: Measurement of the amount of triglyceride (any of a group of lipids that are esters formed from one molecule of glycerol and three molecules of one or more fatty acids, are widespread in adipose tissue, and commonly circulate in the blood in the form of lipoproteins) carried in very low-density lipoprotein (VLDL) molecules in a specified volume of blood. VLDL constitute a class of large (e.g. approximately 30-80 nm in diameter) lipoprotein particles, complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids. The VLDL class of lipoproteins has a density between 0.95 and 1.006 g/ml.
synonyms: triglycerides in very small VLDL measurement

CMO:0002689.name: blood chylomicron triglyceride level
CMO:0002689.def: Measurement of the amount of triglyceride (any of a group of lipids that are esters formed from one molecule of glycerol and three molecules of one or more fatty acids, are widespread in adipose tissue, and commonly circulate in the blood in the form of lipoproteins) carried in chylomicron molecules in a specified volume of blood. Chylomicrons are a class of lipoproteins (approximate density range <0.95 g/ml) that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the small intestine to other tissues.

CMO:0002690.name: blood lipoprotein measurement
CMO:0002690.def: A value resulting from the quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of a blood-derived lipoprotein, any of a class of complex molecules found in blood that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids.

CMO:0002691.name: blood lipoprotein particle diameter
CMO:0002691.def: The diameter, that is the distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of a blood-derived lipoprotein particle, a complex molecule found in blood that consists of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids.

CMO:0002692.name: blood high density lipoprotein particle diameter
CMO:0002692.def: The diameter, that is the distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of blood-derived high-density lipoprotein (HDL) particles. HDL is the smallest of the major lipoprotein particles, complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids. The HDL class of lipoproteins, specifically the subtypes of HDL2 and HDL3, have densities between 1.063 and 1.210 g/ml.
synonyms: high density lipoprotein particle size measurement

CMO:0002693.name: blood low density lipoprotein particle diameter
CMO:0002693.def: The diameter, that is the distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of blood-derived low-density lipoprotein (LDL) particles. LDL constitute a class of relatively large, heterogeneous lipoprotein particles, complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids. The LDL class of lipoproteins has a density between 1.019 and 1.063 g/ml. In some animal species, such as canine and rodents, this may overlap with the HDL1 class and be designated LDL/HDL1.
synonyms: low density lipoprotein particle size measurement

CMO:0002694.name: blood very low density lipoprotein particle diameter
CMO:0002694.def: The diameter, that is the distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of blood-derived very low-density lipoprotein (VLDL) particles. VLDL constitute a class of large (e.g. approximately 30-80 nm in diameter) lipoprotein particles, complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids. The VLDL class of lipoproteins has a density between 0.95 and 1.006 g/ml.
synonyms: very low density lipoprotein particle size measurement

CMO:0002695.name: blood chylomicron particle diameter
CMO:0002695.def: The diameter, that is the distance between two specified opposite points on the periphery of blood-derived chylomicron particles. Chylomicrons are a class of lipoproteins (approximate density range <0.95 g/ml) that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the small intestine to other tissues.

CMO:0002696.name: blood lipoprotein cholesterol level
CMO:0002696.def: Measurement of the amount of cholesterol, a eukaryotic sterol that in higher animals is the precursor of bile acids and steroid hormones and a key constituent of cell membranes, carried in lipoprotein molecules in a specified volume of blood. Lipoprotein particles are complexes that consist of protein surrounding a core of lipids.

CMO:0002697.name: blood lipoprotein phospholipid level
CMO:0002697.def: Measurement of the amount of phospholipid, any of various phosphorus-containing lipids that are composed mainly of fatty acids, a phosphate group, and a simple organic molecule such as glycerol, carried in lipoprotein molecules in a specified volume of blood. Lipoprotein particles are complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids.

CMO:0002698.name: urine ketone body level
CMO:0002698.def: Measurement of the amount of ketone bodies, that is, acetoacetate, 3-hydroxybutyrate and/or acetone, in a specified sample of urine. Ketone bodies are produced by fatty acid and carbohydrate metabolism and seen in conditions such as fasting, starvation and diabetes mellitus.

CMO:0002699.name: dopaminergic neuron count
CMO:0002699.def: Measurement of the number of dopamine-producing neurons in a specified sample. Dopamine is a monoamine neurotransmitter formed in the brain by the decarboxylation of dopa and essential to the normal functioning of the central nervous system. A reduction in its concentration within the brain is associated with Parkinson's disease.

CMO:0002700.name: tibia midshaft cortical cross-sectional area
CMO:0002700.def: The portion of the cross-sectional area of the tibia, measured midway between the two ends of the bone, that corresponds to the area of the cortex, the outer layer of the bone.  The cross-sectional area of the tibia is a measurement of the extent of a plane through, i.e. perpendicular to the axis of, the tibia, the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg of bipeds or hindlimb of quadrupeds which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus.

CMO:0002701.name: tibia trabecular bone volume
CMO:0002701.def: Measurement of the size of the three dimensional space occupied by the portion of a tibia composed of trabecular bone. The tibia is the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg of bipeds or hindlimb of quadrupeds which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus. Trabecular or spongy bone is the porous type of bone found in the vertebrae and at all articulating joints, consisting of an irregular three-dimensional array of boney rods and plates (trabeculae) which themselves are composed of a composite material with bone marrow filling the spaces of the pores.

CMO:0002702.name: bone section morphological measurement
CMO:0002702.def: Measurement of the physical form or structure of a slice or similar portion of a bone.

CMO:0002703.name: calculated bone section morphological measurement
CMO:0002703.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the physical form or structure of a slice or other portion of a bone.

CMO:0002704.name: bone section total volume
CMO:0002704.def: Volume of the entire region of interest in a sample, for example a slice, of bone.

CMO:0002705.name: bone section mineralized tissue volume
CMO:0002705.def: In a sample of bone, the volume of the portion which has been segmented as mineralized, radiodense/radiopaque tissue.

CMO:0002706.name: bone section mineralized tissue surface area
CMO:0002706.def: In a sample of bone, the surface area, that is, the two-dimensional extent of a planar region comprising the superficial or external aspect, of the portion which has been segmented as mineralized, radiodense/radiopaque tissue.

CMO:0002707.name: bone section volume fraction
CMO:0002707.def: In a sample of bone, the volume of the portion of the sample which has been segmented as mineralized, radiodense/radiopaque tissue divided by the total volume of the region of interest.
synonyms: bone section mineralized tissue volume to bone section total volume ratio

CMO:0002708.name: bone section surface density
CMO:0002708.def: In a sample of bone, the surface area of the portion of the sample which has been segmented as mineralized, radiodense/radiopaque tissue divided by the total volume of the region of interest.
synonyms: bone section mineralized tissue surface area to bone section total volume ratio

CMO:0002709.name: bone section specific bone surface
CMO:0002709.def: A calculated measurement in which, in a sample of bone, the surface area of the portion of the sample which has been segmented as mineralized, radiodense/radiopaque tissue is divided by the volume of the portion of the sample which has been segmented as mineralized, radiodense/radiopaque tissue.
synonyms: bone section mineralized tissue surface area to mineralized tissue volume ratio
bone section mineralized tissue surface-area-to-volume ratio

CMO:0002710.name: bone section structure model index
CMO:0002710.def: A quantitative measure of bone microarchitecture calculated by means of three-dimensional image analysis and based on the volume ratio of plate-shaped trabeculae to rod-shaped ones. For bones which contain both structures the value is expected to be between 0 (all parallel plates) and 3 (all cylindrical rods) although a value of 4 is possible (denoting spherical trabeculae).  Also, where the fraction of mineralized tissue in a bone section is extremely high or low, values outside this 0-4 range are possible.

CMO:0002711.name: bone section connectivity density
CMO:0002711.def: A measure of the degree of connectivity of trabeculae divided by the total volume of the bone sample.  The degree of connectivity is an index calculated from the Euler number, a fundamental topologic measure counting the number of objects, the number of marrow cavities fully surrounded by bone, and the number of connections that must be broken to split the structure in two parts.

CMO:0002712.name: bone section trabecular number
CMO:0002712.def: Measure of the average number of trabeculae per unit length in a sample of bone. Trabeculae are the interconnecting, rod- or needle-like bony structures in cancellous bone which form a meshwork of intercommunicating spaces that are filled with bone marrow.

CMO:0002713.name: bone section trabecular thickness
CMO:0002713.def: Mean thickness of trabeculae in a sample of bone. Trabeculae are the interconnecting, rod- or needle-like bony structures in cancellous bone which form a meshwork of intercommunicating spaces that are filled with bone marrow.

CMO:0002714.name: bone section trabecular separation
CMO:0002714.def: Mean distance between trabeculae in a sample of bone.  Trabeculae are the interconnecting, rod- or needle-like bony structures in cancellous bone which form a meshwork of intercommunicating spaces that are filled with bone marrow.

CMO:0002715.name: number of rearing movements with lid-pushing in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002715.def: A value or quantity determined by count of how many times a quadrupedal subject in a piece of technical equipment or machinery, an appliance, or a device designed for a particular purpose rises up on its back legs and pushes on the lid/top of the apparatus.
synonyms: number of escape attempts in an experimental apparatus

CMO:0002716.name: femur head morphological measurement
CMO:0002716.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of the head of the femur, the hemispheric articular surface at the upper extremity of the thigh bone which acts as the 'ball' in the ball-and-socket hip joint.

CMO:0002717.name: femur head width
CMO:0002717.def: The measurement of the linear distance between two opposite points on the periphery of the head of the femur, that is, the extent of the head of the femur from side to side.

CMO:0002718.name: bone ultimate displacement
CMO:0002718.def: The elongation or displacement of the bone at the point of breakage, for example during a bending test where displacement is the distance between the mid-span position of the bone without loading and the mid-span position of the bone under loading.

CMO:0002719.name: femur ultimate displacement
CMO:0002719.def: The elongation or displacement of the femur at the point of breakage, for example during a bending test where displacement is the distance between the mid-span position of the bone without loading and the mid-span position of the bone under loading.

CMO:0002720.name: aorta length
CMO:0002720.def: The distance between the two ends, that is, of the extent of the longest dimension, of the aorta, the main trunk from which the arterial system proceeds.

CMO:0002721.name: calculated aorta morphological measurement
CMO:0002721.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the physical form or structure of the aorta, the main trunk from which the arterial system proceeds.

CMO:0002722.name: aorta weight to aorta length to body weight ratio
CMO:0002722.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of the aorta is divided by its length and the resulting quantity is divided by the total body weight of the organism.
synonyms: aorta mass to aorta length to body mass ratio

CMO:0002723.name: percent change in pulse pressure
CMO:0002723.def: A calculated measurement of the relative difference in pulse pressure between a treated state and a control state or between two points in time, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0002724.name: serum insulin level to serum glucose level ratio
CMO:0002724.def: A calculated measurement in which the value for the amount of insulin in a specified sample of serum is divided by the value for the level of glucose in the same sample of serum, and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002725.name: calculated serum glucose level
CMO:0002725.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the amount of glucose in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0002726.name: spinal cord cellular composition measurement
CMO:0002726.def: Any quantitation of the cells and/or cell types which constitute the make-up of the spinal cord.

CMO:0002727.name: spinal cord ventral horn cellular composition measurement
CMO:0002727.def: Any quantitation of the cells and/or cell types which constitute the make-up of the spinal cord ventral horn, either of the horn-like projections of gray matter into the white matter of the spinal cord. The anterior/ventral horn contains efferent fibers innervating skeletal muscle tissue.
synonyms: spinal cord anterior column cellular composition measurement
spinal cord anterior horn cellular composition measurement

CMO:0002728.name: tissue cellular composition measurement
CMO:0002728.def: Any quantitation of the cells or cell types which constitute the make-up of a tissue or a set of tissues.

CMO:0002729.name: spinal cord ventral horn CD3-positive cell count
CMO:0002729.def: The number of cells in the spinal cord ventral/anterior horn which express the CD3 antigen on the cell surface.
synonyms: spinal cord anterior column CD3-positive cell count
spinal cord anterior horn CD3-positive cell count
spinal cord ventral horn CD3(+) cell count
spinal cord ventral horn T lymphocyte cell count

CMO:0002730.name: serum hemoglobin level
CMO:0002730.def: The amount of hemoglobin, the oxygen carrying pigment of erythrocytes, found in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0002731.name: tibia midshaft morphological measurement
CMO:0002731.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of the section of the tibia located midway between the two epiphyses (that is, the ends) of the bone.

CMO:0002732.name: tibia midshaft cortical thickness
CMO:0002732.def: The width of the layer of cortical (compact) bone of the diaphysis (shaft) measured midway between the two epiphyses of the shinbone.

CMO:0002733.name: time to locate a target in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002733.def: Measurement of the amount of time spent by an experimental subject in an experimental apparatus searching for and/or determining the position of a desired goal or reward.
synonyms: latency to locate a target in an experimental apparatus

CMO:0002734.name: time to locate a target platform in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002734.def: Measurement of the amount of time spent by an experimental subject in an experimental apparatus searching for and/or determining the position of a, possibly raised, horizontal surface within the apparatus.
synonyms: latency to locate a target platform in an experimental apparatus

CMO:0002735.name: time to locate a visible target platform in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002735.def: Measurement of the amount of time spent by an experimental subject in an experimental apparatus searching for and/or determining the position of a, possibly raised, horizontal surface within the apparatus which can be seen during the search.
synonyms: latency to locate a visible target platform in an experimental apparatus

CMO:0002736.name: time to locate a hidden target platform in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002736.def: Measurement of the amount of time spent by an experimental subject in an experimental apparatus searching for and/or determining the position of a submerged, horizontal surface within the apparatus which cannot be seen during the search.
synonyms: latency to locate a hidden target platform in an experimental apparatus

CMO:0002737.name: ratio of survivors to total study population during a period of time
CMO:0002737.def: The total number of experimental subjects within a study population which remain alive during a specified period of time divided by the total number of individuals in the study population, presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. ratio of survivors of metabolic syndrome to total study population during a period of time
synonyms: percentage of survivors in the total study population during a period of time
ratio of subjects surviving to total study population during a period of time

CMO:0002738.name: heart protein activity measurement
CMO:0002738.def: Any quantification of the ability of a protein of the heart to accomplish an effect, e.g. take part in a chemical reaction or carry out a specified molecular function.

CMO:0002739.name: heart enzyme activity level
CMO:0002739.def: Any quantification of the ability of a heart enzyme, i.e. a protein located in the heart that catalyzes chemical reactions of other substances without itself being destroyed or altered upon completion of the reactions, to carry out its specified molecular function.

CMO:0002740.name: heart angiotensin I converting enzyme 2 activity level
CMO:0002740.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin I converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) in a specified sample of heart tissue. ACE2, an ACE homolog, is a zinc-dependent peptidase of the M2-metalloprotease family that is sensitive to chloride ion concentration, is a membrane-bound enzyme that acts as a monocarboxypeptidase, and is an essential regulator of heart function.
synonyms: heart angiotensin II converting enzyme activity level

CMO:0002741.name: heart angiotensin I converting enzyme activity level
CMO:0002741.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin I converting enzyme (ACE) in a specified sample of heart tissue. ACE is one of the enzymes of the renin-angiotensin system, and catalyzes the conversion of angiotensin I into a physiologically active vasoconstrictor peptide angiotensin II.

CMO:0002742.name: blood angiotensin I converting enzyme 2 activity level
CMO:0002742.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin converting enzyme2 (ACE2) in a specified sample of blood. ACE2, an ACE homolog, is a zinc-dependent peptidase of the M2-metalloprotease family that is sensitive to chloride ion concentration, and is a membrane-bound enzyme that acts as a monocarboxypeptidase and is an essential regulator of heart function.

CMO:0002743.name: serum angiotensin I converting enzyme 2 activity level
CMO:0002743.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin converting enzyme2 (ACE2) in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. ACE2, an ACE homolog, is a zinc-dependent peptidase of the M2-metalloprotease family that is sensitive to chloride ion concentration, and is a membrane-bound enzyme that acts as a monocarboxypeptidase and is an essential regulator of heart function.

CMO:0002744.name: plasma angiotensin I converting enzyme 2 activity level
CMO:0002744.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin converting enzyme2 (ACE2) in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. ACE2, an ACE homolog, is a zinc-dependent peptidase of the M2-metalloprotease family that is sensitive to chloride ion concentration, and is a membrane-bound enzyme that acts as a monocarboxypeptidase and is an essential regulator of heart function.

CMO:0002745.name: kidney angiotensin I converting enzyme 2 activity level
CMO:0002745.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin converting enzyme2 (ACE2) in a specified sample of kidney. ACE2, an ACE homolog, is a zinc-dependent peptidase of the M2-metalloprotease family that is sensitive to chloride ion concentration, and is a membrane-bound enzyme that acts as a monocarboxypeptidase and is an essential regulator of heart function.
synonyms: kidney angiotensin II converting enzyme activity level

CMO:0002746.name: kidney angiotensin I converting enzyme activity level
CMO:0002746.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin I converting enzyme (ACE) in a specified sample of kidney tissue. ACE is one of the enzymes of the renin-angiotensin system, and catalyzes the conversion of angiotensin I into a physiologically active vasoconstrictor peptide angiotensin II.

CMO:0002747.name: lung measurement
CMO:0002747.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological, involving the lung or any part thereof. The lungs comprise the organ component of the respiratory system responsible for the exchange of gases between the environment and the blood.

CMO:0002748.name: lung protein activity measurement
CMO:0002748.def: Any quantification of the ability of a protein of the lung to accomplish an effect, e.g. take part in a chemical reaction or carry out a specified molecular function.

CMO:0002749.name: lung enzyme activity measurement
CMO:0002749.def: Any quantification of the ability of a lung enzyme, i.e. a protein located in the lung that catalyzes chemical reactions of other substances without itself being destroyed or altered upon completion of the reactions, to carry out its specified molecular function.

CMO:0002750.name: lung angiotensin I converting enzyme 2 activity level
CMO:0002750.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin converting enzyme2 (ACE2) in a specified sample of lung. ACE2, an ACE homolog, is a zinc-dependent peptidase of the M2-metalloprotease family that is sensitive to chloride ion concentration, and is a membrane-bound enzyme that acts as a monocarboxypeptidase and is an essential regulator of heart function.
synonyms: lung angiotensin II converting enzyme activity level

CMO:0002751.name: lung angiotensin I converting enzyme activity level
CMO:0002751.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by angiotensin I converting enzyme (ACE) in a specified sample of lung tissue. ACE is one of the enzymes of the renin-angiotensin system, and catalyzes the conversion of angiotensin I into a physiologically active vasoconstrictor peptide angiotensin II.

CMO:0002752.name: congenital malformation incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0002752.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display congenital malformation(s) at a point in time or develop congenital malformation(s) within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. Congenital malformations represent a heterogenous group of structural defects, which are usually identified at birth.

CMO:0002753.name: anorectal malformation incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0002753.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display anorectal malformation at a point in time or develop anorectal malformation within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. Anorectal malformations (ARMs) represent a spectrum of congenital anomalies characterized by the obstruction of the anal opening.

CMO:0002754.name: percentage of study population developing anorectal malformation during a period of time
CMO:0002754.def: The number of new cases of anorectal malformation appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. Anorectal malformations (ARMs) represent a spectrum of congenital anomalies characterized by the obstruction of the anal opening.

CMO:0002755.name: percentage of study population displaying anorectal malformation at a point in time
CMO:0002755.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display, i.e., are manifesting symptoms of or have been diagnosed with, anorectal malformation at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. Anorectal malformations (ARMs) represent a spectrum of congenital anomalies characterized by the obstruction of the anal opening.

CMO:0002756.name: anogenital distance to cube root of body weight ratio
CMO:0002756.def: A calculated value in which anogenital distance (the length of a line between the anal opening and the genitalia) is divided by the cube root of the weight of the body and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002757.name: calculated urine creatinine level
CMO:0002757.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of creatinine in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0002758.name: urine protein level to urine creatinine level ratio
CMO:0002758.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of protein in a specified sample of urine or the amount of protein excreted into the urine in a specified period of time is divided by the amount of creatinine in that sample of urine or the amount of creatinine excreted into the urine in that period of time, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002759.name: cardiac muscle fiber morphological measurement
CMO:0002759.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of a cardiac muscle fiber, a striated cardiac muscle cell (cardiomyocyte) that is responsible for heart contraction.

CMO:0002760.name: cardiac muscle fiber diameter
CMO:0002760.def: The length of a straight line passing through a cardiac muscle fiber, that is a cardiomyocyte, for instance through the center of its nucleus, and connecting opposite points on its periphery.

CMO:0002761.name: skin molecular composition measurement
CMO:0002761.def: Any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of the skin, the tough, supple cutaneous membrane that covers the surface of the body.

CMO:0002762.name: skin electrolyte measurement
CMO:0002762.def: A quantification of one or more electrolytes in the skin.  An electrolyte is an element or compound that, when melted or dissolved in a solvent, dissociates into ions and is able to conduct an electric current.

CMO:0002763.name: skin potassium level
CMO:0002763.def: Quantification of the amount of potassium atoms or ions in a specified sample of skin.

CMO:0002764.name: skin sodium level
CMO:0002764.def: Quantification of the amount of sodium atoms or ions in a specified sample of skin.

CMO:0002765.name: skin chloride level
CMO:0002765.def: Quantification of the amount of chloride ions, that is, univalent anionic chlorine ions, in a specified sample of skin.

CMO:0002766.name: skin water level
CMO:0002766.def: Quantification of the amount of water in a specified sample of skin.

CMO:0002767.name: calculated skin electrolyte measurement
CMO:0002767.def: A measurement, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of any electrolyte(s) in skin.

CMO:0002768.name: skin potassium level to skin dry weight ratio
CMO:0002768.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of potassium atoms or ions in a specified sample of skin is divided by the dry weight of that skin sample and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: skin K+ level to skin dry weight ratio

CMO:0002769.name: skin sodium level to skin dry weight ratio
CMO:0002769.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of sodium atoms or ions in a specified sample of skin is divided by the dry weight of that skin sample and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: skin Na+ level to skin dry weight ratio

CMO:0002770.name: skin chloride level to skin dry weight ratio
CMO:0002770.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of chloride atoms or ions in a specified sample of skin is divided by the dry weight of that skin sample and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
