synonyms: skin Cl- level to skin dry weight ratio

CMO:0002771.name: skin water level to skin dry weight ratio
CMO:0002771.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of water in a specified sample of skin is divided by the dry weight of that skin sample and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: skin H2O level to skin dry weight ratio

CMO:0002772.name: skin potassium level plus skin sodium level to skin water level ratio
CMO:0002772.def: A calculated measurement in which the sum of the amount of potassium in a specified sample of skin and the amount of sodium in that sample of skin is divided by the amount of water in the same sample of skin.
synonyms: skin (K+ + Na+) level to skin H2O level ratio
skin (potassium plus sodium) level to skin water level ratio

CMO:0002773.name: skin potassium level to skin water level ratio
CMO:0002773.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of potassium in a specified sample of skin is divided by the amount of water in the same sample of skin and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: skin K+ level to skin H2O level ratio

CMO:0002774.name: skin sodium level to skin water level ratio
CMO:0002774.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of sodium in a specified sample of skin is divided by the amount of water in the same sample of skin and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: skin Na+ level to skin H2O level ratio

CMO:0002775.name: skin chloride level to skin water level ratio
CMO:0002775.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of chloride in a specified sample of skin is divided by the amount of water in the same sample of skin and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: skin Cl- level to skin H2O level ratio

CMO:0002776.name: blood cystatin level
CMO:0002776.def: The amount of any cystatin (that is, of any member of the cystatin superfamily of proteins, many of which act as cysteine protease inhibitors) found in a specified sample of blood, the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, capillaries and veins carrying nutrients and oxygen to the body tissues and metabolites away from them.

CMO:0002777.name: blood cystatin C level
CMO:0002777.def: The amount of the protein cystatin C found in a specified sample of blood, the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, capillaries and veins carrying nutrients and oxygen to the body tissues and metabolites away from them. Cystatin C is a member of the cystatin superfamily of proteins, is the most abundant extracellular inhibitor of cysteine proteases, and can be found in high concentrations in biological fluids.

CMO:0002778.name: plasma cystatin C level
CMO:0002778.def: The amount of the protein cystatin C found in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0002779.name: serum cystatin C level
CMO:0002779.def: The amount of the protein cystatin C found in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0002780.name: nose to tail body mass index
CMO:0002780.def: A calculated measurement of body size in which the weight of an animal is divided by the square of the body length, where body length is measured from the tip of the nose to the tip (that is, the distal end) of the tail.
synonyms: BMI using body length, nose to tail
BMI using nose to tail body length

CMO:0002781.name: nose to rump body mass index
CMO:0002781.def: A calculated measurement of body size in which the weight of an animal is divided by the square of the body length, where body length is measured from the tip of the nose to the rump, that is, the base of the tail.
synonyms: BMI using body length, nose to rump
BMI using nose to rump body length

CMO:0002782.name: renal plasma flow to body weight ratio
CMO:0002782.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of plasma that perfuses the kidneys per unit time per amount of body weight.

CMO:0002783.name: glomerular filtration rate to body weight ratio
CMO:0002783.def: A calculated measurement in which glomerular filtration rate, an estimate of the volume of fluid filtered from the kidney glomerular capillaries into the Bowman's capsule per specified unit of time, is divided by the total weight of the body and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002784.name: kidney sclerotic glomerular volume to total kidney glomerular volume ratio
CMO:0002784.def: A calculated value in which the volume of glomeruli with lesions resulting from fibrosis, scarring or hyaline deposits is divided by the total volume of glomeruli in a specified sample of kidney and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the total volume of glomeruli.

CMO:0002785.name: plasma angiotensin II level to plasma angiotensin I level ratio
CMO:0002785.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of angiotensin II in a specified sample of blood plasma is divided by the amount of angiotensin I in the same or a comparable sample of blood plasma, and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002786.name: blood hemoglobin A1c level
CMO:0002786.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of hemoglobin A1c (hemoglobin glycosylated as a result of the nonenzymatic attachment of a glucose/hexose moiety) in a specified sample of blood is divided by the amount of total hemoglobin in that same sample, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: blood hemoglobin A1c level level to blood hemoglobin level ratio

CMO:0002787.name: heart left ventricle weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0002787.def: A calculated value in which the weight of the heart left ventricle is divided by the length of the tibia (the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg of bipeds or hindlimb of quadrupeds which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus), and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage,thus normalizing it to the length of the leg and, by extension, to the size of the body.

CMO:0002788.name: calculated heart blood flow measurement
CMO:0002788.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the movement of blood into, through or out of the heart.

CMO:0002789.name: E/A wave ratio
CMO:0002789.def: A calculated measurement in which the value of the E wave (that is, the velocity of the blood flow across the mitral valve during passive filling of the left ventricle in early diastole) is divided by the value of the A wave (that is, the velocity of the blood flow across the mitral valve during active filling of the left ventricle caused by atrial contraction in late diastole).

CMO:0002790.name: artery tunica media width to artery inner diameter ratio
CMO:0002790.def: A calculated measurement in which the average width of the tunica media is divided by the inner diameter (that is, the diameter of the lumen) of the artery and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002791.name: heart interventricular end-diastolic septal wall  thickness
CMO:0002791.def: The thickness, width or depth of the septal wall of the heart ventricles (that is, the portion of the wall between the left and right ventricles that is shared between the two) at the end of diastole when the heart muscle is maximally relaxed.

CMO:0002792.name: heart interventricular end-systolic septal wall thickness
CMO:0002792.def: The thickness, width or depth of the septal wall of the heart ventricles (that is, the portion of the wall between the left and right ventricles that is shared between the two) at the end of systole when the heart muscle is maximally contracted.

CMO:0002793.name: tissue ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002793.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified tissue.

CMO:0002794.name: adrenal gland ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002794.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNA) of which the tissue of the adrenal gland is formed or composed.
synonyms: adrenal gland ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0002795.name: brain ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002795.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the brain is formed or composed.

CMO:0002796.name: heart ribonucleic acid composition measurement
CMO:0002796.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the heart is formed or composed.

CMO:0002797.name: kidney ribonucleic acid composition measurement
CMO:0002797.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the kidney is formed or composed.

CMO:0002798.name: lung ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002798.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the lung is formed or composed.

CMO:0002799.name: muscle ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002799.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which muscle tissue is formed or composed.

CMO:0002800.name: spleen ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002800.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the spleen is formed or composed.

CMO:0002801.name: testis ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002801.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which testis tissue is formed or composed.

CMO:0002802.name: thymus ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002802.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the thymus is formed or composed.

CMO:0002803.name: uterus ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002803.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the uterus is formed or composed.

CMO:0002804.name: body weight to body length (nose to rump) ratio
CMO:0002804.def: A calculated value in which the total body weight of an organism is divided by the length of the organism from the distance between the tip of the nose to the base of the tail, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to  the length of the body.

CMO:0002805.name: body weight to body length (nose to tail) ratio
CMO:0002805.def: A calculated value in which the total body weight of an organism is divided by the length of the organism from the distance between the tip of the nose to the distal end of the tail, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to  the length of the body.

CMO:0002806.name: body weight area under curve (AUC)
CMO:0002806.def: A calculated measurement in which a series of body weight measurements is plotted against time for a single individual and the extent of the two dimensional region bounded by the curve and the axes of the graph is determined.

CMO:0002807.name: calculated whole body visceral fat weight
CMO:0002807.def: Measurement of the whole body visceral fat which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0002808.name: whole body visceral fat weight to body length (nose to rump) ratio
CMO:0002808.def: A calculated value in which the whole body visceral fat weight is divided by the length of the organism from the tip of the nose to the base of the tail, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the length of the body.

CMO:0002809.name: systolic blood pressure variability
CMO:0002809.def: A variability measurement in which the mean is calculated from the standard deviations or the standard deviation is calculated from the means of sequential one hour systolic blood pressure measurements.

CMO:0002810.name: diastolic blood pressure variability
CMO:0002810.def: A variability measurement in which the mean is calculated from the standard deviations or the standard deviation is calculated from the means of sequential one hour diastolic blood pressure measurements.

CMO:0002811.name: mean arterial blood pressure variability
CMO:0002811.def: A variability measurement in which the mean is calculated from the standard deviations or the standard deviation is calculated from the means of sequential one hour mean arterial blood pressure measurements.

CMO:0002812.name: heart rate variability
CMO:0002812.def: Heart rate variability (HRV) is the physiological phenomenon of variation in the time interval between heartbeats. It is measured by the variation in the beat-to-beat interval.

CMO:0002813.name: ratio of horizontal distance covered in proximity of the target to total horizontal distance covered in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002813.def: This is the ratio of the total horizontal distance of an experimental subject made in proximity to the target to the total horizontal distance made within an apparatus. These movements are the result of voluntary locomotion of the experimental subject.
synonyms: horizontal distance covered resulting from voluntary locomotion in proximity to the target in an experimental apparatus to total horizontal distance covered ratio

CMO:0002814.name: calculated horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion in an experimental apparatus

CMO:0002815.name: ratio of number of glomeruli with microaneurysms to number of total glomeruli
CMO:0002815.def: A calculated value in which the number of glomeruli with microaneurysm (focal dilation of arteriocapillary junctions), is divided by the total number of glomeruli in the kidney and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the total number of glomeruli.

CMO:0002816.name: ratio of glomerular area occupied by activated mesangial cells to total glomerular area
CMO:0002816.def: A calculated value in which the area of glomeruli with activated mesangial cells (determined by the expression of α-smooth muscle actin), is divided by the total area of glomeruli counted in the kidney and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the total number of glomeruli.

CMO:0002817.name: calculated kidney glomerulus measurement
CMO:0002817.def: Any measurement that has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the glomeruli of one or both kidneys, the paired organ which functions to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes.

CMO:0002818.name: blood type I collagen C-terminal telopeptide level
CMO:0002818.def: The amount of type I collagen C-terminal telopeptide in a specified volume of blood. The C-terminal telopeptide can be used as a biomarker in the serum to measure the rate of bone turnover.

CMO:0002819.name: plasma type I collagen C-terminal telopeptide level
CMO:0002819.def: The amount of type I collagen C-terminal telopeptide in a specified volume of plasma. The C-terminal telopeptide can be used as a biomarker in the serum to measure the rate of bone turnover.

CMO:0002820.name: serum type I collagen C-terminal telopeptide level
CMO:0002820.def: The amount of type I collagen C-terminal telopeptide in a specified volume of serum. The C-terminal telopeptide can be used as a biomarker in the serum to measure the rate of bone turnover.

CMO:0002821.name: blood osteocalcin level
CMO:0002821.def: The amount of osteocalcin in a specified volume of blood. Osteocalcin is the most abundant noncollagenous protein in bone, and its concentration in serum is closely linked to bone metabolism and serves as a biological marker for the clinical assessment of bone disease.

CMO:0002823.name: plasma osteocalcin level
CMO:0002823.def: The amount of osteocalcin in a specified volume of plasma. Osteocalcin is the most abundant noncollagenous protein in bone, and its concentration in serum is closely linked to bone metabolism and serves as a biological marker for the clinical assessment of bone disease.

CMO:0002824.name: serum osteocalcin level
CMO:0002824.def: The amount of osteocalcin in a specified volume of serum. Osteocalcin is the most abundant noncollagenous protein in bone, and its concentration in serum is closely linked to bone metabolism and serves as a biological marker for the clinical assessment of bone disease.

CMO:0002825.name: cell organelle measurement
CMO:0002825.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of one or more cellular organelles.

CMO:0002826.name: neuron organelle measurement
CMO:0002826.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of one or more neuronal organelles.

CMO:0002827.name: neuron cytoplasm measurement
CMO:0002827.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of neuron cytoplasm.

CMO:0002828.name: neuron cytoplasm area
CMO:0002828.def: A measurement of the average extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through the cell cytoplasm. (GO:0005737 and ISBN:0198547684).

CMO:0002829.name: neuron mitochondrion measurement
CMO:0002829.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of one or more neuronal mitochondria.

CMO:0002830.name: neuron mitochondrion area
CMO:0002830.def: A measurement of the average extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through neuronal mitochondria.

CMO:0002831.name: calculated neuron mitochondrion area measurement
CMO:0002831.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the neuron mitochondrion area.

CMO:0002832.name: neuron mitochondrion area to neuron cytoplasm area ratio
CMO:0002832.def: A calculated measurement in which the neuronal mitochondrion area is divided by the neuronal cytoplasm area, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: neuronal mitochondrion area to neuronal cytoplasm area ratio

CMO:0002833.name: neuron lysosome measurement
CMO:0002833.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of one or more neuronal lysosomes.

CMO:0002834.name: neuron lysosome area
CMO:0002834.def: A measurement of the average extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through neuronal lysosomes.

CMO:0002835.name: calculated neuron lysosome area measurement
CMO:0002835.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the neuron lysosome area.

CMO:0002836.name: neuron lysosome area to neuron cytoplasm area ratio
CMO:0002836.def: A calculated measurement in which the neuronal lysosome area is divided by the neuronal cytoplasm area, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: neuronal lysosome area to neuronal cytoplasm area ratio

CMO:0002837.name: neuron golgi apparatus measurement
CMO:0002837.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of the neuronal golgi apparatus.

CMO:0002838.name: neuron golgi apparatus area
CMO:0002838.def: A measurement of the average extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through the neuronal golgi apparatus.

CMO:0002839.name: calculated neuron golgi apparatus area measurement
CMO:0002839.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the neuron golgi apparatus area.
synonyms: calculated neuronal golgi apparatus area measurement

CMO:0002840.name: neuron golgi apparatus area to neuron cytoplasm area ratio
CMO:0002840.def: A calculated measurement in which the neuronal golgi apparatus area is divided by the neuronal cytoplasm area, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: neuronal golgi apparatus area to neuronal cytoplasm area ratio

CMO:0002841.name: neuron  rough endoplasmic reticulum measurement
CMO:0002841.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of the neuronal rough endoplasmic reticulum.

CMO:0002842.name: neuron rough endoplasmic reticulum area
CMO:0002842.def: A measurement of the average extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through the neuronal rough endoplasmic reticulum.
synonyms: neuronal rough endoplasmic reticulum area measurement

CMO:0002843.name: calculated neuron rough endoplasmic reticulum area measurement
CMO:0002843.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the neuron rough endoplasmic reticulum area.
synonyms: calculated neuronal rough endoplasmic reticulum area measurement

CMO:0002844.name: neuron rough endoplasmic reticulum area to neuron cytoplasm area ratio
CMO:0002844.def: A calculated measurement in which the neuronal rough endoplasmic reticulum area is divided by the neuronal cytoplasm area, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: neuronal rough endoplasmic reticulum area to neuronal cytoplasm area ratio

CMO:0002845.name: neuron  vacuole measurement
CMO:0002845.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of the neuronal vacuole.

CMO:0002846.name: neuron vacuole area
CMO:0002846.def: A measurement of the average extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through the neuronal vacuole.

CMO:0002847.name: calculated neuron vacuole area measurement
CMO:0002847.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the neuron vacuole area.

CMO:0002848.name: neuron vacuole area to neuron cytoplasm area ratio
CMO:0002848.def: A calculated measurement in which the neuronal vacuole area is divided by the neuronal cytoplasm area, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: neuronal vacuole area to neuronal cytoplasm area ratio

CMO:0002849.name: mesenteric artery morphological measurement
CMO:0002849.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of one or more of the mesenteric arteries, which arise from the anterior surface of the abdominal aorta, just inferior to the origin of the celiac trunk, and supplies blood to the intestine from the lower part of the duodenum through two-thirds of the transverse colon, as well as the pancreas.

CMO:0002850.name: mesenteric artery molecular composition measurement
CMO:0002850.def: Any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of the wall of one or more of the mesenteric arteries.

CMO:0002851.name: calculated mesenteric artery molecular composition measurement
CMO:0002851.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the physical form or structure of any of the mesenteric arteries.
synonyms: calculated mesenteric artery wall molecular composition measurement

CMO:0002852.name: mesenteric artery phosphorylated eNOS level to total eNOS level ratio
CMO:0002852.def: A calculated measurement in which mesenteric artery phosphorylated eNOS protein level is divided by aorta wall total eNOS protein level and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Phosphorylation of eNOS is a mechanism that catylzes a structural change of the enzyme to an activated form.
synonyms: mesenteric artery phosphylated eNOS protein level to total eNOS protein level ratio
mesenteric artery wall phosphylated eNOS level to total eNOS level ratio

CMO:0002853.name: aorta wall phosphorylated eNOS level to total eNOS level ratio
CMO:0002853.def: A calculated measurement in which aorta wall phosphorylated eNOS protein level is divided by aorta wall total eNOS protein level and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Phosphorylation of eNOS is a mechanism that catylzes a structural change of the enzyme to an activated form.
synonyms: aorta wall phosphylated eNOS protein level to total eNOS protein level ratio

CMO:0002854.name: voluntary horizontal locomotion rate in an experimental apparatus
CMO:0002854.def: The count of discrete movements of an organism from one place to another along a plane parallel to the plane of the horizon in a piece of technical equipment or machinery, or in an appliance or device designed for a particular purpose originated, undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice within a specified period of time.

CMO:0002855.name: blood fructosamine level
CMO:0002855.def: The amount of fructosamine, the compound that results from glycation reactions between a sugar and a primary amine, followed by isomerization via the Amadori rearrangement, found in a specific volume of blood

CMO:0002856.name: serum fructosamine level
CMO:0002856.def: The amount of fructosamine, the compound that results from glycation reactions between a sugar and a primary amine, followed by isomerization via the Amadori rearrangement, found in a specific volume of serum.

CMO:0002857.name: plasma fructosamine level
CMO:0002857.def: The amount of fructosamine, the compound that results from glycation reactions between a sugar and a primary amine, followed by isomerization via the Amadori rearrangement, found in a specific volume of plasma.

CMO:0002858.name: calculated water drink intake rate
CMO:0002858.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the water drink intake rate.

CMO:0002859.name: water intake drink rate to body weight ratio
CMO:0002859.def: Amount of water consumed as a drink per unit time divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002860.name: monophasic action potential
CMO:0002860.def: Monophasic action potentials (MAPs) are recorded using contact electrode catheters. The recordings provide local information about the actual cellular depolarization and repolarization process of myocardial tissue. They are different from body surface electrocardiographic (ECG) recordings or standard endocardial electrograms, which produce a summative or derivative view of the heart's electrical activity

CMO:0002861.name: conduction velocity
CMO:0002861.def: Conduction velocity is calculated as the distance from pacing electrode to the monophasic action potential recording electrode across the epicardial surface, divided by the conduction time, the time from the pacing spike to monophasic action potential onset.

CMO:0002862.name: E/E' wave ratio
CMO:0002862.def: The E/E' is a ratio of peak velocity of early diastolic trans-mitral flow (E) to the peak velocity of early diastolic mitral annular motion (E')
synonyms: E wave velocity to E' wave velocity ratio

CMO:0002863.name: heart molecular composition measurement
CMO:0002863.def: Any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of the tissue(s) of the heart.

CMO:0002864.name: heart free fatty acid level
CMO:0002864.def: Measurement of the amount of free fatty acids within the heart.

CMO:0002865.name: heart triglyceride level
CMO:0002865.def: Measurement of the amount of triglycerides within the heart.

CMO:0002866.name: calculated heart left ventricle end-systolic posterior wall thickness
CMO:0002866.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the end-systolic heart left ventricle posterior wall thickness.

CMO:0002867.name: heart left ventricle end-systolic posterior wall index
CMO:0002867.def: A calculated measurement in which the heart left ventricle end-systolic posterior wall thickness is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002868.name: calculated heart left ventricle end-systolic internal diameter
CMO:0002868.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the heart left ventricle end-systolic internal diameter.
synonyms: calculated heart left ventricle end-systolic internal dimension

CMO:0002869.name: heart left ventricle end-systolic diameter to body weight ratio
CMO:0002869.def: A calculated measurement in which the heart left ventricle end-systolic internal diameter is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: heart left ventricle end-systolic dimension to body weight ratio
heart left ventricle end-systolic internal dimension index
LV internal dimension during systole divided by body weight

CMO:0002870.name: calculated heart ventricle end-systolic septal wall thickness
CMO:0002870.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the heart ventricle end-systolic septal wall thickness.
synonyms: calculated heart end-systolic intraventricular wall thickness

CMO:0002871.name: heart ventricle end-systolic septal wall index
CMO:0002871.def: A calculated measurement in which the heart ventricle end-systolic septal wall thickness is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002872.name: A wave velocity
CMO:0002872.def: Peak velocity of late atrial diastolic trans-mitral flow (A).

CMO:0002873.name: E' wave velocity
CMO:0002873.def: E' wave velocity is the peak velocity of early mitral annular diastolic motion.

CMO:0002874.name: A' wave velocity
CMO:0002874.def: A' wave velocity (A') is the peak velocity of late (atrial) diastolic mitral annular motion.

CMO:0002875.name: blood NAGA activity level
CMO:0002875.def: The amount of enzymatic activity of α-N-acetylgalactosaminidase (NAGA) in a specified sample of blood.

CMO:0002876.name: blood NH2-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide level
CMO:0002876.def: This is a measurement of the amount of N-terminal (NT)-pro hormone BNP (NPPB) in a specified volume of blood.
synonyms: N-terminal prohormone brain natriuretic peptide measurement

CMO:0002877.name: plasma NH2-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide level
CMO:0002877.def: This is a measurement of the amount of N-terminal (NT)-pro hormone BNP (NPPB) in a specified volume of plasma.

CMO:0002878.name: calculated plasma aldosterone level
CMO:0002878.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of aldosterone in a specified sample of plasma.

CMO:0002879.name: plasma aldosterone level to plasma renin activity ratio

CMO:0002880.name: calculated cardiac output measurement
CMO:0002880.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of cardiac output.

CMO:0002881.name: cardiac index
CMO:0002881.def: A calculated measurement in which the cardiac output is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002882.name: calculated stroke volume
CMO:0002882.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of cardiac stroke volume.

CMO:0002883.name: stroke index
CMO:0002883.def: A calculated measurement in which the cardiac stroke volume is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002884.name: calculated left ventricular end-systolic blood pressure
CMO:0002884.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the left ventricular end-systolic blood pressure.

CMO:0002885.name: arterial elastance
CMO:0002885.def: Effective arterial elastance (Ea), defined as the ratio of left ventricular end-systolic pressure (Pes) to stroke volume (SV), provides a convenient, useful method to assess arterial load.

CMO:0002886.name: ventricle stroke work
CMO:0002886.def: Defined as the work performed by the left or right ventricle to eject the stroke volume into the aorta or pulmonary artery, respectively.

CMO:0002887.name: left ventricle stroke work
CMO:0002887.def: Defined as the work performed by the left ventricle to eject the stroke volume into the aorta.

CMO:0002888.name: preload recruitable left ventricle stroke work
CMO:0002888.def: Preload recruitable stroke work (PRSW) is determined by the linear regression of stroke work with the end-diastolic volume. The slope of the PRSW relationship is a highly linear index of myocardial contractility that is insensitive to preload and afterload.

CMO:0002889.name: maximum rate of positive change in left ventricular blood pressure to left ventricular end-diastolic volume ratio
CMO:0002889.def: A calculated measurement in which the maximum rate of positive change in left ventricular blood pressure is divided by the left ventricular end-diastolic volume, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002890.name: calculated heart left ventricle end-diastolic posterior wall thickness
CMO:0002890.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the end-diastolic heart left ventricle posterior wall thickness.

CMO:0002891.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic posterior wall index
CMO:0002891.def: A calculated measurement in which the heart left ventricle end-diastolic posterior wall thickness is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002892.name: calculated heart left ventricle end-diastolic anterior wall thickness
CMO:0002892.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the heart left ventricle end-diastolic anterior wall thickness.

CMO:0002893.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic anterior wall index
CMO:0002893.def: A calculated measurement in which the heart left ventricle end-diastolic anterior wall thickness is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002894.name: calculated heart ventricle end-diastolic septal wall thickness
CMO:0002894.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the heart ventricle end-diastolic septal wall thickness.

CMO:0002895.name: heart ventricle end-diastolic septal wall index
CMO:0002895.def: A calculated measurement in which the heart ventricle end-diastolic septal wall thickness is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002896.name: urine 3-hydroxybutyrate level
CMO:0002896.def: Measurement of the amount of a ketone body, 3-hydroxybutyrate, in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0002897.name: urine acetoacetate level
CMO:0002897.def: This is a measurement of the amount of a ketone body, acetoacetate, in a specified sample of urine. Acetoacetate is the conjugate base of acetoacetic acid, a physiologically relevant ketone body.

CMO:0002898.name: blood glycated albumin level
CMO:0002898.def: The amount of glycated albumin in a specified volume of blood. Glycation is the result of a sugar molecule, such as fructose or glucose, bonding to a protein or lipid molecule without the controlling action of an enzyme.

CMO:0002899.name: blood glycated albumin level to blood albumin level ratio
CMO:0002899.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of glycated albumin in a specified sample of blood is divided by the amount of total albumin in that same sample, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002900.name: calculated blood hemoglobin level
CMO:0002900.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of hemoglobin, or a derivative of hemoglobin, in a specified sample of blood.

CMO:0002901.name: calculated blood glycated albumin level
CMO:0002901.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of glycated albumin in a specified sample of blood.

CMO:0002902.name: blood hemoglobin A1c level level to blood hemoglobin level ratio
CMO:0002902.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of hemoglobin A1c in a specified sample of blood is divided by the amount of total hemoglobin in that same sample, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002903.name: renal medullary blood flow rate
CMO:0002903.def: Renal medullary blood flow (MBF) is the volume of blood delivered to or exiting from the renal medulla per unit time.

CMO:0002904.name: blood vasopressin level
CMO:0002904.def: The amount of vasopressin in a specified volume of blood. Vasopressin belongs to family of cyclic nonapeptide hormones found in most mammals. Synthesised in the hypothalamus and stored in the post-pituitary, vasopressins play a key role in homeostasis, particularly in regulating the body's water content. Together with the similar neuropeptide oxytocin, they are believed to influence social cognition and behaviour

CMO:0002905.name: plasma vasopressin level
CMO:0002905.def: The amount of vasopressin in a specified volume of plasma. Vasopressin belongs to family of cyclic nonapeptide hormones found in most mammals. Synthesised in the hypothalamus and stored in the post-pituitary, vasopressins play a key role in homeostasis, particularly in regulating the body's water content. Together with the similar neuropeptide oxytocin, they are believed to influence social cognition and behaviour.

CMO:0002906.name: serum vasopressin level
CMO:0002906.def: The amount of vasopressin in a specified volume of serum. Vasopressin belongs to family of cyclic nonapeptide hormones found in most mammals. Synthesised in the hypothalamus and stored in the post-pituitary, vasopressins play a key role in homeostasis, particularly in regulating the body's water content. Together with the similar neuropeptide oxytocin, they are believed to influence social cognition and behaviour.

CMO:0002907.name: urine phosphate excretion rate
CMO:0002907.def: Measurement of the amount of phosphorus, measured as inorganic phosphate eliminated from the body in the urine per unit time.

CMO:0002908.name: urine urea excretion rate
CMO:0002908.def: The amount of urea excreted into the urine within a specified period of time.

CMO:0002909.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic elastance
CMO:0002909.def: Left ventricle end-diastolic elastance (Eed) is the estimate of the slope of the line Ped = Eed(Ved-V0), which is based on linear regression of points determined by iterative calculation of the LV end-diastolic pressure-volume relationship.

CMO:0002910.name: heart left ventricle end-systolic elastance
CMO:0002910.def: Left ventricle end-systolic elastance (Ees) is the estimate of the slope of the line Pes = Ees(Ves-V0), which is based on linear regression of points determined by iterative calculation of the LV end-systolic pressure-volume relationship.

CMO:0002911.name: calculated ventricle contraction measurement
CMO:0002911.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of components of the periodic tightening and loosening of the muscles of a ventricle of the heart.

CMO:0002912.name: heart left ventricle diastolic volume-axis intercept
CMO:0002912.def: Left ventricle diastolic volume-axis intercept (V0) is determined by the line Ped = Eed(Ved-V0), which is based on linear regression of points determined by iterative calculation of the LV end-diastolic pressure-volume relationship. Ped = end-diastolic pressure, Ved = end-diastolic volume, V0  theoretical volume when no pressure is generated, Eed (end-diastolic elastance, stiffness) is the slope of the EDPVR (LV end-diastolic pressurevolume relationship).

CMO:0002913.name: heart left ventricle systolic volume-axis intercept
CMO:0002913.def: Left ventricle systolic volume-axis intercept (V0) is determined by the line Pes = Ees(Ves-V0), which is based on linear regression of points determined by iterative calculation of the LV end-diastolic pressurevolume relationship. Pes = end-systolic pressure, Ves = end-systolic volume, V0  theoretical volume when no pressure is generated, Ees (index of LV systolic function, contractility) is the slope of the ESPVR (LV end-systolic pressurevolume relationship).

CMO:0002914.name: calculated end-diastolic volume
CMO:0002914.def: A measurement of the volume of blood in ventricle immediately before a contraction which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation. .

CMO:0002915.name: calculated end-systolic volume
CMO:0002915.def: A measurement of the volume of blood in a ventricle at the end of a contraction which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0002916.name: kidney adrenomedullin level
CMO:0002916.def: The amount of adrenomedullin in a specified sample of kidney tissue.

CMO:0002917.name: kidney medullary adrenomedullin level
CMO:0002917.def: The amount of adrenomedullin in a specified sample of medullary kidney tissue.

CMO:0002918.name: kidney cortical adrenomedullin level
CMO:0002918.def: The amount of adrenomedullin in a specified sample of cortical kidney tissue.

CMO:0002919.name: urine urotensin II level
CMO:0002919.def: The amount of urotensin II in a specified volume of urine.

CMO:0002920.name: calculated urine urotensin II level
CMO:0002920.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of urotensin II in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0002921.name: urine urotensin II level to urine creatinine level ratio
CMO:0002921.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of urotensin II is divided by the amount of creatinine in a specified volume of urine.

CMO:0002922.name: calculated urine albumin level
CMO:0002922.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of albumin in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0002923.name: plasma osmolality
CMO:0002923.def: The number of dissolved particles in a specified volume of plasma.

CMO:0002924.name: urine urea level
CMO:0002924.def: Any measurement of urea in urine, the fluid waste product excreted by the kidneys. Urea is the main nitrogenous breakdown product of protein metabolism in mammals and is excreted in urine.

CMO:0002925.name: calculated urine urea level
CMO:0002925.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of urea in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0002926.name: urine urea level to urine creatinine level ratio
CMO:0002926.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of urea present in a specified volume of urine , is divided by the amount of creatinine in a specified volume of urine.

CMO:0002927.name: calculated urine sodium level
CMO:0002927.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of sodium in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0002928.name: urine sodium level to urine creatinine level ratio
CMO:0002928.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of sodium ions present in a specified volume of urine , is divided by the amount of creatinine in a specified volume of urine.

CMO:0002929.name: calculated urine potassium level
CMO:0002929.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of potassium in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0002930.name: urine potassium level to urine creatinine level ratio
CMO:0002930.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of potassium ions present in a specified volume of urine , is divided by the amount of creatinine in a specified volume of urine.

CMO:0002931.name: calculated glomerular filtration rate
CMO:0002931.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the volume of fluid filtered from the kidney glomerular capillaries into the Bowman's capsule per specified unit of time based on a blood solute level, weight and age of organism and other factors.

CMO:0002932.name: heart nucleic acid measurement
CMO:0002932.def: Any quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of one or more nucleic acids in the heart. Nucleic acids are high-molecular-weight polymeric compounds composed of nucleotides, each consisting of a purine or pyrimidine base, a ribose or deoxyribose sugar, and a phosphate group, and are involved in the determination and transmission of genetic characteristics.

CMO:0002933.name: heart ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002933.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the heart is formed or composed.

CMO:0002934.name: heart insulin-like growth factor 1 mRNA level

CMO:0002935.name: heart left ventricle ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002935.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the heart left ventricle is formed or composed.
synonyms: heart left ventricle ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0002936.name: heart right ventricle insulin-like growth factor 1 mRNA level

CMO:0002937.name: heart right ventricle ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0002937.def: This is a measurement of the amount of ribonucleic acid (RNA), the molecule composed of the sugar ribose, phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or uracil, extracted from or contained in the heart right ventricle, the lower chamber of the right side of the heart (from the perspective of the organism rather than the observer), which pumps venous blood through the pulmonary trunk and arteries to the capillaries of the lung.
synonyms: heart right ventricle ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0002938.name: heart right ventricle molecular composition measurement

CMO:0002939.name: heart left ventricle insulin-like growth factor 1 mRNA level
synonyms: heart left ventricle Igf1r mRNA level

CMO:0002940.name: heart insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor mRNA level

CMO:0002941.name: heart right ventricle insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor mRNA level

CMO:0002942.name: heart left ventricle insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor mRNA level

CMO:0002943.name: renal filtration fraction
CMO:0002943.def: Filtration fraction is the ratio of the glomerular filtration rate (GFR) to the renal plasma flow (RPF). Filtration Fraction, FF = GFR/RPF. The filtration fraction, therefore, represents the proportion of the fluid reaching the kidneys which passes into the renal tubules.

CMO:0002944.name: glomerular filtration rate to kidney weight ratio

CMO:0002945.name: single nephron glomerular filtration rate
CMO:0002945.def: A calculated measurement to determine the volume of fluid filtered from the renal (kidney) glomerular capillaries of a single nephron into Bowman's capsule per unit time.

CMO:0002946.name: single nephron filtration fraction
CMO:0002946.def: A calculated measurement to determine the ratio of the single nephron glomerular filtration rate (SNGFR) to the renal plasma flow (RPF). Single nephron filtration Fraction, SNFF = SNGFR/RPF. The single nephron filtration fraction, therefore, represents the proportion of the fluid reaching the kidneys which passes into the renal tubules from a single nephron.

CMO:0002948.name: renal tubulointerstitial score
CMO:0002948.def: A semiquantitative evaluation of the renal interstitium using a grading system with a score of 0 to 4+, which assesses the tubules and the interstitium for the presence of (1) tubular atrophy, (2) tubular dilatation, (3) interstitial inflammatory cell infiltrates, and (4) interstitial fibrosis. A score of 0 indicates no lesion (normal kidney), 1+ indicates a single, small focal lesion with very minimal tubular alterations and interstitial inflammatory cell infiltration, and 2+ to 4+ indicated increasing severity of tubular lesions, interstitial inflammatory cell infiltration, and/or fibrosis. A score of 4+ indicates involvement of approximately 50% or more of the renal parenchyma or interstitium.

CMO:0002949.name: urine podocalyxin excretion rate
CMO:0002949.def: Measurement of the amount of podocalyxin eliminated from the body in the urine per unit time. Podocalyxin is a sialoglycoprotein found in the glycocalyx that covers the apical surface of podocytes.

CMO:0002950.name: heart left atrium weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0002950.def: A calculated value in which the weight of the left atrium, the upper chamber on the left side of the heart which empties into the lower left chamber, is divided by the total weight of the body and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight.

CMO:0002951.name: calculated heart right atrium morphological measurement
CMO:0002951.def: A measurement of the physical form or structure of the right atrium, the right upper chamber of the heart that receives blood from the vena cava and forces it into the right ventricle, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0002952.name: heart right atrium weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0002952.def: A calculated value in which the weight of the right atrium, the upper chamber on the right side of the heart which empties into the lower right left chamber, is divided by the total weight of the body and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight.

CMO:0002953.name: heart septum weight
CMO:0002953.def: The weight of the septum of the heart, which is the portion of the heart left ventricle ventral/anterior wall and right ventricle dorsal/posterior wall which is shared between the ventricles, after removal from the body and separation from the rest of the heart.

CMO:0002954.name: number of podocytes per  kidney glomerulus
CMO:0002954.def: The average number of podocytes in the kidney glomeruli.

CMO:0002955.name: number of podocytes to glomerular volume ratio
CMO:0002955.def: A calculated measurement in which the average number of podocytes is divided by the average volume of kidney glomeruli.

CMO:0002956.name: urine aldosterone measurement
CMO:0002956.def: Any measurement of aldosterone in urine.

CMO:0002957.name: urine aldosterone level
CMO:0002957.def: Measurement of the amount of aldosterone in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0002958.name: urine aldosterone excretion rate
CMO:0002958.def: Measurement of the amount of aldosterone eliminated from the body in the urine per unit time. Aldosterone is a mineralocorticoid hormone produced by the adrenal cortex.

CMO:0002959.name: number of nucleated cells per  kidney glomerulus
CMO:0002959.def: The average number of nucleated cells in the kidney glomeruli.

CMO:0002960.name: mesangial injury score
CMO:0002960.def: An injury score obtained by multiplying the degree of glomerular damage (0 to 4) with the percentage of the glomeruli with that type of injury (i.e., increase in mesangial matrix material or glomerulosclerosis).

CMO:0002961.name: blood parathyroid hormone level
CMO:0002961.def: Amount of parathyroid hormone, a hormone that regulates blood calcium and phosphate levels, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0002962.name: plasma parathyroid hormone level
CMO:0002962.def: Amount of parathyroid hormone, a hormone that regulates blood calcium and phosphate levels, in a specified volume of plasma.

CMO:0002963.name: serum parathyroid hormone level
CMO:0002963.def: Amount of parathyroid hormone, a hormone that regulates blood calcium and phosphate levels, in a specified volume of serum.

CMO:0002964.name: tibialis anterior muscle weight
CMO:0002964.def: The weight or the measure of the heaviness of tibialis anterior muscle, which is a muscle that originates in the upper two-thirds of the lateral surface of the tibia and inserts into the medial cuneiform and first metatarsal bones of the foot. Its acts to invert the foot. It is situated on the lateral side of the tibia; it is thick and fleshy above, tendinous below. This muscle overlaps the anterior tibial vessels and deep peroneal nerve in the upper part of the leg.

CMO:0002965.name: extensor digitorum longus muscle weight
CMO:0002965.def: The weight or the measure of the heaviness of extensor digitorum longus muscle, which is a penniform muscle of the lateral front part of the hindlimb responsible for extension of the digits and dorsiflexion of the ankle.

CMO:0002966.name: tibialis anterior muscle weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0002966.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of tibialis anterior muscle is divided by the total weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thereby normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.

CMO:0002967.name: extensor digitorum longus muscle weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0002967.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of extensor digitorum longus muscle is divided by the total weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thereby normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.

CMO:0002968.name: afferent arteriolar plasma flow rate
CMO:0002968.def: Volume of blood plasma delivered to a single glomerulus per unit time

CMO:0002969.name: glomerular capillary hydraulic pressure
CMO:0002969.def: Force exerted on the luminal capillary wall from fluid flowing through the capillary.

CMO:0002970.name: arteriole measurement
CMO:0002970.def: Any measurement of one of the small blood vessels carrying blood between arteries and capillaries.

CMO:0002971.name: arteriolar resistance
CMO:0002971.def: Resistance that must be overcome to push blood through arterioles to create flow.

CMO:0002972.name: efferent arteriolar resistance
CMO:0002972.def: Resistance to blood flow measured within the efferent arteriole proximal to a glomerular capillary network.

CMO:0002973.name: afferent arteriolar resistance
CMO:0002973.def: Resistance to blood flow measured within the afferent arteriole distal to a glomerular capillary network.

CMO:0002974.name: total arteriolar resistance
CMO:0002974.def: Total resistance to blood flow measured within the afferent arteriole proximal and distal to a glomerular capillary network (Rt = Ra + Re).

CMO:0002975.name: afferent arteriolar plasma protein concentration
CMO:0002975.def: Measurement of the total amount of all proteins found in a specific volume of afferent arteriolar plasma.

CMO:0002976.name: efferent arteriolar plasma protein concentration
CMO:0002976.def: Measurement of the total amount of all proteins found in a specific volume of efferent arteriolar plasma.

CMO:0002977.name: afferent colloid osmotic pressure
CMO:0002977.def: A form of osmotic pressure exerted by proteins, notably albumin, in the afferent arteriole's plasma that tends to pull water into the circulatory system. It is the opposing force to hydrostatic pressure. It has a major effect on the pressure across the glomerular filter.

CMO:0002978.name: efferent colloid osmotic pressure
CMO:0002978.def: A form of osmotic pressure exerted by proteins, notably albumin, in the efferent arteriole's plasma that tends to pull water into the circulatory system. It is the opposing force to hydrostatic pressure. It has a major effect on the pressure across the glomerular filter

CMO:0002979.name: glomerular capillary ultrafiltration coefficient
CMO:0002979.def: A measure of a membrane's permeability to water; specifically, the volume of fluid filtered in unit time through a unit area of membrane per unit pressure difference, and it is defined as the glomerular filtration rate (GFR) for both kidneys per millimeter of mercury (mmHg) of filtration pressure.

CMO:0002980.name: ratio of the area occupied by cysts to the total area of the kidney
CMO:0002980.def: A calculated measurement in which the area occupied by renal cysts is divided by the total the kidney, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002981.name: blood angiotensin I level
CMO:0002981.def: Blood measurement of Angiotensin I, a decapeptide that is cleaved from precursor angiotensinogen by renin. It is converted to angiotensin II by angiotensin converting enzyme.

CMO:0002982.name: plasma angiotensin I level
CMO:0002982.def: Plasma measurement of Angiotensin I, a decapeptide that is cleaved from precursor angiotensinogen by renin. It is converted to angiotensin II by angiotensin converting enzyme.

CMO:0002983.name: serum angiotensin I level
CMO:0002983.def: Serum measurement of Angiotensin I, a decapeptide that is cleaved from precursor angiotensinogen by renin. It is converted to angiotensin II by angiotensin converting enzyme.

CMO:0002984.name: mean proximal tubular hydraulic pressure
CMO:0002984.def: Force exerted on the luminal surface of the proximal tubule from fluid flowing through the tubule.

CMO:0002985.name: efferent arteriolar hydraulic pressure
CMO:0002985.def: Force exerted on the luminal vessel wall from fluid flowing through the efferent arteriole.

CMO:0002986.name: glomerular transcapillary hydraulic pressure gradient
CMO:0002986.def: The difference between the force exerted on the luminal glomerular capillary wall and the force exerted on the luminal proximal tubular membrane (Pgc - Pt = delta P).

CMO:0002990.name: retroperitoneal fat pad weight to tibia length ratio

CMO:0002991.name: inguinal fat pad weight to tibia length ratio

CMO:0002992.name: calculated left ventricular end-diastolic blood pressure measurement

CMO:0002993.name: heart left ventricular end-diastolic blood pressure to heart left ventricular end-diastolic diameter ratio
CMO:0002993.def: A calculated measurement in which the pressure in the heart left ventricle at the end of diastole, the period when the heart is in a state of relaxation and expansion and the ventricles fill with blood, divided by the diameter across the left ventricle of the heart at the end of diastole and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0002994.name: rate-pressure product
CMO:0002994.def: Rate-pressure product is defined as the product of the heart rate (the number of contractions of the cardiac ventricles per unit of time) (beats per minute) and mean arterial blood pressure (the average force the blood exerts on an artery wall) (mm Hg).

CMO:0002995.name: liver weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0002995.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of the liver is divided by the length of tibia, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.

CMO:0002996.name: pancreas weight to tibia length
CMO:0002996.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of the pancreas is divided by the length of tibia, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.

CMO:0002997.name: urine sodium level to body weight ratio
CMO:0002997.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of sodium ions present in a specified volume of urine , is divided by the total weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.

CMO:0002998.name: urine potassium level to body weight ratio
CMO:0002998.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of potassium ions present in a specified volume of urine , is divided by the total weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.

CMO:0002999.name: urine sodium level to urine potassium level ratio
CMO:0002999.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of sodium ions present in a specified volume of urine , is divided by the amount of potassium in a specified volume of urine.

CMO:0003000.name: blood insulin level AUC to blood glucose level AUC ratio
CMO:0003000.def: The calculated value blood insulin level area under curve divided by the calculated blood glucose level area under curve. Area under the curve for blood glucose or insulin is a value in which a series of measurements of the amount of insulin or glucose in a specified volume of blood is plotted against time for a single individual and the extent of the two dimensional region bounded by the curve and the axes of the graph is determined.

CMO:0003001.name: whole body insulin sensitivity index
CMO:0003001.def: A calculated measurement to estimate the effect of insulin on net glucose disposal (insulin sensitivity) in an organism, calculated as 10000/(sqaure root of ((fasting glucose x fasting insulin) x (mean glucose across duration of glucose tolerance test x mean insulin across duration of glucose tolerance test).

CMO:0003002.name: Homeostatic Model Assessment of Insulin Resistance
CMO:0003002.def: Calculated model of insulin resistance where the product of fasting glucose and fasting insulin is divided by 22.5. Glucose is measured in mmol/L and insulin in measured in uIU/ml.

CMO:0003003.name: blood hesperetin level
CMO:0003003.def: The amount of hesperetin found in a specified volume of blood. Hesperetin belongs to the flavanone class of flavonoids. Hesperetin, in the form of its glycoside Hesperidin, is the predominant flavonoid in lemons and oranges.

CMO:0003004.name: plasma hesperetin level
CMO:0003004.def: The amount of hesperetin found in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.Hesperetin, in the form of its glycoside Hesperidin, is the predominant flavonoid in lemons and oranges.

CMO:0003005.name: serum hesperetin level
CMO:0003005.def: The amount of hesperetin found in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. Hesperetin, in the form of its glycoside Hesperidin, is the predominant flavonoid in lemons and oranges.

CMO:0003006.name: liver glucose-6-phosphatase level
CMO:0003006.def: Amount of glucose-6-phophatase measured in a specified sample of liver.

CMO:0003007.name: liver glucokinase level
CMO:0003007.def: Amount of glucokinase measured in a specified sample of liver.

CMO:0003008.name: calculated serum high density lipoprotein cholesterol level
CMO:0003008.def: A measurement of the amount of high density lipoprotein cholesterol in serum which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation. Cholesterol is a eukaryotic sterol that in higher animals is the precursor of bile acids and steroid hormones and a key constituent of cell membranes, is carried in high-density lipoprotein (HDL) molecules. High density lipoprotein cholesterol refers to any of a group of conjugated proteins that have at least one lipid component.

CMO:0003009.name: serum high density lipoprotein cholesterol level to serum total cholesterol level ratio
CMO:0003009.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of HDL cholesterol in a specified volume of serum is divided by the amount of total serum cholesterol, without taking into account any association with other molecules such as lipoproteins, in a specified volume of serum, in the same sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003010.name: blood dipeptidyl peptidase 4 activity level
CMO:0003010.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by dipeptidyl-peptidase 4 (DPP4) in a specified volume of blood. Dpp4 is a cell surface glycoprotein receptor involved in the costimulatory signal essential for T-cell receptor (TCR)-mediated T-cell activation.

CMO:0003011.name: plasma dipeptidyl peptidase 4 activity level
CMO:0003011.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by dipeptidyl-peptidase IV (DPP4) in a specified volume of plasma. Dpp4 is a cell surface glycoprotein receptor involved in the costimulatory signal essential for T-cell receptor (TCR)-mediated T-cell activation.

CMO:0003012.name: serum dipeptidyl peptidase 4 activity level
CMO:0003012.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by dipeptidyl-peptidase IV (DPP4) in a specified volume of serum. Dpp4 is a cell surface glycoprotein receptor involved in the costimulatory signal essential for T-cell receptor (TCR)-mediated T-cell activation.

CMO:0003013.name: artery tunica media to artery total diameter ratio
CMO:0003013.def: A calculated measurement of the average width of the tunica media (the middle coat of the arterial wall) divided by the artery total diameter (measured as the length of a line which crosses a transverse view of an artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the outer surface of the blood vessel wall).

CMO:0003014.name: artery lumen to artery total diameter ratio
CMO:0003014.def: A calculated measurement of the average width of the artery lumen (measured as the length of a line which crosses a transverse view of an artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall) divided by the artery total diameter (measured as the length of a line which crosses a transverse view of an artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the outer surface of the blood vessel wall).

CMO:0003015.name: gastrointestinal tract morphological measurement
CMO:0003015.def: Measurement of the morphological characteristics of the gastrointestinal tract. The gastrointestinal tract is an organ system within humans and other animals which takes in food, digests it to extract and absorb energy and nutrients, and expels the remaining waste as feces. The mouth, esophagus, stomach and intestines are part of the gastrointestinal tract.

CMO:0003016.name: gastrointestinal tract weight
CMO:0003016.def: Measurement of the weight or heaviness of the gastrointestinal tract, that is, the degree to which it is drawn toward the earth by gravity. The gastrointestinal tract is an organ system within humans and other animals which takes in food, digests it to extract and absorb energy and nutrients, and expels the remaining waste as feces. The mouth, esophagus, stomach and intestines are part of the gastrointestinal tract.

CMO:0003017.name: calculated gastrointestinal tract weight
CMO:0003017.def: A measurement of the weight of the gastrointestinal tract which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003019.name: both ovaries weight to body weight ratio

CMO:0003020.name: total reticulocyte count
CMO:0003020.def: The number of reticulocytes in a specified volume of blood. Reticulocytes are newly produced, relatively immature red blood cells.

CMO:0003021.name: reticulocyte count to total red blood cell count ratio
CMO:0003021.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of reticulocyte in a specified sample of blood is divided by the total number of red blood cell in that sample and presented as a ratio, fraction or percentage.

CMO:0003022.name: hemoglobin distribution width
CMO:0003022.def: The distribution width of erythrocytes by their cellular (individual) hemoglobin concentrations. It is a measurement of the heterogeneity of the red cell hemoglobin concentration.

CMO:0003023.name: urine sorbital dehydrogenase level
CMO:0003023.def: The amount of sorbital dehydrogenase in a specific volume of urine. Sorbitol dehydrogenase is an enzyme in carbohydrate metabolism converting sorbitol, the sugar alcohol form of glucose, into fructose.

CMO:0003024.name: urine chloride level to urine creatinine level ratio
CMO:0003024.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of chloride present in a specified volume of urine, is divided by the amount of creatinine in a specified volume of urine.

CMO:0003025.name: calculated urine chloride level
CMO:0003025.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of chloride in a specified sample of urine.

CMO:0003026.name: serum total bile acid
CMO:0003026.def: The amount of bile acid in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. Bile acid is any member of a group of hydroxy-5beta-cholanic acids concurring in bile, where they are present as the sodium salts of their amides with glycine or taurine. In mammals bile acids almost invariably have 5beta-configuration.

CMO:0003027.name: renal cortex volume
CMO:0003027.def: A morphological measurement of the size, volume of the outer part of the kidney, composed mainly of glomeruli and convoluted tubules.

CMO:0003028.name: renal medulla volume
CMO:0003028.def: A morphological measurement of the size, volume, of the renal medulla, the innermost part of the kidney which contains the structures of the nephrons responsible for maintaining the salt and water balance of the blood.

CMO:0003029.name: gastrointestinal tract weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0003029.def: A calculated value in which the weight of the gastrointestinal tract is divided by the total weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism. The gastrointestinal tract is an organ system within humans and other animals which takes in food, digests it to extract and absorb energy and nutrients, and expels the remaining waste as feces. The mouth, esophagus, stomach and intestines are part of the gastrointestinal tract.

CMO:0003030.name: blood galanin level
CMO:0003030.def: The amount of galanin in a specified sample of blood. Galanin is a neuropeptide encoded by the Gal gene, that is widely expressed in the brain, spinal cord, and gut of humans as well as other mammals.

CMO:0003031.name: serum galanin level
CMO:0003031.def: The amount of galanin in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. Galanin is a neuropeptide encoded by the Gal gene, that is widely expressed in the brain, spinal cord, and gut of humans as well as other mammals.

CMO:0003032.name: blood lutenizing hormone  level
CMO:0003032.def: Measurement of the amount in blood of lutenizing hormone (LH) produced by gonadotropic cells in the anterior pituitary gland. In females, an acute rise of LH triggers ovulation and development of the corpus luteum. In males, LH stimulates Leydig cell production of testosterone.

CMO:0003033.name: serum lutenizing hormone  level
CMO:0003033.def: The amount of lutenizing hormone (LH) in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0003034.name: blood plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 level
CMO:0003034.def: a measurement of the amount of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 (PAI-1)in the blood. PAI-1 is a serine protease inhibitor protein that functions as the principal inhibitor of tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) and urokinase (uPA), the activators of plasminogen and hence fibrinolysis (the physiological breakdown of blood clots).

CMO:0003035.name: serum plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 level
CMO:0003035.def: A measurement of the amount of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 (PAI-1) in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. PAI-1 is a serine protease inhibitor protein that functions as the principal inhibitor of tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) and urokinase (uPA), the activators of plasminogen and hence fibrinolysis (the physiological breakdown of blood clots).
synonyms: serum serpin family E member 1 level

CMO:0003036.name: urine lipocalin 2 level
CMO:0003036.def: The amount of lipocalin 2 in a specified volume of urine. lipocalin 2 belongs to the lipocalin family. Members of this family transport small hydrophobic molecules such as lipids, steroid hormones and retinoids.

CMO:0003037.name: urine osteopontin level
CMO:0003037.def: The amount of osteopontin in a specified volume of urine.Osteopontin is a secreted multifunctional glycoprotein. Its putative functions include roles in bone metabolism, immune regulation, wound healing, cell survival, and tumor progression.

CMO:0003038.name: urine KIM-1/TIM-1/HAVCR level
CMO:0003038.def: The amount of hepatitis A virus cellular receptor 1 (HAVCR1)in a specific volume of urine. HAVCR1is also called kidney injury molecule 1(KIM1)and T-cell immunoglobulin mucin family member 1 (TIM-1).

CMO:0003039.name: blood beta-2 microglobulin
CMO:0003039.def: The amount of beta-2 microglobulin (B2m) in a specified volume of blood. B2m is found in association with the major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class I heavy chain on the surface of most cells and has a predominantly beta-pleated sheet structure that can form amyloid fibrils in some pathological conditions.

CMO:0003040.name: serum beta-2 microglobulin
CMO:0003040.def: The amount of beta-2 microglobulin (B2m) in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. B2m is found in association with the major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class I heavy chain on the surface of most cells and has a predominantly beta-pleated sheet structure that can form amyloid fibrils in some pathological conditions.

CMO:0003041.name: blood calbindin level
CMO:0003041.def: The amount of calbindin in a specified sample of blood. Calbindin is a member of the calcium-binding protein superfamily that includes calmodulin and troponin C.

CMO:0003042.name: serum calbindin level
CMO:0003042.def: The amount of calbindin in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. Calbindin is a member of the calcium-binding protein superfamily that includes calmodulin and troponin C.

CMO:0003043.name: blood clusterin level
CMO:0003043.def: The amount of clusterin in a specific sample of blood. Clusterin is a secreted chaperone that can under some stress conditions also be found in the cell cytosol. It has been suggested to be involved in several basic biological events such as cell death, tumor progression, and neurodegenerative disorders.

CMO:0003044.name: serum clusterin level
CMO:0003044.def: The amount of clusterin in a specific sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.. Clusterin is a secreted chaperone that can under some stress conditions also be found in the cell cytosol. It has been suggested to be involved in several basic biological events such as cell death, tumor progression, and neurodegenerative disorders.

CMO:0003045.name: blood glutathione S-transferase-alpha level
CMO:0003045.def: Measurement of the amount in blood of glutathione S-transferase-alpha (GST-a). GST-a is one of a family of enzymes that play an important role in detoxification by catalyzing the conjugation of many hydrophobic and electrophilic compounds with reduced glutathione.

CMO:0003046.name: serum glutathione S-transferase-alpha level
CMO:0003046.def: Measurement of the amount of glutathione S-transferase-alpha (GST-a)in a specific sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. GST-a is one of a family of enzymes that play an important role in detoxification by catalyzing the conjugation of many hydrophobic and electrophilic compounds with reduced glutathione.

CMO:0003047.name: blood glutathione S-transferase-mu level
CMO:0003047.def: Measurement of the amount of glutathione S-transferase-mu (GST-u)in a specific sample of blood. GST-u functions in the detoxification of electrophilic compounds, including carcinogens, therapeutic drugs, environmental toxins and products of oxidative stress, by conjugation with glutathione.

CMO:0003048.name: serum glutathione S-transferase-mu level
CMO:0003048.def: Measurement of the amount of glutathione S-transferase-mu (GST-mu)in a specific sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. GST-mu functions in the detoxification of electrophilic compounds, including carcinogens, therapeutic drugs, environmental toxins and products of oxidative stress, by conjugation with glutathione.

CMO:0003049.name: blood tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase-1 level
CMO:0003049.def: Measurement of the amount of tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase 1 (TIMP-1)in a specific sample of blood. TIMP-1 belongs to the TIMP gene family. The proteins encoded by this gene family are natural inhibitors of the matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs), a group of peptidases involved in degradation of the extracellular matrix. In addition to its inhibitory role against most of the known MMPs, the encoded protein is able to promote cell proliferation in a wide range of cell types, and may also have an anti-apoptotic function.

CMO:0003050.name: serum tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase 1 level
CMO:0003050.def: Measurement of the amount of tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase 1 (TIMP-1)in a specific sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. TIMP-1 belongs to the TIMP gene family. The proteins encoded by this gene family are natural inhibitors of the matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs), a group of peptidases involved in degradation of the extracellular matrix. In addition to its inhibitory role against most of the known MMPs, the encoded protein is able to promote cell proliferation in a wide range of cell types, and may also have an anti-apoptotic function.

CMO:0003051.name: blood vascular endothelial growth factor A level
CMO:0003051.def: Measurement of the amount of vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGFA) in a specific sample of blood.
synonyms: blood vascular endothelial growth factor A measurement
vascular endothelial growth factor A measurement

CMO:0003052.name: serum vascular endothelial growth factor A level
CMO:0003052.def: Measurement of the amount of vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGFA) in a specific sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.
