synonyms: serum vascular endothelial growth factor A measurement

CMO:0003053.name: blood complement C3a des Arg level
CMO:0003053.def: This is a measurement of the amount of C3a des Arg in a specified sample of blood. C3a des Arg is formed from C3a via carboxypeptidase cleavage of the C-terminal arginine group.

CMO:0003054.name: serum Complement C3a des Arg  level
CMO:0003054.def: This is a measurement of the amount of C3a des Arg in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. C3a des Arg is formed from C3a via carboxypeptidase cleavage of the C-terminal arginine group.

CMO:0003055.name: blood lipocalin 2 level
CMO:0003055.def: The amount of lipocalin 2 in a specified volume of blood. Lipocalin 2 belongs to the lipocalin family. Members of this family transport small hydrophobic molecules such as lipids, steroid hormones and retinoids.

CMO:0003056.name: serum lipocalin 2 level
CMO:0003056.def: The amount of lipocalin 2 in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. Lipocalin 2 belongs to the lipocalin family. Members of this family transport small hydrophobic molecules such as lipids, steroid hormones and retinoids.

CMO:0003057.name: blood osteopontin level
CMO:0003057.def: The amount of osteopontin in a specified volume of blood. Osteopontin is a secreted multifunctional glycoprotein. Its putative functions include roles in bone metabolism, immune regulation, wound healing, cell survival, and tumor progression.

CMO:0003058.name: serum osteopontin level
CMO:0003058.def: The amount of osteopontin in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. Osteopontin is a secreted multifunctional glycoprotein. Its putative functions include roles in bone metabolism, immune regulation, wound healing, cell survival, and tumor progression.

CMO:0003059.name: blood KIM-1/TIM-1/HAVCR1
CMO:0003059.def: The amount of hepatitis A virus cellular receptor 1 (HAVCR1)in a specified volume of blood. HAVCR1is also called kidney injury molecule 1(KIM1)and T-cell immunoglobulin mucin family member 1 (TIM-1).

CMO:0003060.name: serum KIM-1/TIM-1/HAVCR1
CMO:0003060.def: The amount of hepatitis A virus cellular receptor 1 (HAVCR1)in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. HAVCR1is also called kidney injury molecule 1(KIM1)and T-cell immunoglobulin mucin family member 1 (TIM-1).

CMO:0003065.name: blood interleukin-4 level
CMO:0003065.def: Measurement of the amount of interleukin-4 (IL4) in blood, the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, capillaries and veins carrying nutrients and oxygen to the body tissues and metabolites away from them.

CMO:0003066.name: serum interleukin-4 level
CMO:0003066.def: Measurement of the amount of interleukin-4 (IL4) in serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0003067.name: blood interleukin-9 level
CMO:0003067.def: Measurement of the amount of interleukin-9 (IL9) in blood, the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, capillaries and veins carrying nutrients and oxygen to the body tissues and metabolites away from them.

CMO:0003068.name: serum interleukin-9 level
CMO:0003068.def: Measurement of the amount of interleukin-9 (IL9) in serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0003069.name: intestine measurement
CMO:0003069.def: Any measurement, morphological or physiological of the intestine, the portion of the alimentary canal extending from the pyloric opening of the stomach to the anus.

CMO:0003070.name: intestine protein/peptide measurement
CMO:0003070.def: The quantification of any physiological parameter of one or more proteins or peptides (low molecular weight compounds composed of at least two amino acids joined by peptide linkages) in intestine.

CMO:0003071.name: intestine enzyme measurement
CMO:0003071.def: Any measurement related to an enzyme, a protein that acts as a catalyst, increasing the rate at which a chemical reaction occurs without itself being destroyed or altered upon completion of the reaction, in the intestine or in a sample of intestine tissue.

CMO:0003072.name: intestine trypsin level
CMO:0003072.def: Amount of trypsin enzyme activity measured in a specified sample of intestine.

CMO:0003073.name: blood AMG-8718 level
CMO:0003073.def: Measurement of the amount of AMG-8718, a BACE1 inhibitor, in a specified sample of blood.

CMO:0003074.name: plasma AMG-8718 level
CMO:0003074.def: Measurement of the amount of AMG-8718, a BACE1 inhibitor, in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0003075.name: calculated plasma AMG-8718 level
CMO:0003075.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of AMG-8718, a BACE1 inhibitor, in a specified sample of plasma.

CMO:0003076.name: plasma AMG-8718 level area under curve (AUC)
CMO:0003076.def: A calculated measurement in which a series of measurements of the amount of AMG-8718 (BACE1 inhibitor) in a specified volume of plasma is plotted against time for a single individual and the extent of the two dimensional region bounded by the curve and the axes of the graph is determined.

CMO:0003077.name: blood AMG-8718 maximum concentration
CMO:0003077.def: The peak concentration that AMG-8718 achieves in a specified volume of blood after the drug has been administrated and before administration of a second dose.

CMO:0003078.name: plasma AMG-8718 maximum concentration
CMO:0003078.def: The peak concentration that AMG-8718 achieves in a specified volume of plasma after the drug has been administrated and before administration of a second dose.

CMO:0003080.name: eye morphological measurement
CMO:0003080.def: Measurement of the physical form or structure of the eye, the organ of vision, which is sensitive to light and in which the optic nerve terminates.

CMO:0003082.name: full retina thickness
CMO:0003082.def: Measurement of the thickness of the full retina between the apical portion of the retinal pigment epithelium and the outer margin of the ganglion cell layer.

CMO:0003083.name: retinal outer layer thickness
CMO:0003083.def: The outer retinal thickness is defined as straight lines between outer plexiform layer to the apical layer of the retinal pigment epithelium perpendicular to the retinal layer measured. The measurement usually is done by optical coherence tomography (OCT).

CMO:0003084.name: retinal inner layer thickness
CMO:0003084.def: The inner retinal thickness is defined as straight lines between outer plexiform layer to the vitreous perpendicular to the retinal layer measured. The measurement usually is done by optical coherence tomography (OCT).

CMO:0003085.name: retinal outer nuclear layer photoreceptor nucleus count
CMO:0003085.def: The number of photoreceptor nuclei in the retinal outer nuclear layer.

CMO:0003086.name: retinal outer nuclear layer thickness
CMO:0003086.def: The measurement of the thickness of the retinal layer that contains the nuclei and cell bodies of rods and cones.

CMO:0003087.name: stress-related movement measurement
CMO:0003087.def: Any measurable or observable characteristic of actions or reactions related to how the body reacts to a stressor (a stimulus that causes stress), real or imagined.

CMO:0003088.name: duration of  lower body licking events
CMO:0003088.def: A measurement of the time subjects spend licking the abdomen during a period of time.

CMO:0003089.name: number of lower body licking events
CMO:0003089.def: Measurement of the number of times an experimental subject or organism performs a lower body licking event on itself during an experimental time period. A lower body licking event usually involves licking of the abdomen.

CMO:0003090.name: number of abdominal retractions
CMO:0003090.def: The number of abdominal retractions performed in a specified period by an experimental subject. An abdominal retraction is the contraction of the abdominal wall such that an `arched' posture is observed for a couple seconds.

CMO:0003091.name: forebrain monoamine hormone measurement
CMO:0003091.def: Measurement of the amount in the forebrain of an amine compound containing one amino group and derived from an aromatic amino acid, that is produced in one part or organ of the body and initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0003095.name: forebrain norepinephrine level
CMO:0003095.def: The measurement of norepinephrine level in the forebrain. Norepinephrine is a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter in the sympathetic nervous system. It is also called noradrenaline.

CMO:0003096.name: forebrain 5-HIAA level
CMO:0003096.def: The measurement of forebrain level of 5-HIAA, (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetic acid, the major metabolite of serotonin.

CMO:0003097.name: forebrain HVA level
CMO:0003097.def: measurement of the level of HVA in the forebrain. HVA, homovanillic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003098.name: forebrain DOPAC level
CMO:0003098.def: measurement of the level of DOPAC in the forebrain. DOPAC, the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003100.name: platelet morphological measurement
CMO:0003100.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of platelets, the disk-shaped structures found in the blood of mammals which play a vital role in blood coagulation. Platelets lack nuclei and DNA but contain active enzymes and mitochondria.

CMO:0003101.name: platelet physiological measurement
CMO:0003101.def: Any measurement relating to the function of platelets, the disk-shaped structures found in the blood of mammals which play a vital role in blood coagulation. Platelets lack nuclei and DNA but contain active enzymes and mitochondria.

CMO:0003102.name: red blood cell morphological measurement
CMO:0003102.def: Any measurement of the physical form or structure of a red blood cell or of all of the red blood cells in a sample of blood. Red blood cells (erythrocytes) are the hemoglobin-containing blood cells that transport oxygen and carbon dioxide to and from the tissues,

CMO:0003103.name: red blood cell physiological measurement
CMO:0003103.def: Any measurement relating to the function of of red blood cells, one of the hemoglobin-containing blood cells that transport oxygen and carbon dioxide to and from the tissues, or of all of the red blood cells in a sample of blood.

CMO:0003104.name: hypothalamus 5-HIAA level
CMO:0003104.def: The measurement of hypothalamus level of 5-HIAA, (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetic acid, the major metabolite of serotonin.

CMO:0003105.name: hypothalamus DOPAC level
CMO:0003105.def: measurement of the level of DOPAC in the hypothalamus. DOPAC, the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003106.name: hypothalamus dopamine level
CMO:0003106.def: The measurement of dopamine in the hypothalamus.

CMO:0003107.name: hypothalamus norepinephrine level
CMO:0003107.def: The measurement of norepinephrine in the hypothalamus. Norepinephrine is a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter in the sympathetic nervous system. It is also called noradrenaline.

CMO:0003108.name: midbrain/pons monoamine hormone measurement
CMO:0003108.def: Measurement of the amount in the midbrain/pons of an amine compound containing one amino group and derived from an aromatic amino acid, that is produced in one part or organ of the body and initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0003111.name: midbrain/pons 5-HIAA level
CMO:0003111.def: The measurement of midbrain/pons level of 5-HIAA, (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetic acid, the major metabolite of serotonin.

CMO:0003112.name: midbrain/pons norepinephrine level
CMO:0003112.def: The measurement of norepinephrine level in the midbrain/pons. Norepinephrine is a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter in the sympathetic nervous system. It is also called noradrenaline

CMO:0003113.name: midbrain/pons HVA level
CMO:0003113.def: measurement of the level of HVA in the midbrain/pons. HVA, homovanillic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003114.name: midbrain/pons dopamine level
CMO:0003114.def: The measurement of dopamine in the midbrain/pons.

CMO:0003115.name: midbrain/pons DOPAC level
CMO:0003115.def: measurement of the level of DOPAC in the midbrain/pons. DOPAC, the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003116.name: medulla oblongata monoamine hormone measurement
CMO:0003116.def: Measurement of the amount in the medulla oblongata of an amine compound containing one amino group and derived from an aromatic amino acid, that is produced in one part or organ of the body and initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0003119.name: medulla oblongata  5-HIAA level
CMO:0003119.def: The measurement of medulla oblongata level of 5-HIAA, (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetic acid, the major metabolite of serotonin.

CMO:0003120.name: medulla oblongata DOPAC level
CMO:0003120.def: measurement of the level of DOPAC in the medulla oblongata. DOPAC, the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003122.name: medulla oblongata HVA level
CMO:0003122.def: measurement of the level of HVA in themedulla oblongata. HVA, homovanillic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003123.name: medulla oblongata norepinephrine level
CMO:0003123.def: The measurement of norepinephrine level in the medulla oblongata. Norepinephrine is a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter in the sympathetic nervous system. It is also called noradrenaline.

CMO:0003124.name: cervical spinal cord monoamine hormone measurement
CMO:0003124.def: Measurement of the amount in the cervical spinal cord of an amine compound containing one amino group and derived from an aromatic amino acid, that is produced in one part or organ of the body and initiates or regulates the activity of an organ or a group of cells in another part of the body.

CMO:0003128.name: cervical spinal cord DOPAC level
CMO:0003128.def: measurement of the level of DOPAC in the cervical spine. DOPAC, the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003130.name: cervical spinal cord norepinephrine level
CMO:0003130.def: The measurement of norepinephrine level in the cervical spinal cord . Norepinephrine is a catecholamine hormone that functions as a neurotransmitter in the sympathetic nervous system. It is also called noradrenaline.

CMO:0003131.name: blood xenobiotic measurement
CMO:0003131.def: Measurement of the amount of any xenobiotic or metabolic kinetics in a specified sample of blood. A xenobiotic is a chemical compound foreign to a given biologic system, or more specifically, a pharmacologically, endocrinologically, or toxicologically active substance not endogenously produced and therefore foreign to an organism.

CMO:0003133.name: elimination half-life of nifedipine in the plasma
CMO:0003133.def: The time it takes for the body to eliminate or breakdown half of a dose of this potent vasodilator agent, in practice the time taken for plasma concentration of nifedipine to be reduced by 50%.

CMO:0003134.name: initial nifedipine concentration in the plasma

CMO:0003136.name: plasma nifedipine level
CMO:0003136.def: This is a measure of the content of this potent vasodilator agent in blood plasma.
synonyms: initial nifedipine concentration in the plasma

CMO:0003137.name: the first 120min of plasma nifedipine level area under curve

CMO:0003138.name: plasma nifedipine level area under curve
CMO:0003138.def: A calculated measurement in which a series of measurements of the amount of nifedipine in a specified volume of plasma is plotted against time for a single individual and the extent of the two dimensional region bounded by the curve and the axes of the graph is determined.

CMO:0003139.name: nifedipine mean residence time
CMO:0003139.def: The mean residence time is the average time a dose of nifedipine remains in the blood.

CMO:0003140.name: plasma nifedipine clearance
CMO:0003140.def: The measurement of the rate at which nifedipine is eliminated from blood plasma.

CMO:0003141.name: volume of distribution of nifedipine in the blood
CMO:0003141.def: In pharmacology, the volume of distribution (VD, also known as apparent volume of distribution) is the theoretical volume that would be necessary to contain the total amount of an administered drug at the same concentration that it is observed in the blood plasma. It is defined as the distribution of a medication between plasma and the rest of the body after oral or parenteral dosing.

CMO:0003144.name: lung weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0003144.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of one or both lungs is divided by the length of tibia, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to tibia length.

CMO:0003145.name: single kidney weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0003145.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of one kidney is divided by the length of tibia, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to tibia length.

CMO:0003146.name: nasal septum epithelium intracellular mucus area to basement membrane width ratio
CMO:0003146.def: The amount of stored mucosubstance in the epithelium of nasal septum quantified by the area of AB-PAS (alcian blue periodic acid Schiff) positive tissue per unit width of basement membrane.

CMO:0003148.name: trachea morphological measurement
CMO:0003148.def: measurement related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tube descending from the larynx and branching into the right and left main bronchi.

CMO:0003149.name: trachea lumen circumference
CMO:0003149.def: the measurement of the the enclosing boundary of the trachea lined by the apical surface of epithelium

CMO:0003150.name: trachea cartilage area
CMO:0003150.def: The measurement of total cartilage area in the tracheal ring.

CMO:0003151.name: trachea cartilage area to trachea lumen circumference ratio

CMO:0003152.name: calculated trachea morphological measurement
CMO:0003152.def: Measurement which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation of any measurement related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the tube descending from the larynx and branching into the right and left main bronchi.

CMO:0003153.name: maximum trachea cartilage thickness
CMO:0003153.def: Maximal cartilage thickness was is determined by measuring the perpendicular distance between outer boundaries of cartilage rings.

CMO:0003154.name: trachea epithelial layer thickness
CMO:0003154.def: measurement of the distance between the basement membrane (on the serosal surface) and the apical membrane lumenally

CMO:0003155.name: trachea submucosal gland area
CMO:0003155.def: Submucosal gland area determined by measuring the total area of both serous and mucus components of the gland structures via histology

CMO:0003156.name: trachea submucosal gland area to trachea lumenal circumference ratio

CMO:0003157.name: trachea submucosal gland intracellular mucus area
CMO:0003157.def: This is determined by histological measurement of the intracellular mucus area in the submucosal gland of the trachea.

CMO:0003158.name: trachea submucosal gland intracellular mucus area to total trachea submucosal gland area ratio
CMO:0003158.def: A calculated value in which the cross sectional area of the submucosal gland taken up by mucus is divided by the total cross-sectional area of the submucosal gland, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to trachea submucosal gland area.

CMO:0003160.name: blood C-reactive protein level
CMO:0003160.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of C-reactive protein (CRP) found in the blood. CRP is an acute phase reactant protein used to indicate inflammatory illness. It is believed to be of value in predicting coronary events.

CMO:0003161.name: serum C-reactive protein level
CMO:0003161.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of C-reactive protein (CRP) found in the serum, the clear liquid that is separated from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. CRP is an acute phase reactant protein used to indicate inflammatory illness. It is believed to be of value in predicting coronary events.

CMO:0003162.name: plasma C-reactive protein level
CMO:0003162.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of C-reactive protein (CRP) found in the plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. CRP is an acute phase reactant protein used to indicate inflammatory illness. It is believed to be of value in predicting coronary events.

CMO:0003163.name: kidney total CD3 positive T cell count
CMO:0003163.def: The number of CD3-positive T cells in the kidney.

CMO:0003164.name: kidney cellular composition measurement
CMO:0003164.def: Any quantitation of the cells and/or cell types which constitute the make-up of the kidney

CMO:0003165.name: kidney total  CD45 positive leukocyte count

CMO:0003166.name: blood regulatory T cell count to total T cell count ratio
CMO:0003166.def: Measurement of the relative abundance of regulatory T cells whose function is control or suppression of the T cell mediated immune response. Regulatory T cells are generally distinguished from other classes of lymphocytes on the basis of the presence and/or absence of a number of specific cell surface marker proteins.

CMO:0003167.name: spleen regulatory T cell count to total T cell count ratio
CMO:0003167.def: Measurement of the relative abundance of regulatory T cells in the spleen. Regulatory T cells control or suppress T cell mediated immune response. Regulatory T cells are generally distinguished from other classes of lymphocytes on the basis of the presence and/or absence of a number of specific cell surface marker proteins.

CMO:0003168.name: calculated brain infarction volume
CMO:0003168.def: A measurement which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation of the brain infarction volume. A brain infarction is an area of necrotic tissue in the brain resulting from a reduction or obstruction of the oxygen or blood supply to the brain.

CMO:0003169.name: cerebrum infarct volume to total cerebrum volume ratio
CMO:0003169.def: A calculated value in which the volume of cerebrum infarction is divided by the total volume of the cerebrum, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction or percentage, thus normalizing it to the size of the brain.

CMO:0003170.name: verapamil apparent influx permeability clearance in brain
CMO:0003170.def: This is a calculated measurement which is used to determine passive permeability coefficients. It helps assess the rate of verapamil permeation and the presence of active transport processes in a two compartment system involving brain and blood plasma. This calculated value is determined by this formula: Capp(t)/Cp(t) = Kin,tissue x AUC(t)/Cp(t) + Vi, where Capp=apparent concentration, p=plasma, and Vi=rapidly equilibrated distribution volume of verapamil in brain.

CMO:0003172.name: verapamil apparent influx permeability clearance in retina
CMO:0003172.def: This is a calculated measurement which is used to determine passive permeability coefficients. It helps assess the rate of verapamil permeation and the presence of active transport processes in a two compartment system involving retina and blood plasma. This calculated value is determined by this formula: Capp(t)/Cp(t) = Kin,tissue x AUC(t)/Cp(t) + Vi, where Capp=apparent concentration, p=plasma, and Vi=rapidly equilibrated distribution volume of verapamil in retina.

CMO:0003173.name: verapamil apparent influx permeability clearance in aqueous humor
CMO:0003173.def: This is a calculated measurement which is used to determine passive permeability coefficients. It helps assess the rate of verapamil permeation and the presence of active transport processes in a two compartment system involving aqueous humor and blood plasma. This calculated value is determined by this formula: Capp(t)/Cp(t) = Kin,tissue x AUC(t)/Cp(t) + Vi, where Capp=apparent concentration, p=plasma, and Vi=rapidly equilibrated distribution volume of verapamil in the aqueous humor.

CMO:0003174.name: rapidly equilibrated distribution volume of verapamil in brain
CMO:0003174.def: This measurement is the apparent volume in brain occupied by verapamil at a specified time point after injection of verapamil into the carotid artery. It is the ratio of the verapamil concentration in brain to verapamil concentration in plasma at a given time and roughly equivalent to the extracellular space of the brain.

CMO:0003175.name: rapidly equilibrated distribution volume of verapamil in retina
CMO:0003175.def: This measurement is the apparent volume in retina occupied by verapamil at a specified time point after injection of verapamil into the carotid artery. It is the ratio of the verapamil concentration in retina to verapamil concentration in plasma at a given time and roughly equivalent to the extracellular space of the retina.

CMO:0003176.name: rapidly equilibrated distribution volume of verapamil in aqueous humor
CMO:0003176.def: This measurement is the apparent volume in aqueous humor occupied by verapamil at a specified time point after injection of verapamil into the carotid artery. It is the ratio of the verapamil concentration in aqueous humor to verapamil concentration in plasma at a given time and roughly equivalent to the extracellular space of the aqueous humor.
synonyms: Volume of Distribution in aqueous humor

CMO:0003177.name: brain uptake index of verapamil
CMO:0003177.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of verapamil in brain 15 seconds after an injection of verapamil into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of verapamil and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected verapamil found in brain

CMO:0003178.name: retinal uptake index of verapamil
CMO:0003178.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of verapamil in retina 15 seconds after an injection of verapamil into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of verapamil and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected verapamil found in retina

CMO:0003179.name: aqueous humor uptake index of verapamil
CMO:0003179.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of verapamil in aqueous humor 15 seconds after an injection of verapamil into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of verapamil and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected verapamil found in aqueous humor

CMO:0003182.name: aqueous humor uptake index of digoxin
CMO:0003182.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of digoxin in aqueous humor 15 seconds after an injection of digoxin into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of digoxin and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected digoxin found in aqueous humor

CMO:0003183.name: brain uptake index of digoxin
CMO:0003183.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of digoxin in brain 15 seconds after an injection of digoxin into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of digoxin and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected digoxin found in brain

CMO:0003184.name: retinal uptake index of digoxin
CMO:0003184.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of digoxin in retina 15 seconds after an injection of digoxin into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of digoxin and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected digoxin found in retina

CMO:0003185.name: aqueous humor uptake index of quinidine
CMO:0003185.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of quinidine in aqueous humor 15 seconds after an injection of quinidine into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of quinidine and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected quinidine found in aqueous humor

CMO:0003186.name: brain uptake index of quinidine
CMO:0003186.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of quinidine in brain 15 seconds after an injection of quinidine into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of quinidine and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected quinidine found in brain

CMO:0003187.name: retinal uptake index of quinidine
CMO:0003187.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of quinidine in the retina 15 seconds after an injection of quinidine into the carotid artery is divided by the injected amount of quinidine and presented as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of injected quinidine found in retina

CMO:0003188.name: heart right ventricle weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0003188.def: A calculated value in which the weight of the heart right ventricle is divided by the length of the tibia (the medial and larger of the two bones of the lower leg of bipeds or hindlimb of quadrupeds which articulates with the femur, fibula, and talus), and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage,thus normalizing it to the length of the leg and, by extension, to the size of the body.

CMO:0003189.name: fully muscularized arterioles to total arterioles ratio
CMO:0003189.def: A calculated measurement in which the count of fully muscularized arterioles in a sample of lung is divided by the count of all arterioles in that sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the total number of arterioles.

CMO:0003190.name: non-muscularized arterioles to total arterioles ratio
CMO:0003190.def: A calculated measurement in which the count of non-muscularized arterioles in a sample of lung is divided by the count of all arterioles in that sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the total number of arterioles.

CMO:0003191.name: heart right atrium weight to left atrium weight ratio

CMO:0003192.name: heart right atrium weight to tibia length ratio

CMO:0003193.name: heart left atrium weight to tibia length ratio

CMO:0003194.name: skeletal muscle molecular composition measurement
CMO:0003194.def: Any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of a skeletal muscle.

CMO:0003195.name: skeletal muscle triglyceride level
CMO:0003195.def: Measurement of the amount of triglycerides within skeletal muscle

CMO:0003198.name: blood reactive oxygen metabolite level
CMO:0003198.def: This is a measure of derivatives of reactive oxidative metabolites (dROMs) in blood. Derivatives of reactive oxidative metabolites are an indicator of the level of reactive oxygen species (ROS) production.
synonyms: blood derivatives of reactive oxidative metabolite level

CMO:0003199.name: serum derivatives of reactive oxygen metabolites level
CMO:0003199.def: This is a measure of derivatives of reactive oxidative metabolites (dROMs) in serum. Derivatives of reactive oxidative metabolites are an indicator of the level of reactive oxygen species (ROS) production.
synonyms: serum derivatives of reactive oxidative metabolite level

CMO:0003200.name: left ventricle end-diastolic wall stress
CMO:0003200.def: Left ventricle end-diastolic wall stress (LVED-WS) is a calculated measurement of the force acting against the left ventricle wall at the end of diastole, that is when the heart muscle is maximally relaxed, and usually corresponds to its largest diameter. It is calculated by multiplying ventricular pressure by ventricular radius and dividing by 2 times the wall thickness. It is commonly referred to as the Law of Laplace.

CMO:0003201.name: left ventricle end-systolic wall stress
CMO:0003201.def: Left ventricle end-systolic wall stress (LVES-WS)is calculated measurement of the force acting against the left ventricle wall at the endo of end of systole, the period of contraction of the heart when the blood is forced from the ventricles into the pulmonary artery (right ventricle) and the aorta (left ventricle). It is calculated by multiplying ventricular pressure by ventricular radius and dividing by 2 times the wall thickness. Commonly referred to as Law of Laplace (PMID: 2198115)

CMO:0003202.name: Myocardial interstitial angiotensin II level
CMO:0003202.def: Angiotensin II collected by microdialysis probe with semipermeable membrane fiber at a depth of 4 mm within the LV myocardium free wall.

CMO:0003203.name: myocardial interstitial bradykinin level
CMO:0003203.def: Bradykinin found in the intercellular spaces of the myocardium.

CMO:0003204.name: Myocardial interstitial norepinephrine
CMO:0003204.def: Norepinephrine collected by microdialysis probe with semipermeable membrane fiber at a depth of 4 mm within the LV myocardium free wall - PMID: 22768235

CMO:0003205.name: Myocardial interstitial epinephrine
CMO:0003205.def: Epinephrine collected by microdialysis probe with semipermeable membrane fiber at a depth of 4 mm within the LV myocardium free wall - PMID: 22768235

CMO:0003206.name: blood bradykinin level
CMO:0003206.def: The amount of bradykinin in a specified sample of blood. Bradykinin is a linear nonapeptide messenger belonging to the kinin group of proteins, with amino acid sequence RPPGFSPFR. Enzymatically produced from kallidin in the blood, it is a powerful vasodilator that causes smooth muscle contraction, and may mediate inflammation.

CMO:0003207.name: plasma bradykinin level
CMO:0003207.def: The amount of bradykinin in a specified sample of plasma. A linear nonapeptide messenger belonging to the kinin group of proteins, with amino acid sequence RPPGFSPFR. Enzymatically produced from kallidin in the blood, it is a powerful vasodilator that causes smooth muscle contraction, and may mediate inflammation.

CMO:0003208.name: glucose disappearance constant
CMO:0003208.def: The rate constant associated with glucose disappearance from a loaded system.

CMO:0003209.name: heart left ventricle weight to right ventricle weight ratio
CMO:0003209.def: A calculated value which compares the weight of the left ventricle, the lower chamber of the left side of the heart, which pumps oxygenated blood out through the aorta to all the tissues of the body, with the weight of the right ventricle, the lower chamber of the right side of the heart, which pumps venous blood through the pulmonary trunk and arteries to the capillaries of the lung, and presents it as a ratio.

CMO:0003210.name: heart left ventricle weight to right ventricle weight ratio
CMO:0003210.def: A calculated value which compares the weight of the left ventricle, the lower chamber of the left side of the heart, which pumps oxygenated blood out through the aorta to all the tissues of the body, with the weight of the right ventricle, the lower chamber of the right side of the heart, which pumps venous blood through the pulmonary trunk and arteries to the capillaries of the lung, and presents it as a ratio.

CMO:0003211.name: Homeostatic Model Assessment of Beta cell function
CMO:0003211.def: Homeostatic model assessment (HOMA-Beta) is a method for assessing β-cell function from basal (fasting) glucose and insulin or C-peptide concentrations. The empirical formulae: HOMA-Beta = 20 x fasting insulin (uU/mL) /[fasting glycemia (mmol=L)- 3.5]

CMO:0003212.name: adrenal  angiotensin II type 1 receptor density
CMO:0003212.def: A measurement of the amount of angiotensin II type 1 receptor, the angiotensin receptor exhibiting vasopressor effects, regulation of aldosterone secretion and blood pressure and volume control, in a specified sample of adrenal tissue expressed relative to the weight of total protein in that sample.

CMO:0003213.name: blood urotensin II level
CMO:0003213.def: The amount of urotensin II in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0003214.name: plasma urotensin II level
CMO:0003214.def: The amount of urotensin II in a specified volume of plasma.

CMO:0003215.name: serum low density lipoprotein cholesterol to high density lipoprotein cholesterol ratio
CMO:0003215.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of LDL, relatively large-particle lipoproteins that transport cholesterol to extrahepatic tissue,in a specified volume of serum is divided by the amount of HDL, small-particle lipoproteins that promote transport of cholesterol from extrahepatic tissue to the liver for excretion in the bile, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003216.name: aorta weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0003216.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of the aorta is divided by the total body weight of the organism.

CMO:0003217.name: urine albumin level to urine total protein level ratio
CMO:0003217.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of albumin in a specified sample of urine or the amount of albumin excreted into the urine in a specified period of time is divided by the amount of total protein in that sample of urine or the amount of total protein excreted into the urine in that period of time, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003218.name: renal vascular resistance to kidney weight ratio

CMO:0003219.name: calculated heart left ventricle end-diastolic diameter
CMO:0003219.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the heart left ventricle end-diastolic internal diameter.
synonyms: Calculated heart left ventricle end-diastolic dimension
Calculated heart left ventricle end-diastolic internal dimension

CMO:0003220.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic diameter to body weight ratio
CMO:0003220.def: A calculated measurement in which the heart left ventricle end-diastolic internal diameter is divided by the weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Heart left ventricle end-diastolic internal dimension is the diameter across the left ventricle of the heart at the end of diastole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally relaxed, and usually corresponds to its largest diameter.
synonyms: heart left ventricle end-diastolic dimension to body weight ratio
heart left ventricle end-diastolic internal dimension index

CMO:0003221.name: blood CD3 lymphocyte count to total lymphocyte count ratio
CMO:0003221.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of lymphocytes expressing the CD3 antigen on their surface in a specified sample of blood is divided by the total number of lymphocytes in the sample, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. The CD3 (cluster of differentiation 3) T cell co-receptor helps to activate both the cytotoxic T cell (CD8+ naive T cells) and also T helper cells (CD4+ naive T cells). It consists of a protein complex and is composed of four distinct chains.

CMO:0003222.name: mononuclear cell interferon gamma expression
CMO:0003222.def: The amount of interferon gamma (Ifng) expressed (i.e. mRNA or protein) from one or more mononuclear cells. Ifng is a member of the type II interferon family which is a soluble cytokine with antiviral, immunoregulatory and anti-tumor properties and functions as a potent activator of macrophages.

CMO:0003223.name: percentage of CD4 positive cells expressing interferon gamma

CMO:0003224.name: percentage of CD8 positive cells expressing interferon gamma

CMO:0003225.name: osteoclast surface area to total bone area ratio

CMO:0003226.name: calculated serum calcium level
CMO:0003226.def: This is a measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the amount of calcium in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0003227.name: serum calcium to serum phosphate ratio
CMO:0003227.def: This is a measure of calcium in serum divided by the inorganic phosphate in serum from a specified sample of serum, presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Serum is the clear liquid that separates from coagulated blood after solids have been removed.

CMO:0003228.name: plasma pyrophosphate level
CMO:0003228.def: This is a measure of pyrophosphates in plasma, the clear liquid that separates from blood after the cells and platelets have been removed. Pyrophosphates are phosphorus oxyanions that contain two phosphorus atoms in a P-O-P linkage with the formula O7P2.

CMO:0003229.name: blood pyrophosphate level
CMO:0003229.def: This is a measure of pyrophosphates in a given volume of blood. Pyrophosphates are phosphorus oxyanions that contain two phosphorus atoms in a P-O-P linkage with the formula O7P2.

CMO:0003230.name: calculated serum phosphate level
CMO:0003230.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the amount of phosphate in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0003231.name: serum phosphate level to plasma pyrophosphate level ratio
CMO:0003231.def: This is a measure of inorganic phosphate in serum in plasma divided by the inorganic pyrophosphate from the same individual subject, presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Pyrophosphates are phosphorus oxyanions that contain two phosphorus atoms in a P-O-P linkage with the formula O7P2 and inorganic phosphorus is any phosphate not associated with carbon atoms.
synonyms: serum inorganic phosphate level to plasma inorganic pyrophosphate level ratio

CMO:0003232.name: red blood cell distribution width- standard deviation
CMO:0003232.def: Red blood cell distribution width- standard deviation (RDW-SD) is a measurement derived from the red blood cell distribution curves generated on automated hematology analyzers and is an indicator of variation in RBC size within a blood sample. The RDW is used along with the indices (MCV, MCH, MCHC) to describe a population of RBCs. The RDW measures the deviation of the RBC width, not the actual width or size of individual cells. The RDW-SD is an actual measurement of the width of the red cell distribution curve in femtoliters (fL). The width of the distribution curve is measured at the point that is 20% above the baseline. Since the RDW-SD is an actual measurement, it is not influenced by the MCV and more accurately reflects the red cell size variance.

CMO:0003233.name: platelet-large cell ratio
CMO:0003233.def: Platelet-large cell ratio (P-LCR) is defined as the ratio of platelets that exceed the normal value of platelet volume (e.g. 12 fL in human) to the total platelet count.

CMO:0003234.name: calculated platelet count
CMO:0003234.def: A quantification which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the number of platelet in a specified sample of blood.

CMO:0003235.name: hypothalamus serotonin level
CMO:0003235.def: The measurement of serotonin in the hypothalamus.

CMO:0003236.name: hypothalamus HVA level
CMO:0003236.def: measurement of the level of HVA in the hypothalamus. HVA, homovanillic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003237.name: cervical spinal cord HVA level
CMO:0003237.def: Measurement of the amount in the cervical spinal cord the level of HVA , homovanillic acid, is a catecholamine metabolite.

CMO:0003240.name: calculated heart left ventricle infarction volume

CMO:0003243.name: heart left ventricle infarction area to total heart left ventricle area  ratio

CMO:0003244.name: ratio of the area occupied by interstitial collagen to the total area of the heart left ventricle
CMO:0003244.def: A calculated measurement in which the area of the heart left ventricle occupied by interstitial collagen is divided by the total area of the heart left ventricle, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003245.name: heart left ventricle angiotensin II level

CMO:0003246.name: heart left ventricle interstitial angiotensin II level
CMO:0003246.def: Angiotensin II collected from the intercellular spaces of the left ventricle myocardium.

CMO:0003248.name: heart left ventricle interstitial bradykinin level

CMO:0003249.name: heart left ventricle interstitial epinephrine level
CMO:0003249.def: Epinephrine collected from the intercellular spaces of the left ventricle myocardium.

heart left ventricle myocardium interstitial epinephrine level

CMO:0003250.name: heart left ventricle interstitial norepinephrine level
CMO:0003250.def: Norepinephrine collected from the intercellular spaces of the left ventricle myocardium.

CMO:0003251.name: skeletal muscle ribonucleic acid composition measurement
CMO:0003251.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of a skeletal muscle.

CMO:0003252.name: gastrocnemius ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003252.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) in the gastrocnemius, the most superficial muscle of the triceps surae group, in the posterior portion of the lower hindleg.

CMO:0003253.name: ovary ribonucleic acid composition measurement
CMO:0003253.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which ovary tissue is formed or composed.

CMO:0003254.name: colon ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003254.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which colon tissue is formed or composed.

CMO:0003256.name: appendix ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003256.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the vermiform appendix, a blind-ended tube connected to the cecum, from which it develops embryologically.

CMO:0003276.name: adipose tissue ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003276.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in adipose tissue, the portion of connective tissue composed of adipocytes enmeshed in areolar tissue.

CMO:0003277.name: blood sorbital dehydrogenase level
CMO:0003277.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by Sorbitol dehydrogenase in a specified sample of blood. Sorbitol dehydrogenase is an enzyme in carbohydrate metabolism converting sorbitol, the sugar alcohol form of glucose, into fructose.

CMO:0003278.name: plasma sorbital dehydrogenase activity
CMO:0003278.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by Sorbitol dehydrogenase in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. Sorbitol dehydrogenase is an enzyme in carbohydrate metabolism converting sorbitol, the sugar alcohol form of glucose, into fructose.

CMO:0003279.name: serum sorbital dehydrogenase activity
CMO:0003279.def: Quantitation of the catalytic effect exerted by Sorbitol dehydrogenase in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. Sorbitol dehydrogenase is an enzyme in carbohydrate metabolism converting sorbitol, the sugar alcohol form of glucose, into fructose

CMO:0003280.name: heart right ventricle weight to left ventricle plus septum weight ratio
CMO:0003280.def: A calculated value which compares the weight of the right ventricle, the lower chamber of the right side of the heart, which pumps venous blood through the pulmonary trunk and arteries to the capillaries of the lung, with the weight of the left ventricle (including the ventricular septum), the lower chamber of the left side of the heart, which pumps oxygenated blood out through the aorta to all the tissues of the body, and presents it as a ratio.
synonyms: Ratio of RV weight to LV+S weight

CMO:0003281.name: right ventricular end-systolic blood pressure
CMO:0003281.def: Measurement of the pressure within the heart right ventricle at the end of systole, the period of contraction of the heart when the blood is forced from the ventricles into the pulmonary artery (right ventricle) and the aorta (left ventricle).

CMO:0003282.name: right ventricular systolic blood pressure
CMO:0003282.def: Measurement of the pressure within the heart right ventricle at the point of maximal contraction, when the blood is forced from the right ventricle into the pulmonary artery.

CMO:0003283.name: right ventricular diastolic blood pressure
CMO:0003283.def: The minimum pressure in the heart right ventricle, usually at the point at which the heart is in a state of relaxation and expansion and the ventricles fill with blood.

CMO:0003284.name: right ventricular end-diastolic blood pressure
CMO:0003284.def: The pressure in the heart right ventricle at the end of diastole, the period when the heart is in a state of relaxation and expansion and the ventricles fill with blood.

CMO:0003285.name: mean aortic pressure
CMO:0003285.def: The average pressure (geometric mean) during the aortic pulse cycle.

CMO:0003286.name: mesenteric fat pad weight to tibia length ratio
CMO:0003286.def: A calculated value in which the weight of the mesenteric fat pad, the encapsulated adipose tissue attached to the membranous fold or mesentery of the abdomen, is divided by the length of the tibia, the inner and larger bone of the lower leg or hindlimb, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the length of the leg and, by extension, to the length of the body.

CMO:0003287.name: maximum rate of positive change in left ventricular blood pressure to left ventricular systolic blood pressure ratio
CMO:0003287.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the maximum rate of positive change in left ventricular blood pressure in a subject is divided by the left ventricular systolic blood pressure in that subject and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the left ventricular systolic blood pressure.

CMO:0003288.name: minimum rate of positive change in left ventricular blood pressure
CMO:0003288.def: A calculated measurement that is used as an index to characterize the contractile ability of the heart.

CMO:0003330.name: uterine cervix ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003330.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the uterine cervix, the lower, narrow portion of the uterus where it joins with the top end of the vagina.

CMO:0003331.name: substantia nigra ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003331.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the substantia nigra, a predominantly gray matter midbrain structure lying dorsal to the crus cerebri and ventral to the midbrain tegmentum. It is divided into a dorsal, cellularly compact region known as the pars compacta and a more ventrally located, containing more loosely packed cells, the pars reticulata. The most lateral region of the reticulata is identified as the pars lateralis.

CMO:0003368.name: telencephalon ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003368.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the telencephalon is formed or composed. Together with the diencephalon the telencephalon is part of the the most anterior region of the brain, called the forebrain.

CMO:0003369.name: forebrain ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003369.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the forebrain is formed or composed. The forebrain is the most anterior region of the brain including both the telencephalon and diencephalon.

CMO:0003375.name: urine sodium excretion rate to kidney weight ratio

Urine sodium excretion rate is the amount of sodium, the chemical element with atomic number 11, discharged in the urine, the fluid waste product separated and discharged by the kidneys, per unit time.

CMO:0003376.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic internal diameter
CMO:0003376.def: The diameter across the inside of the left ventricle of the heart at the end of diastole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally relaxed, and usually corresponds to its largest diameter.

CMO:0003386.name: subcutaneous tumor measurement
CMO:0003386.def: Measurement of one or more tumors of the hypodermis. A tumor is an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0003387.name: percentage of study population developing subcutaneous tumors during a period of time
CMO:0003387.def: The number of new cases of individuals developing subcutaneous tumors in a study population during a certain period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of study population developing hypodermis tumors during a period of time

CMO:0003388.name: subcutaneous tumor incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0003388.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display subcutaneous tumors at a point in time or develop subcutaneous tumors within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage or ratio. A subcutaneous tumor is a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive occurring in and composed of cells specific to the hypodermis, lowermost layer of the integumentary system in vertebrates.

CMO:0003389.name: kidney wet weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0003389.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight after removal from the body but without desiccation of the weight of one or both kidneys, one of the paired organs which function to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes, is divided by the total weight of the body and presented as a ratio, percentage, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to body weight.
synonyms: kidney wet weight as percentage of body weight

CMO:0003390.name: serum anti-coronavirus antibody level
CMO:0003390.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-coronavirus antibodies in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. An anti-coronavirus antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a coronavirus.

CMO:0003391.name: serum anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody level
CMO:0003391.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-SARS-CoV2 antibodies in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. An anti-SARS-CoV2 antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a SARS-CoV2 betacoronavirus.
synonyms: serum anti-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2 antibody level

CMO:0003392.name: serum anti-SARS-CoV antibody level
CMO:0003392.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-SARS-CoV antibodies in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. An anti-SARS-CoV antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a SARS-CoV betacoronavirus.
synonyms: serum anti-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus antibody level

CMO:0003393.name: serum anti-MERS-CoV antibody level
CMO:0003393.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-MERS-Cov antibodies in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. An anti-MERS-Cov antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a MERS-Cov betacoronavirus.
synonyms: serum anti-Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus antibody level

CMO:0003394.name: plasma anti-coronavirus antibody level
CMO:0003394.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-coronavirus antibodies in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. An anti-coronavirus antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a coronavirus.

CMO:0003395.name: plasma anti-MERS-CoV antibody level
CMO:0003395.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-MERS-CoV antibodies in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. An anti-MERS-CoV antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a MERS-CoV betacoronavirus.
synonyms: plasma anti-Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus antibody level

CMO:0003396.name: plasma anti-SARS-CoV antibody level
CMO:0003396.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-SARS-CoV antibodies in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. An anti-SARS-CoV antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a SARS-CoV betacoronavirus.
synonyms: plasma anti-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus antibody level

CMO:0003397.name: plasma anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody level
CMO:0003397.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibodies in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. An anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a SARS-CoV-2 betacoronavirus.
synonyms: plasma anti-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2 antibody level

CMO:0003398.name: serum anti-betacoronavirus antibody level
CMO:0003398.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-betacoronavirus antibodies in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. An anti-betacoronavirus antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a betacoronavirus. Betacoronaviruses represent one of four genera of coronaviruses of the subfamily Orthocoronavirinae in the family Coronaviridae, of the order Nidovirales.

CMO:0003399.name: plasma anti-betacoronavirus antibody level
CMO:0003399.def: Measurement of the amount of anti-betacoronavirus antibodies in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. An anti-betacoronavirus antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a betacoronavirus. Betacoronaviruses represent one of four genera of coronaviruses of the subfamily Orthocoronavirinae in the family Coronaviridae, of the order Nidovirales.

CMO:0003400.name: heart left ventricle plus septum wet weight
CMO:0003400.def: The weight of the lower left chamber of the heart (including the ventricular septum), which pumps oxygenated blood through the aorta into the systemic arteries, after removal from the body and separation from the rest of the heart but without desiccation.

CMO:0003401.name: kidney glomerulus basement membrane thickness
CMO:0003401.def: The width of the layer of extracellular matrix that lies between the endothelium of the glomerular capillaries and the podocytes of the inner or visceral layer of Bowman's capsule.

CMO:0003402.name: mesangium volume to glomerulus volume ratio
CMO:0003402.def: A calculated value made by dividing the mesangial fraction volume by the total glomerular volume, both values having been calculated from measurements of microscopic images.
synonyms: kidney mesangium volume to glomerulus volume ratio
ratio of glomerular area occupied by mesangial cells to total glomerular area
renal mesangium volume to glomerulus volume ratio

CMO:0003403.name: kidney fractional mesangial volume
CMO:0003403.def: A calculated value made by dividing the mesangial volume measurement by the total glomerular volume measurement, both values having been determined from measurements of microscopic images.
synonyms: ratio of glomerular area occupied by mesangial cells to total glomerular area

CMO:0003404.name: serum eicosanoid level
CMO:0003404.def: Measurement of the amount of one or more eicosanoids, physiologically active molecules derived by oxidation of twenty-carbon essential fatty acids such as arachidonic acid, in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which clotting factors have been removed.

CMO:0003405.name: serum 8-epi-prostaglandin F2alpha level
CMO:0003405.def: Measurement of the amount of 8-epi-prostaglandin F2alpha, an isoprostane that is prostaglandin F2alpha having inverted stereochemistry at the 8-position., in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which clotting factors have been removed.

CMO:0003406.name: plasma 8-epi-prostaglandin F2alpha level
CMO:0003406.def: Measurement of the amount of 8-epi-prostaglandin F2alpha, an isoprostane that is prostaglandin F2alpha having inverted stereochemistry at the 8-position., in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0003407.name: plasma eicosanoid level
CMO:0003407.def: Measurement of the amount of one or more eicosanoids, physiologically active molecules derived by oxidation of twenty-carbon essential fatty acids such as arachidonic acid, in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0003408.name: carbachol response/sensitivity measurement
CMO:0003408.def: Measurement of an organism's, organ's, tissue's or cell's capacity to respond, such as by a change in activity, state or condition, to carbachol, the ammonium salt that is a slowly hydrolyzed cholinergic agonist that acts at both muscarinic receptors and nicotinic receptors.

CMO:0003409.name: concentration of carbachol at which the reduction in force during dilation of a blood vessel is half the maximum value (EC50)
CMO:0003409.def: A calculated value for the concentration of carbachol, the ammonium salt that is a slowly hydrolyzed cholinergic agonist that acts at both muscarinic receptors and nicotinic receptors, at which the energy exerted during the active expansion in the diameter of a blood vessel in response to the application of carbachol is halfway between the highest value, that is the force at greatest constriction (often measured in a pre-constricted blood vessel), and the lowest achievable value of such contractile energy during carbachol-induced relaxation of the vessel wall (i.e. the maximum effect of carbachol which is the minimum contractile energy).
synonyms: concentration of carbamylcholine at which the reduction in force during dilation of a blood vessel is half the maximum value (EC50)
concentration of carbastat at which the reduction in force during dilation of a blood vessel is half the maximum value (EC50)

CMO:0003410.name: carbachol-induced blood vessel dilation expressed as percent reduction of  the force generated in a pre-constricted blood vessel
CMO:0003410.def: This is a measure of the relaxation caused by the addition of carbachol to a pre-constricted blood vessel. It is the ratio of the amount of dilation compared to a fully dilated blood vessel.
synonyms: carbachol-induced blood vessel dilation expressed as percent of phenylephrine-induced vasoconstriction

CMO:0003411.name: BAY60-4552 response/sensitivity measurement
CMO:0003411.def: Measurement of an organism's, organ's, tissue's or cell's capacity to respond, such as by a change in activity, state or condition, to BAY60-4552, a chemical that belongs to a novel group of small molecule compounds which increase the enzymatic activity of soluble guanylate cyclase.

CMO:0003412.name: BAY 60-4552-induced  blood vessel dilation expressed as percent reduction of  the force generated in a pre-constricted blood vessel
CMO:0003412.def: This is a measure of the relaxation caused by the addition of BAY 60-4552 to a pre-constricted blood vessel. It is the ratio of the amount of dilation compared to a fully dilated blood vessel.
synonyms: Nelociguat-induced blood vessel dilation expressed as percent reduction of  the force generated in a pre-constricted blood vessel

CMO:0003413.name: concentration of BAY 60-4552 at which the reduction in force during dilation of a blood vessel is half the maximum value (EC50)
CMO:0003413.def: A calculated value for the concentration of BAY 60-4552, a small molecule stimulator of soluble guanylate cyclase, at which the energy exerted during the active expansion in the diameter of a blood vessel in response to the application of BAY 60-4552 is halfway between the highest value, that is the force at greatest constriction (often measured in a pre-constricted blood vessel), and the lowest achievable value of such contractile energy during BAY 60-4552-induced relaxation of the vessel wall (i.e. the maximum effect of BAY 60-4552 which is the minimum contractile energy).
synonyms: concentration of Nelociguat at which the reduction in force during dilation of a blood vessel is half the maximum value (EC50)

CMO:0003414.name: GSK2181236A response/sensitivity measurement
CMO:0003414.def: Measurement of an organism's, organ's, tissue's or cell's capacity to respond, such as by a change in activity, state or condition, to GSK2181236A, a chemical that belongs to a novel group of small molecule compounds which increase the enzymatic activity of soluble guanylate cyclase.

CMO:0003415.name: GSK2181236A-induced blood vessel dilation expressed as percent reduction of  the force generated in a pre-constricted blood vessel
CMO:0003415.def: This is a measure of the relaxation caused by the addition of GSK2181236A to a pre-constricted blood vessel. It is the ratio of the amount of dilation compared to a fully dilated blood vessel.
synonyms: GSK2181236A-induced blood vessel dilation expressed as percent of phenylephrine-induced vasoconstriction

CMO:0003416.name: concentration of GSK2181236A at which the reduction in force during dilation of a blood vessel is half the maximum value (EC50)
CMO:0003416.def: A calculated value for the concentration of GSK2181236A, a small molecule activator of soluble guanylate cyclase, at which the energy exerted during the active expansion in the diameter of a blood vessel in response to the application of GSK2181236A is halfway between the highest value, that is the force at greatest constriction (often measured in a pre-constricted blood vessel), and the lowest achievable value of such contractile energy during GSK2181236A-induced relaxation of the vessel wall (i.e. the maximum effect of GSK2181236A which is the minimum contractile energy).

CMO:0003417.name: brain oxygen measurement
CMO:0003417.def: The quantification of interstitial oxygen in the brain, the portion of the central nervous system enclosed within the cranium which is composed of gray matter and white matter and is the primary center for the regulation and control of bodily activities.The brain tissue partial pressure of oxygen (PtO2) depends on the cerebral metabolic rate (CMR), the local cerebral blood flow (CBF) and the systemic exposure of hypoxia.
synonyms: brain partial pressure of oxygen measurement

CMO:0003418.name: free water clearance
CMO:0003418.def: In the physiology of the kidney, free water clearance is the volume of blood plasma that is cleared of solute-free water per unit time. A free water clearance of zero means the kidney is producing urine isotonic with respect to the plasma. Values greater than zero for free water clearance imply that the kidney is producing dilute urine through the excretion of solute-free water.

CMO:0003419.name: kidney physiological measurement
CMO:0003419.def: Any measurement relating to the function of the kidney or any part thereof. The kidney functions to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes.

CMO:0003420.name: calculated kidney physiological measurement
CMO:0003420.def: A measurement of kidney function which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003421.name: free water clearance level to body weight ratio
CMO:0003421.def: A calculated measurement in which the value for free water clearance is divided by the total body weight of the organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight.
synonyms: kidney water reabsorption level to body weight ratio
nephron water absorption level to body weight ratio
renal water absorption level to body weight ratio
renal water reabsorption level to body weight ratio

CMO:0003422.name: kidney hyaluronic acid level
CMO:0003422.def: The amount of hyaluronic acid, a mucopolysaccharide composed of N-acetylglucosamine and glucuronic acid subunits found in the connective tissues of vertebrates, found in a specified sample of kidney tissue.

CMO:0003423.name: calculated kidney enzyme activity measurement
CMO:0003423.def: Any measurement that has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of enzyme activity in a specified sample of kidney.

CMO:0003424.name: kidney hyaluronidase activity to total protein level ratio
CMO:0003424.def: A calculated measurement in which the level of hyaluronidase enzyme activity in a specified sample of kidney is divided by the weight of total protein in that sample. Hyaluronidase is a term applied to a group of very dissimilar enzymes that degrade hyaluronan (HA, hyaluronic acid), a high-molecular-weight glycosaminoglycan of the extracellular matrix.
synonyms: renal hyaluronidase activity to total protein level ratio

CMO:0003425.name: lung tumorous lesion incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0003425.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display lung tumorous lesions at a point in time or develop lung tumorous lesions within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells. The lungs comprise the organ component of the respiratory system responsible for the exchange of gases between the environment and the blood.

CMO:0003426.name: lung tumorous lesion measurement
CMO:0003426.def: Measurement of a lung lesion which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors, preneoplastic lesions, and hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells. The lungs comprise the organ component of the respiratory system responsible for the exchange of gases between the environment and the blood.

CMO:0003427.name: lung tumor incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0003427.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population displaying one or more tumors of the lung at a point in time or developing such growths within a determined period of time, are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. A tumor is an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0003428.name: lung tumor measurement
CMO:0003428.def: Measurement of an abnormal growth of tissue in the lung resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0003429.name: percentage of study population developing lung tumors during a period of time
CMO:0003429.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop new instances of lung tumors during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. A tumor is an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0003430.name: percentage of study population displaying lung tumors at a point in time
CMO:0003430.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display tumors of the lung at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. A tumor is an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function.

CMO:0003431.name: percentage of study population displaying metastatic tumors in the lung at a point in time
CMO:0003431.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display metastatic tumors in the lung at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. A metastatic tumor in the lung is a secondary abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the lung from the place where they first formed.

CMO:0003432.name: percentage of study population developing metastatic lung tumors during a period of time
CMO:0003432.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop metastatic lung tumors during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. A metastatic tumor in the lung is a secondary abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the lung from the place where they first formed.

CMO:0003433.name: lung tumor number
CMO:0003433.def: A value or quantity determined by count of lung tumors, abnormal growths of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function in the lung.

CMO:0003434.name: metastatic lung tumor number
CMO:0003434.def: A value or quantity determined by count of metastatic tumors in the lung. A metastatic tumor in the lung is a secondary, abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the lung from the place where they first formed.

CMO:0003435.name: lung tumorous lesion size measurement
CMO:0003435.def: Any measurement of the size of an individual tumorous lesion in the lung, or of the amount of the lung occupied by tumorous lesions. A tumorous lesion is one which is or has the potential to become a tumor, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive. Tumorous lesions include tumors and preneoplastic lesions, as well as hyperplastic lesions composed of histologically normal cells.

CMO:0003436.name: metastatic lung tumor size measurement
CMO:0003436.def: Any measurement of the size of an individual metastatic tumorous lesion in the lung, or of the amount of the lung occupied by metastatic tumorous lesions. A metastatic tumor in the lung is a secondary abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the lung from the place where they first formed.

CMO:0003437.name: metastatic lung tumor area measurement
CMO:0003437.def: A measurement of the extent of a two-dimensional surface of or plane through an individual metastatic tumorous lesion in the lung, or a measurement of the average total area occupied by metastatic tumorous lesions in cross-sections of lung per subject.

CMO:0003438.name: renal uptake of xenobiotic
CMO:0003438.def: Measurement of the amount of any xenobiotic or metabolic kinetics in a specified sample of kidney. A xenobiotic is a chemical compound foreign to a given biologic system, or more specifically, a pharmacologically, endocrinologically, or toxicologically active substance not endogenously produced and therefore foreign to an organism.

CMO:0003439.name: renal uptake of gadolinium-based contrast agent
CMO:0003439.def: Measurement of the amount of a gadolinium-based contrast agent or metabolic kinetics in a specified sample of kidney. Gadolinium-Based Contrast Agents (GBCA) are intravenous drugs used in diagnostic imaging procedures to enhance the quality of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or magnetic resonance angiography (MRA).

CMO:0003440.name: time to peak measurement of Gd-DTPA uptake by kidney cortex
CMO:0003440.def: Measurement of the the time elapsed between intravenous injection of Gd-DTPA (gadopentetate dimeglumine) and highest concentration of Gd-DTPA in the kidney cortex.
synonyms: time to peak measurement of gadopentetate dimeglumine uptake by kidney cortex

CMO:0003441.name: calculated retinal outer nuclear layer photoreceptor nucleus count
CMO:0003441.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the retinal outer nuclear layer photoreceptor nucleus count.

CMO:0003442.name: retinal outer nuclear layer photoreceptor nucleus count to layer length ratio
CMO:0003442.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of photoreceptor nuclei in a specified segment of retinal outer nuclear layer is divided by the length of that segment, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003443.name: kidney tubule regeneration foci count
CMO:0003443.def: The total number of microscopic instances of kidney tubule regenerative structures observed in a diseased kidney.
