CMO:0003444.name: kidney total tubule cast count
CMO:0003444.def: The total number of microscopically detected kidney tubule casts observed in a kidney.Renal intratubular casts may be hyaline or granular and observed in a number of renal diseases. Commonly observed hyaline (eosinophilic, homogeneous, proteinaceous) casts are associated with increased glomerular permeability such as with chronic progressive nephropathy and granular (necrotic cellular debris) casts are indicative of previous tubule cell necrosis.

CMO:0003445.name: interstitial nephritis foci count
CMO:0003445.def: The total number of microscopic instances of inflammation of the interstitial tissue of the kidney. The term interstitial tissue of the kidney is generally used for primary inflammation of kidney tubules and/or surrounding interstitium.

CMO:0003446.name: renal fibrosis foci count
CMO:0003446.def: The total number of microscopic instances of fibrosis observed in a diseased kidney. Renal fibrosis is the consequence of excessive accumulation of extracellular matrix and represents a failed wound-healing process of the kidney tissue.

CMO:0003447.name: kidney glomerular lesion count
CMO:0003447.def: The total number of microscopic instances of glomerular injury observed in a diseased kidney. The spectrum of glomerular lesions can be focal (only in some glomeruli), diffuse (in all or almost all the glomeruli), segmental (only a part of the glomerulus), or global (the entire glomerulus).

CMO:0003448.name: glycosuria incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0003448.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display glycosuria at a point in time or develop arthritis within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage or ratio. Glucose in the urine (glycosuria or glucosuria), results from the glomerular filtration of more glucose than the renal tubule can absorb.

CMO:0003449.name: percentage of study population developing glycosuria during a period of time
CMO:0003449.def: The number of new cases of glycosuria appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of study population developing glucosuria during a period of time

CMO:0003450.name: percentage of study population displaying glycosuria at a point in time
CMO:0003450.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display glycosuria at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of study population developing glucosuria at a point in time

CMO:0003451.name: body weight growth curve measurement
CMO:0003451.def: A calculated measurement in which a series of body weight measurements is plotted against time for a single individual and various values are determined from the plotted data.

CMO:0003452.name: maximum slope of body weight growth curve
CMO:0003452.def: The maximum slope of a body weight curve is the slope (m in y=mx+c) of the steepest tangent line along the curve, found by differentiating the equation of the curve.

CMO:0003453.name: brain mineral measurement
CMO:0003453.def: Any measurement of an inorganic element or compound containing a metal, nonmetal, radical, or phosphate that is needed for proper body function and maintenance of health, in brain, the portion of the central nervous system enclosed within the cranium which is composed of gray matter and white matter and is the primary center for the regulation and control of bodily activities, receiving and interpreting sensory impulses, and transmitting information to the muscles and body organs.

CMO:0003454.name: brain copper measurement
CMO:0003454.def: Any measurement of copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in brain, the portion of the central nervous system enclosed within the cranium which is composed of gray matter and white matter and is the primary center for the regulation and control of bodily activities, receiving and interpreting sensory impulses, and transmitting information to the muscles and body organs.

CMO:0003455.name: brain copper weight
CMO:0003455.def: Measurement of the weight or heaviness of the copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in a specified sample of brain.

CMO:0003456.name: calculated brain copper weight
CMO:0003456.def: A measurement of the weight or heaviness of the copper in a specified sample of brain, when that measurement has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003457.name: brain total copper weight
CMO:0003457.def: Measurement of the total weight or heaviness of the copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in a whole brain.

CMO:0003458.name: brain copper weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0003458.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of copper in a specified sample of brain is divided by the total weight of the body of the organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the size of the organism

CMO:0003459.name: brain copper weight to brain weight ratio
CMO:0003459.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of copper in a specified sample of brain is divided by the weight of that brain sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003460.name: brain copper weight to brain dry weight ratio
CMO:0003460.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of copper in a specified sample of brain is divided by the dry weight of that brain sample, that is, the weight of the sample after dessication, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003461.name: brain copper weight to brain wet weight ratio
CMO:0003461.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of copper in a specified sample of brain is divided by the wet weight of that brainsample, that is, the weight of the sample after removal from the body but without dessication, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003462.name: blood mineral measurement
CMO:0003462.def: Any measurement of an inorganic element or compound containing a metal, nonmetal, radical, or phosphate that is needed for proper body function and maintenance of health, in blood.

CMO:0003463.name: blood copper level
CMO:0003463.def: The amount of copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in a specified sample of blood, the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, capillaries and veins carrying nutrients and oxygen to the body tissues and metabolites away from them.

CMO:0003464.name: plasma copper level
CMO:0003464.def: The amount of copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0003465.name: serum copper level
CMO:0003465.def: The amount of copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0003466.name: blood ceruloplasmin level
CMO:0003466.def: The amount of ceruloplasmin in a specified sample of blood. Ceruloplasmin is a metalloprotein that binds most of the copper in plasma and is involved in the peroxidation of Fe(II)transferrin to Fe(III) transferrin.

CMO:0003467.name: plasma ceruloplasmin level
CMO:0003467.def: The amount of ceruloplasmin in a specified sample of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0003468.name: serum ceruloplasmin level
CMO:0003468.def: The amount of ceruloplasmin in a specified sample of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0003469.name: heart left ventricle epinephrine level
CMO:0003469.def: The amount in a specified sample of tissue from the heart left ventricle, of epinephrine, a catecholamine which can act as a neurotransmitter, a stress hormone, a stimulator of the sympathetic nervous system and a vasoconstrictor.

CMO:0003470.name: heart left ventricle norepinephrine level
CMO:0003470.def: The amount in a specified sample of tissue from the heart left ventricle, of norepinephrine, a catecholamine neurotransmitter and stress hormone with multiple physiological roles including affects on heart rate, blood pressure and vascular tone.

CMO:0003471.name: heart left ventricle end-diastolic diameter to posterior wall thickness ratio
CMO:0003471.def: A calculated measurement in which the heart left ventricle end-diastolic internal diameter is divided by the posterior wall thickness, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Heart left ventricle end-diastolic internal dimension is the diameter across the left ventricle of the heart at the end of diastole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally relaxed, and usually corresponds to its largest diameter.

CMO:0003472.name: kidney mineral measurement
CMO:0003472.def: Any measurement of an inorganic element or compound containing a metal, nonmetal, radical, or phosphate that is needed for proper body function and maintenance of health, in kidney, the organ which functions to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes.

CMO:0003473.name: kidney copper measurement
CMO:0003473.def: Any measurement of copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in kidney, the organ which functions to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes.

CMO:0003474.name: kidney copper weight
CMO:0003474.def: Measurement of the weight or heaviness of the copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in a specified sample of kidney.

CMO:0003475.name: kidney total copper weight
CMO:0003475.def: Measurement of the total weight or heaviness of the copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in one or both kidneys.

CMO:0003476.name: calculated kidney copper weight
CMO:0003476.def: A measurement of the weight or heaviness of the copper in a specified sample of kidney, when that measurement has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003477.name: kidney copper weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0003477.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of copper in a specified sample of kidney is divided by the total weight of the body of the organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the size of the organism.
synonyms: renal copper weight to body weight ratio

CMO:0003478.name: kidney copper weight to kidney dry weight ratio
CMO:0003478.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of copper in a specified sample of kidney is divided by the dry weight of that kidney sample, that is, the weight of the sample after dessication, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: renal copper weight to renal dry weight ratio

CMO:0003479.name: kidney copper weight to kidney weight ratio
CMO:0003479.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of copper in a specified sample of kidney is divided by the weight of that kidney sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: renal copper weight to renal weight ratio

CMO:0003480.name: kidney copper weight to kidney wet weight ratio
CMO:0003480.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of copper in a specified sample of kidney is divided by the wet weight of that kidney sample, that is, the weight of the sample after removal from the body but without dessication, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage
synonyms: renal copper weight to renal wet weight ratio

CMO:0003481.name: heart left ventricle interstitial bradykinin level during a period of time
CMO:0003481.def: The amount of bradykinin collected from the intercellular spaces of the left ventricle myocardium over a designated period of time.

CMO:0003482.name: heart left ventricle interstitial angiotensin II level during a period of time
CMO:0003482.def: The amount of angiotensin II in the heart left ventricle interstitium measured over a designated period of time. Ang II is considered to be the main effector of the renin-angiotensin system (RAS), has endocrine, autocrine/paracrine, and intracrine hormone activities in the body and acts as a powerful vasoconstrictor.

CMO:0003483.name: heart left ventricle interstitial epinephrine level during a period of time
CMO:0003483.def: The amount of epinephrine collected from the intercellular spaces of the left ventricle myocardium over a designated period of time.
synonyms: heart left ventricle interstitial adrenaline level during a period of time
heart left ventricle myocardium interstitial epinephrine level during a period of time

CMO:0003484.name: heart left ventricle interstitial norepinephrine level during a period of time
CMO:0003484.def: The amount of norepinephrine collected from the intercellular spaces of the left ventricle myocardium over a designated period of time.
synonyms: heart left ventricle interstitial noradrenaline level during a period of time
heart left ventricle myocardium interstitial norepinephrine level during a period of time

CMO:0003485.name: blood NAG activity level
CMO:0003485.def: The amount of enzymatic activity of N-acetyl-β-d-glucosaminidase (NAG) in a specified sample of blood. N-Acetyl-β-D-Glucosaminidase (NAG) is an intracellular lysosomal enzyme, present in the S3 segment of proximal tubular cells and distal nephron.

CMO:0003486.name: plasma NAG activity level
CMO:0003486.def: The amount of enzymatic activity of N-acetyl-β-d-glucosaminidase (NAG) in a specified sample of plasma. N-Acetyl-β-D-Glucosaminidase (NAG) is an intracellular lysosomal enzyme, present in the S3 segment of proximal tubular cells and distal nephron.

CMO:0003487.name: serum NAG activity level
CMO:0003487.def: The amount of enzymatic activity of N-acetyl-β-d-glucosaminidase (NAG) in a specified sample of serum. N-Acetyl-β-D-Glucosaminidase (NAG) is an intracellular lysosomal enzyme, present in the S3 segment of proximal tubular cells and distal nephron.

CMO:0003488.name: kidney glomerular surface area
CMO:0003488.def: The measurement of the total glomerular surface area as delimited by the internal edge of Bowman's capsule.

CMO:0003489.name: kidney glomerular tuft surface area
CMO:0003489.def: The tuft surface area is defined as the total glomerular surface area minus the urinary space area and the urinary recesses.

CMO:0003490.name: urine mineral measurement
CMO:0003490.def: Any measurement of an inorganic element or compound containing a metal, nonmetal, radical, or phosphate that is needed for proper body function and maintenance of health, in urine, the fluid waste product excreted by the kidneys.

CMO:0003491.name: urine copper measurement
CMO:0003491.def: Any measurement of copper, an essential dietary trace element, atomic number 29, involved in the formation of bone and blood as a necessary component of several enzymes, in urine, the fluid waste product excreted by the kidneys.

CMO:0003492.name: calculated urine copper measurement
CMO:0003492.def: Any measurement of urine copper which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003493.name: urine copper level to urine creatinine level ratio
CMO:0003493.def: A calculated measurement in which the level of copper in a specified sample of urine is divided by the level of creatinine in that sample of urine and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003494.name: cell ion flux
CMO:0003494.def: The movement of ions across biological membranes essential for generating electrical signals, regulating ion homeostasis, cell volume, and maintaining the resting membrane potential.

CMO:0003495.name: calculated cell ion flux
CMO:0003495.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of cellular ion flux.

CMO:0003496.name: net sodium influx to blood lymphocyte dry weight ratio per unit time
CMO:0003496.def: A measurement, which has been derived by a mathematical process, of lymphocytes present in a sample of blood for which sodium flux was determined in samples of isolated cells following ex vivo assay and sample drying.
synonyms: net Na influx to blood lymphocyte dry weight ratio per unit time

CMO:0003497.name: net potassium efflux to blood lymphocyte dry weight ratio per unit time
CMO:0003497.def: A measurement, which has been derived by a mathematical process, of lymphocytes present in a sample of blood for which potassium flux was determined in samples of isolated cells following ex vivo assay and sample drying.
synonyms: net K efflux to blood lymphocyte dry weight ratio per unit time

CMO:0003498.name: maximum oxygen consumption to body weight ratio
CMO:0003498.def: The maximum amount of oxygen that an individual can utilize during intense or maximal exercise usually measured as volume of oxygen per unit of time, relative to the individual's body weight.
synonyms: maximal oxygen consumption to body weight ratio

CMO:0003499.name: percentage of study population developing cerebral beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time
CMO:0003499.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop new instances of cerebral beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0003500.name: percentage of study population developing cerebral small perivascular bleeds during a period of time
CMO:0003500.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop new instances of cerebral small perivascular bleeds during a period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.
synonyms: percentage of study population with cerebral microhemorrhages during a period of time

CMO:0003501.name: percentage of study population developing  cerebral small vessel thrombosis and adjacent tissue infarction during a period of time
CMO:0003501.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop new instances of cerebral small vessel thromboses and adjacent tissue infarction during a period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.
synonyms: cerebral small vessel thromboses and adjacent tissue infarction incidence

CMO:0003502.name: percentage of study population developing cerebral small perivascular bleeds and beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time
CMO:0003502.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop new instances of cerebral small perivascular bleeds and beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population with beta-amyloid deposits, expressed as a percentage.
synonyms: cerebral small perivascular bleeds and beta-amyloid deposits incidence
percentage of beta-amyloid deposits positive population developing cerebral small perivascular bleeds during a period of time
percentage of cerebral small perivascular bleeds positive population developing cerebral beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time
percentage of study population developing cerebral microhemorrhages and beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time

CMO:0003503.name: percentage of study population developing cerebral small perivascular bleeds and no beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time
CMO:0003503.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop new instances of cerebral small perivascular bleeds and no beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population with no beta-amyloid deposits, expressed as a percentage.
synonyms: cerebral small perivascular bleeds and no beta-amyloid deposits incidence
percentage of study population developing cerebral microhemorrhages and no beta-amyloid deposits during a period of time

CMO:0003504.name: percentage of study population developing renal vascular pathology during a period of time
CMO:0003504.def: The number of individuals in a study population which develop new instances of renal vascular pathology during a period of time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage.

CMO:0003505.name: blood pro-A-type natriuretic peptide level
CMO:0003505.def: This is a measurement of the amount of pro hormone ANP (NPPA) peptides (proANP 1-30 [first 30 amino acids(a.a) of the 126 a.a atrial natriuretic peptide (ANP) prohormone], proANP 31-67 (a.a 31-67), and/or full length proANP (a.a 1-126) in a specified volume of blood.
synonyms: blood atrial natriuretic factor prohormone level
blood atrial natriuretic peptide prohormone level

CMO:0003506.name: blood proANF 31-67 peptide level
CMO:0003506.def: This is a measurement of the amount of proANF 31-67 (a.a 31-67 of the amino terminal of pro hormone ANP (Nppa)) in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0003507.name: plasma proANF 31-67 peptide level
CMO:0003507.def: This is a measurement of the amount of proANF 31-67 (a.a 31-67 of the amino terminal of pro hormone ANP (Nppa)) in a specified volume of plasma.

CMO:0003508.name: serum proANF 31-67 peptide level
CMO:0003508.def: This is a measurement of the amount of proANF 31-67 (a.a 31-67 of the amino terminal of pro hormone ANP (Nppa)) in a specified volume of serum.

CMO:0003509.name: blood 11-dehydrocorticosterone level
CMO:0003509.def: The amount of 11-dehydrocorticosterone, an 11-oxo steroid that is corticosterone in which the hydroxy substituent at the 11beta position has been oxidized to give the corresponding ketone, found in a specific volume of blood.

CMO:0003510.name: plasma 11-dehydrocorticosterone level
CMO:0003510.def: The amount of 11-dehydrocorticosterone, an 11-oxo steroid that is corticosterone in which the hydroxy substituent at the 11beta position has been oxidized to give the corresponding ketone, found in a specific volume of plasma.

CMO:0003511.name: serum 11-dehydrocorticosterone level
CMO:0003511.def: The amount of 11-dehydrocorticosterone, an 11-oxo steroid that is corticosterone in which the hydroxy substituent at the 11beta position has been oxidized to give the corresponding ketone, found in a specific volume of serum.

CMO:0003512.name: calculated blood corticosterone level
CMO:0003512.def: Measurement of the amount of corticosterone in a specified volume of blood, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003513.name: calculated plasma corticosterone level
CMO:0003513.def: Measurement of the amount of corticosterone in a specified volume of plasma, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003514.name: plasma corticosterone level to 11-dehydrocorticosterone level ratio
CMO:0003514.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of corticosterone in a sample of plasma is divided by the amount of 11-dehydrocorticosterone in that sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the 11-dehydrocorticosterone level.
synonyms: plasma corticosterone level to 11β,21-dihydroxyprogesterone level ratio
plasma corticosterone level to 17-deoxycortisol level ratio

CMO:0003515.name: necrotic liver tumorous lesion area to total liver tumorous lesion area ratio
CMO:0003515.def: A calculated value in which the area of a liver tumorous lesion occupied by necrosis is divided by the total area of that individual liver tumorous lesion and presented as a ratio, percentage, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the size of the liver tumorous lesion.

CMO:0003516.name: area of necrosis in liver tumorous lesion
CMO:0003516.def: A measurement of the extent of necrosis in a two-dimensional surface of, or in a plane through an individual tumorous lesion in the liver.

CMO:0003517.name: CD3+ thymocyte count
CMO:0003517.def: The number of thymocytes expressing CD3 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of thymus tissue. The CD3 complex, including five CD3 subunits, binds either TCR alpha/beta or TCR gamma/delta to form the TCR/CD3 complex on the surface of T-cells. The thymus is the lymphoid organ which is the site of the proliferation, differentiation and maturation of T lymphocytes, and of the production of hormones such as thymopoietin and thymosin, which control these processes.

CMO:0003518.name: blood amylase activity level
CMO:0003518.def: The amount of enzymatic activity of amylase, a digestive enzyme that helps the body break down carbohydrates, in a specified sample of blood. Both the salivary glands and the pancreas produce amylase. Blood amylase level is used to diagnose or monitor a problem with the pancreas.

CMO:0003519.name: serum amylase activity level
CMO:0003519.def: The amount of enzymatic activity of amylase, a digestive enzyme that helps the body break down carbohydrates, in a specified sample of serum. Both the salivary glands and the pancreas produce amylase. Blood amylase level is used to diagnose or monitor a problem with the pancreas.

CMO:0003520.name: plasma amylase activity leve
CMO:0003520.def: The amount of enzymatic activity of amylase, a digestive enzyme that helps the body break down carbohydrates, in a specified sample of plasma. Both the salivary glands and the pancreas produce amylase. Blood amylase level is used to diagnose or monitor a problem with the pancreas.

CMO:0003521.name: apoptotic hypodiploid thymocyte count to total thymocyte count ratio
CMO:0003521.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of hypodiploid thymocytes displaying apoptotic features in a specified sample of thymus is divided by the total number of thymocytes in the sample, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Hypodiploid is the condition of having slightly fewer than the diploid number of chromosomes and apoptosis is a programmed cell death process which proceeds through a series of specific biochemical events.

CMO:0003522.name: calculated thymocyte count
CMO:0003522.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of one or more of the various, specific types of thymocytes present in a sample of thymus for which a total thymocyte count was taken.

CMO:0003523.name: G0 stage diploid thymocyte count to total thymocyte count ratio
CMO:0003523.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of G0 stage diploid thymocytes in a specified sample of thymus is divided by the total number of thymocytes in the sample, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Diploid is the condition of having two sets of homologous chromosomes and G0 is a cell cycle quiescent stage .

CMO:0003524.name: G2/M stage tetraploid thymocyte count to total thymocyte count ratio
CMO:0003524.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of G2/M stage tetraploid thymocytes in a specified sample of thymus is divided by the total number of thymocytes in the sample, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Tetraploid is the condition of having four sets of homologous chromosomes and G2/M is a cell cycle checkpoint which assures that mitosis doesn't proceed until DNA replication/repair is finished .

CMO:0003525.name: calculated platelet morphological measurement
CMO:0003525.def: A quantification which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the measurement of the physical form or structure of platelets, the disk-shaped structures found in the blood of mammals which play a vital role in blood coagulation. Platelets lack nuclei and DNA but contain active enzymes and mitochondria.

CMO:0003526.name: platelet distribution width (percentage)
CMO:0003526.def: A measurement of platelet anisocytosis calculated from the distribution of individual platelet volumes and reported as percentage.

CMO:0003527.name: CD4+CD8- thymocyte count
CMO:0003527.def: The number of thymocytes expressing CD4 molecules but not CD8 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of thymus tissue. The CD4 molecule acts as a coreceptor with the T-cell receptor on the T lymphocyte to recognize antigens displayed by an antigen presenting cell in the context of class II MHC molecules. The CD8 molecule is a cell surface glycoprotein found on most cytotoxic T lymphocytes that mediates efficient cell-cell interactions within the immune system.

CMO:0003528.name: CD4+CD8+ thymocyte count
CMO:0003528.def: The number of thymocytes expressing both CD4 and CD8 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of thymus tissue. The CD4 molecule acts as a coreceptor with the T-cell receptor on the T lymphocyte to recognize antigens displayed by an antigen presenting cell in the context of class II MHC molecules. The CD8 molecule is a cell surface glycoprotein found on most cytotoxic T lymphocytes that mediates efficient cell-cell interactions within the immune system.

CMO:0003529.name: CD4-CD8+ thymocyte count
CMO:0003529.def: The number of thymocytes expressing CD8 molecules but not CD4 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of thymus tissue. The CD4 molecule acts as a coreceptor with the T-cell receptor on the T lymphocyte to recognize antigens displayed by an antigen presenting cell in the context of class II MHC molecules. The CD8 molecule is a cell surface glycoprotein found on most cytotoxic T lymphocytes that mediates efficient cell-cell interactions within the immune system.

CMO:0003530.name: CD4+CD25+ thymocyte count
CMO:0003530.def: The number of thymocytes expressing both CD4 and CD25 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of thymus tissue. The CD4 molecule acts as a coreceptor with the T-cell receptor on the T lymphocyte to recognize antigens displayed by an antigen presenting cell in the context of class II MHC molecules. The CD25 molecule (IL2RA) is normally an integral-membrane protein, but soluble IL2RA has been isolated and determined to result from extracellular proteolysis.

CMO:0003531.name: CD4+CD25+ splenocyte count
CMO:0003531.def: The number of splenocytes expressing both CD4 and CD25 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of spleen tissue. The CD4 molecule acts as a coreceptor with the T-cell receptor on the T lymphocyte to recognize antigens displayed by an antigen presenting cell in the context of class II MHC molecules. The CD25 molecule (IL2RA) is normally an integral-membrane protein, but soluble IL2RA has been isolated and determined to result from extracellular proteolysis.

CMO:0003532.name: CD4+CD25- splenocyte count
CMO:0003532.def: The number of splenocytes expressing CD4 molecules, but not CD25 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of spleen tissue. The CD4 molecule acts as a coreceptor with the T-cell receptor on the T lymphocyte to recognize antigens displayed by an antigen presenting cell in the context of class II MHC molecules. The CD25 molecule (IL2RA) is normally an integral-membrane protein, but soluble IL2RA has been isolated and determined to result from extracellular proteolysis.

CMO:0003533.name: CD3+ splenocyte count
CMO:0003533.def: The number of splenocytes expressing CD3 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of spleen, the highly vascular lymphoid organ which serves to store blood, disintegrate old blood cells, filter foreign substances from the blood, and produce lymphocytes.. The CD3 complex, including five CD3 subunits, binds either TCR alpha/beta or TCR gamma/delta to form the TCR/CD3 complex on the surface of T-cells.

CMO:0003534.name: CD11b/c+ splenocyte count
CMO:0003534.def: The number of splenocytes expressing CD11B and/or CD11C molecules on their surface in a specified sample of spleen tissue. The CD11B molecule (ITGAM, integrin alpha M chain) combines with the beta 2 chain (ITGB2) to form a leukocyte-specific integrin referred to as macrophage receptor 1 (Mac-1), or inactivated-C3b (iC3b) receptor 3 (CR3). The CD11C molecule (ITGAX, integrin subunit alpha X chain) combines with the beta 2 chain (ITGB2) to form a leukocyte-specific integrin referred to as inactivated-C3b (iC3b) receptor 4 (CR4).

CMO:0003535.name: CD45RA+ splenocyte count
CMO:0003535.def: The number of splenocytes expressing CD45RA molecules (PTPRC) on their surface in a specified sample of spleen tissue. The CD45RA molecule is the long isoform of CD45 and is expressed on naive T lymphocytes.

CMO:0003536.name: calculated spleen mononuclear cell count
CMO:0003536.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the mononuclear cell counts of the spleen, that is, the number of mononuclear cells (leukocytes such as lymphocytes and monocytes with a single round or oval nucleus) found in a specified sample of spleen.

CMO:0003537.name: CD4+CD25- splenocyte count to total splenocyte count ratio
CMO:0003537.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of splenocytes expressing surface CD4 molecules, but not CD25 molecules, in a specified sample of spleen tissue is divided by the number of total splenocytes in the same sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003538.name: CD4+CD25+ splenocyte count to total splenocyte count ratio
CMO:0003538.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of splenocytes expressing both CD4 and CD25 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of spleen tissue is divided by the number of total splenocytes in the same sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003539.name: CD3+ splenocyte count to total splenocyte count ratio
CMO:0003539.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of splenocytes expressing surface CD3 molecules in a specified sample of spleen tissue is divided by the number of total splenocytes in the same sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003540.name: CD11b/c+ splenocyte count to total splenocyte count ratio
CMO:0003540.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of splenocytes expressing CD11B and/or CD11C molecules on their surface in a specified sample of spleen tissue is divided by the number of total splenocytes in the same sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. The CD11C molecule (ITGAX, integrin subunit alpha X chain) combines with the beta 2 chain (ITGB2) to form a leukocyte-specific integrin referred to as inactivated-C3b (iC3b) receptor 4 (CR4).

CMO:0003541.name: CD45RA+ splenocyte count to total splenocyte count ratio
CMO:0003541.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of splenocytes expressing CD45RA molecules (PTPRC) on their surface in a specified sample of spleen tissue is divided by the number of total splenocytes in the same sample, and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. The CD45RA molecule is the long isoform of CD45 and is expressed on naive T lymphocytes.
synonyms: CD45 RA+ splenocyte count to total splenocyte count ratio
CD45RA splenocyte count to total splenocyte count ratio

CMO:0003542.name: CD4-CD25+ splenocyte count
CMO:0003542.def: The number of splenocytes expressing CD25 molecules, but not CD4 molecules on their surface in a specified sample of spleen tissue. The CD4 molecule acts as a coreceptor with the T-cell receptor on the T lymphocyte to recognize antigens displayed by an antigen presenting cell in the context of class II MHC molecules. The CD25 molecule (IL2RA) is normally an integral-membrane protein, but soluble IL2RA has been isolated and determined to result from extracellular proteolysis.

CMO:0003543.name: bacterial infection incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0003543.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display a specified bacterial infection at a point in time or develop a specified parasitic infection within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. A bacterial infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by bacteria, any of the unicellular prokaryotic microorganisms that commonly multiply by cell division, lack a nucleus or membrane-bound organelles, and possess a cell wall.

CMO:0003544.name: bacterial infection population measurement
CMO:0003544.def: Any measurement which deals with bacterial infections in terms of population, geography or demographics.

CMO:0003545.name: number of individuals in a study population displaying Pasteurellaceae infection at a point in time
CMO:0003545.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display a specified bacterial infection at a point in time are counted. A Pasteurellaceae infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by any bacteria of the family Pasteurellaceae, a large family of Gram-negative bacteria including the genera Pasteurella and Haemophilus, some of which are pathogenic.
synonyms: count of individuals in a study population displaying Pasteurellaceae infection at a point in time

CMO:0003546.name: number of individuals in a study population developing Pasteurellaceae infection during a period of time
CMO:0003546.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that develop a Pasteurellaceae infection within a determined period of time are counted. A Pasteurellaceae infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by any bacterial species of the family Pasteurellaceae, a large family of Gram-negative bacteria including the genera Pasteurella and Haemophilus, some of which are pathogenic.
synonyms: count of individuals in a study population developing Pasteurellaceae infection during a period of time

CMO:0003547.name: number of individuals in a study population displaying Haemophilus H21 infection at a point in time
CMO:0003547.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display a Haemophilus H21 infection at a point in time are counted. A Haemophilus H21 infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by the H21 strain of Haemophilus, a genus of Gram-negative, coccobacilli bacteria, some of which are pathogenic.
synonyms: count of individuals in a study population displaying Haemophilus H21 infection at a point in time

CMO:0003548.name: number of individuals in a study population displaying Haemophilus H35 infection at a point in time
CMO:0003548.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display a Haemophilus H35 infection at a point in time are counted. A Haemophilus H35 infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by the H35 strain of Haemophilus, a genus of Gram-negative, coccobacilli bacteria, some of which are pathogenic.
synonyms: count of individuals in a study population displaying Haemophilus H35 infection at a point in time

CMO:0003549.name: number of individuals in a study population displaying Pasteurella pneumotropica infection at a point in time
CMO:0003549.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display a Pasteurella pneumotropica infection at a point in time are counted. A Pasteurella pneumotropica infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by Pasteurella pneumotropica. Pasteurella pneumotropica is a species of Pasteurella, a genus of Gram-negative, coccobacilli bacteria, some of which are pathogenic.
synonyms: count of individuals in a study population displaying Pasteurella pneumotropica infection at a point in time

CMO:0003550.name: number of individuals in a study population developing Haemophilus H21 infection during a period of time
CMO:0003550.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that develop a Haemophilus H21 infection within a determined period of time are counted. A Haemophilus H21 infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by the H21 strain of Haemophilus, a genus of Gram-negative, coccobacilli bacteria, some of which are pathogenic.
synonyms: count of individuals in a study population developing Haemophilus H21 infection during a period of time

CMO:0003551.name: number of individuals in a study population developing Haemophilus H35 infection during a period of time
CMO:0003551.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that develop a Haemophilus H35 infection within a determined period of time are counted. A Haemophilus H35 infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by the H35 strain of Haemophilus, a genus of Gram-negative, coccobacilli bacteria, some of which are pathogenic.
synonyms: count of individuals in a study population developing Haemophilus H35 infection during a period of time

CMO:0003552.name: number of individuals in a study population developing Pasteurella pneumotropica infection during a period of time
CMO:0003552.def: A measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that develop a Pasteurella pneumotropica infection within a determined period of time are counted. A Pasteurella pneumotropica infection is the invasion and colonization of one or more tissues in the body by Pasteurella pneumotropica. Pasteurella pneumotropica is a species of Pasteurella, a genus of Gram-negative, coccobacilli bacteria, some of which are pathogenic.
synonyms: count of individuals in a study population developing Pasteurella pneumotropica infection during a period of time

CMO:0003553.name: intraperitoneal tumor measurement
CMO:0003553.def: The quantification of a parameter related to an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function, which occurs in the lining of/or within the peritoneal cavity.

CMO:0003554.name: metastatic intraperitoneal tumor weight
CMO:0003554.def: The weight of metastatic tumors in the peritoneum. A metastatic tumor in the peritoneum is a secondary, abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the peritoneum from the place where they first formed.

CMO:0003555.name: plasma insulin level to plasma glucose level ratio
CMO:0003555.def: A calculated measurement in which the value for the amount of insulin in a specified sample of plasma is divided by the value for the level of glucose in the same sample of plasma, and the result is presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003556.name: calculated plasma glucose level
CMO:0003556.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the amount of glucose in a specified sample of plasma.

CMO:0003557.name: retina cell count
CMO:0003557.def: The total number of cells in a specified sample of retina, the innermost layer or coating at the back of the eyeball, which is sensitive to light and in which the optic nerve terminates.

CMO:0003558.name: retina horizontal cell count
CMO:0003558.def: The total number of horizontal cells in the retina, the innermost layer or coating at the back of the eyeball, which is sensitive to light and in which the optic nerve terminates. A horizontal cell is a neuron that laterally connects other neurons in the inner nuclear layer of the retina.

CMO:0003559.name: calculated retina horizontal cell count
CMO:0003559.def: Any measurement that has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the retina horizontal cell count from one or both retinas.

CMO:0003560.name: central retina horizontal cell count to area ratio
CMO:0003560.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of horizontal cells in the central retina is divided by the total area of the peripheral retina. A horizontal cell is a neuron that laterally connects other neurons in the inner nuclear layer of the retina.

CMO:0003561.name: peripheral retina horizontal cell count to area ratio
CMO:0003561.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of horizontal cells in the peripheral retina is divided by the total area of the peripheral retina. A horizontal cell is a neuron that laterally connects other neurons in the inner nuclear layer of the retina.

CMO:0003562.name: retina rod bipolar cell count
CMO:0003562.def: The total number of rod bipolar cells in the retina, the innermost layer or coating at the back of the eyeball, which is sensitive to light and in which the optic nerve terminates. A rod bipolar cell is a neuron that is synapsed by rod photoreceptor cells but not by cone photoreceptor cells.

CMO:0003563.name: calculated retina rod bipolar cell count
CMO:0003563.def: Any measurement that has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the retina rod bipolar cell count from one or both retinas.

CMO:0003564.name: central retina rod bipolar cell count to area ratio
CMO:0003564.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of rod bipolar cells in the central retina is divided by the total area of the central retina. A rod bipolar cell is a neuron that is synapsed by rod photoreceptor cells but not by cone photoreceptor cells.

CMO:0003565.name: peripheral retina rod bipolar cell count to area ratio
CMO:0003565.def: A calculated measurement in which the number of rod bipolar cells in the peripheral retina is divided by the total area of the peripheral retina. A rod bipolar cell is a neuron that is synapsed by rod photoreceptor cells but not by cone photoreceptor cells.

CMO:0003566.name: measurement of minimal stimulus needed to elicit evasive reaction
CMO:0003566.def: A measurement of thermal, mechanical, or chemical stimulus which causes the subject to take evasive action to avoid further stimulation.

CMO:0003567.name: measurement of minimal mechanical stimulus needed to elicit evasive reaction
CMO:0003567.def: A measurement of the pressure of liquid, gas, or solid stimulus which causes the subject to take evasive action to avoid further stimulation. This measurement is often interpreted as the threshold of pain.

CMO:0003568.name: liver adult Schistosoma mansoni worm count
CMO:0003568.def: Measurement of the total number of adult, that is, fully developed, Schistosoma mansoni trematode worms recovered from a specified sample or perfusate of liver from an infected subject.

CMO:0003569.name: percent protection by treatment for Schistosoma mansoni
CMO:0003569.def: A measurement of the degree to which the presentation of the Schistosomiasis disease state, i.e. infection with trematode worms of Schistosomiasis mansoni), has been reduced in a population as a result of some intervening treatment.

CMO:0003570.name: intestine tumor incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0003570.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display intestine tumors at a point in time or develop intestine tumors within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. Intestine tumors are abnormal growths of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function, which occur in the intestine, the portion of the alimentary canal extending from the pyloric opening of the stomach to the anus.

CMO:0003571.name: intestine tumor measurement
CMO:0003571.def: The quantification of a parameter related to an abnormal growth of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function, which occurs in the intestine, the portion of the alimentary canal extending from the pyloric opening of the stomach to the anus.

CMO:0003572.name: percentage of study population developing intestine tumors during a period of time
CMO:0003572.def: The number of new cases of intestine tumors appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage, but could be expressed as a ratio. Intestine tumors are abnormal growths of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function, which occur in the intestine, the portion of the alimentary canal extending from the pyloric opening of the stomach to the anus.
synonyms: percentage of study population developing intestinal tumors during a period of time

CMO:0003573.name: percentage of study population displaying intestine tumors at a point in time
CMO:0003573.def: The number of individuals in a study population which display intestine tumors at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage or ratio. Intestine tumors are abnormal growths of tissue resulting from uncontrolled, progressive multiplication of cells and serving no physiological function, which occur in the intestine, the portion of the alimentary canal extending from the pyloric opening of the stomach to the anus.
synonyms: percentage of study population displaying intestinal tumors at a point in time

CMO:0003574.name: liver iron measurement
CMO:0003574.def: Any measurement of iron, a heavy metal element that is vital to many biological processes, in liver, the large, dark-red organ located in the cranial portion of the abdomen of vertebrates, just behind or below the diaphragm, the functions of which include storage and filtration of blood, secretion of bile, detoxification of noxious substances, conversion of sugars into glycogen, synthesis and breakdown of fats, and synthesis of serum proteins.

CMO:0003575.name: liver iron amount
CMO:0003575.def: Measurement of the amount of the iron, a heavy metal element that is vital to many biological processes, in a specified sample of liver.

CMO:0003576.name: calculated liver iron amount
CMO:0003576.def: A measurement of the amount of the iron in a specified sample of liver, when that measurement has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003577.name: liver iron weight to liver weight ratio
CMO:0003577.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of iron in a specified sample of liver is divided by the weight of that liver sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003578.name: liver tumorous lesion iron weight to liver tumorous lesion weight ratio
CMO:0003578.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of iron in a specified sample of liver tumorous lesion is divided by the weight of that liver tumorous lesion sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003579.name: liver iron weight to liver metastastic tumorous lesion weight ratio
CMO:0003579.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of iron in a specified sample of liver metastastic tumorous lesion is divided by the weight of that liver metastastic tumorous lesion sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003580.name: tear morphological measurement
CMO:0003580.def: Measurement of the physical characteristics (volume, pH, chemical composition, etc.) of tears, the fluid secreted by the lacrimal glands by means of which the conjunctiva and cornea are kept moist.

CMO:0003581.name: tear volume measurement
CMO:0003581.def: Any measurement of the size of the three dimensional space of tears, the fluid secreted by the lacrimal glands by means of which the conjunctiva and cornea are kept moist.

CMO:0003582.name: calculated tear volume measurement
CMO:0003582.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the size of the three dimensional space occupied by tears produced by an organism.

CMO:0003583.name: tear secretion rate
CMO:0003583.def: A measure of tears secreted per unit time.

CMO:0003584.name: measurement of minimal stimulus of cornea needed to elicit eyelid blinking
CMO:0003584.def: This measurement involves thermal, chemical, or mechanical stimulation of the cornea until the induction of eye blinking.

CMO:0003585.name: parasitic infection population measurement
CMO:0003585.def: This is any measurement which deals with parasitic infections in terms of population, geography or demographics.

CMO:0003586.name: lymphoma size measurement
CMO:0003586.def: Any measurement of the size of an individual tumorous lymphomatous lesion, or of the amount of the surrounding tissue occupied by tumorous lesions. A lymphoma is a tumor, usually malignant, made up of lymphocytes from lymphoid tissue or blood-forming organs.

CMO:0003587.name: calculated lymphoma size measurement
CMO:0003587.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process of a lymphomatous lesion, that is, a neoplasm or new growth of lymphocytes in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive.

CMO:0003588.name: maximum tumor size decrease to pretreatment tumor size ratio
CMO:0003588.def: A calculated value (size of the tumor at the start of therapy minus minimal obtained tumor size, divided by tumor size at the start of therapy x 100) in which the maximum size reduction of a lymphoma is divided by the pretreatment size of the lymphoma and presented as a ratio, fraction or quotient, thus normalizing it to the pretreatment size of the lymphoma.

CMO:0003589.name: time from start of drug therapy to immunocytoma regrowth
CMO:0003589.def: The length of time elapsed between the beginning of drug therapy and the regrowth of immunocytoma(s).
synonyms: time from start of drug therapy to lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma regrowth

CMO:0003590.name: time from therapy-induced maximal immunocytoma size decrease to regrowth of tumor to a diameter of 10 mm
CMO:0003590.def: The elapsed time between the maximal therapy-induced tumor size reduction to regrowth of the tumor to a diameter of ten millimeters.
synonyms: time from therapy-induced maximal lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma size decrease to regrowth of tumor to a diameter of 10 mm

CMO:0003591.name: soleus muscle weight
CMO:0003591.def: The weight of all or part of a soleus muscle, a deep muscle of the triceps surae group, in the superficial posterior compartment of the leg.

CMO:0003592.name: soleus muscle weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0003592.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of the soleus muscle is divided by the total weight of the body, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thereby normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.
synonyms: soleus weight to body weight ratio

CMO:0003593.name: capillary number to soleus muscle fiber number ratio
CMO:0003593.def: The total number of capillaries divided by the total number of skeletal muscle fibers within each soleus muscle histological cross‐section.
synonyms: capillary count to soleus muscle fiber count ratio

CMO:0003594.name: urine albumin level to urine osmolality ratio
CMO:0003594.def: A calculated measurement in which the amount of albumin in a specified volume of urine is divided by the osmolality of the same sample of urine.

CMO:0003595.name: liver MRI signal intensity to paravertebral muscle MRI signal intensity ratio
CMO:0003595.def: A calculated value in which the signal intensity value from healthy liver tissue is divided by the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle of the same subject and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle.

CMO:0003596.name: liver tumor MRI signal intensity to paravertebral muscle MRI signal intensity ratio
CMO:0003596.def: A calculated value in which the signal intensity value from tumorous liver tissue is divided by the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle of the same subject and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle.

CMO:0003597.name: calculated morphological liver measurement
CMO:0003597.def: A measurement of any parameter in a specified sample of liver, when that measurement has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003598.name: liver MRI signal intensity to paravertebral muscle MRI signal intensity ratio (PD-weighted)
CMO:0003598.def: A calculated value in which the signal intensity value from healthy liver tissue is divided by the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle of the same subject and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle. A PD-weighted image relies on the proton density of the imaged material.

CMO:0003599.name: liver MRI signal intensity to paravertebral muscle MRI signal intensity ratio (T2-weighted)
CMO:0003599.def: A calculated value in which the signal intensity value from healthy liver tissue is divided by the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle of the same subject and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle. A characteristic of a T2-weighted image is the high intensity signal of water versus a low intensity signal of bone or air.

CMO:0003600.name: liver tumor MRI signal intensity to paravertebral muscle MRI signal intensity ratio (PD-weighted)
CMO:0003600.def: A calculated value in which the signal intensity value from tumorous liver tissue is divided by the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle of the same subject and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle. A PD-weighted image relies on the proton density of the imaged material.

CMO:0003601.name: liver tumor MRI signal intensity to paravertebral muscle MRI signal intensity ratio (T2-weighted)
CMO:0003601.def: A calculated value in which the signal intensity value from tumorous liver tissue is divided by the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle of the same subject and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the signal intensity value from paravertebral muscle. A characteristic of a T2-weighted image is the high intensity signal of water versus a low intensity signal of bone or air.

CMO:0003602.name: liver iron weight to liver wet weight ratio
CMO:0003602.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of iron in a specified sample of wet liver is divided by the weight of that liver sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003603.name: liver iron weight to liver dry weight ratio
CMO:0003603.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of iron in a specified sample of dessicated liver is divided by the weight of that liver sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. The dry weight of the liver may also be estimated by subtracting the weight of water in the liver sample from the total weight of the liver sample.

CMO:0003604.name: liver tumorous lesion iron weight to liver tumorous lesion wet weight ratio
CMO:0003604.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of iron in a specified sample of wet liver tumorous lesion is divided by the weight of that liver sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003605.name: liver tumorous lesion iron weight to liver tumorous lesion dry weight ratio
CMO:0003605.def: A calculated measurement in which the weight of iron in a specified sample of dessicated liver tumorous lesion is divided by the weight of that liver sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. The dry weight of the liver tumorous lesion may also be estimated by subtracting the weight of water in the liver tumorous lesion sample from the total weight of the liver tumorous lesion sample.

CMO:0003606.name: calculated plasma nifedipine level
CMO:0003606.def: Any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of nifedipine, a potent vasodilator agent with calcium antagonistic action, in a specified sample of plasma.

CMO:0003607.name: calculated plasma triglyceride level
CMO:0003607.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the amount of triglycerides in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. Triglycerides are any of a group of lipids that are esters formed from one molecule of glycerol and three molecules of one or more fatty acids and are widespread in adipose tissue.

CMO:0003608.name: plasma triglyceride level area under curve
CMO:0003608.def: A calculated measurement in which a series of measurements of the amount of triglycerides in a specified volume of plasma is plotted against time for a single individual and the extent of the two dimensional region bounded by the curve and the axes of the graph is determined.

CMO:0003609.name: metastatic subcutaneous tumor weight
CMO:0003609.def: The weight of one or more metastatic tumors measured after growing in the hypodermis, any subcutaneous position in the body. A metastatic subcutaneous tumor is a secondary, abnormal, subcutaneous growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells from the place where they first formed.

CMO:0003610.name: metastatic liver tumor number
CMO:0003610.def: A value or quantity determined by count of metastatic tumors in the liver. A metastatic tumor in the liver is a secondary, abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the liver from the place where they first formed.

CMO:0003611.name: number of small metastatic liver tumors
CMO:0003611.def: A value or quantity determined by count of small (< 1 mm) metastatic tumors in the liver. A metastatic tumor in the liver is a secondary, abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the liver from the place where they first formed.
synonyms: count of metastatic liver tumors < 1 mm
count of small metastatic liver tumors
number of small metastatic tumors found in the liver

CMO:0003612.name: number of medium-sized metastatic liver tumors
CMO:0003612.def: A value or quantity determined by count of medium-sized (1-3 mm) metastatic tumors in the liver. A metastatic tumor in the liver is a secondary, abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the liver from the place where they first formed.
synonyms: count of medium-sized metastatic liver tumors

CMO:0003613.name: number of large metastatic liver tumors
CMO:0003613.def: A value or quantity determined by count of large (> 3 mm) metastatic tumors in the liver. A metastatic tumor in the liver is a secondary, abnormal growth of tissue resulting from the spread of cancer cells to the liver from the place where they first formed.
synonyms: count of large metastatic liver tumors
count of metastatic liver tumors > 3 mm

CMO:0003614.name: red blood cell molecular composition measurement
CMO:0003614.def: Any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of a red blood cell (erythrocyte) or of all of the red blood cells in a sample of blood. Red blood cells are the hemoglobin-containing blood cells that transport oxygen and carbon dioxide to and from the tissues.

CMO:0003615.name: free water reabsorption
CMO:0003615.def: In the physiology of the kidney, free water reabsorption is the volume of water reabsorbed by the blood plasma from the kidney per unit time. A free water reabsorption of zero means the kidney is producing urine isotonic with respect to the plasma. Values greater than zero for free water reabsorption imply that the kidney is producing concentrated urine through the excretion of water with a high level of solutes.

CMO:0003616.name: free water reabsorption level to body weight ratio
CMO:0003616.def: A calculated measurement in which the value for free water reabsorption is divided by the total body weight of the organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight.

CMO:0003617.name: kidney cortex hyaluronic acid level
CMO:0003617.def: The amount of hyaluronic acid, a mucopolysaccharide composed of N-acetylglucosamine and glucuronic acid subunits found in the connective tissues of vertebrates, found in a specified sample of kidney cortex tissue.

CMO:0003618.name: kidney papilla hyaluronic acid level
CMO:0003618.def: The amount of hyaluronic acid, a mucopolysaccharide composed of N-acetylglucosamine and glucuronic acid subunits found in the connective tissues of vertebrates, found in a specified sample of kidney papillary tissue.

CMO:0003619.name: nephron morphological measurement
CMO:0003619.def: Measurement of the physical form or structure of one or more nephrons in the kidney. A nephron is made up of a glomerulus, Bowman's capsule, proximal convoluted tubule, loop of Henle, distal convoluted tubule, collecting tubule, and collecting duct. A nephron is the basic functional unit of the kidney and its chief function is to regulate the concentration of water and soluble substances like sodium salts by filtering the blood, reabsorbing what is needed and excreting the rest as urine.

CMO:0003620.name: nephron count
CMO:0003620.def: The total number of nephrons in a kidney. A nephron is made up of a glomerulus, Bowman's capsule, proximal convoluted tubule, loop of Henle, distal convoluted tubule, collecting tubule, and collecting duct. A nephron is the basic functional unit of the kidney and its chief function is to regulate the concentration of water and soluble substances like sodium salts by filtering the blood, reabsorbing what is needed and excreting the rest as urine.

CMO:0003621.name: kidney cortex hyaluronidase activity to total protein level ratio
CMO:0003621.def: A calculated measurement in which the level of hyaluronidase enzyme activity in a specified sample of kidney cortex is divided by the weight of total protein in that sample. Hyaluronidase is a term applied to a group of very dissimilar enzymes that degrade hyaluronan (HA, hyaluronic acid), a high-molecular-weight glycosaminoglycan of the extracellular matrix.
synonyms: renal cortex hyaluronidase activity to total protein level ratio

CMO:0003622.name: kidney papilla hyaluronidase activity to total protein level ratio
CMO:0003622.def: A calculated measurement in which the level of hyaluronidase enzyme activity in a specified sample of kidney papillary tissue is divided by the weight of total protein in that sample. Hyaluronidase is a term applied to a group of very dissimilar enzymes that degrade hyaluronan (HA, hyaluronic acid), a high-molecular-weight glycosaminoglycan of the extracellular matrix.
synonyms: renal papilla hyaluronidase activity to total protein level ratio

CMO:0003623.name: left anterior descending artery outer diameter
CMO:0003623.def: The average length of a line which crosses a transverse view of the left anterior descending artery, one of the two branches of the left coronary artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the outer surface of the blood vessel wall.
synonyms: left anterior descending artery external diameter

CMO:0003624.name: coronary septal artery outer diameter
CMO:0003624.def: The average length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a coronary septal artery, a branch of the left anterior descending artery that supplies blood to the interventricular septum of the heart, passing through its center and ending on either side at the outer surface of the blood vessel wall.

CMO:0003625.name: middle cerebral artery outer diameter
CMO:0003625.def: The length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a middle cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the outer surface of the blood vessel wall. The middle cerebral arteries are the largest of the cerebral arteries and supply blood to the lateral cerebral cortex, anterior temporal lobes and insular cortices of the brain.

CMO:0003626.name: partial pressure of brain white matter oxygen
CMO:0003626.def: The quantification of interstitial oxygen in the white matter of the brain, the portion of the central nervous system enclosed within the cranium which is composed of gray matter and white matter and is the primary center for the regulation and control of bodily activities.The brain tissue partial pressure of oxygen (PtO2) depends on the cerebral metabolic rate (CMR), the local cerebral blood flow (CBF) and the systemic exposure of hypoxia.
synonyms: brain white matter partial pressure of oxygen measurement

CMO:0003627.name: partial pressure of brain gray matter oxygen
CMO:0003627.def: The quantification of interstitial oxygen in the gray matter of the brain, the portion of the central nervous system enclosed within the cranium which is composed of gray matter and white matter and is the primary center for the regulation and control of bodily activities.The brain tissue partial pressure of oxygen (PtO2) depends on the cerebral metabolic rate (CMR), the local cerebral blood flow (CBF) and the systemic exposure of hypoxia.
synonyms: artial pressure of brain grey matter oxygen
brain gray matter partial pressure of oxygen measurement

CMO:0003628.name: glomerular filtration rate index
CMO:0003628.def: This index is the first order rate constant, k(cl), which describes the clearance of an extracellular contrast agent (Gd-DTPA (gadopentetic acid), Gd-DOTA (gadoteric acid), or gadoterate meglumine (organoammonium salt of gadoteric acid) from renal cortex to outer medulla as calculated according to the following equation: k(cl)=(dc[medulla]/dt)/c[cortex]. The concentration in the cortex (predominantly blood signal) is compared to the concentration in the medulla (predominantly urine). The clearance of the contrast agent can serve as a marker for the glomerular filtration rate.

CMO:0003629.name: renal perfusion index
CMO:0003629.def: An index which describes the uptake of contrast agent by the renal cortex. It is the time at which contrast concentration reaches its maximum.

CMO:0003630.name: ratio of survivors of severe albuminuria to total study population during a period of time
CMO:0003630.def: The total number of experimental albuminuria subjects within a study population which remain alive during a specified period of time divided by the total number of individuals in the study population, presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. Albuminuria is the increased presence of albumin in the urine, indicative of kidney disease.
synonyms: percentage of albuminuria survivors in a study population during a period of time

CMO:0003631.name: multiregional glomerular filtration rate index
CMO:0003631.def: The concentration of a contrast agent in the cortex (predominantly blood signal) from multiple areas of both kidneys is compared to the concentration in multiple areas of the medulla (predominantly urine) of both kidneys to obtain the first order rate constant, k(cl). The clearance of the contrast agent can serve as a marker for the glomerular filtration rate.

CMO:0003632.name: regional glomerular filtration rate index
CMO:0003632.def: The concentration of a contrast agent in the cortex (predominantly blood signal) from limited areas of one kidney is compared to the concentration in limited areas of the medulla (predominantly urine) of the same kidney to obtain the first order rate constant, k(cl). The clearance of the contrast agent can serve as a marker for the glomerular filtration rate.

CMO:0003633.name: age at time of death of ileocecal immunocytoma-free subjects
CMO:0003633.def: Measurement of the amount of time between the beginning of life of an ileocecal immunocytoma-free organism and the permanent and irreversible cessation of the vital functions of that organism.

CMO:0003634.name: ileocecal immunocytoma latency period
CMO:0003634.def: The amount of time to the first discernible appearance of an ileocecal immunocytoma during the lifetime of a subject.

CMO:0003635.name: glomerular sieving coefficient for albumin
CMO:0003635.def: This is a calculated measurement of the ability of the kidney glomerulus to keep albumin out of the urine by its filtering function. It is the ratio of the albumin concentration in the filtrate (in Bowmans space) to the albumin concentration in the plasma (in the glomerular capillaries). The equation to derive this sieving value is based on fluorescence values from intravital multiphoton microscopy: (intensity of Bowmans space  intensity of background Bowmans space)/(intensity of capillaries  intensity of background capillaries).

CMO:0003636.name: proximal tubule albumin uptake to tubule area ratio
CMO:0003636.def: A microscopic measure of the amount of albumin reabsorbed by the proximal tubule per area of proximal tubule, where a fluorescent intensity value represents the amount of albumin reabsorbed per square area of proximal tubule.

CMO:0003637.name: blood glucagon-like peptide 1 level
CMO:0003637.def: The amount of glucagon-like peptide 1, a peptide of 36 or 37 amino acids that is derived from PROGLUCAGON and mainly produced by the INTESTINAL L CELLS, in a specified volume of blood. GLP-1 peptides are known to enhance glucose-dependent INSULIN release, suppress GLUCAGON release and gastric emptying, lower BLOOD GLUCOSE, and reduce food intake.

CMO:0003638.name: plasma glucagon-like peptide 1 level
CMO:0003638.def: The amount of glucagon-like peptide 1, a peptide of 36 or 37 amino acids that is derived from PROGLUCAGON and mainly produced by the INTESTINAL L CELLS, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended. GLP-1 peptides are known to enhance glucose-dependent INSULIN release, suppress GLUCAGON release and gastric emptying, lower BLOOD GLUCOSE, and reduce food intake.

CMO:0003639.name: serum glucagon-like peptide 1 level
CMO:0003639.def: The amount of glucagon-like peptide 1, a peptide of 36 or 37 amino acids that is derived from PROGLUCAGON and mainly produced by the INTESTINAL L CELLS, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed. GLP-1 peptides are known to enhance glucose-dependent INSULIN release, suppress GLUCAGON release and gastric emptying, lower BLOOD GLUCOSE, and reduce food intake.

CMO:0003640.name: blood gastric inhibitory polypeptide level
CMO:0003640.def: The amount of gastric inhibitory polypeptide, a 42-amino-acid hormone that is produced by enteroendocrine K-cells and released into the circulation in response to nutrient stimulation, in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0003641.name: plasma gastric inhibitory polypeptide level
CMO:0003641.def: The amount of gastric inhibitory polypeptide, a 42-amino-acid hormone that is produced by enteroendocrine K-cells and released into the circulation in response to nutrient stimulation, in a specified volume of plasma, the fibrinogen-containing fluid portion of the blood in which the particulate components are suspended.

CMO:0003642.name: serum gastric inhibitory polypeptide level
CMO:0003642.def: The amount of gastric inhibitory polypeptide, a 42-amino-acid hormone that is produced by enteroendocrine K-cells and released into the circulation in response to nutrient stimulation, in a specified volume of serum, the clear liquid that separates from blood after it has clotted completely, i.e. blood plasma from which fibrinogen has been removed.

CMO:0003643.name: ratio of area of glomerular capillary peripheral tuft not covered by podocytes to total area of glomerular capillary peripheral tuft
CMO:0003643.def: A calculated measurement in which the average area of glomerular capillary peripheral tuft not covered by podocytes is divided by the total area of glomerular capillary peripheral tuft. It is a measure of how much capillary area is directly exposed to the urinary space of Bowman's capsule.
synonyms: percentage of glomerular capillary peripheral tuft not covered by podocytes to total area of glomerular capillary peripheral tuft
ratio of area of  glomerular capillary peripheral tuft not covered by body of podocytes to total area of glomerular capillary peripheral tuft
ratio of glomerular capillary peripheral tuft not covered by body of podocytes to total glomerular capillary peripheral tuft

CMO:0003644.name: number of spontaneous locomotor movements per unit time
CMO:0003644.def: Measurement of spontaneous locomotor activity, that is any locomotor movements during a period of time.

CMO:0003645.name: artery neointimal hyperplastic lesion area including tunica media
CMO:0003645.def: The average measurements of planes through hyperplastic lesions of the tunica intima and tunica media, that is, a cross-section of the arterial wall from endothelium through the external elastic lamina. A hyperplastic lesion is a localized pathological increase in the number of cells of an organ or tissue resulting from an increased rate of cellular division due to injury or disease.
synonyms: artery intimal hyperplastic lesion area including tunica media

CMO:0003646.name: circular vessel area
CMO:0003646.def: The circular vessel area of an artery is the area of the tunica intima with a patent lumen. Because arteries sometimes collapse during experimental processing, the circular vessel area (CA) can be calculated by measuring a length of the internal elastic lamina (IEL) of an artery and applying the following formula: CA=(IEL x IEL)/4π.

CMO:0003647.name: calculated blood vessel area
CMO:0003647.def: A measurement of blood vessel area which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003648.name: kidney tubulointerstitial damage incidence/prevalence measurement
