HEF can be calculated using deconvolution analysis of the liver using scintigraphic data.

CMO:0003847.name: body length, crown to rump
CMO:0003847.def: The distance between the crown of the head and the back end of an organism.
synonyms: body length, top of head to rump

CMO:0003848.name: number of ureteric bud tips per kidney
CMO:0003848.def: This is a measurement of the number of ureteric bud tips calculated to be in one kidney from a measured sample of that kidney. Ureteric bud tips are at the terminal ends of the ureteric tree. The ureteric tip cells are proliferating immature cells located at the branching points that induce the adjacent cap mesenchyme to undergo nephrogenesis.
synonyms: ureteric bud tip count per kidney

CMO:0003849.name: number of glomeruli per kidney to number of ureteric bud tips per kidney ratio
CMO:0003849.def: A calculated measurement in which the average number of glomeruli calculated to be in one kidney is divided by the average number of ureteric bud tips calculated to be in one kidney and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to one kidney.
synonyms: count of glomeruli per kidney to count of ureteric bud tips per kidney ratio

CMO:0003850.name: total kidney protein to kidney weight ratio
CMO:0003850.def: A calculated value in which the total amount of protein in a kidney is divided by the total weight of the body and presented as a ratio thus normalizing it to body weight.
synonyms: total weight of kidney protein to whole kidney weight ratio

CMO:0003851.name: heart left ventricle end-systolic internal diameter
CMO:0003851.def: The diameter across the inside of the left ventricle of the heart at the end of systole, that is, when the heart muscle is maximally contracted, and usually corresponds to its smallest diameter.
synonyms: heart left ventricular end-systolic internal diameter
left ventricular internal dimension at systole

CMO:0003852.name: calculated red blood cell Na+/K+ ATPase activity
CMO:0003852.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the red blood cell Na+/K+ ATPase activity, the level of ouabain-sensitivity activity of the erythrocyte sodium-potassium adenosine triphosphatase.
synonyms: calculated red blood cell ouabain-sensitive Na+/K+ ATPase activity

CMO:0003853.name: rate constant of red blood cell Na+/K+ ATPase activity
CMO:0003853.def: A measurement which has been derived by computation of the red blood cell Na+/K+ ATPase activity, the level of ouabain-sensitivity activity of the erythrocyte sodium-potassium adenosine triphosphatase, a reaction that accomplishes the transport of three Na+ to the outside of the cell and the transport of two K+ ions to the inside.
synonyms: rate constant of red blood cell ouabain-sensitive Na+/K+ ATPase activity

CMO:0003854.name: calculated red blood cell Na-K-Cl cotransport activity
CMO:0003854.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the red blood cell Na-K-Cl cotransport activity, the action of the symporter that transports two chloride ions for every sodium and potassium ion transported, thus maintaining electroneutrality.
synonyms: calculated red blood cell Na-K-Cl simporter activity

CMO:0003855.name: rate constant of red blood cell Na-K-Cl cotransport activity
CMO:0003855.def: A measurement which has been derived by computation of the red blood cell Na-K-Cl cotransport activity, the level of ouabain-resistant, bumetanide-sensitive, simporter activity in the erythrocyte cell membrane.
synonyms: rate constant of red blood cell Na-K-Cl simporter activity

CMO:0003856.name: ouabain-sensitive red blood cell Na+ export rate
CMO:0003856.def: Measurement of the amount of sodium ion that is blocked from being exported by ouabain inhibition of the erythrocyte sodium-potassium adenosine triphosphatase, an enzyme which catalyzes the active, ATP-dependent transport of sodium and potassium ions across cell membranes, in a specified volume of red blood cells during a specified unit of time.

CMO:0003857.name: ouabain-sensitive red blood cell K+ import rate
CMO:0003857.def: Measurement of the amount of potassium ion that is blocked from being imported by ouabain inhibition of the erythrocyte sodium-potassium adenosine triphosphatase, an enzyme which catalyzes the active, ATP-dependent transport of sodium and potassium ions across cell membranes, in a specified volume of red blood cells during a specified unit of time. Rubidium is sometimes assayed as a substitute for potassium.
synonyms: ouabain-sensitive red blood cell Rb+ import rate

CMO:0003858.name: bumetanide-sensitive red blood cell Na+ export rate
CMO:0003858.def: Measurement of the amount of sodium ion that is blocked from being imported by bumetanide inhibition of the erythrocyte membrane transport protein that transports sodium (Na), potassium (K), and chloride (Cl) ions across the cell membrane into erythrocytes, in a specified volume of red blood cells during a specified unit of time.

CMO:0003859.name: bumetanide-sensitive red blood cell K+ import rate
CMO:0003859.def: Measurement of the amount of potassium ion that is blocked from being imported by bumetanide inhibition of the erythrocyte membrane transport protein that transports sodium (Na), potassium (K), and chloride (Cl) ions across the cell membrane into erythrocytes, in a specified volume of red blood cells during a specified unit of time. Rubidium is sometimes assayed as a substitute for potassium.
synonyms: bumetanide-sensitive red blood cell Rb+ import rate

CMO:0003860.name: ouabain- and bumetanide-resistant red blood cell Na+ import rate
CMO:0003860.def: Measurement of the amount of sodium ion that is imported despite ouabain and bumetanide inhibition of the Na+/K+ ATPase and Na-K-Cl symporter that transport sodium (Na), potassium (K), and chloride (Cl) ions across the cell membrane, in a specified volume of red blood cells during a specified unit of time.
synonyms: ouabain- and bumetanide-resistant erythrocyte Na+ import rate

CMO:0003861.name: ouabain- and bumetanide-resistant red blood cell K+ import rate
CMO:0003861.def: Measurement of the amount of potassium ion that is imported despite ouabain and bumetanide inhibition of the Na+/K+ ATPase and Na-K-Cl symporter that transport sodium (Na), potassium (K), and chloride (Cl) ions across the cell membrane, in a specified volume of red blood cells during a specified unit of time.
synonyms: ouabain- and bumetanide-resistant erythrocyte K+ import rate
ouabain- and bumetanide-resistant red blood cell Rb+ import rate

CMO:0003862.name: calculated red blood cell sodium/potassium passive permeability
CMO:0003862.def: A measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the red blood cell sodium and potassium ion flux into erythrocytes in the presence of a sodium-potassium pump inhibitor (ouabain) and a sodium-potassium-chloride cotransporter inhibitor (furosemide or bumetamide).
synonyms: calculated ouabain- and bumetanide-resistant sodium/potassium flux

CMO:0003863.name: rate constant of red blood cell sodium/potassium passive permeability
CMO:0003863.def: A measurement which has been derived by computation of the net effect of blocking both the Na/K pump and Na-K-Cl cotransporters in red blood cells. It is essentially a measurement of the level of ouabain-resistant, bumetanide-sensitive ion flux in the erythrocyte cell membrane.

CMO:0003864.name: volume of glomerular capillary tuft occupied by sclerosis to volume of total glomerular capillary tuft ratio
CMO:0003864.def: A calculated measurement in which the average volume of glomerular capillary tuft occupied by sclerotic changes is divided by the total average total volume of glomerular capillary tuft with the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to total of glomerular capillary tuft volume.
synonyms: percentage of tuft volume affected by sclerosis

CMO:0003865.name: healthy glomeruli to total glomeruli ratio
CMO:0003865.def: A calculated measurement in which the average number of healthy glomeruli per subject is divided by the average total number of glomeruli per subject with the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to total number of glomeruli.

CMO:0003866.name: post-treatment survival time from doxorubicin-treated IgM immunocytoma
CMO:0003866.def: This is a measurement of the length of time between introduction of a doxorubicin treatment protocol for an IgM immunocytoma and the death of the subject, i.e. the cessation of all vital functions of the body including the heartbeat, brain activity (including the brain stem), and breathing.

CMO:0003867.name: post-treatment survival time from drug-treated IgM immunocytoma
CMO:0003867.def: This is a measurement of the length of time between introduction of a drug treatment protocol for an IgM immunocytoma and the death of the subject, i.e. the cessation of all vital functions of the body including the heartbeat, brain activity (including the brain stem), and breathing.

CMO:0003868.name: blood B-type natriuretic peptide level
CMO:0003868.def: A measurement of the amount of B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) in a specified volume of blood.

CMO:0003869.name: heart left ventricle plus septum weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0003869.def: A calculated value in which sum of the weight of the left ventricle and the weight of the interventricular septum is divided by the total weight of the body with the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to body weight and by extension to the size of the organism.

CMO:0003870.name: metastatic liver tumor incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0003870.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display metastatic liver tumors at a point in time or develop metastatic liver tumors within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. A metastatic liver tumor is a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive occurring in, but originating distant to the liver.

CMO:0003871.name: percentage of study population developing metastatic liver tumors during a period of time
CMO:0003871.def: The number of new cases of metastatic liver tumors appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. A metastatic liver tumor is a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive occurring in, but originating distant to the liver.
synonyms: percentage of study population developing metastatic hepatic tumors during a period of time

CMO:0003872.name: percentage of study population displaying metastatic liver tumors at a point in time
CMO:0003872.def: This is a measurement of the number of individuals in a study population which display metastatic liver tumors at a certain point in time compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. A metastatic liver tumor is a neoplasm or new growth of tissue in which cell multiplication is more or less uncontrolled and progressive occurring in, but originating distant to the liver.
synonyms: percentage of study population displaying metastatic hepatic tumors at a point in time

CMO:0003873.name: ratio of survivors of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors to total study population during a period of time
CMO:0003873.def: This is a measure of the total number of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor subjects within a study population which remain alive during a specified period of time divided by the total number of individuals in the study population, presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: incidence of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor survivors
percentage of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor survivors in a study population during a period of time

CMO:0003874.name: post-insult time of death due to ENU-induced malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors
CMO:0003874.def: This is a measurement of the length of time between an injection of N-ethyl-N-nitrosourea (ENU) and the death of the subject as a result of malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors.
synonyms: post-insult time of death due to N-ethyl-N-nitrosourea-induced malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumors

CMO:0003875.name: ratio of deaths related to FUDR toxicity to total study population during a period of time
CMO:0003875.def: A measure of the total number of deaths related to 2'-deoxy-5-fluorouridine (FUDR) toxicity occurring during a specified period of time within a study population divided by the total number of individuals in the study population and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: ratio of deaths related to 2'-deoxy-5-fluorouridine toxicity to total study population during a period of time

CMO:0003876.name: blood urea level
CMO:0003876.def: This is the level of urea in the blood; converted from urea nitrogen to urea concentration by multiplying urea nitrogen concentration by 60/28 or 2.14. Urea is the chief nitrogenous end product of protein metabolism in whole blood. Urea is formed in the liver from amino acids and from ammonia compounds and can be found in urine, blood, and lymph.

CMO:0003877.name: serum urea level
CMO:0003877.def: This is the level of urea in blood serum, i.e. blood plasma from which clotting factors have been removed. This value can be determined by converting urea nitrogen to urea concentration by multiplying urea nitrogen concentration by 60/28 or 2.14. Urea is the chief nitrogenous end product of protein metabolism in whole blood. Urea is formed in the liver from amino acids and from ammonia compounds and can be found in urine, blood, and lymph.

CMO:0003878.name: plasma urea level
CMO:0003878.def: This is the level of urea in blood plasma, i.e. blood from which cells and cellular components have been removed. This value can be determined by converting urea nitrogen to urea concentration by multiplying urea nitrogen concentration by 60/28 or 2.14. Urea is the chief nitrogenous end product of protein metabolism in whole blood. Urea is formed in the liver from amino acids and from ammonia compounds and can be found in urine, blood, and lymph.

CMO:0003879.name: ratio of survivors of meconium ileus to total study population during a period of time
CMO:0003879.def: This is a measure of the total number of subjects within a study population which remain alive despite a propensity to suffer from meconium ileus during a specified period of time divided by the total number of individuals in the study population, presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003880.name: meconium ileus incidence/prevalence measurement
CMO:0003880.def: Any measurement in which the number of individuals in a study population that display meconium ileuss at a point in time or develop meconium ileus within a determined period of time are compared to the total number of individuals in the study population. Often expressed as a percentage but could be expressed as a ratio. Meconium ileus is intestinal obstruction due to inspissated meconium in the distal ileum and cecum, which develops in utero and presents shortly after birth as a failure to pass meconium.

CMO:0003881.name: percentage of study population developing meconium ileus during a period of time
CMO:0003881.def: This is the number of new cases of meconium ileus appearing in a study population during a certain period compared to the total number of individuals in the study population, expressed as a percentage. Meconium ileus is intestinal obstruction due to inspissated meconium in the distal ileum and cecum, which develops in utero and presents shortly after birth as a failure to pass meconium.

CMO:0003882.name: post-insult time of death due to metastatic liver tumors
CMO:0003882.def: This is a measurement of the length of time between experimental introduction of metastatic liver tumors and the death of the subject, i.e. the cessation of all vital functions of the body including the heartbeat, brain activity (including the brain stem), and breathing.
synonyms: post-insult time of death as a result of metastatic liver tumors
post-insult time of death due to colonic adenocarcinoma PROb cells

CMO:0003883.name: serum carbon dioxide level
CMO:0003883.def: The concentration of carbon dioxide (the product of the combustion of carbon with an excess of oxygen) in blood serum.

CMO:0003884.name: serum glucose level area under curve (AUC)
CMO:0003884.def: A calculated value in which a series of measurements of the amount of glucose in a specified volume of serum is plotted against time and the extent of the two dimensional region bounded by the curve and the axes of the graph is determined.

CMO:0003885.name: serum insulin level area under curve (AUC)
CMO:0003885.def: A calculated value in which a series of measurements of the amount of insulin in a specified volume of serum is plotted against time and the extent of the two dimensional region bounded by the curve and the axes of the graph is determined.

CMO:0003886.name: combined renal and gonadal fat pad weight
CMO:0003886.def: This is a measurement which has been derived by addition of the weight of the encapsulated adipose tissue surrounding the epididymis and the weight of the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the kidney.
synonyms: combined perirenal and epididymal fat pad weight
combined perirenal and gonadal fat pad weight
combined renal and epididymal fat pad weight

CMO:0003887.name: tissue deoxyribonucleic acid composition measurement
CMO:0003887.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the deoxyribonucleic acids (DNAs) found in a specified tissue.

CMO:0003888.name: calculated tissue deoxyribonucleic acid composition measurement
CMO:0003888.def: This is a measurement of one or more deoxyribonucleic acids, the molecules that are usually the molecular basis of heredity, which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation.

CMO:0003889.name: tissue mitochondrial DNA to nuclear DNA ratio
CMO:0003889.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the amount of mitochondrial DNA in a specified sample of tissue is divided by the amount of nuclear DNA in the same sample and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to nuclear DNA level.
synonyms: tissue mitochondrial deoxyribonucleic acid to nuclear deoxyribonucleic acid ratio

CMO:0003890.name: calculated bone mineral density measurement
CMO:0003890.def: This is a measurement, the value of which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the mass of mineral per unit volume of bone, the hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates and composed chiefly of calcium salts.
synonyms: spine bone mineral density change measurement

CMO:0003891.name: total bone mineral density
CMO:0003891.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the sum of the bone mineral density in all of the bones measured is divided by the total number of bones or types of bones measured. This measurement represents an average bone mineral density across different bones.

CMO:0003892.name: range of RSNA changes during variation of MAP
CMO:0003892.def: This calculated measurement is the range of change in renal sympathetic nerve activity relative to the change in mean arterial blood pressure over time and/or in response to a change in conditions.
synonyms: range of percentage of change in renal sympathetic nerve activity
range of percentage of change in RSNA
range of ratio of change in RSNA
range of renal sympathetic nerve activity changes during variation of mean arterial blood pressure
ratio of change in renal sympathetic nerve activity (range)

CMO:0003893.name: change in RSNA to change in MAP ratio
CMO:0003893.def: This calculated value is the average slope of the curve defined by the change in renal sympathetic nerve activity relative to the change in mean arterial blood pressure over time and/or in response to a change in conditions.
synonyms: change in renal sympathetic nerve activity to change in mean arterial blood pressure ratio

CMO:0003894.name: mean arterial pressure at the midpoint of a range of renal sympathetic nerve activity
CMO:0003894.def: This calculated value is the value of the mean arterial blood pressure at the midpoint of the curve defined by the change of renal sympathetic nerve activity relative to the change in mean arterial blood pressure over time and/or in response to a change in conditions.

CMO:0003895.name: calculated mean arterial blood pressure measurement
CMO:0003895.def: This is a measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of mean arterial blood pressure, the average blood pressure within an artery over a specified period of time.

CMO:0003896.name: range of heart rate variation during variation of mean arterial blood pressure
CMO:0003896.def: This calculated measurement is the range of change in heart rate (the number of contractions of the cardiac ventricles per unit of time) relative to the change in mean arterial blood pressure (the average force the blood exerts on an artery wall) over time and/or in response to a change in conditions.
synonyms: range of change in heart rate during changes in mean arterial blood pressure
range of change in HR during changes in MAP
range of variation in HR during variation in MAP

CMO:0003897.name: mean arterial pressure at the midpoint of a range of heart rates
CMO:0003897.def: This calculated value is the value of the mean arterial blood pressure at the midpoint of the curve defined by the change of heart rate relative to the change in mean arterial blood pressure over time and/or in response to a change in conditions.

CMO:0003898.name: cerebrospinal fluid potassium level
CMO:0003898.def: The amount of cationic potassium in a specified volume of cerebrospinal fluid.

CMO:0003899.name: calculated plasma chylomicron cholesterol level
CMO:0003899.def: The amount of chylomicron cholesterol in a specified volume of blood plasma where the value was derived by a mathematical process or computation rather than being measured directly. Chylomicrons are a class of lipoproteins (approximate density range <0.95 g/ml) that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the small intestine to other tissues.

CMO:0003900.name: calculated plasma very low density lipoprotein cholesterol level
CMO:0003900.def: The amount of very low density lipoprotein (VLDL) cholesterol in a specified volume of blood plasma where the value was derived by a mathematical process or computation rather than being measured directly. VLDL are a class of lipoproteins (typical density in plasma between 0.95 and 1.006 g/ml) that transport exogenous triglycerides and cholesterol from the small intestine to other tissues. VLDL constitute a class of large (e.g. approximately 30-80 nm in diameter) lipoprotein particles.
synonyms: very low density lipoprotein cholesterol change measurement

CMO:0003901.name: plasma chylomicron and VLDL cholesterol level
CMO:0003901.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the value for chylomicron cholesterol and the value for very low density lipoprotein cholesterol in a specified sample of plasma are added together for an approximation of non-HDL, non-LDL cholesterol in that same sample.
synonyms: plasma chylomicron and very low density lipoprotein cholesterol level

CMO:0003902.name: calculated plasma intermediate density lipoprotein cholesterol level
CMO:0003902.def: The amount of intermediate density lipoprotein (IDL) cholesterol in a specified volume of blood plasma where the value was derived by a mathematical process or computation rather than being measured directly. IDL are relatively large lipoprotein particles (complexes that consist of protein surrounding a core of lipids) formed by degradation of very low density lipoproteins (VLDL) particles and thus having a size intermediate between those of VLDL and LDL.

CMO:0003903.name: plasma IDL and LDL cholesterol
CMO:0003903.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the value for intermediate density lipoprotein (IDL) cholesterol and the value for low density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol in a specified sample of plasma are added together for an approximation of non-HDL, non-chylomicron/VLDL cholesterol in that same sample. Together, IDL and LDL cover a plasma density of 1.006 to 1.063 g/ml.
synonyms: plasma intermediate density lipoprotein and low density lipoprotein cholesterol

CMO:0003904.name: change in heart rate to change in vasoactive chemical dose ratio
CMO:0003904.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the difference in the heart rate recorded between two or more dosages of a drug or chemical which reduces or increases the interior diameter of blood vessels is divided by the difference of the applied dosages and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. The value is calculated as the slope of the curve of the heart rate versus the chemical dose graph.
synonyms: beta coefficent of the heart rate/ vasoactive chemical dose curve
slope of the heart rate/ vasoactive chemical dose curve

CMO:0003905.name: area of atherosclerotic lesion to total artery area ratio
CMO:0003905.def: This is calculated value in which the extent of the two-dimensional surface occupied by atherosclerotic lesion(s) is divided by the total extent of the two-dimensional surface of the artery and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing it to the size of the artery.
synonyms: atherosclerotic area as percentage of total
lesioned artery area to total artery area ratio

CMO:0003906.name: coronary perfusion pressure
CMO:0003906.def: This is a calculated measurement of the pressure gradient that drives coronary blood pressure. CPP can be measured by calculating the difference between the aortic pressure and the left ventricular end diastolic pressure: Coronary Perfusion Pressure (CPP) = Aortic Diastolic Pressure  Left Ventricular end-diastolic Pressure (LVEDP).

CMO:0003907.name: coronary blood flow rate
CMO:0003907.def: The is a measurement of the amount of blood perfusing the heart muscle through the coronary arteries per unit time.

CMO:0003908.name: coronary blood flow rate to heart weight ratio
CMO:0003908.def: The is a measurement of the amount of blood perfusing the heart muscle through the coronary arteries per unit time, divided by the total weight of the heart, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing coronary blood flow rate to heart weight.
synonyms: coronary blood flow per gram of heart tissue

CMO:0003909.name: blood myoglobin level
CMO:0003909.def: The amount of myoglobin in a specified volume of blood. Myoglobin is an iron-containing protein similar to hemoglobin that is found in muscle.

CMO:0003910.name: erythrocyte sedimentation rate
CMO:0003910.def: This is the sinking velocity red corpuscles, i.e., the rapidity which which the red cells sink in a mass of drawn blood.

CMO:0003911.name: kidney nucleic acid measurement
CMO:0003911.def: This is quantification of a morphological or physiological parameter of one or more nucleic acids in a specified sample of kidney tissue, that is, tissue from one or both of the paired organs which function to maintain proper water and electrolyte balance, regulate acid-base concentration, and filter the blood of metabolic wastes. Nucleic acids are high-molecular-weight polymeric compounds composed of nucleotides, each consisting of a purine or pyrimidine base, a ribose or deoxyribose sugar, and a phosphate group, and are involved in the determination and transmission of genetic characteristics.

CMO:0003912.name: kidney ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003912.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) that reside in the kidney. Ribonucleic acids are high-molecular-weight polymeric compounds composed of nucleotides, each consisting of a purine or pyrimidine base, a ribose sugar, and a phosphate group. They are involved in the determination and transmission of genetic characteristics.

CMO:0003913.name: kidney mRNA level
CMO:0003913.def: This is the measurement of the amount of messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) which codes for the amino acid sequences of proteins in a specified sample of kidney.

CMO:0003914.name: cell composition measurement
CMO:0003914.def: This is the quantitation or other measurement of the organelles, cytosol, and molecules which constitute the total make-up of a specified cell or set of cells.

CMO:0003915.name: cell molecular composition measurement
CMO:0003915.def: This is any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of a specified cell or set of cells.

CMO:0003916.name: cell ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003916.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified cell or set of cells.

CMO:0003917.name: native cell ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003917.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified type of cell or set of cells found in a natural setting, which includes multicellular organism cells 'in vivo' (i.e. part of an organism), and unicellular organisms 'in environment' (i.e. part of a natural environment).
synonyms: native cell ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0003918.name: isolated cell ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003918.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified type of cell or set of cells isolated from an organism before the occurance of any in vitro culturing.
synonyms: isolated cell ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0003919.name: cultured cell ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003919.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified type of cell or set of cells after in vitro cell culturing for a specified length of time. Cell culture refers to the growth of isolated cells from an animal or plant in a favorable artificial environment.
synonyms: cultured cell ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0003920.name: primary cultured cell ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003920.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified type of cell or set of cells after in vitro cell culturing for a specified length of time without the benefit of cell passage (harvesting and reseeding/splitting into multiple daughter cultures) . Cell culture refers to the growth of isolated cells from an animal or plant in a favorable artificial environment.
synonyms: primary cultured cell RNA composition measurement

CMO:0003921.name: cell line ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003921.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified cell line after in vitro cell culturing for a specified number of passages (harvesting and reseeding/splitting into multiple daughter cultures). A cell linerefers to a defined population of cells that can be maintained in culture for an extended period of time, retaining stability of certain phenotypes and functions. Cell lines are usually clonal, meaning that the entire population originated from a single common ancestor cell.
synonyms: cell line ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0003922.name: peripheral nervous system measurement
CMO:0003922.def: This any measurement of the peripheral nervous system, a major division of the nervous system that contains nerves which connect the central nervous system (CNS) with sensory organs, other organs, muscles, blood vessels and glands.

CMO:0003923.name: peripheral nervous system morphological measurement
CMO:0003923.def: This is any measurement of the physical form or structure of the peripheral nervous system, a major division of the nervous system that contains nerves which connect the central nervous system (CNS) with sensory organs, other organs, muscles, blood vessels and glands.

CMO:0003924.name: peripheral nervous system molecular composition measurement
CMO:0003924.def: This is any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of a designated part of the peripheral nervous system, a major division of the nervous system that contains nerves which connect the central nervous system (CNS) with sensory organs, other organs, muscles, blood vessels and glands.

CMO:0003925.name: peripheral nervous system ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003925.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the peripheral nervous system is formed or composed.
synonyms: peripheral nervous system ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0003926.name: dorsal root ganglion ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003926.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the dorsal root ganglion is formed or composed.

CMO:0003927.name: sciatic nerve ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003927.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the sciatic nerve is formed or composed.

CMO:0003928.name: cerebellum ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003928.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the cerebellum is formed or composed.

CMO:0003929.name: midbrain ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003929.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the midbrain is formed or composed.

CMO:0003930.name: hypothalamus ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003930.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the hypothalamus is formed or composed.

CMO:0003931.name: dermis ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003931.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in dermis, a layer of skin between the epidermis (with which it makes up the skin) and subcutaneous tissues. Dermis is composed of two layers, the papillary and reticular dermis.

CMO:0003932.name: epidermis ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003932.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in epidermis, the outer epithelial layer of skin that is superficial to the dermis.

CMO:0003933.name: bisphenol F in ethanol drink intake rate
CMO:0003933.def: The amount of a solution of bisphenol F that is consumed as a drink containing ethanol, that is, a liquid that is brought into the mouth and swallowed to quench thirst, for nourishment, etc., per unit time.
synonyms: BPF in ethanol drink intake rate

CMO:0003934.name: calculated calorie intake measurement
CMO:0003934.def: This is any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the calories consumed by a subject per period of time.

CMO:0003935.name: calories absorbed to calorie intake ratio
CMO:0003935.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the number of calories absorbed by a subject during a specified period of time or under specified conditions, is divided by the total calories consumed by the subject, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage. It is a measure of the amount of ingested chemical energy actually absorbed by the subject.
synonyms: total caloric absorption to total caloric intake ratio

CMO:0003936.name: total caloric absorption
CMO:0003936.def: This is a measurement of total calories consumed minus total calories lost through defecation during a specific time period. Total caloric absorption = [Total calories consumed ] - [Total caloric loss through feces]

CMO:0003937.name: dry feces weight
CMO:0003937.def: This is a measure of the relative mass of a sample of fecal matter. The weight of an object is the force acting on the object due to acceleration or gravity.

CMO:0003938.name: fecal calorie level
CMO:0003938.def: This is a measure of the calories generated by fecal matter. It may be determined by use of a bomb calorimeter.

CMO:0003939.name: calculated body weight gain measurement
CMO:0003939.def: This is any measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation, of the total body weight gained by a subject per period of time or or under specified conditions.

CMO:0003940.name: body weight gain to calories absorbed ratio
CMO:0003940.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the number of grams of body weight gained by a subject during a specified period of time or under specified conditions, is divided by the total calories absorbed by the subject, and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0003941.name: interscapular fat pad weight
CMO:0003941.def: This is a measure of the relative mass of the interscapular fat pad, the accumulation of encapsulated adipose tissue located in between the scapulae.

CMO:0003942.name: total body water mass
CMO:0003942.def: This measurement is a calculated/estimated value of the relative mass of total fluid in an organism. The two main fluid compartments are divided by the cell membrane into the extracellular fluid (ECF) and the intracellular fluid (ICF).

CMO:0003943.name: defecation rate by mass
CMO:0003943.def: This is a measurement of the weight of fecal matter excreted within a specified period of time.

CMO:0003944.name: total body fat-free mass
CMO:0003944.def: This is a measurement that determines whole body lean tissue mass of an organism by subtracting whole body fat mass from total body mass.

CMO:0003945.name: total body fat mass to total body mass ratio
CMO:0003945.def: This is a calculated value in which the total fat mass of an organism is divided by the total mass of an organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing fat mass to the total mass of the body.

CMO:0003946.name: total body fat-free mass to total body mass ratio
CMO:0003946.def: This is a calculated value in which the total lean mass of an organism is divided by the total mass of an organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing lean mass to the total mass of the body. Whole body lean tissue mass of an organism is determined by subtracting whole body fat mass from total body mass.
synonyms: total body fat-free weight to total body weight ratio

CMO:0003947.name: total body water mass to total body mass ratio
CMO:0003947.def: This is a calculated value in which the total water mass of an organism is divided by the total mass of an organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing water mass to the total mass of the body. Total body water mass of an organism is a calculated/estimated value of the relative mass of total fluid in an organism.
synonyms: total body fluid mass to total body mass ratio
total body water weight to total body weight ratio

CMO:0003948.name: urine mass
CMO:0003948.def: This is any measurement of the mass of urine voided.

CMO:0003949.name: timed urine mass
CMO:0003949.def: This is any measurement of the mass of urine voided over a specified period of time.

CMO:0003950.name: total body lean mass
CMO:0003950.def: This is a measurement of the total mass of the lean tissue of an organism. This measurement can be done by (TD-NMR) time-domain nuclear magnetic resonance for laboratory animals, or estimated by calculation using height and weight for human subjects.

CMO:0003951.name: calculated lean tissue mass measurement
CMO:0003951.def: This is a measurement which has been normalized or adjusted by a mathematical process or computation of the total lean tissue mass of an organism.

CMO:0003952.name: total body lean mass to total body mass ratio
CMO:0003952.def: This is a calculated value in which the total lean mass of an organism is divided by the total mass of an organism and presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage, thus normalizing lean mass to the total mass of the body. Whole body lean tissue mass of an organism is determined by TD-NMR (time-domain nuclear magnetic resonance) or a formula using height and weight of subject.

CMO:0003953.name: thyroid gland wet weight to body weight ratio
CMO:0003953.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the wet weight of the thyroid gland, the largest of the endocrine glands, is divided by the total body weight of the organism and the result presented as a ratio, fraction, quotient or percentage thus normalizing it to body weight and, by extension, to the size of the organism.

CMO:0003954.name: whole body physiology measurement
CMO:0003954.def: This is any measurement of a physiological process(es) which involve(s) or affect(s) most organ systems in the body.

CMO:0003955.name: basal metabolic rate
CMO:0003955.def: This is a calculated value which is a measure of the rate of energy expenditure per unit time by endothermic animals at rest. It represents the minimum amount of energy required to sustain life while at complete rest, including the body being in a post-absorptive state (ie the digestive system is inactive.

CMO:0003956.name: metabolic rate
CMO:0003956.def: This is a calculated value which is a measure of the rate of energy expenditure per unit time by endothermic animals at a specific moment or across a specified span of time, under specific conditions.

CMO:0003957.name: resting metabolic rate
CMO:0003957.def: This is a calculated value which is a measure of the rate of energy expenditure per unit time by endothermic animals at rest. It represents the minimum amount of energy required to sustain life during a time period of steady resting conditions, with less rigorous criteria than for basal metabolic rate.

CMO:0003958.name: ANCOVA-adjusted average metabolic rate
CMO:0003958.def: This is a calculated value which is a measure of the rate of energy expenditure per unit time by endothermic animals at a specific moment or across a specified span of time, under specific conditions. It involves analysis of covariance which examines the influence of an independent variable on a dependent variable while removing the effect of the covariate factor.

CMO:0003959.name: ANCOVA-adjusted resting metabolic rate
CMO:0003959.def: This is a calculated value which is a measure of the rate of energy expenditure per unit time by endothermic animals at rest. It represents the minimum amount of energy required to sustain life during a time period of steady resting conditions, with less rigorous criteria than for basal metabolic rate. It involves analysis of covariance which examines the influence of an independent variable on a dependent variable while removing the effect of the covariate factor.

CMO:0003960.name: kidney glomerulus area
CMO:0003960.def: This is a calculated measurement of the average cross-sectional area of glomeruli sampled in microscopic images.

CMO:0003961.name: kidney cortex damaged tubule count to kidney cortex total tubule count ratio
CMO:0003961.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the average number of damaged kidney cortex tubules per subject is divided by the average total number of kidney cortex tubules per subject with the result presented as a ratio, thus normalizing the number of damaged tubules to total number of tubules.
synonyms: percentage of damaged kidney cortex tubules
percentage of damaged renal cortex tubules
renal cortex damaged tubule count to renal cortex total tubule count ratio

CMO:0003962.name: kidney medulla damaged tubule count to kidney medulla total tubule count ratio
CMO:0003962.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the average number of damaged kidney medulla tubules per subject is divided by the average total number of kidney medulla tubules per subject with the result presented as a ratio, thus normalizing the number of damaged tubules to the total number of tubules.
synonyms: percentage of damaged kidney medulla tubules
percentage of damaged renal medulla tubules
renal medulla damaged tubule count to renal medulla total tubule count ratio

CMO:0003963.name: CD4+ lymphocyte ribonucleic acid composition measurement
CMO:0003963.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in CD4+ lymphocytes. CD4 is a membrane glycoprotein found primarily on T lymphocytes, but also can be expressed on B cells, macrophages, and granulocytes. On T cells it is a co-receptor for the T cell receptor (TCR), interacts with MHC class II antigens, and functions to initiate or augment the early phase of T-cell activation.
synonyms: CD4(+) llymphocyte ribonucleic acid composition measurement
CD4(+) lymphocyte ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0003964.name: blood anti-coronavirus antibody level
CMO:0003964.def: This is a measurement of the amount of anti-coronavirus antibodies in a specified sample of blood, the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, capillaries and veins carrying nutrients and oxygen to the body tissues and metabolites away from them. An anti-coronavirus antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a coronavirus.

CMO:0003965.name: blood anti-betacoronavirus antibody level
CMO:0003965.def: This is a measurement of the amount of anti-betacoronavirus antibodies in a specified sample of blood, the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, capillaries and veins carrying nutrients and oxygen to the body tissues and metabolites away from them. An anti-betacoronavirus antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a betacoronavirus. Betacoronaviruses represent one of four genera of coronaviruses of the subfamily Orthocoronavirinae in the family Coronaviridae, of the order Nidovirales.

CMO:0003966.name: blood anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody level
CMO:0003966.def: This is a measurement of the amount of anti-SARS-CoV2 antibodies in a specified sample of blood, the fluid that circulates through the heart, arteries, capillaries and veins carrying nutrients and oxygen to the body tissues and metabolites away from them. An anti-SARS-CoV2 antibody is an immunoglobulin molecule possessing a specific amino acid sequence that binds to a specific antigen found on or in a SARS-CoV2 betacoronavirus.
synonyms: blood anti-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2 antibody level

CMO:0003967.name: blood non-high density lipoprotein cholesterol level
CMO:0003967.def: This is a calculated measurement in which the value for high density lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol in a specified sample of blood is subtracted from the value for total cholesterol in that same sample. HDL is the smallest of the major lipoprotein particles, complex molecules that consist of a protein membrane surrounding a core of lipids

CMO:0003968.name: retina ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003968.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the retina, the innermost layer or coating at the back of the eyeball, which is sensitive to light and in which the optic nerve terminates.

CMO:0003969.name: trigeminal ganglion ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003969.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the trigeminal ganglion is composed.

CMO:0003970.name: urethra molecular composition measurement
CMO:0003970.def: This is any quantification of the amounts or proportions of proteins, lipids, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in a specified sample of urethral tissue, the tissue comprising the canal through which urine is discharged from the bladder in most mammals and through which semen is discharged in the male.

CMO:0003971.name: urethra ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003971.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in urethral tissue.

CMO:0003972.name: MRPVAT ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003972.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in adipose tissue surrounding small mesenteric blood vessels.
synonyms: small mesenteric blood vessel perivascular adipose tissue RNA level

CMO:0003973.name: tendon ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003973.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in tendon, the fibrous bands or cords of connective tissue at the ends of muscle fibers that attach muscles to bones and other structures.

CMO:0003974.name: temporal lobe ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003974.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the temporal lobe of one or both cerebral hemisphere(s) is formed or composed.

CMO:0003975.name: ear ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003975.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the ear, the sense organ in vertebrates that is specialized for the detection of sound, and the maintenance of balance.

CMO:0003976.name: outer ear ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003976.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the outer ear, part of the ear external to the tympanum (eardrum), consisting of a tube (the external auditory meatus) and the pinna (auricle).
synonyms: external ear ribonucleic acid composition measurement
outer ear ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0003977.name: mammary gland ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003977.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the mammary gland, the specialized exocrine gland of the skin of female mammals, which secretes milk for nourishment of the young.
synonyms: mammary gland ribonucleic acid composition measurement
mammary organ ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0003978.name: vena cava morphological measurement
CMO:0003978.def: This is any quantification of the physical form or structure of the largest veins (superior vena cava and inferior vena cava in mammals) which deliver de-oxygenated blood from throughout the body back to the right cardiac atrium.

CMO:0003979.name: vena cava molecular composition measurement
CMO:0003979.def: This is any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of the largest veins (superior vena cava and inferior vena cava in mammals) which deliver de-oxygenated blood from throughout the body back to the right cardiac atrium.

CMO:0003980.name: vena cava ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003980.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the largest veins (superior vena cava and inferior vena cava in mammals) which deliver de-oxygenated blood from throughout the body back to the right cardiac atrium.

CMO:0003981.name: cornea ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003981.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the cornea, the transparent anterior portion of the fibrous coat of the eye that serves as the chief refractory structure.

CMO:0003982.name: aorta ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003982.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the great artery arising from the left ventricle from which the systemic arterial system proceeds.

CMO:0003983.name: vibrissa follicle ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003983.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in vibrissa follicles, the tubular invaginations of the epidermis enclosing the hair roots and from which grow the vibrissae (whiskers) located on the muzzle and face of many species.

CMO:0003984.name: heart right atrium ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003984.def: This is a measurement of the amount of ribonucleic acid (RNA), the molecule composed of the sugar ribose, phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or uracil, extracted from or contained in the heart right atrium, the upper chamber of the right side of the heart, which receives deoxygenated blood from the venae cavae and the coronary sinus, and pumps it into the right ventricle through the tricuspid valve.
synonyms: heart right atrium ribonucleic acid amount
right cardiac atrium ribonucleic acid amount

CMO:0003985.name: sinoatrial node ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003985.def: This is a measurement of the amount of ribonucleic acid (RNA), the molecule composed of the sugar ribose, phosphate groups and any combination of the bases adenine, guanine, cytosine, and/or uracil, extracted from or contained in the sinoatrial node of the heart right atrium, the upper chamber of the right side of the heart, which receives deoxygenated blood from the vena cavae and the coronary sinus, and pumps it into the right ventricle through the tricuspid valve. The sinoatrial node is located at the junction of the superior vena cava and the right atrium.

CMO:0003986.name: embryonic cell/tissue ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003986.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in embryonic cells or tissue.

CMO:0003987.name: 1-cell embryo ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003987.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a one-cell embryo (zygote).

CMO:0003988.name: 2-cell embryo ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003988.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a two-cell embryo.

CMO:0003989.name: 4-cell embryo ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003989.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a four-cell embryo.

CMO:0003990.name: blastocyst ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003990.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a blastocyst, a hollow ball of cells in an early-stage embryo containing two cell types, the inner cell mass and the trophectoderm.

CMO:0003991.name: 8-cell embryo ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003991.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a eight-cell embryo.

CMO:0003992.name: oocyte ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003992.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a female germ cell(s) that has entered meiosis.

CMO:0003993.name: inferior alveolar nerve ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003993.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the inferior alveolar nerve is formed or composed. The inferior alveolar nerve is the branch of the mandibular nerve responsible for sensory innervation to the gingivae of the lower jaw.

CMO:0003994.name: joint molecular composition measurement
CMO:0003994.def: This is any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of a specified skeletal joint, one of the articulations between bones which may be immovable, slightly movable or freely movable.

CMO:0003995.name: knee joint ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003995.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the knee joint, the joint that joins the thigh with the leg and consists of two articulations: one between the femur and tibia, and one between the femur and patella.

CMO:0003996.name: articular chondrocyte ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003996.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in chondrocytes isolated from articular cartilage. Articular cartilage is a thin layer of cartilage, usually hyaline cartilage, on the articular surface of bones in synovial joints.

CMO:0003997.name: maximim inner diameter of middle cerebral artery perfused in bicarbonate-buffered, calcium-free saline
CMO:0003997.def: This is an ex vivo measurement of the length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a calcium-free physiological salt solution (PSS)-perfused (80 mmHg equilibrium pressure) middle cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall. The middle cerebral arteries are the largest of the cerebral arteries and supply blood to the lateral cerebral cortex, anterior temporal lobes and insular cortices of the brain.
synonyms: maximim diameter of middle cerebral artery perfused in bicarbonate-buffered, calcium-free saline
maximim lumen diameter of middle cerebral artery perfused in bicarbonate-buffered, calcium-free PSS
maximum inner diameter of MCA perfused in calcium-free PSS

CMO:0003998.name: resting inner diameter of middle cerebral artery perfused in bicarbonate-buffered, normal saline
CMO:0003998.def: This is an ex vivo measurement of the length of a line which crosses a transverse view of a saline-perfused (80 mmHg equilibrium pressure) middle cerebral artery, passing through its center and ending on either side at the inner surface of the blood vessel wall. The middle cerebral arteries are the largest of the cerebral arteries and supply blood to the lateral cerebral cortex, anterior temporal lobes and insular cortices of the brain.
synonyms: lumen diameter of middle cerebral artery perfused in bicarbonate-buffered, normal saline
resting diameter of middle cerebral artery perfused in bicarbonate-buffered, normal physiological salt solution
resting inner diameter of MCA perfused in normal PSS

CMO:0003999.name: fracture hematoma ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0003999.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a fracture hematoma, the first stage of healing for a bone fracture. The hematoma formation involves platelet aggregation, activation of the compliment cascade, and local hypoxia following the disruption of vasculature. The area is then invaded by a number of undifferentiated and committed cells resulting in the organisation of hematoma and the formation of granulation tissue.
synonyms: broken bone hematoma ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004000.name: neoplastic tissue ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004000.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified neoplastic tissue.

CMO:0004001.name: malignant, neoplastic tissue ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004001.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified malignant, neoplastic tissue.
synonyms: cancerous neoplastic tissue ribonucleic acid level
malignant, neoplastic tissue ribonucleic acid composition measurement

CMO:0004002.name: benign, neoplastic tissue ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004002.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a specified benign, neoplastic tissue.
synonyms: benign, neoplastic tissue ribonucleic acid composition measurement
noncancerous, neoplastic tissue ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004003.name: endometrium ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004003.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the endometrium, the glandular mucous membrane lining of the uterine cavity that is hormonally responsive during the estrous/menstrual cycle and during pregnancy.

CMO:0004004.name: endometrial cancer ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004004.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a malignant tumor of the endometrium, the glandular mucous membrane lining of the uterine cavity that is hormonally responsive during the estrous/menstrual cycle and during pregnancy.
synonyms: endometrial, malignant neoplasm ribonucleic acid level
endometrial, malignant, neoplastic tissue ribonucleic acid level
endometrial, malignant tumor ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004005.name: mammary gland ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004005.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the mammary gland(s), a specialized accessory gland of the skin of mammals that secretes milk. The gland is typically only developed in females, and regresses in males.

CMO:0004006.name: mammary gland cancer ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004006.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a malignant tumor of the mammary gland(s), a specialized accessory gland of the skin of mammals that secretes milk. The gland is typically only developed in females, and regresses in males.
synonyms: mammary gland malignant neoplasm RNA level
mammary gland malignant tumor RNA level

CMO:0004007.name: calculated plasma pyrophosphate level
CMO:0004007.def: This is a measurement which has been normalized, adjusted or derived by a mathematical process or computation of the amount of inorganic pyrophosphate in a specified sample of plasma, the clear liquid that separates from blood after cells, platelets, and cellular debris has been removed.

CMO:0004008.name: total number of entries into the arms of an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004008.def: This is a count of entries of an experimental subject into any arm of an elevated plus maze, including entries into both open and enclosed arms.
synonyms: total number of entries into an arm of an EPM
total number of entries into any arm of an elevated plus maze

CMO:0004009.name: number of entries into an enclosed arm of an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004009.def: The count of movements from the center of the elevated plus maze into either of the two arms of the maze that are enclosed by walls sufficiently high to prevent the escape of an experimental subject. The walls of the enclosed arms may be opaque to prevent the experimental subject from seeing anything outside the maze.
synonyms: number of entries into a closed arm of an elevated plus maze
number of entries into an enclosed arm of an EPM

CMO:0004010.name: number of entries into an open arm of an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004010.def: The count of movements of an experimental subject into either of the two arms of an elevated plus maze that do not have walls to prevent the experimental subject from escaping or from seeing anything outside the maze.
synonyms: number of entries into an open arm of an EPM
number of entries into any open arm of an elevated plus maze

CMO:0004011.name: amount of experiment time spent in a discrete space in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004011.def: The total amount of time during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject spends in a distinct and specified area of an elevated plus maze (EPM). An EPM is an apparatus with an open center area, two open arms without enclosing walls and two enclosed arms with walls to prevent the experimental subject from escaping or from seeing anything outside the maze. The apparatus is raised a specified distance above the floor and is used to measure movement, behavior, learning, memory, etc., generally in rodents.
synonyms: amount of experiment time spent in a discrete space in an EPM

CMO:0004012.name: total amount of experiment time spent in an enclosed arm of an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004012.def: The cumulative amount of time during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject spends in either of the two arms of an elevated plus maze that are enclosed by opaque walls to prevent the experimental subject from escaping and from seeing anything outside the maze.
synonyms: amount of experiment time spent in an enclosed arm of an EPM

CMO:0004013.name: total amount of experiment time spent in any open area of an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004013.def: The cumulative amount of time during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject spends in any of the unenclosed areas of an elevated plus maze including the open center of the maze and/or the open arms of the maze.
synonyms: amount of experiment time spent in an open area of an EPM
time spent in the open arms and center of an elevated plus maze
total time spent in theopen areas of an elevated plus maze apparatus

CMO:0004014.name: total amount of experiment time spent in the open arms of an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004014.def: The cumulative amount of time during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject spends specifically in either of the two arms of the maze that do not have walls to prevent the experimental subject from seeing anything outside the maze.
synonyms: amount of experiment time spent in the open arms of an EPM
time spent in the open arms of an elevated plus maze apparatus

CMO:0004015.name: number of 20 x 20 cm floor squares crossed into, out of, or within a discrete space in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004015.def: This is a measurement of the distance traveled in an open field apparatus, measured as a count of the squares of a 20 cm square grid marked on the floor of the apparatus, crossed by an experimental subject during an experiment. An open field apparatus is a circular or square arena with enclosing walls of sufficient height to prevent the escape of the experimental subject.

CMO:0004016.name: number of 20 x 20 cm floor squares crossed on the periphery of an open field apparatus
CMO:0004016.def: This is a measurement of the horizontal movement within the periphery of an open field apparatus, measured as a count of the 20 x 20 cm floor squares adjacent to the enclosing wall crossed by an experimental subject during an experiment.

CMO:0004017.name: number of 20 x 20 cm floor squares crossed in the center of an open field apparatus
CMO:0004017.def: This is a measurement of the horizontal movement within the center of an open field apparatus, measured as a count of the 20 x 20 cm floor squares not adjacent to the enclosing wall crossed by an experimental subject during an experiment.

CMO:0004018.name: defecation rate by count
CMO:0004018.def: Measurement of the number of boli of fecal matter excreted within a specified period of time determined by counting the number of individual pellets deposited by the experimental subject.
synonyms: total number of fecal boli deposited during a period of time
total number of fecal boluses deposited during a period of time

CMO:0004019.name: number of lines crossed in the center of an open field apparatus
CMO:0004019.def: A measurement of the distance traveled within the region in the center of an open field apparatus, measured as a count of the grid lines, marked on the floor of the apparatus, crossed by an experimental subject during an experiment.

CMO:0004020.name: measurement of voluntary locomotion in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004020.def: Any measurement of the movement of an organism from one place to another in an open field apparatus when that movement originated and/or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice. An open field apparatus is an arena, often but not always circular and brightly lit, enclosed in walls of sufficient height to prevent the escape of the experimental subject.

CMO:0004021.name: measurement of voluntary locomotion in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004021.def: Any measurement of the movement of an organism from one place to another in an elevated plus maze apparatus when that movement originated and/or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice. An elevated plus maze (EPM) is an apparatus with an open center area, two open arms without enclosing walls and two enclosed arms with walls to prevent the experimental subject from escaping or from seeing anything outside the maze. The apparatus is raised a specified distance above the floor and is used to measure movement, behavior, learning, memory, etc., generally in rodents.
synonyms: measurement of voluntary locomotion in an EPM

CMO:0004022.name: number of entries into a discrete space in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004022.def: A count of the number of times during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject moves into a distinct and specified area of an elevated plus maze (EPM). An EPM is an apparatus with an open center area, two open arms and two enclosed arms raised a specified distance above the floor. It is used to measure movement, behavior, learning, and memory, generally in rodents.
synonyms: number of entries into a discrete space in an EPM

CMO:0004023.name: ratio of count of open arm entries to total count of arm entries in an elevated plus maze apparatus
CMO:0004023.def: The number of movements of an experimental subject into either of the two arms of an elevated plus maze that do not have walls to prevent the experimental subject from escaping or from seeing anything outside the maze divided by the total number of counts of the experimental subject entering any arm of the maze. Ratio may be expressed as a fraction, quotient, or percentage.
synonyms: number of entries into an open arm of an elevated plus maze as percent of total arm entries
number of entries into an open arm of an elevated plus maze to count of total arm entries ratio
ratio of count of entries into an open arm of an elevated plus maze to total count of arm entries
ratio of count of entries into an open arm to total count of arm entries in an elevated plus maze
ratio of count of open arm entries to total count of arm entries in an EPM
ratio of entries into open arms to total arm entries in an elevated plus maze
ratio of entries into open arms to total arm entries in an EPM

CMO:0004024.name: medial collateral ligament ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004024.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the medial collateral ligament, the tendon on the inner side of the knee joint that connects the femur and the tibia, thus helping to stabilize the joint.

CMO:0004025.name: lateral collateral ligament ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004025.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the lateral collateral ligament, the tendon on the outer side of the knee joint that connects the femur and the fibula, thus helping to stabilize the joint.

CMO:0004026.name: number of fecal boluses
CMO:0004026.def: A count of the instances of defecation indicated by the number of pieces of fecal matter collected.

CMO:0004027.name: gonadal adipose ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004027.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the encapsulated adipose tissue surrounding the epididymis/testicle or ovary.
synonyms: epididymal fat pad ribonucleic acid level
ovarian fat pad ribonucleic acid level
periovarian fat pad ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004028.name: common carotid artery ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004028.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in either of the bilaterally paired branched arteries that originate from the aortic arch and divide into and include as parts the internal and external carotid arteries.
synonyms: external carotid artery ribonucleic acid level
internal carotid artery ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004029.name: carotid body ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004029.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the carotid body, a small epithelioid structure consisting of a small cluster of chemoreceptive and supporting cells located near the bifurcation of the common carotid artery that serves as a chemoreceptive organ that senses the pH, carbon dioxide, and oxygen concentrations in the blood and plays a crucial role in their homeostatic control.

CMO:0004030.name: superior cervical ganglion ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004030.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the superior cervical ganglion is formed or composed. The superior cervical ganglion is the largest sympathetic trunk ganglion, normally located at the base of the skull and innervating the head and neck.
synonyms: superior sympathetic cervical ganglion RNA level

CMO:0004031.name: vein morphological measurement
CMO:0004031.def: This is any quantification of the physical form or structure of a vein, any of the tubular branching vessels that carry blood from the capillaries toward the heart.

CMO:0004032.name: pulmonary vein morphological measurement
CMO:0004032.def: This is any quantification of the physical form or structure of a pulmonary vein, a blood vessel that transport bloods from the lungs to the heart

CMO:0004033.name: right pulmonary vein molecular composition measurement
CMO:0004033.def: This is any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of the right pulmonary vein, the vein that drains the right lung and returns blood to the heart..

CMO:0004034.name: right pulmonary vein ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004034.def: Any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the right pulmonary vein is formed or composed.

CMO:0004035.name: lymphatic vessel ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004035.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in lymphatic vessels, vessels that contain or convey lymph, that originate as an interfibrillar or intercellular cleft or space in a tissue or organ.

CMO:0004036.name: gastric cardia lymphatic vessel ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004036.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in lymphatic vessels of the gastric cardia, the portion of the stomach closest to the esophagus. .
synonyms: cardia lymphatic vessel ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004037.name: intervertebral disk ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004037.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in intervertebral disk , a pad of fibrocartilage between the articular surfaces of two successive vertebral centra which has nucleus pulposus at its core.

CMO:0004038.name: nucleus pulposus ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004038.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in nucleus pulposus, the jelly-like substance in the middle of the vertebral disk which is a remnant of the notochord.
synonyms: RNA level in nucleus pulposus of intervertebral disk

CMO:0004039.name: CA1 field of hippocampus ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004039.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the CA1 field of the hippocampus is formed or composed.
synonyms: CA1 field of hippocampus RNA level

CMO:0004040.name: larynx morphological measurement
CMO:0004040.def: This is a measurement related to the shape, structure, color, or pattern of the modified upper part of the trachea of air-breathing vertebrates that in humans, most other mammals, and some amphibians and reptiles contains the vocal cords.

CMO:0004041.name: larynx molecular composition measurement
CMO:0004041.def: This is any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of the larynx, the modified upper part of the trachea of air-breathing vertebrates that in humans, most other mammals, and some amphibians and reptiles contains the vocal cords.

CMO:0004042.name: larynx ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004042.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of the larynx.

CMO:0004043.name: thyroarytenoid muscle ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004043.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of the thyroarytenoid muscle, a broad, thin, muscle which lies parallel with and lateral to the vocal fold, and supports the wall of the ventricle and its appendix. The thyroarytenoid muscle functions in fine tonal control of the vocal cords..

CMO:0004044.name: central gray substance of midbrain ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004044.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the central gray substance of the midbrain is formed or composed.
synonyms: central gray substance of midbrain RNA level

CMO:0004045.name: tibia molecular composition measurement
CMO:0004045.def: This is any any quantification of the amounts or proportions of proteins, lipids, minerals, nutrients, gases, or other substances in a specified sample of tibia.

CMO:0004046.name: tibia ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004046.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tibia is formed or composed.

CMO:0004047.name: skull morphological measurement
CMO:0004047.def: This is a measurement of the structure or forms of the bony components of the head, consisting entirely of cranium and mandible.

CMO:0004048.name: cranium ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004048.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the cranium, the upper portion of the skull, excluding the mandible.

CMO:0004049.name: skull molecular composition measurement
CMO:0004049.def: This is a quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of the bony components of the head, consisting entirely of cranium and mandible.

CMO:0004050.name: mammary gland molecular composition measurement
