CMO:0004050.def: This is any quantitation of the molecules, atoms and/or ions which constitute the chemical make-up of the mammary gland, the specialized accessory gland of the skin of mammals that secretes milk.

CMO:0004051.name: triceps brachii ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004051.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the triceps brachii, the three headed muscle responsible for extension of the elbow joint.
synonyms: triceps brachii muscle ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004052.name: number of entries into opposite side of a two-way shuttle box during intertrial time
CMO:0004052.def: This is a measurement of the total number of times during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject enters into the opposite side of a two-way shuttle box during the time intervals between successive trials.

CMO:0004053.name: time to first movement outside a discrete space in a two-way shuttle box after start of conditioned stimulus
CMO:0004053.def: This is a measurement of the time it takes to move away from a conditioned stimulus or conditioned/unconditioned stimulus combination after the stimulus is initiated.
synonyms: response latency in a two-way shuttle box after start of conditioned stimulus

CMO:0004054.name: amount of time spent in voluntary immobility after start of conditioned stimulus in a two-way shuttle box
CMO:0004054.def: This is a measurement of the total amount of experiment time that an organism or experimental subject spends frozen, that is, not moving from one place or position to another after a conditioned stimulus has been initiated.

CMO:0004055.name: amount of time spent in voluntary immobility after start of conditioned stimulus in a two-way shuttle box
CMO:0004055.def: This is a measurement of the total amount of experiment time that an organism or experimental subject spends frozen, that is, not moving from one place or position to another after the conditioned stimulus is initiated.
synonyms: amount of time spent in voluntary immobility after start of conditioned stimulus in a two-way shuttle box
amount of time spent stationary after start of conditioned stimulus in a two-way shuttle box

CMO:0004056.name: number of entries into opposite side of a two-way shuttle box during conditioned stimulus
CMO:0004056.def: This is a measurement of the total number of times during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject enters into the opposite side of a two-way shuttle box during the conditioned stimulus.
synonyms: number of avoidances in a two-way shuttle box

CMO:0004057.name: number of stretched attend postures in elevated zero maze
CMO:0004057.def: This is a measurement of the number of times an experimental subject or organism displays a stretched-attend posture movement during an experimental time period in the elevated zero maze. The stretched-attend posture is one during which the hind legs remain stationary while the body is stretched forward with head raised.
synonyms: number of stretch-attend postures in elevated zero maze
number of stretched attend posture movements during experiment time in elevated zero maze

CMO:0004058.name: number of fecal boluses during experiment time in elevated zero maze
CMO:0004058.def: This is a measurement of the number of boluses of fecal matter excreted within a specified period of time determined by counting the number of individual pellets deposited by the experimental subject in the elevated zero maze.
synonyms: number of defecation boluses during experiment time in elevated zero maze
number of fecal boluses during trial time in elevated zero maze

CMO:0004059.name: time to first movement into an open section in elevated zero maze
CMO:0004059.def: This is a measurement of the latency period spent by an organism or experimental subject in the initial closed section before moving to an open section of an elevated zero maze.
synonyms: latency before first movement into an open section in elevated zero maze
time to first movement outside of initail closed section of elevated zero maze

CMO:0004060.name: total amount of experiment time spent in open sections of an elevated zero maze
CMO:0004060.def: This is a measurement of the cumulative amount of time during an experiment that an organism or experimental subject spends in any of the unenclosed areas of an elevated zero maze.
synonyms: time spent in open sections of an elevated zero maze

CMO:0004061.name: total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion during habituated time in a novel cage
CMO:0004061.def: This is a measurement of the voluntary movement of an organism or experimental subject along a plane parallel to the horizon in a novel cage at the end of the experiment, during the habituated time in the apparatus.
synonyms: horizontal distance moved during habituated time in novel cage

CMO:0004062.name: total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion during initial exposure in a novel cage
CMO:0004062.def: This is a measurement of the voluntary movement of an organism or experimental subject along a plane parallel to the horizon in a novel cage during the initial exposure to the apparatus.
synonyms: horizontal distance moved during initial time in novel cage

CMO:0004063.name: total number of entries into an open section of an elevated zero maze during experiment
CMO:0004063.def: This is a measurement of the number of times an experimental subject entered into an open section of an elevated zero maze. An elevated zero maze is an elevated ring-shaped runway. Open sections of an elevated zero maze have no walls.
synonyms: number of entries into any open section of an elevated zero maze during experiment
number of entries into any open section of an elevated zero maze during trial

CMO:0004064.name: number of fecal boluses during experiment time in open field apparatus
CMO:0004064.def: This is a measurement of the number of boluses of fecal matter excreted within a specified period of time determined by counting the number of individual pellets deposited by the experimental subject in the experimental open field apparatus.
synonyms: number of defecation boluses during experiment time in open field apparatus
number of fecal boluses during trial time in open field apparatus

CMO:0004065.name: total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004065.def: This is a measurement of the horizontal movement of an organism from one place to another in an elevated plus maze apparatus when that movement originated and/or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice. An elevated plus maze (EPM) is an apparatus with an open center area, two open arms without enclosing walls and two enclosed arms with walls to prevent the experimental subject from escaping or from seeing anything outside the maze. The apparatus is raised a specified distance above the floor and is used to measure movement, behavior, learning, memory, etc., generally in rodents.
synonyms: total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion in an elevated plus maze apparatus
total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion in an EPM
total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion in an EPM apparatus

CMO:0004066.name: total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004066.def: This is a measurement of the horizontal movement of an organism from one place to another in an open field apparatus when that movement originated and/or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice. An open field (OF) apparatus is a circular or square apparatus with enclosing walls to prevent the experimental subject from escaping or from seeing anything outside the apparatus.
synonyms: total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion in an OF apparatus

CMO:0004067.name: ratio of time spent in center to total test time in open field apparatus
CMO:0004067.def: This is the amount of time an experimental subject spends in the center of an open field apparatus divided by the total amount of time spent by the experimental subject in the open field appartatus. This measurement may be presented as a fraction, quotient or percentage.
synonyms: percentage of experiment time spent in center of OF apparatus
ratio of time spent in center to total test time in OF apparatus

CMO:0004068.name: ratio of 13 cm2 floor sectors crossed into or out of, to total 13 cm2 floor sectors within an open field apparatus
CMO:0004068.def: This is a count of 13 cm2 floor sectors crossed into or out of by an experimental subject, divided by the total number of 13 cm2 floor sectors in an open field apparatus. This measurement may be presented as a fraction, quotient or percentage.

CMO:0004069.name: striatum ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004069.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the striatum is formed or composed. The striatum is a region of the forebrain that consists of the caudate nucleus, putamen and fundus striati.

CMO:0004070.name: amount of time spent exploring a novel object in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004070.def: This is a measure of the total amount of experiment time that a subject spends exploring a novel object in an open field apparatus.
synonyms: amount of time spent exploring a novel object in an OF apparatus
duration of novel object exploration in an OF apparatus
duration of novel object exploration in an open field apparatus

CMO:0004071.name: amount of time spent exploring a familiar object in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004071.def: This is a measure of the total amount of experiment time that a subject spends exploring a familiar object in an open field apparatus.
synonyms: amount of time spent exploring a familiar object in an OF apparatus
duration of familiar object exploration in an OF apparatus
duration of familiar object exploration in an open field apparatus

CMO:0004072.name: time to first grooming within an open field apparatus
CMO:0004072.def: This is a measurement of the latency period spent by an organism or experimental subject in an open field apparatus before starting any activity of self-cleaning or cleaning another subject.
synonyms: grooming latency within an OF apparatus
grooming latency within an open field apparatus
time to first grooming within an OF apparatus

CMO:0004073.name: number of periods of grooming in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004073.def: A value or quantity determined by count of distinct, separable periods of time during which an animal in an open field apparatus is cleaning itself or another animal.
synonyms: number of bouts of grooming in an OF apparatus
number of bouts of grooming in an open field apparatus
number of instances of grooming in an open field apparatus
number of periods of grooming in an OF apparatus

CMO:0004074.name: total accumulated grooming time in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004074.def: This is a measure of the total amount of time during an experiment in an open field apparatus that an animal spends cleaning itself or cleaning another animal.
synonyms: total accumulated grooming time during a trial in an OF apparatus
total accumulated grooming time during a trial in an open field apparatus
total accumulated grooming time in an OF apparatus

CMO:0004075.name: ratio of time spent in the open arms to total test time in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004075.def: This is a measure of the proportion of time spent in the open arms to total test time that an organism or experimental subject spends in an elevated plus maze. This ratio is presented as a fraction, quotient, or percentage.
synonyms: ratio of time spent in the open arms to total test time in an EPM

CMO:0004076.name: number of head dipping movements in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004076.def: This is a measure of the number of times that a quadrupedal subject moves its head purposefully in a downward motion during experiment time in an elevated plus maze.
synonyms: number of head dipping movements in an EPM

CMO:0004077.name: time to first head dip within an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004077.def: This is a measurement of the latency period spent by an subject in an elevated plus maze before starting any intentional downward motion of the head.
synonyms: head dip latency in an elevated plus maze
head dip latency in an EPM
head dipping latency in an elevated plus maze
time to first head dips within an elevated plus maze

CMO:0004078.name: swim speed in a Morris water maze apparatus
CMO:0004078.def: This is a measurement of the linear equivalent of the extent of forward progress attained via the movement of an individual during a specified period of time into, out of, or within a distinct and specified area of a Morris water maze apparatus when such movement originated and/or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice.
synonyms: distance moved per unit of time into, out of or within a discrete space in a Morris water maze apparatus apparatus

CMO:0004079.name: measurement of voluntary locomotion into, out of, or within a discrete space in a Morris water maze apparatus
CMO:0004079.def: This is any measurement of the movement of an organism from one place to another into, out of, or within a distinct and specified area of a Morris watyer maze apparatus (especially such a movement accomplished by the action of appendages such as flagella, limbs, or wings) originated, undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice.
synonyms: measurement of voluntary locomotion into, out of, or within a discrete space in a MWM apparatus

CMO:0004080.name: ratio of the distance swam in the target area of a Morris water maze hidden platform during a probe trial to the total distance swam during the probe trial
CMO:0004080.def: This is the ratio of the total horizontal distance of an experimental subject made in proximity to the target in a Morris water maze apparatus to the total horizontal distance made within the Morris water maze apparatus during a certain period of time. The measurement ratio is presented as a fraction, quotient, or percentage.
synonyms: ratio of the distance swam in the target area of a MWM hidden platform during a probe trial to the total distance swam during the probe trial

CMO:0004081.name: sperm ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004081.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in sperm, the cells that play an important role in the process of fertilization, where they fuse with a female gamete or egg cell (ovum) to form a zygote.

CMO:0004082.name: parathyroid gland ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004082.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the parathyroid gland, usually found as a pair, embedded in the connective tissue capsule on the posterior surface of the thyroid gland

CMO:0004083.name: cerebral artery ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004083.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in any of the bilaterally paired main cerebral arteries (anterior, middle, and posterior cerebral arteries) that are interconnected to form the circle of Willis, a crucial system for ensuring adequate blood flow to the brain.
synonyms: anterior cerebral artery ribonucleic acid level
middle cerebral artery ribonucleic acid level
posterior cerebral artery ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004084.name: number of rearing movements in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004084.def: This is a measurement of how many times a quadrupedal subject in an open field apparatus rises up on its back legs during a testing period.

CMO:0004085.name: amount of time spent making rearing movements in an open field apparatus
CMO:0004085.def: This is a measurement of the total amount of time that a quadrupedal subject spends in an open field apparatus rising up on its back legs during an experiment .

CMO:0004086.name: time to first rearing within an open field apparatus
CMO:0004086.def: This is a measurement of the latency period spent by an experimental, quadrupedal subject in an open field apparatus before rising up on its back legs.
synonyms: rearing latency in an open field apparatus

CMO:0004087.name: amount of time spent making stretched attend posture movements in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004087.def: This is a measurement of the total amount of time a subject or organism displays a stretched-attend posture movement during an experimental time period in an elevated zero maze. The stretched-attend posture is one during which the hind legs remain stationary while the body is stretched forward with head raised.
synonyms: amount of time spent making stretch attend posture movements in an elevated plus maze
amount of time spent making stretched attend posture movements during an experiment in an elevated plus maze
amount of time spent making stretched attend posture movements during experiment time in elevated plus maze
duration of stretched attend postures in an elevated plus maze
SAP duration in an elevated plus maze

CMO:0004088.name: time to first stretched attend posture movement in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004088.def: This is a measurement of the latency period spent by an experimental subject in an elevated plus maze before starting any stretched-attend posture movement.
synonyms: SAP latency in an elevated plus maze
stretch-attend posture movement latency in an elevated plus maze
stretched attend posture movement latency in an elevated plus maze
time to first stretched attend posture movement during an experiment in an elevated plus maze

CMO:0004089.name: mesenteric artery ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004089.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in one or more of the mesenteric arteries, which arise from the abdominal aorta and distribute to most of the intestines.

CMO:0004090.name: number of photobeam interrupting movements in an open field apparatus with 2.5 cm beam spacing
CMO:0004090.def: This is a measurement of both horizontal and vertical movements in an open field apparatus equipped with infrared beams/detectors and computerized data recording.
synonyms: number of photobeam interruptions in an open field apparatus with 2.5 cm beam spacin
number of recordable movements in an open field apparatus

CMO:0004091.name: voluntary body movement measurement
CMO:0004091.def: This is any measurement of mobility of all or part of the body which originated, or was undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of an organism's free will or choice.

CMO:0004092.name: corpus cavernosum penis ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004092.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the corpus cavernosum of the penis. The corpus cavernosum is one of the columns of erectile tissue forming the dorsum and sides of the penis.

CMO:0004093.name: arterial aneurysm ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004093.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in an aneurysmic lesion of an artery.
synonyms: arterial aneurysmic lesion ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004094.name: Circle of Willis ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004094.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the Circle of Willis, a junction of arteries in the base of the brain that supply blood to the brain. The Circle of Willis includes parts of the internal carotid arteries, parts of the cerebral arteries, the communicating arteries, and part of the basilar artery.
synonyms: arterial circle of Willis RNA level

CMO:0004095.name: average maximal distance run on treadmill
CMO:0004095.def: This is a measurement of the average distance achieved while running on a treadmill before exhaustion was reached over the course of multiple trials. This measurement may refer to one subject or a group.
synonyms: average distance run on treadmill uhtil exhaustion

CMO:0004096.name: number of rearing movements in a defensive burying apparatus
CMO:0004096.def: This is a measurement of how many times a quadrupedal subject in a defensive burying apparatus rises up on its back legs during a testing period.
synonyms: number of rearing movements in a defensive burying chamber

CMO:0004097.name: total accumulated grooming time in a defensive burying apparatus
CMO:0004097.def: This is a measure of the total amount of time during an experiment in a defensive burying apparatus that an animal spends cleaning itself or cleaning another animal.
synonyms: duration of grooming in a defensive burying apparatus
total accumulated grooming time during a trial in a defensive burying apparatus

CMO:0004098.name: number of lines crossed in the seven-section, 50 cm diameter center of a circular open field apparatus
CMO:0004098.def: This is a measurement of the distance traveled within the region in the center of a circular open field apparatus, measured as a count of the grid lines, marked on the floor of the apparatus, crossed by an experimental subject during an experiment. The diameter of the whole apparatus is 82 cm, which is divided into 19 sections.
synonyms: number of lines crossed in the 50 cm diameter center of a circular, 82 cm diameter open field apparatus

CMO:0004099.name: average horizontal distance between subject and target during voluntary locomotion in a Morris water maze apparatus
CMO:0004099.def: This is a calculation of the arithmetic mean of all measured horizontal distances between a test subject and a specific target such as a submerged platform as the subject searches for the target. Horizontal distance is the length of a line between two points within a single plane parallel to the ground.

CMO:0004100.name: total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary locomotion in pursuit of a target in a Morris water maze apparatus
CMO:0004100.def: This is a measurement of the linear equivalent of the extent of forward progress attained via the movement of an individual along a plane parallel to the plane of the horizon in pursuit of a target in a Morris water maze apparatus undertaken, controlled, or accomplished as a result of free will or choice.
synonyms: total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary aquatic locomotion in pursuit of a target in a Morris water maze apparatus
total horizontal distance resulting from voluntary swimming in pursuit of a target in a Morris water maze apparatus

CMO:0004101.name: gastric mucosa ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004101.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which gastric mucosa is formed or composed. Gastric mucosa is made up of three layers: an inner epithelium, a middle lamina propria, and an outer muscularis mucosae.
synonyms: mucosa of stomach ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004102.name: nucleus accumbens ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004102.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the nucleus accumbens, a region of the brain consisting of a collection of neurons located in the forebrain ventral to the caudate and putamen (caudoputamen in rodent) and continuous with these structures. Together with the neostriatum (caudate nucleus and putamen), the nucleus accumbens forms the striatum.

CMO:0004103.name: vertebra ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004103.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the ossified form of a vertebral element, a skeletal element that forms around the notochord and is part of the vertebral column.

CMO:0004104.name: lumbar vertebra ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004104.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the bony segments of the spinal column located anterior/superior to the sacral vertebrae and posterior/inferior to the thoracic vertebrae.

CMO:0004105.name: CA1 stratum radiatum ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004105.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the part of the stratum radiatum hippocampal layer lying in area CA1, superficial to the CA1 pyramidal cell layer and deep to the CA1 stratum lucidum-moleculare, continuous with the stratum radiatum of CA2 and bounded by the subiculum.

CMO:0004106.name: CA1 stratum oriens ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004106.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the part of the stratum oriens hippocampal layer lying in area CA1, superficial to the alveus of CA1 and deep to the pyramidal cell layer of CA1. It is continuous with the stratum oriens of CA2 and bounded by the subiculum.

CMO:0004107.name: time to locate a hidden target platform in a Morris water maze apparatus
CMO:0004107.def: This is a measurement of the amount of time spent by an experimental subject in a Morris water maze apparatus searching for and/or determining the position of a submerged, horizontal surface within the apparatus which cannot be seen during the search.
synonyms: latency to locate a Morris water maze apparatus

CMO:0004108.name: total number of arm changes during experiment time in an elevated plus maze
CMO:0004108.def: This is a measurement of the number of times that a subject moved from a closed arm to an open arm or the reverse during an experiment in an elevated plus maze.
synonyms: total number of arm changes during an experiment in an elevated plus maze

CMO:0004109.name: time to first movement into the dark chamber of a passive avoidance apparatus
CMO:0004109.def: This is a measurement of the time it takes for a subject in a passive avoidance apparatus to move away from the lighted (safe) chamber to the dark (aversive) chamber after training with a noxious stimulus in the dark chamber. The passive avoidance test is a behavioral assay aiming at measuring long-term memory and emotional learning in rodents. The latency time it takes before the subject visits the dark chamber serves as an index of emotional memory.
synonyms: latency in a passive avoidance apparatus
time to first movement from the lighted chamber to the dark chamber of a passive avoidance apparatus

CMO:0004110.name: parametrial fat pad weight
CMO:0004110.def: This is a measurement of the weight of the parametrial fat pad, the encapsulated adipose tissue associated with the extension of the subserous coat of the uterus laterally between the layers of the broad ligament.

CMO:0004111.name: detrusor ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004111.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) in the detrusor, the smooth muscle fibers forming the muscular wall of the urinary bladder, which are arranged in a longitudinal and a circular layer and, on contraction, serve to expel urine.
synonyms: detrusor muscle of bladder ribonucleic acid level
muscularis propria of the urinary bladder ribonucleic acid level
urinary bladder detrusor smooth muscle ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004112.name: mucosa of urinary bladder ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004112.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the mucosa of the urinary bladder, the mucous membrane lining the urinary bladder. The mucosa of the urinary bladder is comprised of the urothelium and underlying lamina propria.
synonyms: bladder mucous membrane ribonucleic acid level
mucosa of urinary bladder RNA level
mucous membrane of urinary bladder ribonucleic acid level
urinary bladder mucosa ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004113.name: primary motor cortex ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004113.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the primary motor cortex, the part of the cerebral cortex that receives projections from the motor thalamus and which projects to motor neurons in the brainstem and spinal cord. The primary motor cortex, or M1, is located on the precentral gyrus and on the anterior paracentral lobule on the medial surface of the brain.

CMO:0004114.name: articular cartilage of joint ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004114.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a thin layer of cartilage, usually hyaline cartilage, on the articular surface of bones in synovial joints.
synonyms: articular cartilage of joint RNA level

CMO:0004115.name: external carotid artery ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004115.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in either of the external carotid arteries.

CMO:0004116.name: tibialis anterior ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004116.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the muscle that originates in the upper two-thirds of the lateral surface of the tibia and inserts into the medial cuneiform and first metatarsal bones of the foot. Its acts to invert the foot. It is situated on the lateral side of the tibia; it is thick and fleshy above, tendinous below. This muscle overlaps the anterior tibial vessels and deep peroneal nerve in the upper part of the leg.

CMO:0004117.name: fourth lumbar dorsal root ganglion ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004117.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the fourth lumbar vertebra.
synonyms: fourth lumbar dorsal root ganglion RNA level
fourth lumbar spinal ganglion ribonucleic acid level
fourth lumbar spinal ganglion RNA level

CMO:0004118.name: fifth lumbar dorsal root ganglion ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004118.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the fifth lumbar vertebra.
synonyms: fifth lumbar dorsal root ganglion RNA level
fifth lumbar spinal ganglion ribonucleic acid level
fifth lumbar spinal ganglion RNA level
L5 dorsal root ganglion ribonucleic acid  level

CMO:0004119.name: sixth lumbar dorsal root ganglion ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004119.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the group of nerve cell bodies located on the dorsal spinal roots within the vertebral column at the level of the sixth lumbar vertebra.
synonyms: sixth lumbar dorsal root ganglion RNA level
sixth lumbar spinal ganglion ribonucleic acid level
sixth lumbar spinal ganglion RNA level

CMO:0004120.name: femoral nerve ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004120.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) of which the tissue of the femoral nerve is formed or composed.

CMO:0004121.name: stellate ganglion ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004121.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the mass of nerve cell bodies formed by the fusion of the inferior cervical and first thoracic ganglia.

CMO:0004122.name: pancreatic islet ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004122.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in one or more pancreatic islets, i.e. islets of Langerhans, the clusters of endocrine, hormone-producing cells that are scattered throughout the pancreas.
synonyms: islet of Langerhans ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004123.name: basilar artery ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004123.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a major artery that supplies the hindbrain and runs along the ventral keel of the hindbrain.

CMO:0004124.name: thoracic aorta ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004124.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the part of the aorta that extends from the origin at the heart to the diaphragm, and from which arises numerous branches that supply oxygenated blood to the chest cage and the organs within the chest.

CMO:0004125.name: foot pad ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004125.def: The proportion, quantity, or volume of ribonucleic acid in the thick, spongy layer of tissue located under the metacarpal and metatarsal joints of the autopod.

CMO:0004126.name: temporomandibular joint ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004126.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a synovial joint of the jaw that connects the mandible to the temporal bone.

CMO:0004127.name: white adipose tissue ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004127.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in white adipose tissue, connective tissue consisting of fat-storing cells and arranged in lobular groups or along minor blood vessels.

CMO:0004128.name: proximal tubule ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004128.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a nephron tubule that connects the glomerular capsule to the loop of Henle. It has a brush border epithelial morphology.
synonyms: kidney proximal tubule ribonucleic acid level
renal proximal tubule ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004129.name: inner ear ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004129.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the inner ear, the essential organ of hearing and equilibrium that is located in the temporal bone, is innervated by the auditory nerve, and includes the vestibule, the semicircular canals, and the cochlea.

CMO:0004130.name: vestibular epithelium ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004130.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the vestibular epithelium, the specialized sensory tissue in the inner ear vestibular labyrinth (utricle, saccule, and semicircular canals) containing hair cells that detect head movements and gravity, converting these mechanical signals into neural impulses to control balance, posture, and eye movements.
synonyms: vestibular sensory epithelium ribonucleic acid level

CMO:0004131.name: dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004131.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the dentate gyrus, a part of the hippocampal formation forming a 'V' or 'U' shaped structure with the opening bounded by hippocampal area CA3. It consists of 3 layers from superficial to deep: molecular, granule cell, and polymorphic or hilar layer.
synonyms: dentate gyrus of hippocampal formation RNA level

CMO:0004132.name: blood plasma ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004132.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in blood plasma, the liquid component of blood which has had blood cells and platelets removed from it.

CMO:0004133.name: prefrontal cortex ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004133.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the prefrontal cortex, the anterior part of the frontal lobes of the brain, lying in front of the motor and premotor areas. This brain region has been implicated in planning complex cognitive behaviors, personality expression, decision making, and moderating correct social behavior. The basic activity of this brain region is considered to be orchestration of thoughts and actions in accordance with internal goals.

CMO:0004134.name: soleus muscle ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004134.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a deep muscle of the triceps surae group, in the superficial posterior compartment of the leg.

CMO:0004135.name: psoas muscle ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004135.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in a powerful flexor of the thigh at the hip joint (psoas major) and a weak flexor of the trunk and lumbar spinal column (psoas minor).

CMO:0004136.name: retroperitoneal fat pad ribonucleic acid level
CMO:0004136.def: This is any measurement of the absolute or relative amount(s) of one or more of the ribonucleic acids (RNAs) found in the encapsulated adipose tissue located on the dorsal side of the peritoneum.

part_of.name: part_of
part_of.def: This is a measurement of the total amount of all proteins found in a specific volume of blood.
